chunks.t: Adding records in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: This feature allows you to quickly add and manage records in Recruit CRM using multiple options, including the Global Add menu, List view, or Chrome Extension. It also helps link companies while creating jobs, and makes adding location details easier with address suggestions and auto-fill. The method for adding candidates, companies, contacts & jobs is the same. You can use this when you want to manually add the records in RecruitCRM. When adding a job, you must associate it with a company using the Company Name field. Your ability to add or edit records may depend on your role and permissions set by your Recruit CRM admin.

chunks.t: Adding records in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The Chrome extension is an additional option and requires separate installation and setup. 1. Click on the Plus (Global Add) button at the top right of your Recruit CRM window to open the global add menu. 2. From the dropdown menu, select Company . Here we have taken the example of a company. Fill in the company form with all relevant details, then click Submit to add the new company record. 1. Click on the Companies tab on the left side of the screen to open the companies list view. 2. In the Companies list view, click on the Add Company button. 3. Fill in the details related to the company and, if applicable, its primary contact . Click Submit to save the new company record.

chunks.t: Adding records in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Another method for adding candidates, contacts, or companies is by using the Recruit CRM Chrome extension . Install and open the Chrome extension, then follow the prompts to capture and add records directly from your browser. For detailed instructions, refer to the dedicated help article linked within Recruit CRM. When adding a job , the Company Name field is mandatory because every job must be associated with a company. The company dropdown does not show options immediately. Start typing the name of the company you previously created; as you type, the dropdown will display possible matches or allow you to create a new company if it does not already exist.

chunks.t: Adding records in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: We have added a ' Postal Code ' field alongside the Full Address, Locality, City, State, and Country fields. You can also search using a Street Address, City, State, or Postal Code for auto-suggestions while adding the candidate, contact, company and job. When a Postal Code is entered, the system automatically fills in the City, State, and Country using geo-coding services and can edit any location field if needed Note: The address suggestion feature is available on external pages and on the Chrome Extension. Problem: The company you expect does not appear in the dropdown when adding a job Likely cause: The company has not been created yet or the name is being typed differently.

chunks.t: Adding records in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What to check: Check the spelling and try typing more characters of the company name. Resolution path: If no match appears, use the option offered in the dropdown to create a new company record, then associate it with the job. By using the global add menu, the List view, or the Chrome extension, you can quickly add records manually in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Email templates in Recruit CRM let you save reusable email messages that you can send to candidates or contacts. You frequently send the same emails to candidates or contacts and want to avoid retyping them. You want automated emails to go out when specific events occur in your hiring workflow. You need consistent messaging across your team for outreach, updates, or application responses. You want to personalize bulk or repeated emails with candidate or contact details using placeholders. Email templates are available on all Recruit CRM plans: Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: On the Business plan, you can set up to two email signatures if you have connected two email accounts to Recruit CRM. Having your signature ready before using templates is recommended. There are 3 types of Email Templates in Recruit CRM: These are triggered automatically when a specific event occurs, such as when a candidate’s hiring stage changes or when a candidate applies through your website. These are templates you create specifically for candidates. They appear in the template dropdown when sending emails to candidates and only include candidate-related placeholders.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: These are templates you create specifically for contacts. They appear in the template dropdown when sending emails to contacts and only include contact-related placeholders. The Job ID placeholder is available in Automated Candidate Workflow email templates and when sending emails to candidates within a specific job’s candidate pipeline . The placeholder automatically populates with the corresponding Job ID. Recruit CRM also lets you add custom placeholders inside templates to personalize messages while still using a standard structure. Click the green Create Email Template button. ​ Enter the Template Name so you can easily identify it later. ​ Enter the Email Subject for the template. ​

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: (Optional) Turn on the Share with Everyone toggle if you want all users in your account to see and use this template. ​ In the email body editor, write your message content. ​ Insert placeholders where you want Recruit CRM to automatically insert values like candidate first name, candidate last name, contact name, company name, or job name. ​ (Optional) Copy any placeholder and paste it into the Email Subject line if you want the subject to be personalized as well. ​

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If users in your account have a custom role OR a default role with Email Template permissions set to "View Everything" they will be able to see all existing templates , regardless of whether the creator chose to share it with everyone or not. ​ Even if a user doesn't enable the "Share with everyone" option, those with the "View Everything" permission in their role will still have access. If you don't wish to see other teammate's email templates, you can filter the templates in your mailbox based on your own templates or those created by other users, depending on your email template permissions. How to Filter Templates in Your Mailbox 👀 Go to the Email Templates section in your mailbox. ​

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Use the filter option to control which templates you see. ​ Templates created by other users (depending on your email template permissions). While editing or creating a template, locate the placeholder options provided by Recruit CRM. ​ Place the cursor in the body where you want the dynamic value to appear and insert the placeholder. How to Edit an Existing Email Template ✏️ Go to the Mailbox and open the Email Templates section. ​ Click the pencil icon next to that template to open it for editing. ​ Make your changes to the template name, subject, body, or placeholders. ​ Click the green Save button to save your changes. Go to the Email Templates section in your mailbox. ​

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Locate the template you want to delete. ​ Click the dustbin/trash can icon located next to the pencil icon on the same line as the template. ​ Before using your email templates, make sure your email signature is ready! ​ On the Business Plan, you can set up two email signatures if you have connected two email accounts with Recruit CRM. ​ You can read more about how to set up email signature in Recruit CRM from here: Setting Up and Customizing Your Email Signature Problem: Placeholders are not populating correctly in sent emails. Likely cause: The wrong type of template (candidate vs. contact) was used, or placeholders do not match the record type.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Confirm that candidate templates are used for candidate emails and contact templates are used for contact emails. Verify that the placeholders inserted are valid for that template type. Edit the template to use the correct placeholders or create a new template of the correct type and resend. Q1. What is the difference between candidate templates and contact templates? Candidate templates are used when emailing candidates and support candidate-specific placeholders. Contact templates are used when emailing contacts and support contact-specific placeholders.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Email Templates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Using email templates in Recruit CRM helps you send consistent, personalized messages to candidates and contacts while saving time and reducing manual effort. How to Edit Standard Default Email Templates in Recruit CRM Parsing resumes and creating candidate/contact records from your mailbox in Recruit CRM. Bulk emailing candidates/contacts (New UI)

chunks.t: Inviting Teammates
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows account owners, admins, and users with the appropriate permissions to invite new teammates to the account. During the invitation process, you can assign roles, add users to existing teams, and onboard multiple users at once using the bulk invite feature. Add new teammates to your Recruit CRM account. Assign roles to new users during onboarding. Invite multiple users at once using a CSV or XLS file. Only the account owners, admins, and users on custom roles with access can invite more users to the account. Click Invite Teammates in the top-right corner. Enter the user's email address and select the appropriate role.

chunks.t: Inviting Teammates
chunks.x: If required, select an existing team to add the user to. Adding a user to a team during the invitation process is optional. The invited user will receive an email containing a link to join your Recruit CRM account. If you need to invite multiple users at once, you can use the bulk invite option. Upload a CSV or XLS file containing the users' email addresses. Map the email column from the uploaded file. Complete the import to send invitations to all users in the file. This option helps streamline onboarding when adding multiple teammates to your account. A user's role determines the records, activities, and administrative features they can access within Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Inviting Teammates
chunks.x: Admins have broad access across the account. They can create and delete candidates, companies, contacts, and jobs, view the complete database, export up to 1,000 records from list pages to CSV, invite teammates, and access most areas of the Admin Panel. However, Admins do not have access to Roles & Permissions , Plans & Billing , Premium Job Boards , or API Integration Tokens . Team Members can create records such as candidates, companies, contacts, and jobs. They can also add and edit activities, including notes, call logs, tasks, and meetings.

chunks.t: Inviting Teammates
chunks.x: They cannot delete records or activities, export data, or access the Admin Panel. For Deals, Team Members can only view and edit deals that they own. Restricted Team Members can create records but can only view records they own or records where they have been assigned as an owner or collaborator. They can access activities related to those records but cannot view other users' data by default. Restricted Team Members cannot delete data or access the Admin Panel.

chunks.t: Inviting Teammates
chunks.x: Account Owners have the highest level of access in Recruit CRM. In addition to all Admin permissions, they can manage account ownership, change the account currency, purchase calling credits, access full data exports, and manage billing-related settings. Account Owners also have access to the Sent Email Conversation KPI within Team Performance Reports. Likely cause: You may not have permission to invite users. What to check: Verify whether you are an Account Owner, Admin, or have a custom role with user management permissions. Resolution: Contact your Account Owner to grant the necessary permissions. Problem: I receive the error "This email ID is already in use".

chunks.t: Inviting Teammates
chunks.x: Likely cause: The user has already signed up for a Recruit CRM trial account using the same email address. What to check: Confirm whether the user has an existing Recruit CRM account. Resolution: Ask the user to deactivate their trial account before sending the invitation again. Click here To learn How to deactivate Account . 1. Who can invite users to a Recruit CRM account? Only Account Owners, Admins, and users with the appropriate permissions can invite new users. 2. Is adding a user to a team mandatory during the invitation process? No. Adding a user to a team is optional and can be done later if needed. click here to learn How to create Teams inside RCRM?

chunks.t: Inviting Teammates
chunks.x: Yes. Recruit CRM allows you to bulk invite users by uploading a CSV or XLS file containing their email addresses. Recruit CRM makes it easy to onboard new teammates by allowing you to send individual or bulk invitations, assign roles, and add users to existing teams. Before inviting a user, ensure you have the necessary permissions and verify that the email address is not already associated with another Recruit CRM account. How to Share Candidates and Other Records With Teammates/Users in Recruit CRM Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM Deactivating an existing user & inviting a new user to your current plan

chunks.t: How to Add Notes and Customize Note Types in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The notes feature in Recruit CRM lets you write, pin, edit, delete, and categorize notes on candidate, company, job, and contact records. Notes can be tagged with a note type, associated with multiple records, and used to notify teammates via @mentions. You can use this feature when: You want to record important updates or interactions on a candidate, job, company, or contact record. You need to categorize notes using custom note types for better tracking and reporting. You want to @mention teammates so they receive an email notification linked to a specific record.

chunks.t: How to Add Notes and Customize Note Types in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Only users with access to the admin panel on the Business plan, or users with the Admin role on the Pro plan, can customize note types and set default note types. Notes added via the candidate pipeline will automatically associate with the corresponding jobs when using single or bulk note additions. Open the page for the relevant entity (Candidates, Companies, Jobs, or Contacts). ​ Open the details view of a specific record. On the right-hand side of the details view, click the first icon to add a note. ​

chunks.t: How to Add Notes and Customize Note Types in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Type your note content into the note field, then click the Add Note button to save it to that profile. You can also click on the Select Note Type dropdown to choose a specific custom note type for your note. ​ In the note field, type the @ symbol and select your teammate to mention them; this sends an email notification with a link to that record. To pin an important note to the top of the notes section, click the three dots on that note and select Pin Note . To edit or delete a note, click the options (three dots) on the note and choose the relevant action. While adding a note, click Create Associations to link the note to more than one record at a time.

chunks.t: How to Add Notes and Customize Note Types in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Automatic job association from the candidate pipeline: When you add notes via the candidate pipeline, they will automatically be associated with the corresponding jobs. This applies to both single and bulk note additions and works across all candidate pipelines by hiring stage, job, company, recruiter assigned, or owner. In the CRM Process Customization section, click Note Type Customization . ​ Click Add New Status and enter a name for your note type. ​ Ensure your note type name is within the allowed limit of up to 50 characters. ​ To make this the default note type, check the box next to it. ​

chunks.t: How to Add Notes and Customize Note Types in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can also customize the default Note types by editing the corresponding Note type name to the one most relevant to you. Click Save Status to save your new note type. ​ Remember that the number of available call types, meeting types, and note types is 30 in total. To access notes, open the details view of any record. ​ Go to the Notes and Calls tab on that record. ​ To broaden your view of the entire activity section, click the expand icon. From the expanded activity view, use the search options to find notes you have added, and apply filters to refine and manage your notes efficiently. Problem: A note you expect to see is not appearing in the list.

chunks.t: How to Add Notes and Customize Note Types in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: Filters or search criteria may be hiding it. What to check: In the Notes and Calls tab, review applied filters and search terms, and use the expand icon to view the full activity section. Resolution: Clear or adjust filters and search again; widen the view using the expand icon to ensure the note is not hidden. Q1: Do notes added via the candidate pipeline automatically link to jobs? Yes. Notes added via the candidate pipeline are automatically associated with the corresponding jobs, for both single and bulk note additions, across all candidate pipelines. Q2: Can I link a single note to multiple records?

chunks.t: How to Add Notes and Customize Note Types in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Yes. While adding a note or meeting, you can click Create Associations to associate the note with more than one record at a time. Go to the record’s details view, open the Notes and Calls tab, use the expand icon to see the full activity section, then use search and filters to locate specific notes. Using notes and custom note types in Recruit CRM helps you capture detailed activity, collaborate with your team, and keep records organized and easy to search. How to Create, Edit, and Manage Custom Fields in Recruit CRM How to view the candidate hiring pipelines for jobs in Recruit CRM? Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: Assigning candidates to jobs lets you assign people to specific open roles directly from the candidate list page, candidate profile page, job profile page, or while creating a new candidate. You can use this when: You want to assign one or more candidates to open jobs. You need to email primary job contacts at the same time as assigning candidates. You’re viewing a job profile and need to assign existing or new candidates. You’re parsing resumes or using the Chrome extension and want to assign candidates immediately. Ensure job records have primary contacts with valid email addresses if you plan to email them. Have your candidate resumes and attachments ready if you plan to share files.

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: 1. Assign a candidate from the candidate list page: From the candidate list page, select the candidate(s) you want to assign by clicking the checkbox beside each candidate’s name. At the top of the list, you will see new action options appear, including the option to assign the selected candidates to a job. ​ Use the assignment options to either create a new job or select one of the existing jobs in your database. During this process, you can also choose to immediately update the hiring stage of the candidate for the selected job. If the candidate is already assigned to that specific job, the system will alert you with a pop‑up so you do not create duplicate assignments.

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: The system will alert you with a pop-up if the candidate is already assigned to that specific job. Emailing the contacts of the selected jobs While assigning candidates to jobs from the candidate list, you can choose to directly email the primary contacts of the selected jobs. This allows you to assign candidates and share their details with job contacts in a single workflow.

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: In the job assignment window, click the Email Contacts button at the bottom. Then complete the assignment by clicking Assign or Assign and Update Stage , as required. If you have selected candidates who are already assigned to the job, the system will skip reassigning them, but they will still be included in the email that is sent to job contacts. A pop‑up will appear where you can select which candidate fields and files to share (for example, resume, summary, or other attachments). Once you have made your selections, click Generate Email . If any of the selected job contacts are missing an email address, a validation box will appear listing those records.

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: You can review the highlighted records in the validation box and then click Continue to proceed with the valid contacts only. After continuing, you will be redirected to the Compose Email screen. Here, the email will be pre‑filled with: Recipients (only primary contacts linked to the selected jobs) The candidate details and files you selected Review the email content and simply click Send to share the candidates with the selected job contacts. 2. Assign a candidate from the candidate profile To assign a candidate from the candidate profile/details page, scroll down to the candidate’s job section and click the Assigned Jobs tab.

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: There, you will be able to see all the jobs the candidate is currently assigned to and assign them to a new job by clicking on Assign to Jobs . Jobs that the candidate is already assigned to will be pre-selected and will not be selectable again, and you will have the option to view unassigned jobs for easier selection. 3. Assign candidates from within a job profile From inside a job profile, use the Assign Candidates option to add existing candidates to that job. If a candidate does not yet exist in your database, you can parse their resume and assign them to the job as part of the same flow. The assignment can also be performed via the Chrome extension.

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: After saving a new candidate, click on the 'Assign to Job' option on the Chrome Extension, and you will have the option to assign the candidate to the job: If a candidate exists in your database, click on the 'Assign to Job' option as shown below, and you will have the option to assign the candidate to the required job: Click here to learn more about Chrome Extension You can also assign the candidate to a job using our Resume Parser Feature. Click on the 'Assign to Job' option as shown below: Click here to learn more about the Resume Parser How many candidates can be included in the email to the job contacts?

chunks.t: Assigning a candidate to a job
chunks.x: Only the first twenty candidates, sorted by last updated date, will be included in the email sent to job contacts, even if you assign more than twenty in the same action. Which contacts receive the email when I use Email Contacts? Only primary contacts linked to the selected jobs will receive the email. Other contacts on the job who are not marked as primary will not be included. Assigning candidates to jobs helps you keep pipelines accurate, share profiles with job contacts, and streamline your recruiting workflow from multiple entry points. Parsing resumes and creating candidate/contact records from your mailbox in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Sharing Jobs on Social Media in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Recruit CRM lets you share jobs on social media and other external platforms to source candidates from different channels. You can either: Use one-click posting buttons for LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X, or Xing. Copying the job application form link and paste it on any external platform of your choice or just emailing it to candidates. You want to quickly promote open jobs on LinkedIn, Facebook, Xing or Twitter/X using one-click posting. You need a shareable job application link for posting on other platforms or job boards. You want all applicants from social media and external channels to flow directly into Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Sharing Jobs on Social Media in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Make sure you have access to the Jobs list page in Recruit CRM. Ensure you are logged into the social media platform (LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X or Xing) in your browser where you want to post the job. Confirm that your Job Application Form is already customized in Admin settings so that candidates see the correct fields when they apply. To change the default social media share image and text, you need access to Admin settings and the Public Job Page settings. One-click posting on Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or Xing Go to your Jobs list page in Recruit CRM. ​ Click on the job that you want to share from the Jobs List Page. ​

chunks.t: Sharing Jobs on Social Media in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Now, on the specific Job Details page, locate the three social media icons (LinkedIn, Facebook,Twitter/X and Xing) displayed on that job. Click the icon for the social media platform where you want to post the job. A ready-made post will open on that platform. ​ Review the pre-filled content and type any additional text you would like to add to your job listing, and click the Post (or equivalent) button on the social media platform to publish the job. Share a job using the job application URL Open the job in Recruit CRM for which you want to generate a shareable application link. ​ Click the Copy Job Application URL button to copy the application form link associated with that job. ​

chunks.t: Sharing Jobs on Social Media in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Paste this link on any job board, social media platform, or website where you want to accept applications. ​ Optionally, paste the same link into an email if you want to invite specific candidates to apply. When candidates click this link, they will see the job application form you have customized in Admin settings and can submit their details directly. The candidate fills in the job application form you have configured in Admin settings. Once submitted, the candidate’s data is stored directly in the Recruit CRM database. These candidates appear under the Website Applicant area, specifically in the All Website Applicants tab, accessible from the Quick View section.

chunks.t: Sharing Jobs on Social Media in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Change the default social media share image and text Go to " Public Job Page Settings " in Admin Settings . ​ You can change the text inside the 2 boxes, that will appear on your post on Social Media. The format will be like - Apply To {Job Name} With {Company Name}, where {Job Name} & {Company Name} is dynamic and can’t be changed. The {Company Name} is the name of your company/agency, not the clients Upload or select the image you want to use as the default social media share image (this image will be applied to all social media postings). ​

chunks.t: Sharing Jobs on Social Media in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The image you upload in Recruit CRM will be used for all social media posts created from your jobs page, including when candidates themselves share a job from that page. ​ Q1: Whose company name appears in the social media post — ours or the client’s? The company name used in the social media post is your company or agency name, not the client’s name. Sharing jobs on social media with Recruit CRM is designed to be fast and flexible, whether you use one-click posting or the job application URL, while keeping all candidate data centralized in your account. Social Profile Links - Candidates/Companies/Contacts How to Set Up and Customize Your Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page

chunks.t: Receiving feedback from clients through the Online Candidate link
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Online Candidate List Link allows you to submit candidates to clients or hiring managers through a secure online page. Clients can review candidate profiles, update hiring stages, and leave feedback, which is automatically synced back to Recruit CRM. Share shortlisted candidates with clients. Allow clients to update permitted hiring stages. Receive notifications whenever clients leave feedback or update a hiring stage. Submit candidates and receive client feedback To share candidates using the Online Candidate Link: Open the required Job and enable visibility for the candidates you want the client to review.

chunks.t: Receiving feedback from clients through the Online Candidate link
chunks.x: You can also use Set Visibility for All Candidates to update visibility for all candidates at once. Candidate visibility can also be managed directly from each hiring stage by clicking the stage name. Click Submit Candidates , select Online Candidate List, and send the link to the assigned contact(s). The online link displays only the candidate fields you've chosen to share. You can configure the default shared fields in the Field shared with client. You can also customize the fields displayed on the Kanban cards for each job. Leaving feedback on an online candidate Link Once the client opens the link, they can choose between List View and Kanban View to review candidates.

chunks.t: Receiving feedback from clients through the Online Candidate link
chunks.x: Clients can then update the hiring stage and leave remarks or feedback for each candidate. Please note: The client will only be able to change the Hiring Stages you have given them access to by selecting the "Let Client Use" option on the Master Hiring Pipeline : Whenever a client updates a hiring stage or submits feedback, the Job Owner and the Collaborators receive a notification in Recruit CRM. You can also review the client's feedback at any time by clicking the Remarks icon in the Candidate Pipeline for the job. Problem: My client cannot view candidate details. Likely Cause: Candidate visibility hasn't been enabled, or the required fields aren't shared.

chunks.t: Receiving feedback from clients through the Online Candidate link
chunks.x: What to Check: Verify that candidate visibility is turned on and confirm that the necessary candidate fields are included in the shared view. Resolution: Enable candidate visibility and update the shared fields before resending the online candidate link. Problem: I'm not receiving notifications when clients leave feedback. Likely Cause: No feedback has been submitted, or you're not the job owner or added as a collaborator. What to Check: Confirm that the client submitted feedback and verify the job ownership. Resolution: The job owner and collaborators receive notifications automatically whenever a client updates a hiring stage or leaves feedback.

chunks.t: Receiving feedback from clients through the Online Candidate link
chunks.x: The Online Candidate Link makes it easy to collaborate with clients by allowing them to review candidates, leave feedback, and update permitted hiring stages in real time. This helps streamline communication, keeps everyone aligned throughout the hiring process, and ensures feedback is captured directly within Recruit CRM. Adding Feedback On The List Of Candidates Submitted To You Customizing Kanban cards for clients on the online candidate list

chunks.t: Scheduling Meetings
chunks.x: Scheduling a meeting and notifying attendees is easy with Recruit CRM :) You can create a meeting from three different places inside the app! On this page, you can also opt to see your meetings on the 'Calendar View', on a 'Day', 'Week', and 'Month' basis: 3. From inside a candidate/contact/job/company profile: When adding a meeting inside a profile, the name of the record will be automatically added to the "Related To" section: ​ You can also add meetings for candidates from inside the candidate pipeline in a Job: ​ Make sure you have connected your calendar to Recruit CRM first!

chunks.t: Scheduling Meetings
chunks.x: 1. Click on the schedule meeting button , fill in all the required information on the meeting card, and click on the "Add" button to create the meeting. All the names added in the "Related To" section will also be automatically added to the "Attendees" section. If you don't wish to send calendar invites to the record and keep the meeting for internal tracking purposes only, you can simply delete the added names from the Attendees section: 2. If you don't wish to send calendar invites to the attendees, you can select the checkbox at the end of the page. ​ This option will prevent the system from sending calendar invitations and reminders to individuals listed in the Attendees section.

chunks.t: Scheduling Meetings
chunks.x: How to send a meeting confirmation email ✉️ Once you've connected your Google/Outlook calendar to Recruit CRM, clicking on the "Add" button will automatically send calendar invites to all attendees on their calendars (provided you have their email IDs). However, in certain situations, such as when the invitee has an Outlook calendar while you have a Gmail calendar, the invite may not appear automatically on their calendar. ​ In such cases, we also give you an optional prompt to send an email to attendees with the meeting card as shown below. The recipient can use the 'Add to Calendar' button provided in the email they receive.

chunks.t: Scheduling Meetings
chunks.x: They will have the option to add the meeting to Google, Outlook, or Office 365. If you don't see the 'Add to Office 365' option, please reset the Meeting Confirmation template on Standard Email Templates . You can choose whether you wish to send the email to the attendees. If you don't, simply close the email tab. If you have selected the Do not send calendar invites checkbox, the system will skip the display of the email meeting template. You can also add customized Meeting types to tag a meeting with a specific "Type" to make it easier for you and your team to identify/categorize them. Learn how to customize the meeting type in Recruit CRM Accessing the meetings that you've scheduled!

chunks.t: Scheduling Meetings
chunks.x: 1. Navigate to the "Meetings" tab, and easily access the meetings you've scheduled. For a closer look at each individual meeting you've added, simply click on the arrow positioned at the top-left corner. This will expand the meeting, providing a detailed view for easy reference and management. 2. To broaden your view of the entire Activity section, click on the expand icon located at the top right. From there, you can efficiently search for the meetings you've added. Additionally, you have the flexibility to apply filters, allowing you to refine your search and efficiently manage your meetings.

chunks.t: Scheduling Meetings

chunks.t: Creating Tasks
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Tasks help you organize and track activities related to your recruitment workflow. You can create tasks for Candidates, Contacts, Companies, Jobs, and Deals, assign them to yourself or teammates, and link them to multiple records. Create follow-up reminders for Candidates, Contacts, Companies, Jobs, or Deals. Assign tasks to yourself or team members. Collaborate with colleagues on specific tasks. Manage and track all your tasks from one place. Open the profile of a Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, or Deal, then click the Tasks (checklist) icon on the right-hand side.

chunks.t: Creating Tasks
chunks.x: Enter the task details. When creating a task from a record, the Related To field is automatically populated with that record. Add a Collaborator if you'd like another team member to access and collaborate on the task. To link the task to additional records, create Associations and select the relevant Candidates, Contacts, Companies, Jobs, or Deals. Click Add to save the task. It will appear under the Tasks section of the related record. You can also create tasks from other areas in Recruit CRM: Click the ➕ icon in the top-right corner to quickly create a new task. Navigate to the Tasks & Meetings page to create tasks, view all existing tasks, and sort or filter them by date and status.

chunks.t: Creating Tasks
chunks.x: You can also view all your tasks in the Task Queue . Refer to the Task Queue article to learn more. You can create tasks from the Tasks page or directly from the profile of a Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, or Deal using the floating action button. 1. Can I assign a task to another team member? Yes. You can add team members as Collaborators on a task. Tasks help you stay organized by keeping all your follow-ups and action items in one place. Whether you're creating tasks from a record, assigning collaborators, linking multiple records, or managing tasks from the Tasks & Meetings page, Recruit CRM makes it easy to keep your recruitment activities on track.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This article explains how to delete records in Recruit CRM, both individually and in bulk, along with the permissions required and how to manage bulk action options on list pages. The delete functionality allows Account Owners and Admins to permanently remove records that are no longer needed. You can delete a single record from its profile/details page or remove multiple records at once using bulk actions from the list page. You can also customize which bulk actions are available and how they appear, helping you manage records more efficiently.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: Deletion is permanent. Records that are deleted cannot be recovered. There is no undo option, so review your selection carefully before confirming. Only Account Owners and Admins can delete records by default. Users on the Team Member and Restricted Team Member role do not have permission to delete records. Deletion applies to Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, and Deal records. 1. Navigate to the profile of the Candidate, Contact, Company, Job or Deal you want to delete. 2. Click the ellipses icon (...) located at the top of the profile page. 3. Select Delete from the dropdown menu that appears.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: 4. A confirmation pop-up will appear. Enter the number of records you are deleting and click Delete to confirm. 1. Navigate to the list page for the record type you want to delete. You can go to the Candidates, Contacts, Companies, Jobs, or Deals list page. ​ 2. Select the records you want to delete by checking the checkbox on the left side of each row. To select all records on the page, use the checkbox beside the column header. You can use the ' Select 3000 records ' button to select 3000 records at a time. Learn to select more than 1000 records at a time. 3. Click the ellipses icon (...) and then click Delete .

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: 4. A confirmation pop-up will appear. Enter the number of records to be deleted and click Delete to confirm. The method for deleting records is the same for all the entities(candidates, contacts, jobs, companies and deals). 📌 Note: The confirmation step requires you to enter the exact number of records being deleted. This is intentional and helps prevent accidental bulk deletions. Problem: The Delete option is not visible on a record Likely cause: Your user role does not have permission to delete records. What to check: Confirm whether you are logged in as an Account Owner or Admin, or your custom role has the permissions to delete the record.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: Resolution path: Contact your Account Owner to request the necessary permissions or to perform the deletion on your behalf. ​ Problem: The number I enter in the confirmation box is not accepted Likely cause: The number you typed does not match the actual count of selected records. ​ What to check: Recount the selected records in the list or confirm you are deleting only one record from a profile page. ​ Resolution path: Enter the exact number of records shown as selected (for example, “1” for a single record, “4” for four selected records). Problem: Associated notes, tasks, meetings, or call logs disappeared from other entities after deleting a record.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: Likely cause: These items were originally added to the deleted primary record. What to check: Whether the missing activities were created on the record that was deleted. Resolution: Be aware that when a note, task, meeting, or call log added to a specific record is deleted, it is removed from all associated entities. This cannot be reversed. Problem: I deleted the wrong record and want to restore it. Likely cause: The deletion was confirmed in error. What to check: Verify whether the record is still visible anywhere in the system. Resolution: Records once deleted cannot be recovered. You will need to recreate the record manually.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: By default, only Account Owners and Admins can delete records. Users on the Team Member and Restricted Team Member role do not have permission to delete records. No. Deletion is permanent and irreversible. Once a record is deleted, it cannot be restored through the application. Always confirm your selection carefully before proceeding. You can delete Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, and Deal records, both individually and in bulk. What does the confirmation step in the delete pop-up require? Both the individual and bulk delete flows require you to type the number of records being deleted before the deletion is processed. This step is a safeguard to prevent accidental removal of records.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals)
chunks.x: Deleting records in Recruit CRM is a straightforward process, but it is permanent. Whether you are removing a single outdated profile or clearing a batch of records in bulk, following the steps in this article will help you do so safely. If you have questions or need assistance, use the chat icon at the bottom right of the screen to reach the support team. chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use this feature? The bulk import feature allows you to create or update multiple records at once, helping you standardize data and reduce manual effort. You can use this feature: When you’re migrating data from another ATS/ CRM tool or from a spreadsheet. When you need to add candidates/contacts/companies at once in bulk. When you’re cleaning and re-importing data with updated information. If you have a file in XLSX format, you'll first need to convert it into XLS. ​ Here's how you can do this Before you import a file, please make sure it has column headers .

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: If your spreadsheet has additional columns that are not available in Recruit CRM, you first need to create custom fields to map those columns into the system. Special characters like "<,>, & OR;" present in the file, crash the code for import. You need to remove these before importing the file. We do not have the option to import profile pictures into the CRM. The process to import candidates/companies/contacts is the same. Here, we have taken the example of the Candidates Entity. 1. In Recruit CRM, navigate to the ' Candidates ' entity. 2. Click the arrow icon next to the Add Candidate button and select the 'Import CSV/XLS' option.

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: 3. Click on the Upload File button and select your file that contains the data that needs to be imported. Note: Up to 10,000 records can be imported in a single upload. To download a sample CSV file before your import so you can format your data for easier matching, click here: 4. The next step is to map file columns to Recruit CRM fields. Mapping your Recruit CRM fields with the columns in your CSV/XLS file is crucial to make sure that the information in those columns is correctly saved in Recruit CRM. 1. After the file is uploaded, the mapping template window appears.

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: 2. On the left side, you will see the column headers from your CSV/XLS file. On the right side, you will be able to see the available Recruit CRM fields. 3. For each column, select the most accurate corresponding Recruit CRM field to ensure data is stored correctly. 5. To make this process easier for you, we've implemented a feature that covers this step by creating mapping templates. This means you won't have to map the fields manually every single time you upload a file by having your mapping track saved in a template. To save a mapping template, follow the next steps:

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: 1. Once all columns are mapped, you can save this configuration as a mapping template by clicking the 'Save Mapping' option. 2. Enter a name for the mapping template. If you want to share this mapping template with your teammates, turn on the sharing toggle and click the Save button to save the template. This stored template lets you apply the same field mappings to future files without redoing the mapping manually. If you select the option Include first header row of CSV or XLS file , you will not be able to save a mapping template. This setting indicates there are no column names available for mapping, so the template cannot identify which columns to associate with which fields.

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: After confirming all mappings, click Import Candidates to proceed. 6. You will now see options to merge duplicate records during the import. Recruit CRM lets you merge duplicates based on any one of the unique parameters for each entity. Those unique identifiers are: Candidates: Email ID, LinkedIn URL, or Contact Number Companies: Company Name, Website URL, or LinkedIn URL 1. When you click Merge Duplicates , the system prompts you to select one unique parameter to use for detecting duplicates. During import, duplicates will be merged based on the selected parameter.

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: 2. The 'Override Data' toggle provided below allows you to choose whether imported data should override existing records in the database. Enabling the override option ensures that duplicate records in the database are updated with the latest information from the imported spreadsheet. If information is not present in the spreadsheet, existing data will remain unaffected. When the toggle is set to 'OFF', merging duplicates won't override any existing data in Recruit CRM; instead, it will solely update the empty fields on the record with new information present in the CSV. After configuring these options, click Confirm Merge .

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: 7. After confirming merge settings, you will see two options: Add to Hotlist or Import Now . If you do not want to add the records to a Hotlist, select No, Import Now . If you choose the “ Add to Hotlist ” option, you will see all existing Hotlists in your account and will have the option to create a new one as well. 8. Click the Import button to begin importing all records. Depending on the size of your file, the import may take a few minutes. 9. When completed, look for an Import Successful notification to confirm success.

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: You have the flexibility to include both companies and their corresponding contacts within the same CSV/XLS sheet. This allows for the seamless import of both company details and the associated contacts working within those companies into your database in one go. When bulk importing companies, it's important to understand even if you opt for the 'Do Not Merge' option, the system automatically merges the companies from the backend based on unique parameters i.e. Name, Website URL, and LinkedIn URL. Opting for the 'Merge Duplicates' option enables you to merge the contacts being imported along with the companies, based on the unique parameters i.e. Email ID or LinkedIn URL .

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: Problem: Import fails or shows “Import Failed” / “Import Unsuccessful” message. Likely cause: File formatting issues or unsupported characters. Confirm the file is CSV or XLS (not XLSX) and is under 10,000 records. Look for special characters, merged cells, or formulas in the file. Ensure the first row is a header row, not data. Clean the file (remove special characters, merged cells, and formulas). Can I import more than 10,000 records at once? No. A single import supports up to 10,000 records. For larger datasets, split your file into multiple smaller files and run separate imports.

chunks.t: Bulk importing records
chunks.x: Bulk importing records from CSV or XLS into Recruit CRM lets you quickly populate and update your database while controlling field mapping and duplicate handling. By preparing your file carefully and following the steps in this guide, you can complete reliable imports that keep your data accurate and usable. If you need help at any stage, reach out to Recruit CRM support for further assistance. Bulk Importing Records into Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The Files section in Recruit CRM lets you store and organize documents related to any record in your database, such as candidates, jobs, companies, and contacts. You can upload files, create folders to keep them organized, and reuse saved files when filling file-type fields or composing emails. You can use this when: You want to store job descriptions, recommendations, or client briefs against specific records. You need to organize files into folders within a record’s Files section. You want to attach existing files from a record’s Files section to file-type fields.

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Files must be related to an existing record (candidate, contact, company, or job) and uploaded via that record’s details page. Individual file sizes cannot be more than 8 MB. On the business plan, you can create custom roles with restricted access to the Files section. You need access to the relevant record’s details page and Activity section to view and manage files. Open the details page of the record (candidate, job, company, or contact) where you want to store files. ​ In the Activity section, click on the Files tab. ​ Choose the file from your local system that you want to upload, or drag and drop the file into the Files section. ​

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Wait for the upload to complete; the file will then appear in the Files section for that record. How to Create Folders in the Files Tab? 📁 In the record’s Files section, click on the Create New Folder button. ​ In the pop-up menu, enter a name for your folder. ​ Upload or move files into the appropriate folders to keep your documents organized. How to Attach a file from the Files section to a file-type field? 🎯 You can attach files already stored in a record’s Files section directly to file-type fields, without re-uploading from your local system. This works for candidates, contacts, companies, and jobs. Go to the record and locate the file-type field you want to fill. ​

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Click on the pencil (edit) icon next to that file field. ​ Click on the arrow icon beside the file upload option. ​ Select the Select from Saved Files option. ​ The files in the record’s Files section will appear in a dropdown list. You can also click on a file name to open a preview before confirming your selection. ​ Select the file you want to attach from the list. Click on the tick mark icon to upload and save it to the file field. ​ You can upload files from the record’s Files section in the edit form and directly to the file fields on the record. Only files uploaded to the specific record you are editing will be visible in the dropdown list, which keeps the process clean and secure.

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can still choose Upload File to upload a new file directly from your local system if needed. How to Attach files to emails from the Saved Files section? 📧 You can attach files to emails directly from the Saved Files section, without uploading from your device again. In the email compose window, locate the attachment area. ​ Click on the arrow button beside the Upload from Device option. ​ A list of up to 15 recently used files will be displayed. ​ To find a file linked to a specific record, use the search bar to search for the record, then click on the Search button. ​ Click on a file name to preview it, if needed. ​

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Click on Add Files to select the desired files. If required, repeat the search to select files from multiple profiles; you can add files from more than one record to the same email. ​ Once all desired files are selected, click on Done . ​ The selected files will be added as attachments to your email. ​ Problem: You cannot upload a file to a record. Likely cause: The file size exceeds the allowed limit. What to check: Confirm the file size on your device. Resolution: Reduce the file size to 8 MB or less, then upload it again. Problem: You cannot find a file when attaching from Saved Files in an email.

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: The file is not among the fifteen recently used files or you have not searched by the correct record. What to check: Use the search bar to look up the specific record and click Search to load all files for that record. Resolution: Once the record’s files are visible, select the required file and click Add Files , then Done . Problem: A user cannot see or access the Files section. Likely cause: Their role may have restricted access to the Files section (on the business plan). What to check: Ask an administrator or account owner to review the user’s custom role and permissions. Resolution: Update the role to grant the necessary access to the Files section if appropriate.

chunks.t: How to Add Files, Create Folders, and Use Saved Files in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Can I attach files from multiple records to a single email? Yes. You can search files from multiple profiles and add them to your email before clicking Done . Using the Files section, folders, and Saved Files options in Recruit CRM helps you keep all candidate, client, and job documents organized and easy to reuse across records and emails. chunks.t: Column headers
chunks.x: This article explains what column headers are in Excel and other spreadsheet applications. In Excel and other spreadsheet applications, the column header is the row used to identify each column within the sheet or workbook. It provides the visible labels that let you distinguish one column from another and refer to them consistently. Before you import a CSV/XLS file in Recruit CRM to add candidate/contacts/companies/jobs, please make sure it has column headers. Bulk Importing Records into Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Changing Hiring Stage
chunks.x: It is essential to keep track of the candidates once they enter your recruitment pipeline. You can change the candidate's hiring stage in two ways: Option 1: From within the candidate's profile: In candidates , go to the candidate's profile page and click on the Assigned Jobs tab. This will have a list of jobs that the candidate has been assigned to: Click on the hiring stage of the candidate and you will get a drop-down menu of the stages you created like Shortlisted, Assigned, Rejected, and many more. You can customize your hiring stages from the Hiring Pipeline in admin settings.

chunks.t: Changing Hiring Stage
chunks.x: You should select the appropriate stage and it will be updated on Recruit CRM. You can also add a remark or create follow-up tasks while doing this! This will have a list of candidates assigned to the job:

chunks.t: Changing Hiring Stage
chunks.x: Click on the Hiring stage option and you will get a drop-down menu of the different stages like Shortlisted, Assigned, Rejected, and many more. chunks.t: Bulk Updating Records
chunks.x: This feature allows you to update multiple records at once directly from the list view. It helps streamline tasks such as data cleanup, standardization, and managing large lists, giving you a faster and more efficient way to maintain consistency across your database and handle bulk changes with ease. Open the relevant entity List Page that contains the records you want to bulk update. This can be a hotlist, a search results page, or candidates in the hiring stages of a job. Select the records you want to update individually or use the bulk select option to select multiple records (up to 3,000 at a time).

chunks.t: Bulk Updating Records
chunks.x: Once the records are selected, a bulk action bar will appear above the column headers with options like Update Fields , Export , and Add to Hotlist (these options are common across all record types). From this action bar, click Update Fields to proceed. A pop-up window will appear displaying all the fields that can be updated in bulk. Enter or choose the new value for that field. Click on the Submit button. The selected field will be updated instantly for all chosen records.

chunks.t: Bulk Updating Records

If you are a Team Member, please contact your Account Owner to get your role changed. 1. How many records can I bulk update at once? You can select and bulk update up to 3,000 records at a time from a list view. Bulk updating records in Recruit CRM allows you to quickly apply changes to multiple candidates, companies, contacts, or jobs at once. chunks.t: Resume parsing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Adding candidates one at a time is painful. The Resume Parser in Recruit CRM automatically creates candidate profiles from uploaded resumes, making the process both efficient and accurate. The Resume Parser is designed with a user-friendly interface, making it seamless to add and manage candidate profiles. You need to upload and parse multiple resumes at once. You want to quickly create accurate candidate profiles from resumes. If you upload the resume in the Files section, then it will not be parsed. Open Recruit CRM and go to the Candidate List page. ​

chunks.t: Resume parsing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: On the Candidate List page, locate the + Resume Parser button beside the AI Sourcing button, and click it. In the Resume Parser box, either drag and drop resumes into the upload box or select files from your computer. ​ Upload up to 100 resume files in a single batch, then wait for the system notification confirming all resumes have been parsed. Processing time may vary as larger batches can take a few minutes. Once parsing is complete, review the newly created candidate profiles from the Resume Parser page. ​ Use the available bulk actions to manage the newly added candidates. You can add notes, compose emails, add candidates to a Hotlist, and perform other available actions. ​

chunks.t: Resume parsing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Edit individual candidate profiles if you need to review, complete, or update any of the parsed information. ​ You can also bulk assign the parsed candidates to a job directly from the Resume Parser page. Please note: If you are updating a single candidate and want their resume to be parsed, upload the resume in the default Resume field on the candidate profile. Do not upload the resume in the general Files section , as resumes uploaded there will not be parsed. You might also want to check out How Resume Parsing Works in Recruit CRM. Problem: Resumes are uploaded, but no candidate profiles are created.

chunks.t: Resume parsing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: The resumes belong to candidates who already exist in your Recruit CRM database. Recruit CRM identifies existing candidate records by matching information such as their email address, phone number, or LinkedIn URL and updates the existing profile instead of creating a duplicate candidate record. What to check: Search your candidate database for the candidate and check whether their existing profile has been updated with the information from the uploaded resume. Resolution: No further action is required if the existing candidate profile has been updated successfully if you do not want to create duplicate candidates. Problem: Not all resumes in a large batch appear to be parsed.

chunks.t: Resume parsing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: The upload exceeds the limit of 100 files per batch, or parsing is still in progress. ​ What to check: Count how many files you attempted to upload and check whether you received the notification that parsing is complete. ​ Resolution: Ensure each upload batch includes no more than 100 files. If you uploaded a large number of files, wait a few minutes and watch for the completion notification before checking the candidate list again. Q1: How many resumes can I parse at one time? You can parse up to 100 files at a time in a single upload. Q2: How do I access the Resume Parser in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Resume parsing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Navigate to the Candidate List page and click the Resume Parser button beside the AI Sourcing button. Q3: Will files uploaded in the file section be parsed? No. If you upload the resume in the file section, it will not be parsed. Use the Resume Parser or the default resume field if you need parsing. Q4: How will I know when my resumes have finished parsing? You will receive a notification once all your resumes have been parsed. Parsing may take a few minutes if you have uploaded a large number of files.

chunks.t: Resume parsing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Using the Resume Parser in Recruit CRM, you can turn multiple CVs on your computer into structured candidate profiles in just a few clicks, then immediately manage them with bulk actions and job assignments. If you need more help using the Resume Parser or handling specific resume formats, reach out to Recruit CRM support for further guidance. Parsing resumes and creating candidate/contact records from your mailbox in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Deactivating Teammates & Reducing Paid Seats
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature allows you to deactivate users in Recruit CRM and, if required, reduce your paid license count so you are no longer charged for unused seats. Deactivating a user removes their access to the Recruit CRM database while preserving historical records, reporting data, team associations, and deal attribution. When deactivating a user, you can either: • Keep the license active, allowing you to invite a replacement user or reactivate the same user later. • Reduce the license count, which updates your subscription and stops future charges for that unused seat. • A team member leaves your organisation and no longer requires access to Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Deactivating Teammates & Reducing Paid Seats
chunks.x: • You want to deactivate a user and reduce your paid licenses to avoid being charged for an unused seat. Please note: Deactivating users does not imply reducing the number of purchased licenses. To avoid getting charged for deactivated users, you have to reduce the unused purchased licenses/seat s. Also Recruit CRM, just like any other SaaS product works on a prepaid subscription model. And, as per our company’s terms, all Recruit CRM subscriptions are non-refundable. ​ You can Refer to point 9.5 of Recruit CRM terms for the same. 1. Go to the user management section from your admin settings .

chunks.t: Deactivating Teammates & Reducing Paid Seats
chunks.x: 2. Click on the pencil icon to the right of the user you want to deactivate and click on "Deactivate". ​ 3. Now, the system will give you a pop-up with the following option: ​ If you check the option to "Deactivate user and reduce license", your subscription will be automatically updated, and the license will be reduced. If you don't tick the option, you'll be deactivating the user so they no longer have access to your database, but your subscription won't be updated, and their paid licence will be maintained. And you will still be charged for the unused purchased license till the time you reduce the license after deactivating the user. ​

chunks.t: Deactivating Teammates & Reducing Paid Seats
chunks.x: If you decide to keep the license, you can then invite a new user to the license or reactivate a deactivated user . Note: If you have any unused purchased licenses, a message will display the number of such licenses available in your account, at the top of the User Management page . From here, you'll have two options to choose from: ' Inviting new user (s)' to use the available seats' or alternatively; ' Reducing license count ' to match the number of active users. Now, let's see how you can reduce your paid licenses so you do not get charged for the license that your team is no longer using.

chunks.t: Deactivating Teammates & Reducing Paid Seats
chunks.x: 1. Head over to the Admin Settings and click on the Plans & Billings under the Account Management section. 2. Now, go to "View Current Plan" and click on "Edit Current Plan" 3. Then, decrease the "Total Users" count by the number you want to reduce. For example: If you have 10 licenses and wish to reduce 2, then decrease the "Total Users" count by 2. Thus, the "Total Users" count should be 8 . Here, you'll also be able to see the number of unused licenses you have so that you can reduce the correct number of seats for all the unused licenses and not get charged for them on your next renewal. 4. chunks.t: EEO Compliance
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The EEO Compliance setting in Recruit CRM helps you meet Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) requirements by controlling the visibility of sensitive candidate information. When EEO Compliance is enabled, the Gender and Age fields are hidden throughout the system when adding, viewing, or managing candidate records. When disabled, these fields remain available as normal. This feature is intended for Account Onwers and users responsible for managing compliance, privacy, and account-level settings. • You want Recruit CRM to support your organization's EEO compliance requirements.

chunks.t: EEO Compliance
chunks.x: • You need to hide candidate gender and age information from recruiters and hiring teams. • You are reviewing or updating privacy, compliance, or legal settings for your account. • The Gender and Age fields are hidden throughout the system. • Users cannot enter gender or age information while creating or editing a candidate. • Users cannot view gender or age information on existing candidate records. • The Gender and Age fields become available again. • Users can view, add, and edit this information as part of candidate records. This helps organizations align their recruiting processes with Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) requirements by limiting access to sensitive candidate information.

chunks.t: EEO Compliance
chunks.x: How to Change the EEO Compliance Settings Follow the steps below to enable or disable EEO Compliance in Recruit CRM: Navigate to Admin Settings from the left navigation menu and click Account to open your account settings. On the Account page, scroll down to the Legal Settings section and locate the EEO Compliance toggle. Turn the toggle ON to activate EEO Compliance or turn the toggle OFF to deactivate EEO Compliance. Your changes will take effect across the account and will determine whether gender and age information is visible within candidate records. Problem: Gender and age fields are not visible when adding a candidate. Likely cause: EEO compliance is activated.

chunks.t: EEO Compliance

Recruit CRM allows you to activate or deactivate EEO compliance, including at the time of account creation. What happens when I activate EEO compliance? When you activate EEO compliance, fields like gender and age become invisible. You cannot add gender or age when creating a candidate, and you cannot see these fields when viewing candidate details. Can I change my EEO compliance setting after creating my account?

When EEO compliance is activated, gender and age become invisible when viewing candidate details, regardless of whether they were previously added.

chunks.t: How to Set Up and Customize Your Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page allows candidates to view open positions and apply directly to the jobs visible on the Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page. You can customize the page to match your brand, embed jobs or application forms on your website, share it via a direct link, manage social media sharing settings, control which jobs are publicly visible, and create dedicated job page URLs for specific teams or companies. Use this feature to showcase open roles, streamline applications, and manage how jobs are displayed externally. Ensure you can access Admin Settings in Recruit CRM, as the Public Job Page Settings are configured there.

chunks.t: How to Set Up and Customize Your Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page
chunks.x: The open API used for advanced customizations is available on the Business plan and above. Only jobs that are not closed and have Enable Job Application Form checked will appear on the public jobs page. The image or logo you set in the Social Media Sharing tab applies to all social media posts that use your jobs page link. Have your branding assets ready, such as your logo, background image, and preferred color codes. If you plan to embed the jobs page or forms, ensure you or your web team can edit your website’s HTML. 2. In Admin Settings, select Public Job Page Settings . 3. In Public Job Page Settings, review the three tabs available:

chunks.t: How to Set Up and Customize Your Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page
chunks.x: In the Appearance Settings tab, locate the field for Job Page Title and enter the title you want displayed at the top of your jobs page. Enter a Job Page Subtitle to add a short descriptive line under the title. In Link to More Jobs , add a URL if you want to redirect users to a main jobs page or another relevant page. If you do not want this section to display, leave the field blank. Set the Placeholder Text for Search Box to define the text that appears inside the search box before users type anything. Upload a Background Image to visually brand the page. Upload your Logo so your brand appears clearly on the jobs page. Accepted file formats are: .jpg, .png, .jpeg

chunks.t: How to Set Up and Customize Your Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page
chunks.x: Adjust Text and Background Colors so the jobs page aligns with your company website theme. Fine-tune the list color and apply button color to ensure they are on-brand and accessible. If you need deeper or more complex customization beyond these settings, use the Recruit CRM open API , available on the Business plan and above , to build custom integrations and experiences. Here's our API Documentation for your reference: https://docs.recruitcrm.io Use this if you do not have a website or want a simple, shareable link. Copy the jobs page link and paste it on any platform where you want candidates to access your jobs.

chunks.t: How to Set Up and Customize Your Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page
chunks.x: When candidates apply via this link, their applications go directly into your Recruit CRM database. You can set the job pages link name to the name of your choice to control how the link text appears. Use the provided iframe code to embed the full jobs page into your website. Copy the iframe code from the Job Page Integration tab. Paste this iframe code into your website’s HTML where you want the jobs page to appear. Paste the modified iframe code into your website’s HTML at the location where you want that job’s form to appear. Customize the text that will be used when your jobs page is shared on social media platforms. Upload an image or logo that will be displayed for all social media posts that share your jobs page. Remember that the image or logo set here applies to all your social media posts that use this jobs page link. You can access your jobs page link in two main ways. On the Jobs list page, locate the link to the job page at the top right of the page.

chunks.t: How to Set Up and Customize Your Recruit CRM Public Jobs Page
chunks.x: Open Public Job Page Settings from Admin Settings. Within the Public Job Page Settings tab, locate and copy the jobs page link provided there. chunks.t: Setting Up and Customizing Your Email Signature
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Email Signature feature allows you to create and manage a signature that is automatically added to your outgoing emails. Your signature is applied across Recruit CRM email communications, including any email sequences, helping you maintain a professional and consistent brand presence. Maintain a consistent email signature across emails. Use different signatures for different connected email accounts. Click your profile picture in the top-right corner and open Email Settings . Use the editor to build your signature, adding any contact details, branding elements, or formatting you'd like to include.

chunks.t: Setting Up and Customizing Your Email Signature
chunks.x: If you already have a professionally designed HTML signature, switch to Code View and paste the HTML directly into the editor. Review the signature and save your changes. Once configured, your email signature is automatically added to outgoing emails sent from Recruit CRM, including emails sent through sequences. Set Up Different Signatures for Multiple Email Accounts On the Business Plan and above , you can set up two email signatures if you have connected two email accounts with Recruit CRM. Open the Email Signature settings and select the email account from the Set Email Signature for dropdown. Create or update the signature for that account.

chunks.t: Setting Up and Customizing Your Email Signature
chunks.x: Recruit CRM automatically applies the appropriate signature based on the email account selected when sending an email. How are multiple email signatures used across Recruit CRM? When you have multiple email accounts connected, Recruit CRM automatically applies the signature associated with the email address being used. However, the Default Email ID signature will be used in the following areas: While sending automated emails via talent pool and job application form settings. To change which signature is used for these automated communications, set a different email address as your default from Email Settings by enabling the Mark as Default option.

chunks.t: Setting Up and Customizing Your Email Signature
chunks.x: Problem: My email signature is not appearing in emails Likely Cause: The signature may not have been saved correctly. What to Check: Verify that a signature has been created and saved. Also, confirm that you are sending the email from the account associated with the signature. Resolution: Save the signature again if needed and ensure the correct sender email address is selected before sending the email. Problem: My HTML signature is not displaying correctly Likely Cause: The HTML code may contain unsupported formatting or syntax errors. What to Check: Review the HTML code added through Code View and send a test email to verify how the signature appears to recipients.

chunks.t: Setting Up and Customizing Your Email Signature
chunks.x: Resolution: Correct any issues in the HTML code, save the changes, and send another test email to confirm the formatting displays as expected. By setting up and managing your signatures correctly, you can ensure the right branding and contact information are automatically included in both manual and automated emails.
