chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Changing a user's role in Recruit CRM determines the level of access and actions available to them within the system. Roles control which records users can view and manage, including candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, and deals, as well as activities such as notes, call logs, tasks, and meetings. They also define access to features like data exports and account settings. Recruit CRM's default and custom roles help ensure that users have the appropriate permissions based on their responsibilities. Limit users to viewing and managing only their own records. Click on Admin Settings and navigate to Users under Account Management.

chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: Locate the team member whose role you want to update by searching for their name. Once located, click the Edit (pencil) icon to the extreme right. Click the Role dropdown and select the role you want to assign to the user. Review the changes and click Update to save them. A user's role determines the records, activities, and administrative features they can access within Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: An “Admin” can add records (candidates, companies, contacts, jobs), delete records (candidates, companies, contacts, jobs), view the complete database, export data from the list pages to CSV (up to 1000 records), and also have complete access to the admin panel (except Plans, Billing and API & integrations) and can invite teammates too. Admins share many permissions with account owners but have certain limitations. Admins do not have access to the roles and permission section, plans and billings, premium job boards, and API integration tokens.

chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: A "Team Member" can add records (candidates, companies, contacts, jobs), view the complete database, and add/edit activities like adding notes/call logs/tasks & meetings. They CANNOT delete records and activities, export data, and also won't have access to the admin panel. When it comes to Deals, they will only be able to view and edit deals they own.

chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: A "Restricted Team Member" can add records (candidates, companies, contacts, jobs), and can only view the data that they are adding to the system and not the other user's data unless they have been made "owner" or "collaborator" on the record(s), including activities (notes, call logs, etc). They cannot delete any data and WON'T have access to the admin panel. Account Owners have complete access and control over the account. Other than all the access admin shares, only account owners can purchase calling credits, change account ownership, change account currency, and access full data export. Account owners also have access to the "Sent Email Conversation" KPI in team performance reports.

chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: These permissions will also impact the user's ability to see, create, edit and delete Notes, Call Logs, Tasks and Meetings inside each entity. ​ E.g. If a user has permission to edit only candidates they own, they won't be able to edit the notes inside a candidate that belongs to someone else, even if the note was added by the user themselves. ❌ If a record from a specific entity (candidates, companies, etc.) doesn't have an owner, the user will not be able to edit or delete the Notes, Call Logs, Tasks or Meetings. Note: If you don’t see the pencil icon, try scrolling to the right to locate it.

chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: Alternatively, you can adjust the page zoom to a lower percentage, which should make the pencil icon visible as well. Different roles and permissions can be assigned to users on the Business Plan and Enterprise Plan by creating a custom role. ​ 👉 Click here to learn more about custom roles. Problem: The user still cannot access certain records after their role was changed. Likely cause: The newly assigned role may not have permission to access those records or activities. What to check: Review the permissions associated with the assigned role and verify record ownership. Resolution: Assign a role with the required permissions or update record ownership if necessary.

chunks.t: Changing A User's Role
chunks.x: Problem: I cannot see the pencil icon to edit a user. Likely cause: The action buttons may be hidden due to screen size or browser zoom settings. What to check: Check whether you can scroll horizontally in the Users list and verify your browser zoom level. Resolution: Scroll to the right to locate the pencil icon or reduce your browser zoom level until it becomes visible. Changing a user's role in Recruit CRM allows you to control the level of access and permissions available to each team member. By assigning the appropriate role, you can ensure users have the visibility and actions they need while maintaining data security across your account.

chunks.t: Getting Started with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Recruit CRM is an all-in-one recruitment platform designed to help small and growing recruitment businesses manage candidates, clients, jobs, deals, and day-to-day recruitment activities from a single place. Instead of investing in expensive software, lengthy implementations, and extensive training, Recruit CRM is built to be simple to set up and easy for teams to learn. This guide is ideal if you're setting up Recruit CRM for the first time or onboarding your team. It walks you through the initial setup process, points you to the essential resources available from your dashboard, and explains how to get help whenever you need it. You're setting up Recruit CRM for the first time.

chunks.t: Getting Started with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You're moving from spreadsheets or another recruitment system. You want your team to start using Recruit CRM quickly with minimal training. You're looking for the recommended setup sequence before exploring advanced features. ​ Setting up Recruit CRM is straightforward and can be completed in around 30 minutes by following the recommended onboarding flow. Sign in to your Recruit CRM account and open your Dashboard . The dashboard provides quick access to the onboarding resources needed to configure your account. 2. Complete the recommended setup activities

chunks.t: Getting Started with Recruit CRM

Following the recommended sequence helps ensure your Recruit CRM account is configured correctly, so your team can get up and running quickly from day one. Import Companies & Contacts (Your Clients) Customize Your Hiring Pipeline (Stages in your Recruitment Process) Customize Your Public Jobs Page (Takes Under 5 Mins) Customize Job Application Form (Information You Want Your Candidates To Fill) Connect Your Email Account: Gmail , Outlook or Office 365 , IMAP

chunks.t: Contact Stage (Sales Pipeline)
chunks.x: Contact Stage is a contact (client) property that indicates where a contact (client) is in your marketing/sales funnel. There are 2 ways in which you can change the Stage of a contact. ​ Option 1: To change the contact stage from the contact list page Select a bunch of contacts whose Stage you want to change and click on the "Update Field" button. Select the "Stage" option from the drop-down. Choose an appropriate Sales/Contact Stage from the list. After selecting the desired stage, you will have the option to enter a reason for the change. Once you have provided your reason, simply click on 'Submit' to finalize the update.

chunks.t: Contact Stage (Sales Pipeline)
chunks.x: You can also update the contact stage directly from the main contact page by using the 'Stage' column of any contact. Click on the contact stage that is towards the right of the contact name. Clicking on the contact stage will open a drop-down list where you can select the desired stage and provide a reason for the change. You can easily view the history of changes made to the contact stages, allowing you to visualize every stage the contact has gone through and the reasons for each change. To view the history of stages, click on the 'Remarks' icon next to the contact stage in the contact's profile.

chunks.t: Contact Stage (Sales Pipeline)
chunks.x: You'll see all the stages the contact has gone through, along with the remarks (reasons) for each change, the date each stage was updated, and the user who made the update. This will help you monitor your sales pipeline. Customizing And Using Your Contact Stages (New UI)

chunks.t: How to run a search in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can use Boolean operators to search through all profiles in your database based on specific keywords in their Resume/CV or data fields (including custom fields) in their profile. 1. Click on the Advanced Search button on the top right of your screen. ​2. You can use the Boolean Search to search for specific keywords in the record's profile and uploaded CV (only the file uploaded in the default "Resume" field). In the Boolean Search, you can combine AND , OR , and NOT operators to narrow down your search results. You can also use the "Contains Search" option to find any records that have that word mentioned, not just the exact phrase.

chunks.t: How to run a search in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: E.g If you run a search for "sales" using the Contains Search, you'll get results like "business sales", "international sales", "sales management", etc. ​3. Click on " Apply Filters" to see the results. ​ Alternatively, you can also save your search by selecting the "Apply Filters & Save Search" option, which will allow you to create a folder under the "Saved Searches" tab. ​ Similarly, if you are done, you can click on the red button to reset your current boolean search. You can run a search both in the default fields from Recruit CRM and in the custom fields you've created for your account. Only fields you make visible on your list page appear in the Filter Search area of Advanced Search.

chunks.t: How to run a search in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once the visibility is on, you’ll be able to search specific default and custom fields, including email, phone number, city, state, country, skills, title, LinkedIn URL, and more of the records (candidates, contacts, companies) You can combine multiple filters to get better results and use different filter types for accuracy . Learn how to run a radius search inside the system Specifically for candidates, you can also run a cross-entity search based on Company and Contact fields. Apart from our powerful Boolean & Filter Search, Recruit CRM gives you the ability to Search in Notes. This feature lets you search for a sentence or word through all the notes in candidates' or contacts' profiles.

chunks.t: How to run a search in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Here’s how you can search for keywords/strings inside Notes: 1. Go to Advanced Search and then click on the “Search in Notes” tab. Type your keyword or string in the search box and hit the "Search Notes" button on the bottom right. ​ 2. You only need to hover over the candidate's name and click on the Notes button to see all the notes on that candidate. This feature allows you to enable POP or IMAP access for your Microsoft Office 365, Outlook, or Zoho Mail account so it can be connected to Recruit CRM. Once enabled, Recruit CRM can securely connect to your mailbox and sync email communication between your native email provider and Recruit CRM. • You want to connect your Outlook or Microsoft Office 365 email account to Recruit CRM • You want to connect your Zoho Mail account to Recruit CRM. • You are preparing your mailbox for Recruit CRM email integration and syncing The video below will show you how easy it is to do this with step-by-step instructions.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Custom Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Custom fields in Recruit CRM allow you to capture and organize additional information for records such as Candidates, Companies, Contacts, Jobs & Deals. Using custom fields, you can tailor Recruit CRM to match your recruitment workflows and standardize data collection across the organization. On the Pro plan, you can create up to 15 custom fields per entity (candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, deals). On the Business plan, up to 100 custom fields per entity can be created. You need access to Admin Settings to create and manage custom fields. Deleting a custom field permanently deletes all data stored in that field.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Custom Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 1. Navigate to Admin Settings in your Recruit CRM account. 2. Under Data Customization , select the entity (Candidates, Companies, Contacts, Jobs, or Deals) for which you want to add custom fields. 3. On the right side of the screen, click the + New Custom Field button. ​ 4. Create the new field by selecting the appropriate field type, entering the correct value or label, and then clicking Save Field . 5. After saving, you can find the newly created field under Additional Information (Custom Fields) in the list on the left.

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Custom Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Note: Once a custom field of a specific type is created, its type cannot be changed later. If you need a different type, create a new custom field and delete the old one. Deleting a custom field will permanently remove all data stored in that field. Supported Custom Field Types in Recruit CRM Text (You can add up to 2000 characters in this field) This field type is used to input the data of the "text" type. Long Text (You can add up to 5000 characters in this field.) This field type is used to add a paragraph. Client-facing summaries or internal private notes about a candidate This field type selects an option from a pre-defined set of values.

Problem: I created a custom field, but I cannot see it on the profile page. chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Custom Fields in Recruit CRM

Likely cause: Field types cannot be edited once the custom field is created. ​ What to check: Confirm whether the existing field type still works for your data. chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Custom Fields in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: How to Create, Edit, and Manage Custom Fields in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Call logs in Recruit CRM help you record and manage phone conversations directly against candidate, contact, or company records. They create a searchable and organized history of call activity, making it easier to track conversations, review outcomes, and collaborate with your team. • Notes summarizing the conversation • Call start time and duration • Collaborators who participated in the call • An associated record • A contact number • A customizable call type to match your workflow This feature is especially useful when you want to:

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: • Record important candidate or contact conversations • Build a searchable call history on records • Categorize calls and track outcomes over time • Add and manage call logs while working on mobile devices Make sure you can access the relevant candidate, contact, or company record where you want to add a call log. Be aware that the call outcome field is a default, non-editable field in Recruit CRM. On mobile, ensure you have the Recruit CRM app installed and can access the floater button on the bottom right of the screen. Method 1: Add a call log from a candidate or contact profile Open the relevant record, such as a candidate or contact profile. ​

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Select the specific record you want to work with. Click the call log icon on the profile to start adding a new call log. ​ Fill in the call log details in the form that appears. ​ In the Related to field, confirm or add the company if needed. This can be done when adding call logs from a candidate, contact, or company profile. ​ If needed, specify or update the contact number. The contact number field is optional when adding call logs. On the contact number field, either select a number from existing standard or custom fields or manually enter a new number. ​ Once all details are added, click the green Submit button to save the call log. ​

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Use the call notes section to capture key highlights of the conversation so that you and your team can get value from the call history. Method 2: Add a call log using the Global Add plus button: Click the Global Add plus button on the top right of the screen. ​ In the menu that appears, click the Call Log option. ​ A call log form will open on the right side of the screen. ​ Fill in all required and relevant details, including the Related to field, which you must complete manually in this method. ​ Note: When you add a call log from a record profile, the Related to field is auto-filled. When you add a call log via the Global Add plus button, you must fill the Related to field yourself.

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can add customized call types to tag a call with a specific type so you and your team can easily identify or categorize calls. Use the option to customize call types if you want more granular tracking (for example, different call purposes or stages). Click here to learn how to customize the call type Open the details view of a candidate or any record. ​ Navigate to the Notes and Calls tab to access the call logs associated with that record. ​ To broaden your view of the activity section, click the expand icon at the top right of the activity area. ​

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Use the search box within the expanded activity section to find specific call logs quickly. Apply filters to refine your view and manage your call logs efficiently. ​ On each call log, check the bottom right of the activity card to see the date and time of the call. This is the date you selected when adding the call log. To see when the call log was actually added to the system, hover over the clock icon on the bottom left of the activity card. How to Add Call Logs on the Mobile App? 📲 Open the profile of the specific entity (such as a candidate, contact, or company) in the mobile app. ​ Tap the floater button located at the bottom right corner of the page. ​

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Fill in the call log details, including related record information and call notes. ​ Save the call log to record the call in the system. ​ Please note: System generated call logs associated with phone calling credits cannot be deleted by any user. This restriction helps maintain accurate Phone Calling credit usage and prevents discrepancies in credit reporting. Manually created call logs can still be deleted by users such as Account Owners, Admins, and users on custom roles with the appropriate permissions to delete call logs. To delete manually added call logs, click on the 3 dots icon on the call log and select the 'Delete' option. Click on 'Yes' in the delete call log pop-up.

chunks.t: How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: No. The call outcome field is not editable. It is a default field designed to track the results of calls made within Recruit CRM, such as whether the call was successful or unsuccessful. By following these steps, you can accurately add, review, and manage call logs in Recruit CRM, ensuring every call attempt and conversation is captured for your team. chunks.t: Adding collaborators to tasks and jobs
chunks.x: Collaborating with your teammates on tasks and jobs is a breeze with our Collaborator feature. Before you add a collaborator, ensure that your teammates are already using Recruit CRM. If they haven't joined yet, inviting a teammate takes just a few seconds. When creating a new job or task, the system will automatically populate the Collaborators field with the teams you belong to. You can then choose to remove or add additional teams as needed. ​ Once you add your teammates as collaborators, they will get in-app and email notifications for it. You have the option to add collaborators to both existing tasks or when creating a new task.

chunks.t: Adding collaborators to tasks and jobs
chunks.x: 1. Navigate to the Tasks and Appointments section on the left sidebar and select ' Tasks' from the 'Sort By' drop-down on the right and a list of existing tasks will show up. 2. Click on the pencil icon located to the right of any task to open the editor. This will open up a task form. 3. Within the form, locate the collaborator section and begin typing the name of the teammate/team you wish to add. 4. Once selected, click the green 'Update' button, and you're all set. 1. Navigate to the Tasks and Appointments section and click on the "Add Task" button to create a new task. 2. In the form that appears, you can designate the teammate or team who will be collaborating with you on the task.

chunks.t: Adding collaborators to tasks and jobs
chunks.x: You can also add Tasks by clicking on the " + " button on the top right of your screen. Click here to learn more on how to create tasks in Recruit CRM You can collaborate with your teammates or teams directly when adding or editing jobs. 1. Navigate to Jobs and click on the 'Add Job' button to add a job: 2. Within the form, locate the Collaborator section and begin typing the name of the teammate/team you wish to add. 3. Hit the 'Save Job' button to save your changes. You can also add/edit job collaborators with a line edit within a job's details page: 📊 Reporting on Collaborators: Analyzing Impact and Insights

chunks.t: Adding collaborators to tasks and jobs
chunks.x: Along with the user performing the action, you can track your collaborators' performance in the Reports section, under the Team performance report . ​ Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for team performance affected are: If a " team" is added as a collaborator on a job, the same will reflect on the team's statistics in reports. However, it is important to note, that if a "teammate" is directly added as a collaborator, the same will not be reflected in their statistics on the Team Performance Report. chunks.t: How can I create and access my hotlists?
chunks.x: A hotlist is essentially a pool of records with similar characteristics. In Recruit CRM, you can create hotlists for all your record types: Candidates/ Companies/ Contacts/ Jobs. You can share the hotlists with your team and also perform a bunch of bulk actions on them as well. If you want to create a hotlist in Recruit CRM, you need to follow the steps below: Note: You need to select at least 1 record while creating a new Hotlist. Select the record(s) that you wish to add to the hotlist. Click on the "Add to Hotlist" (Red Fire button) and choose whether to add the record to an existing hotlist or create a new hotlist.

chunks.t: How can I create and access my hotlists?
chunks.x: If you're creating a new hotlist you can also choose whether you want to share it with your teammates or not  ​ PS: You can also create hotlists from the Chrome Extension as well! Later, you can quickly access your hotlists of Candidates, Companies, Contacts, and Jobs. To view/access/find your hotlists, simply click on the quick view button on the top left of the screen. If you are viewing candidates, you will see candidates hotlist and so on for Contacts or Jobs. chunks.t: Exporting Data to Excel/CSV in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: This feature allows you to export data from Recruit CRM into CSV or Excel files directly from list pages or reports, preserving your selected fields and filters for easy use outside the platform. Only the Account Owner, Admins, and users on the Custom Roles with access to export can export data. Users on the Team Member role and Restricted Team Member roles cannot use export. How to export records from the list pages? You can use the same export process for candidates, contacts, jobs, companies, and deals. Navigate to the list page of your desired entity. For example, go to the Candidates entity page. Select the number of records that you want to export.

chunks.t: Exporting Data to Excel/CSV in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Click on the Export button from the top header bar under the More tab. In the export pop-up, choose the fields that you want to have in the exported sheet. Hit the Export button to download the file (CSV or Excel, as available). When exporting Jobs, the "Updated By" column shows the user's full name (e.g., Ryan Cooper), just like other user-reference columns in the export. Select the parameters, i.e., timeframe, teammates, etc, and generate the report. ​ Once the report is generated, click on the Export Report to CSV button to download the tabular data of the report. Note: Click the Export As PNG/JPG/SVG options next to the bar graph to export an image of the chart itself.

chunks.t: Exporting Data to Excel/CSV in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Additionally, each bar on the chart is also clickable and will direct you to the detailed list of data. You can also export this data by clicking the Export to CSV button located on the header bar. Click here to learn about reports in Recruit CRM 📈 Problem: The Export option is not visible on the list page. Likely cause: The user does not have the required permissions. ​ What to check: Confirm whether you are logged in as the account owner or an admin or a user with the custom role and necessary permission. ​ Resolution: Log in with an account that has account owner or admin rights, or ask the Account Owner to perform the export.

chunks.t: Exporting Data to Excel/CSV in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Problem: The exported file is missing some fields you expected. Likely cause: The fields were not selected in the export pop-up. ​ What to check: Review which fields you selected before exporting. ​ Resolution: Repeat the export process and, in the export pop-up, select all the fields you need before clicking Export. Problem: The detailed data for a chart bar is not exporting.

chunks.t: Exporting Data to Excel/CSV in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: The detailed list view was not opened before exporting. ​ What to check: Confirm that you clicked on the specific bar in the chart and are viewing the detailed list of records. ​ Resolution: Click the desired bar on the chart to open the detailed list, then use the Export to CSV button at the top of that list. Q1: Who can export data from Recruit CRM? Only the account owner and admins can export data and users with the custom role with the necessary permissions. Q2: Which record types can I export from list pages? You can export candidate, contact, job, company, and deal records from their respective list pages. Q3: Can I choose which fields are included in the export file?

chunks.t: Exporting Data to Excel/CSV in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Yes. When the export pop-up box appears, you can select the relevant and necessary fields you wish to export before clicking the Export button. Exporting data to CSV or Excel from Recruit CRM helps you analyse, share, and back up your records across candidates, contacts, jobs, companies, deals, and reports. chunks.t: How to enable browser settings to make the Chrome extension work
chunks.x: If you're having problems with our Chrome extension, it is most likely because third-party cookies are not enabled on your Chrome browser. If third-party cookies are blocked in Google Chrome, the extension may repeatedly show “log in or sign up” prompts even when you are already logged into Recruit CRM. Click the three vertical dots next to your avatar in the top-right corner of Chrome, then select Settings . On the Settings page, type cookies in the search bar at the top. From the search results, click Site settings . Scroll down and click Third-party cookies . Locate the option to allow third-party cookies. ​ Make sure Allow third-party cookies is enabled.

chunks.t: How to enable browser settings to make the Chrome extension work
chunks.x: Return to the page where you use the Recruit CRM Chrome extension. Refresh the page and try using the Chrome extension again. Problem: Chrome extension shows no change after enabling third-party cookies. Likely cause: The browser tab was not refreshed, or the extension needs to reload. ​ What to check: Refresh the page where you are trying to use the extension. Resolution: Refresh the page, try again, and if the issue persists, contact support via the chat icon. Why does the Recruit CRM Chrome extension keep asking me to log in or sign up? Because third-party cookies are likely blocked in Chrome, the extension cannot detect your logged-in session and treats you as logged out.

chunks.t: How to enable browser settings to make the Chrome extension work
chunks.x: What should I do after enabling third-party cookies? Refresh the page where you are using the Recruit CRM Chrome extension and try using the extension again. Enabling third-party cookies in Google Chrome usually resolves login and access issues with the Recruit CRM Chrome extension. If you still face problems after following these steps, reach out through the chat icon at the bottom right so the support team can investigate further.

chunks.t: How Email Open Tracking Works in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature lets you monitor which emails have been opened so you can prioritize follow-ups and understand engagement. You can use this feature when: You want to see when candidates or contacts open your emails. You want real-time notifications when emails are opened. Important Note: Email tracking in Recruit CRM shows how many times an email was opened, but the email tracking pixel does not identify whether the email was opened by the sender or the receiver. The tracking pixel gets triggered when the email is clicked/opened. The tracking pixel will be added for emails when the Track Sent Emails toggle is enabled in your profile settings.

chunks.t: How Email Open Tracking Works in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Here is how to add the email tracking pixel: 1. Navigate to the top left corner of the screen and click on your profile avatar. 2. Ensure that the " Track Sent Emails " toggle is set to 'ON'. Enabling this toggle will automatically insert a pixel (an invisible image) into every email sent from Recruit CRM, allowing you to monitor when recipients open the email. How does email open tracking work in Recruit CRM? When you send an email from Recruit CRM, a small "invisible" image of 1 Px is attached to your email. The person receiving your email never sees the image.

chunks.t: How Email Open Tracking Works in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: For email open tracking to work, your recipient's email service provider should allow images to be displayed. For some email clients, it is on by default but for some email clients like Zoho, you might get options like the one in the image below: Once your recipient clicks on 'Display now', that particular email will be tracked and you will get a notification about your email being opened on Recruit CRM. If your recipient doesn't click on the display image, your email won't be tracked & you will not receive any notification on Recruit CRM. How to track opened emails in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: How Email Open Tracking Works in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: 1. Open your mailbox in Recruit CRM and locate the Opened section. This section tracks and displays emails that have been opened. Use the notification panel in Recruit CRM to see real-time notifications for the most recent emails that have been opened. Problem: You are not receiving any email open notifications in Recruit CRM. Likely cause : The tracking pixel is not enabled, or the recipient’s email client is blocking images. Confirm that the Track Sent Emails toggle in your profile settings is set to On . Check whether the recipient’s email client requires them to click “Display now” or a similar option to load images.

chunks.t: How Email Open Tracking Works in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Resolution path: Enable the tracking toggle in your profile, then resend the email. Does the recipient see the tracking pixel? No. The person receiving your email never sees the image. It is a small, invisible 1-pixel image added only for tracking purposes. By enabling the tracking toggle, understanding how image display affects tracking, and using the Mailbox and notification panel, you can monitor engagement and follow up at the right time. If you need more help, you can contact our support team. Understanding bulk email limits in Recruit CRM Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)

Click Disconnect to remove your current email connection from Recruit CRM. Once the disconnection is complete, click Connect to set up your email again. chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Delete Hotlist feature allows users to permanently remove/delete a hotlist from the database. You can use this feature when: You want to remove outdated or irrelevant hotlists from your account. You need to clean up duplicate or mistakenly created hotlists. You want to keep your database organized and focused on active talent pools. 1. By default, only the Account Owner and the Hotlist owner can delete Hotlists. However, if you're on the Business Plan or above, you can create a custom role with permission to edit Hotlists owned by other teammates: ​ 2. When you delete a hotlist in Recruit CRM:

chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists
chunks.x: The hotlist is permanently removed from your account. Deleting a hotlist does not delete the candidates inside it. 👩‍👩‍👧‍👧 Step-by-step instructions on how to delete a hotlist The process of deleting the Hotlists is the same for candidates, contacts, companies, and jobs. Here, we have taken the example of the Candidates entity. 1. Navigate to the 'Quick View' section by clicking on the 'Quick View' button located at the top left corner of your screen: 2. Click on the blue ' View/Rename Candidates Hotlists' button present at the bottom of the Hotlist section.

chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists
chunks.x: 3. You will see the list of hotlists of that particular entity and the option to edit and delete the hotlists you want. To delete a specific hotlist, just click on the Trash icon. You can search for a specific hotlist from the search bar located at the top-right of your screen. You can also filter the hotlists based on the 'Created On', 'Created By', or 'Updated On' fields: Problem: If you’re unable to delete the hotlist. Likely cause : You do not have the required permission or access. What to check: Check if you are the Account Owner or the person who created the hotlist, or if your custom role includes permissions to edit/delete hotlists owned by others.

chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists
chunks.x: Resolution path: If you're unable to delete the hotlist, ensure that you have the required permission or access, or you can reach out to the respective user who has the required permissions to delete it and ask them to delete the hotlist. Problem: The hotlist is still visible after deletion. Likely cause: The page has not refreshed, or the view is cached. What to check: Confirm that you clicked the trash icon and that no error was shown. Resolution path: If the hotlist is still visible after deletion, try refreshing the page and check if that helps. Deleting a hotlist helps you keep your Recruit CRM database clean and focused while keeping all underlying records safe.

chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Talent Pool Page allows candidates to submit their profiles to your database even when they don't find a suitable job opening. You can customize the page appearance, configure form fields, collect language and proficiency details, send automated emails, and embed the Talent Pool Page on your website. Collect profiles from candidates who aren't applying for a specific job. Build and maintain a database of potential candidates. Customize the Talent Pool Page to match your branding. chunks.t: Setting up your Talent Pool page
chunks.x: Customize the appearance of your Talent Pool Page by adding your Company Logo and Cover Image under the Appearance settings tab. Supported logo file types include JPEG, JPG, and PNG. Configure the Page Title, Form Title, and description displayed to candidates. You can enter the content in any language based on your requirements. ( Read the article ) Select and configure the fields you want to display on the Talent Pool application form under Talent Pool form fields settings.

chunks.t: Setting up your Talent Pool page

Under Integrate Talent Pool , customize the link name for your Talent Pool Page and copy the provided iframe code to embed the page on your website.

chunks.t: Setting up your Talent Pool page

The Page Title, Form Title, and description can be configured in any language.

chunks.t: How to Change Your Card on File?
chunks.x: Your card on file is charged at the commencement of your billing cycle, which can be monthly or yearly depending on your plan. Changing your card on file updates the debit or credit card Recruit CRM uses to charge your subscription at the start of each billing cycle. Once you save the new card in your billing settings, all future recurring subscription charges will be attempted using the updated payment method that is set as default. Your current debit or credit card has expired or is about to expire. Your organization has changed its primary business card. You want future subscription charges to be billed to a different debit or credit card. How to change your card on file on Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: How to Change Your Card on File?
chunks.x: 1. Go to Admin Settings & click on Plans & Billing . 2. Select the Payment Method(s) option and click on Add Payment Method. 3. After entering the details, click on Add Payment Method to save your changes. chunks.t: How does the AI Resume Parser work?
chunks.x: What This Feature Does and When to Use It? The AI Resume Parser in Recruit CRM extracts candidate information from resumes and creates candidate profiles instantly. The parser will capture details such as the Candidate’s Name, Phone Number, Email, City, Full Address, Specialization, Work Experience Year, Work Experience Month, Current Organization, Title, Skills, Language Skills, Summary, Educational Qualification, Work and Education History and social medial URLs like Facebook URL, Twitter URL, LinkedIn URL, GitHub URL, Xing URL (if any). It will also extract the candidate’s work and education history from their resume. Additionally, the parser works with the resumes received from:

chunks.t: How does the AI Resume Parser work?
chunks.x: As well as when candidates update their profile using the Profile Update Request Form. Reducing manual data entry during recruitment. Quickly processing and parsing candidate resumes. Updating Existing Candidate Profiles while parsing CV When you parse a resume, Recruit CRM will first check if a candidate with the same Email ID, LinkedIn URL, or Contact Number already exists in your database. If a match is found, the parser will update the existing profile. Any empty fields in the profile will be filled with new information from the resume. Existing data will not be overwritten by default.

chunks.t: How does the AI Resume Parser work?
chunks.x: The "Override Data" toggle, which allows new data to replace existing information, is *not* available when parsing individual resumes. This toggle is exclusively used during the bulk import process. Click here to learn about how to bulk Import Click the Import Candidate dropdown and choose Resume Parser to open the resume parsing option. Upload the candidate resumes or simply drag and drop them into the parser window. Recruit CRM will automatically extract and populate candidate details from the resume. Once completed, a new candidate profile will be created, or the existing profile will be updated if a matching candidate is found. Click here to learn more about 'How to Parse a Resume'.

chunks.t: How does the AI Resume Parser work?
chunks.x: You can use our Boolean Search feature to search all the information in a candidate’s resume/CV. Will parsing a resume create a new candidate every time? No. Recruit CRM first checks for existing candidates using the email address, LinkedIn URL, or contact number. If a match is found, the existing profile is updated instead of creating a duplicate candidate. The AI Resume Parser in Recruit CRM helps recruiters save time and improve efficiency by automatically extracting and organizing candidate information from resumes. By reducing manual data entry and creating structured candidate profiles instantly, the feature helps streamline and simplify the recruitment process.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Posting jobs to free job boards is super simple in Recruit CRM! We do all the heavy lifting for you and it's 100% Automatic. Recruit CRM posts jobs on the following free job boards: Note: If you want to post jobs on Adzuna, Post Job Free, My Jobhelper, Jooble or Twine then you need to select these job boards in the "XML feeds" field while adding or editing a job. On Jooble, applicants will see a "Direct apply" feature rather than being redirected to the Apply page, but please note that we will not get data on custom fields and mandatory fields that you might have added on your application page. How to get a job posted on the free job boards

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Before you create a new job in Recruit CRM, please make sure you have ticked the job posting box inside Job Fields in Admin settings . This will help post your open jobs on your website and other job boards. ❌ Please note that if you untick the checkbox none of your jobs will be posted. The first step is to make sure all the necessary criteria are met for the jobs to be visible on the XML Feed and posted on the free job boards. The job application form should be enabled; The Updated On date should be within the last 30 days;

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM

You may enter either the full name or just the initials in the required fields (necessary for posting on partner job boards), as both options are acceptable. 'Note for candidates' should be filled in (only if the Job Description is uploaded as a file); The "Post On Job Boards" option should be selected inside Admin Settings >> Job Custom Fields ; The job status should not be 'closed', 'on hold' or 'cancelled';

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM

Check if the Account Owner has enforced a default layout. ​ Resolution path: Ask the Account Owner to adjust your role permissions or to make changes to the enforced layout if appropriate. Does changing my column visibility affect other users? No. Changes you make typically apply only to your own view unless you are the Account Owner editing the 'Others view' and enforcing a layout.

chunks.t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on list page
chunks.x: By adjusting field visibility and column order on your list pages, you can create focused, efficient views that match your daily workflows. Use role-based permissions and enforced layouts where needed to balance flexibility with consistency across your team. Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on List page (New UI)

chunks.t: How to choose which jobs are visible on your website?
chunks.x: Recruit CRM lets you choose which jobs you make visible on your website. Important Note: Jobs whose status is set to "Closed" do not appear on your website no matter what! Step 1: Choose which job you want to show on your website. Step 2: Open the job & click on the pencil icon Step 3: Scroll down the form till you find the "Enable Job Application Form" checkbox ​ Please Note : If it is checked it means that this job will be visible on your website and external jobs page and if it is unchecked it means that this job is not visible on your website and external jobs page. You can find more settings about your Jobs Page which is hosted on your website here .

chunks.t: Accessing the Kanban/Board/Trello view on Jobs?
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Kanban View, also known as the Trello Board, provides a visual way to manage candidates within a job's hiring pipeline. You can use it to: Move candidates between stages using drag and drop. Trigger emails to candidates directly from the pipeline (if any triggers are set up). Go to Jobs and open the desired job. Make sure at least one candidate is assigned to it. The Kanban View will open by default. You can switch between Kanban View and List View as needed.

chunks.t: Accessing the Kanban/Board/Trello view on Jobs?
chunks.x: Drag and drop candidate cards between stages to update their hiring stage. You can also add a remark or trigger an email while moving a candidate. Here is a guide on how you can set up email automation/triggers . You can also quickly access the Kanban View by clicking View Candidates from the Dashboard . The Kanban View provides a simple visual way to organize candidates and manage their progress through your hiring pipeline. How to view the candidate hiring pipelines for jobs in Recruit CRM? Bulk-Select Up to 500 Records in Candidate Kanban View

chunks.t: Changing the status of a job
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Job Status feature in Recruit CRM helps you efficiently track and manage the lifecycle of jobs using predefined statuses such as Open, Closed, Hold, and Canceled, while also allowing custom statuses to match specific hiring workflows. Users can update job statuses individually or in bulk, filter jobs based on status in list or Kanban view. Go to Admin Settings and open the Job Status section. Review the predefined job statuses available by default, such as Open, Closed, Hold, and Cancelled. To create a custom job status, click Customize . Add the new status as required and save your changes.

chunks.t: Changing the status of a job
chunks.x: The newly created status will then be available across job records and status dropdowns. Open indicates the jobs that are currently active. Closed indicates the jobs that are finished . Hold indicates a job that's been paused for a period of time. Cancelled indicates a job that was called off/withdrawn. Please note: These statuses can't be deleted or edited as they are used to power events in the app. How to Change the Status of Jobs in Recruit CRM Open the job you want to update from the Jobs List . Click the Job Status button beside the job name. Select the required status from the dropdown menu. Additionally, you can add a remark for the update. Finally, click Submit to save the changes.

chunks.t: Changing the status of a job
chunks.x: All the jobs where the status is NOT "Closed" are considered Active jobs , provided you have the Job Application Form Link enabled. Those jobs will be automatically posted on free job boards like ZipRecruiter, Neuvoo, CareerJet, JobRapido, etc. ​ To ensure the jobs aren't available on the jobs page, we have two criteria: ​ Here you can read more about how it works! Go to the Jobs List and select the jobs you want to update. And click Update Field at the top of the page. Select the new status you want to apply, add a remark for the update, and click Submit to save the changes. All the selected jobs will now be seamlessly updated to the new status you’ve chosen.

chunks.t: Changing the status of a job
chunks.x: While changing the status of a job, you can also choose to close this job on external job boards and disable its Job Application Form. For jobs marked as 'Closed' , both checkboxes are force-checked and cannot be modified. For jobs marked as 'On Hold ' or 'Canceled' , both checkboxes are checked by default but can be manually edited. For jobs marked as 'Open' or any other custom statuses , both checkboxes remain unchecked by default and are editable. You can use the Quick View button on the List View to see all jobs with the default status (open, on hold, closed, and cancelled).

chunks.t: Changing the status of a job
chunks.x: In the Kanban View , you can choose which job statuses are visible and easily drag and drop jobs between stages as their status changes. Click here to learn more about the Kanban View for Jobs! Keeping job statuses up to date helps ensure your job records accurately reflect their current stage and availability. Adding Feedback On The List Of Candidates Submitted To You Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: How to set up Email Triggers in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Email triggers in Recruit CRM automatically send emails or update stages when specific events occur in your pipelines. Send emails automatically when a candidate’s hiring stage is changed. Send emails automatically when a contact’s sales stage is changed. Automatically update a candidate’s hiring stage when a “Submit Candidate – Online Link ” email is sent. Automatically update a candidate’s hiring stage when a “Submit Candidate – Candidate Grid ” email is sent. Make sure you can access the Admin settings in Recruit CRM. Ensure your email account is connected in Email settings .

chunks.t: How to set up Email Triggers in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Prepare or review the email templates you want to use for each trigger, so you can select the correct one during setup. 1. Go to Admin Settings in your Recruit CRM account & click on Email Triggers under CRM process customization. ​3. Enter a clear, descriptive name for your email trigger so you can easily recognize its purpose later (for example, Candidate moved to Interview — to be confirmed ). 4. Select the execution event that should activate the trigger. ​ ​The email trigger offers four types of execution events that will determine when the email is sent and whether stages are updated. ​ This trigger works when a candidate’s hiring stage changes in the hiring pipeline.

chunks.t: How to set up Email Triggers in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can configure it to automatically send an email whenever a candidate is moved into a selected stage. This trigger works when a contact’s stage changes in the sales pipeline. You can configure it to automatically send an email whenever a contact is moved into a selected stage. ⚠️ Note: The email will be sent directly to the candidate or contact once the email trigger is activated and the stage is set. It will not be sent internally. 🔄 Stage Changes Triggered by Sending Emails When "Submit Candidate" email is sent (Online Link) This trigger updates a candidate’s hiring stage automatically when a Submit Candidate – Online Link email is sent.

chunks.t: How to set up Email Triggers in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When "Submit Candidate" email is sent (Candidate Grid) This trigger updates a candidate’s hiring stage automatically when a Submit Candidate – Candidate Grid email is sent. ✅ Please Note: The hiring stage will only be updated if the email is sent successfully. Click here to learn more about how to submit candidates to contacts ​4. Select the Execution Event Value, your hiring stages will appear here, you can add more stages to this pipeline from here . ​5. Select the email template you want to use or you can create email templates from here . This article about email templates will help you create one. 6. Select the sender from the list (from whom the email trigger should be sent).

chunks.t: How to set up Email Triggers in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Please note that if the sender has more than one email ID connected, the email trigger will be sent from the 'Default Email Address' as set in the 'Email Settings' . ​7. Just make sure everything is correct and hit Save. And that's how you set email triggers in Recruit CRM. When you change the hiring stage of a candidate to the stage defined in the trigger, the system will prompt you to the email trigger. For “Submit Candidate” triggers, the candidate’s hiring stage will be updated only when the corresponding email is successfully sent. Problem: Email is being sent from the wrong email address Likely cause: The default email address in Email settings is different from the address you expect.

chunks.t: How to set up Email Triggers in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: In Email settings , confirm which email ID is set as the default . In the trigger configuration, check the sender selected. Update the default email address in Email settings if required. Adjust the sender selection in the email trigger, then save and test. Where do I find email triggers in Recruit CRM? Email triggers are available under Admin settings in the CRM process customization section as Email triggers . Who receives the emails sent by email triggers? Emails configured in email triggers are sent directly to the candidate or contact associated with the event. They are not sent internally to team members.

chunks.t: How to set up Email Triggers in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Email triggers in Recruit CRM help you automate key communication steps and keep your pipelines up to date with less manual work. If you still have questions, just click on the chat icon on your bottom right and hit us with a message. chunks.t: Integrating Recruit CRM Career Page with Squarespace
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM makes it easy to connect your Squarespace website to your Recruit CRM account, allowing you to display your live job listings directly on your website. Candidates who apply through the embedded job are automatically added to your Recruit CRM database, eliminating the need to manually manage applications or update job postings in multiple places. • You manage your website on Squarespace and want to display live job openings from Recruit CRM. • You want candidates applying through your website to be added directly to your Recruit CRM database.

chunks.t: Integrating Recruit CRM Career Page with Squarespace
chunks.x: • You want Recruit CRM to remain your single source of truth for managing jobs while using Squarespace as your public-facing careers site. • You prefer a simple, copy-and-paste integration using Recruit CRM's website integration code snippet. Embed Your Recruit CRM Job Board into Squarespace If you're managing your website using Squarespace, the steps below will help you do that- 1. Log in to your Squarespace account and open the website where you want to display your Recruit CRM jobs. 2. From the left-hand panel, click Pages , then click the + icon to create a new page. ​ 3. Select Blank Page , enter a name for the page (for example, Jobs Page ), and open it in the page editor.

chunks.t: Integrating Recruit CRM Career Page with Squarespace
chunks.x: 4. Click Add Section , then select Add Blank to insert a blank section on the page. 5. Inside the blank section, click Add Block , scroll through the available options, and select Markdown . And then click Edit to open the Markdown block. 6. In Recruit CRM, navigate to Admin Settings → Public Job Page Settings → Job Integration . ​ 7. Under Website Integration , click Copy to copy the integration code snippet. 8. Return to your Squarespace page and paste the copied code into the Markdown block. Resize or reposition the Markdown block as needed to match your preferred page layout.

chunks.t: Integrating Recruit CRM Career Page with Squarespace
chunks.x: Once saved, your Recruit CRM public job board will appear on your Squarespace page, and candidates who apply through it will be added directly to your Recruit CRM database P.S. You can choose if you want to add a banner either from Squarespace OR from Recruit CRM. Problem: The job board appears misaligned or too small/large on the page. Likely cause: The Markdown block or section size has not been adjusted. ​ What to check: Verify the position and size of the Markdown block within the blank section. ​ Resolution: Drag and arrange the box on your page and resize it within Squarespace until it fits your design.

chunks.t: Integrating Recruit CRM Career Page with Squarespace
chunks.x: Q1. Which block should I use in Squarespace to add the Recruit CRM job board? Use a Markdown block inside a blank section on your Squarespace page, then paste the Recruit CRM Website Integration code into that block. Q2. Do applications from the Squarespace Jobs Page go into Recruit CRM automatically? Yes. When candidates apply from your website through the embedded Recruit CRM job board, they are added directly to your Recruit CRM database. Q3. Can I resize or move the embedded job board on my page? Yes. After adding the Markdown block and pasting the code, you can drag and arrange the box and adjust its size within Squarespace.

chunks.t: Integrating Recruit CRM Career Page with Squarespace
chunks.x: By following these steps, you can integrate your Recruit CRM career page into a Squarespace Jobs Page so that candidates apply directly into your Recruit CRM database, while your website continues to serve as the main destination for job seekers. chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: This article explains how to cancel your Recruit CRM subscription, deactivate your account, and what happens to your data at each step. You’ll also learn how you can pause your subscription instead of canceling it if you’d like to keep your data safe for future use. Before canceling or deactivating your account, it’s important to export all your data to avoid any potential data loss. Go to admin settings and Click on " Account " ​ Choose the type of export required: To know more you can go to the article - Exporting All Data For Recruit CRM Account Owners The first step to deactivate your Recruit CRM account is to cancel the paid subscription.

chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: If you have more than 10 active seats, deactivate the other users and reduce your paid licenses to see the option to cancel your subscription and deactivate the account. 1. Go to the admin settings and click on Account . 2. Scroll down, and click on "cancel subscription". Please make sure you don't have any pending invoices to be able to cancel the subscription. In case you have a combination of annual and monthly seats on your subscription, both subscriptions will be set to cancel on the respective renewal dates.

chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: Once you proceed to cancel your subscription, you will still have complete access to your account and all data until the end of your current subscription period. The system will also show you the date until when the subscription remains active. ​ However, after the expiry of this period, you will not be able to access any data from your account. No retrieval or management of data will be possible after this date unless you reactivate your subscription. However, after the expiry of this period, you will not be able to access any data from your account.

chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: Once you successfully cancel the subscription, your subscription for the next upcoming renewal billing will be scheduled to cancel so that you will not be charged on your next billing cycle. You can still edit your subscription after it is scheduled to cancel. You'll receive a pop-up message asking if you would like to revoke the cancellation or simply edit the subscription while it's still active: ​ You still have the option to undo your cancellation. If you’d like to continue using Recruit CRM, you can revoke the cancellation or reactivate your subscription. ​ Click the link below to learn how to revoke your subscription cancellation or reactivate your account. ​

chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: Revoking the subscription cancelation or reactivating the subscription Deactivating your Recruit CRM account is easy! ​ 1. Go to the admin settings and click on Account . 2. Scroll down, and click on "Deactivate Account". You can only initiate the deactivation process after your subscription has expired. For instance, if your subscription renews on 30 October of the current year but you cancel your subscription on 20 October of the current year, you will only be able to proceed with the steps to deactivate the account after the subscription expiry period i.e. on 30 October of the current year.

chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: Once you deactivate the account, your data will be stored on our servers for up to 2 months after which it will be deleted permanently. Within these 14 days, you have the option to revoke the deactivation request. Once the request is canceled, you can restart the subscription anytime! WARNING: PLEASE READ CAREFULLY BEFORE YOU PROCEED Deactivating your Recruit CRM Account will cause permanent data loss . Once you click on the deactivate button, it'll be impossible for us or for anyone to retrieve your data. Everything will be deleted from Recruit CRM such as your records, emails, resumes, notes, & any uploaded files.

chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: Whereas,  canceling your subscription will store your data in the cloud servers till the time you deactivate the account. If you wish to temporarily pause your subscription instead of canceling it, please reach out to Recruit CRM Support via the chatbox. During a paused subscription period: You can access it again once you reactivate. This is ideal if you plan to return to using Recruit CRM in the near future. What happens if I decide to reactivate after cancelation or pausing? If you reactivate your subscription within the retention period (up to 2 months after the subscription ends), you can restore access to your account and data. Can I retrieve my data after the retention period?

chunks.t: Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account
chunks.x: No, data retrieval is not possible once the retention period lapses. To safeguard your information, we strongly recommend exporting your data before pausing or canceling. chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: Ready to move beyond the Recruit CRM free trial or upgrade your existing subscription? Recruit CRM makes it easy to upgrade your account, choose the plan that best fits your team's needs, and manage your billing preferences. You are upgrading from a Free Trial to a paid Recruit CRM plan. You want to upgrade from the Pro Plan to the Business Plan . The sections below walk through the different upgrade scenarios and explain how to complete each one. Upgrading from the free trial to a paid plan Verify your registered email address by completing the verification process in your Recruit CRM account. ​ Once your email has been verified, start the upgrade process by either:

chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: Clicking the Upgrade Your Account button at the top right of your screen, or Navigating to Admin Settings → Plans & Billing → Upgrade Your Account . Choose your preferred billing cycle by switching between Monthly and Annual . The pricing will automatically update based on your selection. Then select the subscription plan you want to purchase ( Pro , Business , or Enterprise ). Once the plan type is selected, configure your subscription by: Selecting the required number of licenses . Adding Additional Record Limits , if required, using the + and − buttons.

chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: You can also choose to purchase the subscription with a combination of annual and monthly licenses. This article will guide you through the steps. Once you've finalized your subscription structure, click Review Order from the right-hand panel. ​ Enter your payment details. (Recruit CRM accepts both debit and credit cards.) Review your purchase details carefully. ​ Accept the Recruit CRM Terms of Service by selecting the confirmation checkbox. ​ Before completing your purchase, review the subscription agreement. All new Recruit CRM customers are required to sign the contract before the subscription can be activated. Create your signature by choosing one of the available options:

chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: Click Create , then Save to complete and store the signed agreement. ​ Click Pay to complete your purchase and upgrade your account. ​ Please read the contract and terms of service carefully before proceeding to sign. You'll be able to view and download the history of your signed agreements on the tab 'View Current Plan' and in the 'Invoice & Subscription Agreement History' tab. Log in to your Recruit CRM account and go to Admin Settings > Plans & Billings . From the left navigation panel, select Plans . Choose the Business Plan as your new subscription. Review your order, including the updated plan details and charges. Proceed to checkout and complete the payment to finalize the upgrade.

chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: You will only be charged a pro-rated amount that will be automatically calculated for the remaining period of your billing cycle. In line with our policies, we don't provide upfront discounts. However, you can save up to 20% by opting for our annual plan. Problem: Cannot start the upgrade from free trial to a paid plan. Likely cause: Registered email address is not verified. ​ What to check: Confirm that you have completed the email verification steps in Recruit CRM. ​ Resolution: Verify your email address first, then use the Upgrade Your Account button or go to Admin Settings → Plans and Billings to restart the upgrade process.

chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: Problem: Pricing does not match expectations when changing billing cycle. Likely cause: Billing toggle is set to the wrong cycle (monthly vs annual). ​ What to check: Confirm whether the toggle is set to monthly or annual and note that prices update automatically. ​ Resolution: Switch the toggle to the intended billing cycle and review the updated prices before proceeding. Problem: Unable to complete the upgrade because the contract is not signed.

chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: Likely cause: Terms of service and contract have not been accepted and signed. ​ What to check: Ensure you have checked the box to agree to the terms of service and completed the signature step. ​ Resolution: Open the contract, read the terms, draw, type, or upload your signature, click Create , then Save , and proceed to payment. Which payment methods are accepted for upgrading my Recruit CRM account? Recruit CRM accepts both debit and credit cards for subscription payments. Can I choose between monthly and annual billing? Yes. You can switch the billing toggle between monthly and annual, and the pricing will automatically adjust according to your selection.

chunks.t: Upgrading Your Account
chunks.x: How am I charged when upgrading from Pro to Business mid-cycle? When you upgrade from Pro to Business, you are charged a prorated amount that is automatically calculated for the remaining period of your current billing cycle. Are there upfront discounts available on plans? In line with the stated policies, Recruit CRM does not provide upfront discounts. However, you can save up to 20% by opting for an annual plan. Upgrading your Recruit CRM account involves verifying your email, choosing the right plan and billing cycle, configuring licenses and record limits, completing payment, and signing the required contract. Updating or Changing Your Recruit CRM Subscription/Account Plan

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) from admin settings
chunks.x: Recruit CRM is designed to be extremely customizable and give you the ability to choose the fields you want to make visible inside the account. ​ Changes made in the visibility of data fields through "Admin Settings" will be reflected in Add/Edit Forms, Lists & Profile Page of Candidates/Companies/Contacts/Jobs. You can make changes in your data fields by following the steps below: Step 1: Click on the "Admin Settings" icon Step 2: Click on any button under the "Data Customisation" section Step 3: Toggle between the data fields of your choice set the visibility of fields as "ON" or "OFF" and mark the fields as " Required" or "Not Required."

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) from admin settings
chunks.x: Step 4: You will be able to see all fields set to " visible" on your List Pages (Candidates/Companies/Contacts/Jobs). An example of the Candidate List Page is below: You'll see all the fields here which you made visible in Admin Settings . Then, you can select fields that you want to be seen on your List Pages. You can also rearrange the order of selected fields by dragging the fields Up or Down. These changes will also appear in "Application forms" and "Profile Pages" . ​ You can access all application forms just by clicking the " + " button at the top right. Inside the add/edit forms, you'll only see the fields that you made visible in admin settings.

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) from admin settings
chunks.x: These same changes will also be reflected inside your Profile Pages: You can then change the order of fields to your liking by just clicking on the pencil icon that will appear when you move your mouse over any field. That will replace the existing field with the new field of your choice. You can rearrange all fields visible on each page (Candidates/Companies/Contacts/Jobs) in an order of your choice. chunks.t: Sharing a formatted CV With Clients
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The formatted CV workflow lets you store and share a version of the candidate’s CV that uses your company’s formatting and this formatted CV can be shared with clients when you submit candidates. You can either use Recruit CRM’s native resume/CV formatting tool or upload externally formatted files into this custom field. You can use this feature when: When you want to send a candidate’s CV in your own company-branded format. When you want to keep a separate “formatted CV” file in Recruit CRM alongside the original resume. When you want clients to see only the formatted CV and not the original resume.

chunks.t: Sharing a formatted CV With Clients
chunks.x: When you regularly submit candidates to clients from jobs and need a consistent CV format. This feature (native resume/CV formatting tool) is available for Business plan users and above. You need access to Admin Settings to create custom candidate fields and configure which fields are shared with clients. Make sure you have your formatted CV files ready to upload if you are formatting resumes outside Recruit CRM. Decide whether you want clients to see only the formatted CV or both the formatted CV and the original resume. How to Create a Custom “Formatted CV” field? 📃 Under Data Customization , click Candidate Fields . ​ On the right side, click the green New Custom Field button. ​

chunks.t: Sharing a formatted CV With Clients
chunks.x: Name the new custom field (for example, “Formatted CV” or “Formatted Resume”). ​ On the left side, ensure the visibility for the new “Formatted CV” field is set to On so that it is visible. ​ Show the formatted CV field on candidate profile pages In the profile section, identify any existing field you do not want to keep (for example, a field like “Locality”). ​ Click the pencil icon to the right of the field you want to replace. ​ From the list, select the “Formatted CV” (or similarly named) custom field you created earlier. ​ The new formatted CV field will now replace the old field in the candidate profile layout. ​ On the candidate profile, locate the new formatted CV field. ​

chunks.t: Sharing a formatted CV With Clients
chunks.x: Click the pencil icon to the right of the empty field. ​ Click Upload and upload the candidate’s CV or formatted resume file. ​ The layout change you made (replacing the old field with the formatted CV field) will reflect on all candidate profile pages, but the uploaded file itself is specific to each candidate. ​ Make the formatted CV field visible to clients Search for the custom “Formatted CV” field you created. ​ Tick the checkbox for Formatted CV so that this file is shared with clients. ​ (Optional) Untick the Resume checkbox if you do not want to share the candidate’s original resume with clients. ​ Click Save Settings to apply your changes. ​

chunks.t: Sharing a formatted CV With Clients
chunks.x: Problem: The formatted CV field does not appear on candidate profiles Likely cause: The field is not set to visible. In Admin Settings > Candidate Fields, confirm the “Formatted CV” field’s visibility is set to On . On a candidate profile, confirm you replaced an existing field with the formatted CV field. Resolution: Turn on visibility for the field and repeat the “Replace Field” steps to add it to the profile layout. Problem: The Upload option is not available on the formatted CV field Likely cause: The field type is not set to File . In Admin Settings > Candidate Fields, confirm the field type for the formatted CV field.

chunks.t: Sharing a formatted CV With Clients
chunks.x: Resolution: If the field is not a file field, create a new custom field with the File type and repeat the configuration steps. Do I need to be on a specific plan to use the native resume/CV formatting tool? Yes. The native resume or CV formatting tool is available for Business plan users and above. Does changing the candidate profile layout affect all candidates? Yes. When you replace a field with the formatted CV field in the profile layout, that layout change reflects on all candidate profile pages. You can now create, upload, and share formatted CVs with clients directly from Recruit CRM, giving you better control over how candidate information is presented.

chunks.t: Replacing/Reordering Fields on profile pages
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to customize the fields shown in the profile section of your records. You can replace an existing field with another field from the available dropdown. Customize the fields displayed on profile pages. Replace fields that are less relevant to your workflow. Display more useful information at the top of Candidate, Contact, Company, or Job profiles. Please note: The Candidate profile is used as an example, but the same functionality applies to Candidates, Contacts, Companies, and Jobs. Open a Candidate, Contact, Company, or Job profile from the relevant list page. Select the field you want to replace from the profile section.

chunks.t: Replacing/Reordering Fields on profile pages

Likely Cause: The field may not be enabled in the Candidate Data Customization . What to Check: Check whether the field is visible under Admin Settings → Candidate Fields . Resolution: Enable the field visibility and return to the profile page. The field should then appear in the dropdown. chunks.t: How to Integrate Google or Outlook Calendar with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The calendar integration connects your Recruit CRM account to your Google or Outlook calendar. Once connected, Recruit CRM can: Fetch events from the calendars you select. Add new events from Recruit CRM into those same calendars. You choose which calendars to sync, so only relevant meetings and events are shared. Confirm you have an active Google account if you plan to integrate Google Calendar. Confirm you have an active Outlook or Microsoft 365 account if you plan to integrate Outlook Calendar. Integrate Google Calendar with Recruit CRM: Go to your user profile in Recruit CRM and click on Calendar settings . ​

chunks.t: How to Integrate Google or Outlook Calendar with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: In the Calendar settings page, click the Connect button in front of Google Calendar . ​ When prompted, grant all the requested permissions so Recruit CRM can access your Google calendars. ​ Select the specific Google calendars you want Recruit CRM to fetch events from and add events to. ​ Review the selected calendars and confirm the connection as shown in the interface. Integrate Outlook Calendar with Recruit CRM: Go to your user profile in Recruit CRM and click on Calendar settings . ​ In the Calendar settings page, locate Outlook Calendar and click the Connect button in front of it. ​ When prompted, grant all the required permissions so Recruit CRM can access your Outlook calendars. ​

chunks.t: How to Integrate Google or Outlook Calendar with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Choose the Outlook calendars you want Recruit CRM to fetch meetings from and add events to. Integrating your Google or Outlook calendar with Recruit CRM ensures your interviews and meetings stay organized across tools. If you need more help with calendar settings or run into issues during setup, contact your internal admin or Recruit CRM support for further assistance. chunks.t: Changing/Resetting Your Recruit CRM Password
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Changing or resetting your Recruit CRM password lets you update the password you use to log in to your account. You can use this when: You want to change your existing Recruit CRM password from within your account. You have forgotten your Recruit CRM password and cannot log in. Or simply, you want to reset your login credentials. There are two ways to change your Recruit CRM password. 1. Change Password From Your Profile Page Settings: Go to the Profile Settings by clicking on the Profile icon. 2. Scroll all the way down and click on the "Change Password" button. ​ 3. Fill in the required fields to change your password and hit “Submit.”

chunks.t: Changing/Resetting Your Recruit CRM Password
chunks.x: If you forgot your Recruit CRM password, you can use the " Forgot Password" link on the login page to reset your password. Once you click on the “Forgot Password” link, it will ask you to enter your registered email address. You’ll get an email from Recruit CRM ( support@recruitcrm.io ) with the reset password link. Note: If you don't find the email in your inbox, please check your spam/junk folder. Click on the link to be redirected to the reset password page. You'll just have to type in your new password and confirm it. ​ Problem: You did not receive the password reset email. Likely cause: Email was filtered to Spam/Junk, or the wrong email address was entered.

chunks.t: Changing/Resetting Your Recruit CRM Password
chunks.x: Confirm you entered the correct registered email address. Check your Spam/Junk folders for an email from support@recruitcrm.io . Search your mailbox for support@recruitcrm.io . You can change or reset your Recruit CRM password either from your Profile Settings when logged in or via the Forgot Password link on the login page if you are locked out.
