chunks.t: Exporting All Data For Recruit CRM Account Owners
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The export feature allows you to download all Recruit CRM record data. You can use this feature when: You want a full backup of all Recruit CRM data. Exporting your data is especially critical when planning to cancel your subscription, as it ensures you retain access to valuable information after your subscription ends. Only account owners can perform this action. The export can be blocked in case of the non-payment of invoices. The Data Export and Full Export options available only to accounts on paid subscription plans. (Pro, Business and Enterprise). Step-by-step instructions on how to initiate the data export

chunks.t: Exporting All Data For Recruit CRM Account Owners
chunks.x: 1. Go to admin settings and click on " Account " Includes CSV files for all candidates, contacts, jobs, companies, and deals data along with the assignments and associations like notes, meetings, tasks, and hotlists. Along with the CSV file included in the "Data Export", the full export will also include all the files attached with candidates, contacts, and company records. You can export the CSV files once a day . You can run the full data export once every 90 days . 1. You will receive an email from support@recruitcrm.io once your data files are ready. This may take a few minutes or up to two days, depending on the size of your data.

chunks.t: Exporting All Data For Recruit CRM Account Owners
chunks.x: Note: The data links are only valid for 3 days. Please make sure you download the data on your device before the links expire. 2. Click on the download links to download all the data on your device and access it as follows 👇 CSV files with all the associations & assignments Once you open the Zip file, you'll find the CSVs for all candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, and deals data along with the associations and assignments. After downloading the Zip file for attachments, you can review the data for each record of all the entities (candidates, companies, and contacts).

chunks.t: Exporting All Data For Recruit CRM Account Owners
chunks.x: You can also check the history of all export actions performed on the account by clicking on the clock icon as shown below: Note: The system will automatically trigger a full data export when you proceed to deactivate your account. However, it is highly recommended to proactively export your data before initiating the cancellation of your subscription, to verify and secure your files. The data export is only applicable for active subscriptions. Please check if you have an unpaid invoice on your subscription or reach out to us using the chatbot. Or, you can email us at support@recruitcrm.io .

chunks.t: Exporting All Data For Recruit CRM Account Owners
chunks.x: If you are considering canceling your Recruit CRM subscription, ensure that all important data related to your business is exported ahead of time. By doing this, you: Retain critical files, databases, and records. Prevent operational disruptions caused by losing access to account data. To export your data, follow the steps outlined in the earlier sections and double-check that all your important files are downloaded and stored securely. Who can export all data from Recruit CRM? Only account owners can perform the Data export and Full export actions. Which subscription plans include Data export and Full export?

chunks.t: Exporting All Data For Recruit CRM Account Owners
chunks.x: Data export and Full export options are available only to accounts on paid subscription plans such as Pro Plan, Business Plan, and Enterprise Plan. Exporting all data from Recruit CRM gives account owners a reliable way to back up records and attached files, especially before canceling a subscription or performing major changes. chunks.t: Candidate questions on the Job Application & Profile Update Request form
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Candidate Questions allow you to collect information from applicants that may not be available on their resumes. You can build a reusable library of questions, assign relevant questions to specific jobs, and review candidate responses. Collect role-specific information during the application process. Make certain questions mandatory for applicants. Reuse a library of questions across multiple jobs. Include candidate questions in Profile Update Request Forms. How to create and add Candidate Questions Go to Admin Settings and open Job Application Form Settings.

chunks.t: Candidate questions on the Job Application & Profile Update Request form
chunks.x: In the Job Application Form field settings tab, scroll down to the Candidate Questions section and click Add Questions. Create the questions you would like candidates to answer. If required, enable the Required option for questions that applicants must answer before submitting their application. Note: Questions added to your question library in the Admin settings do NOT appear in all job application forms by default. How to add related questions inside each job? Navigate to the Jobs page and open the job where you want to add candidate questions. Scroll down to the Job Application Form section and ensure the Enable Job Application Form checkbox is selected.

chunks.t: Candidate questions on the Job Application & Profile Update Request form
chunks.x: Select the questions you want to include from the dropdown for that job. Note: Questions marked as Required in Admin Settings can still be made optional for individual jobs if needed. Add candidate questions to the Profile Update Request Form You can also display Candidate Questions in the Profile Update Request Form sent to candidates. Go to Admin Settings and open Profile Update Form . In the Profile Update Form Fields tab, search for Candidate Questions. Turn on the Visibility toggle to display Candidate Questions in the Profile Update Request Form, and mark the required questions as Required, if applicable. How to track the questions answered by a candidate?

chunks.t: Candidate questions on the Job Application & Profile Update Request form
chunks.x: Candidate responses to the Candidate Questions can be viewed from three different locations: 1. View responses from the Candidate Pipeline Open the desired job and, under Candidate Pipeline, click View All. Switch to List View and click the Edit Columns (Pencil) icon. Enable the Candidate Questions column and position it wherever you'd like it to appear. Click View Q&A to view the candidate's responses. 2. View responses from the Candidate Profile: Navigate to the Questions tab. Here you'll find all questions answered by the candidate, along with the corresponding job. 3. View responses from Job Specific Details: Under Candidate Pipeline, locate the candidate and click Job Specific Details.

chunks.t: Candidate questions on the Job Application & Profile Update Request form
chunks.x: Open the Candidate Questions tab. From here, you can view and edit the candidate's responses or use the search bar to quickly find specific questions. Problem: Candidates cannot see the candidate questions when applying for a job. Likely Cause: The candidate's questions have not been added to the specific job. What to Check: Confirm that the required candidate questions have been selected for that job. Remember that questions created in the library are not automatically added to every job by default. Resolution: Add the required candidate questions to the job, and save your changes. 1. Can I use the same questions for multiple jobs?

chunks.t: Candidate questions on the Job Application & Profile Update Request form
chunks.x: Yes. Once a question is created in the Candidate Questions library, it can be added to any job application form. 2. Can required questions be made optional? Yes. Even if a question is marked as Required in Admin Settings, you can make it optional when configuring an individual job. Candidate Questions help you collect job-specific information during both the application and profile update processes, making it easier to evaluate applicants and maintain accurate candidate records. Translating External Forms For Candidates Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Translating External Forms For Candidates
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to customize the labels displayed on external candidate forms in your preferred language. You can translate buttons and application form fields to provide candidates with a more localized application experience. Display external application forms in your preferred language. Translate Job Application Form field labels. How to translate external forms for candidates? Navigate to Admin Settings → Job Application Form Settings . Open the General Page Settings tab, scroll to Customise Button & Link Labels, and click Edit to customize the text displayed on buttons and links.

chunks.t: Translating External Forms For Candidates
chunks.x: Open Job Application Form Field Settings and click Edit beside the required field to customize its label in your preferred language. Once updated, the customized labels will be reflected on the external Job Application Form. Customizing external candidate forms helps you provide a more localized and consistent application experience. By updating buttons and field labels in Recruit CRM, you can adapt the Job Application Form to your preferred language and make it easier for candidates to complete. chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: Hotlists let you group candidates, companies, contacts, or jobs into a single list based on similar criteria. You can access them easily, view associated records, perform bulk actions, export or delete records, and manage the hotlist as needed. Create targeted groups of candidates, companies, contacts, or jobs. Perform bulk actions on multiple records at once. Quickly access and manage related records from a single list. Share curated record groups with your team. Export, update, or organize records more efficiently. In Recruit CRM, you can create hotlists for all entities, including Candidates, Companies, Contacts, and Jobs. Click here to learn how to create a hotlist!

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: In Recruit CRM, you can create hotlists for all major record types: candidates, companies, contacts, and jobs. You can access all hotlists associated with each record type by clicking the Quick View icon on the respective list pages. A hotlist is essentially a pool of records with similar characteristics. You can effortlessly share the hotlists with your team and also perform bulk actions on it. You can also open the Hotlist tab on a candidate profile to view all hotlists that the candidate belongs to. 2. Perform Bulk Actions on Candidates in a Hotlist You can select candidate records from any hotlist and perform actions such as: Request candidates to update their profiles in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: Enroll candidates in an email sequence etc 3. Add Candidates to a Hotlist from the List Page Select the candidates you want to add, then click the Add to Hotlist button on the header bar. It will give you an option to either add them to an existing hotlist or create a new hotlist. Choose the relevant option and click on the Add to List button. You also have the option to display the hotlist as a column on the list page of candidates, contacts, jobs, and companies. Once enabled, an icon will appear providing quick access to view all hotlists associated with each respective record. Additionally, you can run an advanced search based on the hotlist column.

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: Select the record that you want to remove. Click on the Remove from Hotlist button from the header bar under the More tab. Select the candidates within a hotlist that you want to export. Click on the Export button from the header bar under the More tab. This will export the selected candidates according to your export configuration. 6. Delete Candidates from Your Database via a Hotlist If you wish to delete a candidate from your database, you can delete them from inside a hotlist as well. Open the relevant hotlist and select the candidates you want to delete. Click on the Delete button under the More tab on the header bar.

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: Please note that once you delete any candidate, they will be permanently deleted from your database. By default, only the account owner and hotlist owners can edit a hotlist. However, if you are in the business plan, you can create a custom role with permission to edit the hotlist owned by the other teammates. Click on the View All/Rename Hotlist button inside your Quick View . You'll be redirected to a list of hotlists in your system. Find your desired hotlist and click the pencil (edit) icon on its right. Rename the hotlist. Click Update Hotlist to save your changes.

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: You can further streamline your hotlist management in Recruit CRM by utilizing the search bar to quickly locate specific hotlists or applying filters based on parameters such as Created by, Created on, and Updated on. By default, only account owners and hotlist owners can delete a hotlist. However, if you are on a business plan, you can create a custom role with permission to delete the hotlist owned by other teammates. Click on the View All/Rename Hotlists button inside your Quick View . Click on the Trash icon on the right of the hotlist you wish to delete. Please note that deleting a hotlist does not delete the record inside the hotlist; it only removes the hotlist grouping itself.

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: Problem: You cannot edit or delete a hotlist. Likely cause: You do not have permission to edit or delete that hotlist. What to check: Confirm whether you are the account owner, the hotlist owner, or on a custom role with edit/delete permission. Also, check your plan (Business or otherwise) and your role permissions. Resolution path: Ask your admin or account owner to grant you a custom role with permission to edit or delete the hotlist owned by other teammates. If you are not on a plan that supports this, request the hotlist owner or account owner to make the changes or delete it. Problem: Candidates still appear in your database after deleting a hotlist.

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: Likely cause: Deleting a hotlist does not delete the records inside the hotlist. What to check: Confirm whether you deleted only the hotlist or also deleted candidates via the hotlist. Resolution path: If you want to delete candidates, open the hotlist, select the candidates, and click on the Delete button under the More tab. Remember this permanently deletes them from your database. Yes. You can further streamline your hotlist management by utilizing the search bar to quickly locate a specific hotlist or applying filters based on parameters such as Created by , Created on , and Updated on .

chunks.t: How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists?
chunks.x: Using hotlists in Recruit CRM allows you to group similar records, perform powerful bulk actions, and collaborate efficiently with your team. You can easily access, edit, rename, delete, and manage hotlists and their records as long as you have the right permissions. How can I create and access my hotlists? (New UI) How do I Edit/Rename/Delete my hotlists? (New UI)

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Posting all your jobs from Recruit CRM to Indeed can be automated in minutes. Please note that you need to sponsor your jobs on Indeed. Free posting is not allowed as per Indeed's guidelines. How to get a job posted on the Indeed XML Feed Note: All new and existing accounts are required to verify the account starting January 1, 2025. The first step is to make sure your account is verified with Recruit CRM from the account management settings. Here, fill in all the account information and click on "Verify Account". In case, the auto-verification fails, you have the option to send a manual request to our team.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once the account is verified, you will receive an in-app notification and email notification that your account is enabled for job postings on Indeed. In case you update any account information, you will have to verify the account again. 2. Making sure your jobs meet Indeed's publishing criteria Please note that users on Recruit CRM's free plan can not integrate with Indeed. Criteria to push the jobs to the XML feed 1. The job application form should be enabled; 2. The Updated On date should be within the last 30 days;

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 3. All the fields where you see the message "Required To Post On Partner Job Boards" (City, State, Country, Maximum Salary, Job Description, Currency, Salary Type) need to have a value; Adding city, state, country, and postal code fields is mandatory only if the job type is hybrid or onsite. If it's remote it's not mandatory. 4. 'Note for candidates' should be filled in (only if the Job Description is uploaded as a file); 5. The "Post On Job Boards" option should be selected inside Admin Settings >> Job Custom Fields ; 6. The job status should not be 'closed', 'on hold' or 'canceled';

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 7. Jobs posted on Indeed should be EEO complaint. Discrimination on the basis of age, sex, marital status, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, or disability is not tolerated. Discrimination based on language is not permitted either. If point 7 is not complied with, it could result in a ban of your with Indeed. 8. The job description should be well-formed with at least 300 characters. Emojis are not allowed in the description and the title. 9. You need to sponsor your jobs on Indeed. Free posting is not allowed as per the Indeed guidelines. Recruit CRM can take action against accounts if any spam or fraudulent job is posted to Indeed.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Only the job types full-time and part-time are mapped to the Indeed field. Experience is considered as minimum experience. For instance, if you add 5 years on Recruit CRM, on Indeed it will reflect as 5+ years. Salary description on Indeed is based on how salary fields are added: If Max salary = Min Salary, the salary field will have a single value (e.g., "Pay: $15 per hour"). If Max salary > Min salary, the salary field will have a range between two amounts (e.g., "Pay: $10-15 per hour"). If only Min salary is present, the salary field will have “from” (e.g., "Pay: From $10 per hour"). if only Max salary is present, the salary field will have “up to” (e.g., "Pay: up to $10 per hour").

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If you don't want to share salary information this field can be left blank and salary will not appear on the XML feed. 3. Select "Indeed" under the XML Feeds section You have the ability to selectively push job postings to specific XML feeds. While adding/editing a job, you'll get an option to select the XML feeds from both the default and custom XML feeds that you have built, provided the 'Post on Job Board' option is enabled from the Job Fields settings . While creating a new job or editing an existing one, make sure you select "Indeed" in the XML Feeds section to get your jobs posted on the correct XML Feed. ​

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: By selecting the appropriate XML feeds, you can ensure that your jobs reach the intended audience through the most relevant job boards. You also have the option to preselect the XML feeds in the Build Job Feed XML page. This means the XML Feed will automatically be selected for all the new jobs created. ​ If you don't want a job to be automatically posted on the Indeed XML Feed you can simply disable the preselection on the Build Job Feed XML or uncheck the XML Feed while creating/editing the job: The jobs will be indexed to Indeed and other external boards only if the requirements given above are met. After fulfilling the necessary criteria, the jobs will be visible on the Indeed XML Feed.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The next step is to copy and integrate the XML Feed URL with Indeed. 1. To access the XML feed, go to Admin Settings >>>> Build Job Feed XML . 2. Click on the XML Feed URL for Indeed. ​ 3. You'll be redirected to a new page with the XML Feed page source. Copy the URL and submit it to your Indeed account manager. First, an Indeed account must be created for the integration to work. If you have a paid Indeed account, you'll have a dedicated account manager and can share the XML feed with them directly. How to verify which jobs are being pushed to the Indeed XML Feed You can check the list of jobs being pushed to Indeed's XML Feed by going to Admin Settings >>>>>> Build Job Feed XML .

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Here you can click on "View Listed Jobs" to get a list of all the jobs in your account that currently meet the required criteria: You can also run an Advanced Search inside the Jobs List Page to see all the jobs that have been posted on Indeed (including old jobs that are no longer being pushed to the XML feed). ​ If one of your jobs is not on the list, one of the necessary criteria is not being met. Applicants will be auto-directed to your Recruit CRM Job Application forms and they will be directly added to your Recruit CRM database. How will you get applications for the jobs? When a candidate fills out the application form, you'll be notified in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can see all the website applicants on the candidate list page . You can also specifically look for Indeed applicant candidates in your database by enabling the Source field in Candidate Fields : ​ With the Source field, you'll be able to track the origin of how the candidate was added to the system. If the candidate applies externally, the name of the job board will be mentioned in the field: ​ You can even run an Advanced Search on the Source field: Feel free to reach out if you have any questions! Happy recruiting :) How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM Integrating Recruit CRM with your LogicMelon account How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages
chunks.x: With our handy 'Passcode' feature, you can ensure that your external pages remain secure and accessible only to authorized individuals. Account Owners and Admins can now enable or disable passcodes independently for the Profile Update Request Form and Candidate Submission Links. Passcodes can include numbers, letters, and special characters, with a length requirement of 4 to 12 characters. Users with edit permissions can set unique passcodes for individual jobs in the Candidate Pipeline tab. How to set a passcode for Profile Update Request Forms? 🔢 1. Navigate to the Admin Settings and click on Account under Account Management Settings.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages
chunks.x: 2. Set your passcode under the Request Update/Profile Update Forms tab and hit 'Save Passcode'. How to set a passcode for the Online Candidate List link? 🔢 1. Navigate to the Admin Settings and click on Account under Account Management Settings. 2. Set your passcode under the 'Online Candidate List Pages' tab and hit 'Save Passcode'. Note: If the account-level passcode is updated, it will apply to all the jobs except those with custom job-specific passcodes. How to create unique passcodes for individual jobs? 1. Click on the specific job, and under the 'Candidate Pipeline' tab, you can set your passcode for the job. 2. Click on the save ☑️ icon to save the passcode.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages
chunks.x: Which external pages would ask for a passcode? This Passcode will be required to access the following links: ​ Online Candidate list submitted to the client 1. Go to the Jobs list page and select the appropriate job to be shared with the client. 2. Click on the ' Submit Candidates ' button to submit a list of candidates to the contact associated with that job. When a client receives an email, they will receive a list of candidates that can be accessed only by entering the passcode you shared. Click here to know more about Submit Candidate feature 2. Select a bunch of candidates whose profiles seem to be outdated.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages
chunks.x: When a candidate receives an email, they will receive a link to their Recruit CRM profile that can be accessed only by entering the passcode you shared. chunks.t: Turning Off Email Reminders
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Notification Settings allow you to control which email notifications Recruit CRM sends to you. From your profile settings, you can choose whether to receive email reminders for tasks and meetings, as well as the daily applications report that summarizes applications received within the last 24 hours. When these settings are turned off, Recruit CRM stops sending the corresponding email notifications to your inbox while the underlying tasks, meetings, and application data remain available within the platform. • You do not want to receive email reminders for tasks/meetings in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Turning Off Email Reminders
chunks.x: • You do not want to receive the daily applications summary email. Turn Off Email Reminders for Tasks and Meetings If you no longer want to receive email reminders for your tasks, meetings, or both: Click your Profile icon in the top-right corner of Recruit CRM and select Profile . Locate the Notification Settings section on the right side of the page. • Tasks – Stops email reminders for tasks. • Meetings – Stops email reminders for scheduled meetings. You can disable either notification type individually or turn off both, depending on your preference.

chunks.t: Turning Off Email Reminders
chunks.x: The Daily Email Report is a report you'll receive every morning between 8-10 am, essentially a list of all your website, job boards, and talent pool applications/ Recruit CRM profile submissions from the last 24 hours. Only the account owners and admins receive the daily email reports for ALL the website, job boards, and talent pool applicants when the toggle is turned ON from their respective profile settings. Users other than the account owner and admins will get the email reports for all the applicants that apply to the jobs they own OR are collaborator on. Once the toggle is turned off, Recruit CRM will stop sending the daily report email. What is the daily email report in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Turning Off Email Reminders
chunks.x: The daily email report is an email sent every morning between 8 to 10 AM, listing all website, job board, and talent pool applications or Recruit CRM profile submissions from the last 24 hours. Who receives the daily email report by default? Account owners and admins receive daily email reports for all website, job board, and talent pool applicants when the toggle is turned on in their profile. Other users receive reports only for applicants to jobs they own or are collaborators on. Do these settings affect other users’ reminders or reports? No. The toggles in your profile’s Notification Settings affect only your own email reminders and daily email reports.

chunks.t: Turning Off Email Reminders
chunks.x: Will turning off the daily email report delete any application data? No. Turning off the daily email report only stops the summary email. All applications remain available inside Recruit CRM. You can control your inbox by adjusting task reminders, meeting reminders, and the daily email report directly from your profile’s Notification Settings in Recruit CRM. chunks.t: Linking Candidates & Contacts That Are The Same Person
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? In recruitment, it’s quite common to come across situations where a candidate you’re working with later becomes a client, or a client you’ve been in touch with decides to look for new opportunities as a candidate. This feature in Recruit CRM lets you connect a candidate record and a contact record that represent the same person. ​ To make handling such scenarios simple, Recruit CRM gives you three easy options: Link an existing candidate and contact – If both records belong to the same person, you can link them together. Create a candidate from a contact – Turn an existing client or contact into a new candidate profile.

chunks.t: Linking Candidates & Contacts That Are The Same Person
chunks.x: Create a contact from a candidate – Convert an existing candidate into a new client or contact record. Once you’ve linked the records, you can then access and view the associated “Linked Record” from both candidate and contact profiles. 1. Go to a Candidate or Contact Record. Click on the "Link To Contact/Candidate" button in the header section. ​ If the Candidate or Contact record you wish to link is already in the system you can search for it or you can just hit the blue "Add Contact" or "Add Candidate" button to create a new record and automatically link it. Once you hit the green "Link Contact" or "Link Candidate" button in the pop-up, the 2 records will be linked.

chunks.t: Linking Candidates & Contacts That Are The Same Person
chunks.x: After linking, the candidate and contact profiles are connected you can navigate between the linked records directly. ​ Note: If you wish to unlink them, just click on the button "Contact Linked" or "Candidate Linked" button and then click on the 'Unlink' option: Now, if you wish to delete them as a contact but still leave them as a candidate and vice versa, you can simply delete them as a normal record. Although both are linked, contacts and candidates are different entities, so if you delete one, it won't delete the other. 🔍 Identifying Candidates Who Are Also Contacts From the Candidates List Page , click on the name of the candidate to open their profile.

chunks.t: How to Share Candidates and Other Records With Teammates/Users in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Recruit CRM lets you share any record with any user by mentioning them in the note section of that record. When you mention a teammate using the at symbol (@) in a note, Recruit CRM sends that user an email that includes the note details and a direct link to the record. Check out this article on how the mention feature works. For restricted users, access to that record still follows restricted‑access rules. The Restricted Access role is generally used by companies to grant access to RPO Clients & Freelance/Part-Time Teammates.

chunks.t: How to Share Candidates and Other Records With Teammates/Users in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: While Inviting your teammates to Recruit CRM, you set their Roles (Recruiter or Admin) and Access (Full Access or Restricted Access). They will only be able to open the shared record if they already have permission to view it, typically by being a collaborator on the related job or by having added the data themselves. Make sure the teammate you want to share records with has a Recruit CRM user account with the correct role and access level (full access or restricted access). Understand that restricted users can only see data they added themselves, or candidates assigned to jobs where they are added as collaborators on the job.

chunks.t: How to Share Candidates and Other Records With Teammates/Users in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If you want a restricted user to work on a specific job or its candidates, you must add them as a collaborator on that job first. Open the record you want to share (for example, a candidate or another type of record). ​ Type a new note and use the at symbol (@) followed by your teammate’s name to mention them in the note. ​ Save the note. Recruit CRM will send the mentioned user an email with the note details and a link to the record. Give a restricted user access by adding them as a collaborator: Open the job you want the restricted user to access. ​ In the job view, select the Edit Job action. ​ In the Edit Job form, locate the collaborator section. ​

chunks.t: How to Share Candidates and Other Records With Teammates/Users in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Start typing the restricted user’s name in the collaborator section and select them from the list. ​ Save the job. Once added as a collaborator, the restricted user will have access to that job and the candidates assigned to it. What restricted users see and what happens on access errors: A user with restricted access will get an error message when they try to access the data that is not available for them. ​ Here you can see the list of Jobs inside the login of a user with " Restricted Access ", They have access to jobs & Candidates inside while they are not "Owners" because they have been added as collaborators on those jobs.

chunks.t: How to Share Candidates and Other Records With Teammates/Users in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: Recruit CRM offers flexible subscription plans that let you choose the features, billing cycle, and account capacity that best suit your recruitment team's needs. You can select from Pro , Business , and Enterprise plans, choose monthly or annual billing , manage record limits for candidates, contacts, companies, and jobs, and purchase additional record capacity i.e, data add-ons, without adding user seats. Recruit CRM offers three plans designed for teams of different sizes: Click here to explore the features included in our Pro plan! Click here to explore the features included in our Business plan! Click here to explore the features included in the Enterprise plan!

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: You can check the pricing for each plan from here: Recruit CRM Pricing With monthly billing, you're charged for your provisioned seats at the beginning of your billing cycle every month. The Annual billing option charges you a discounted per-month rate upfront for the whole year. Although you have the flexibility to reassign deactivated seats to new users, it's important to understand that we do not offer refunds or credits for unused time on these seats. The currency and the amount you pay will differ depending on the country in which your company is based. Is it possible to switch between the plans? You can change/review your current plan anytime by going to the Plans in Admin Settings.

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: Click here to learn how to switch or upgrade your plan! For any switch you make, the immediate charges will be calculated on a pro-rated basis for the remaining days in your billing cycle. The full cost of the new plan will only be charged when your account renews in the next billing cycle. What are the record limits for each plan? The candidate, company, and contact limits shown above are calculated per user and then the per-user limit is multiplied by the number of users to determine the account's overall record capacity. • Pro Plan : If your account has 3 users , your total record limit will be 30,000 Candidates, 30,000 Companies, and 30,000 Contacts (10,000 × 3 users).

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: • Business Plan : If your account has 5 users , your total record limit will be 100,000 Candidates, 100,000 Companies, and 100,000 Contacts (20,000 × 5 users). • Enterprise Plan : If your account has 10 users , your total record limit will be 300,000 Candidates, 300,000 Companies, and 300,000 Contacts (30,000 × 10 users). Record limits are calculated at the account level , not at the individual user level . All users share the same combined pool of Candidate, Company, and Contact records.

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: The per-user limit does not cap how many records a single user can create inside the system. Any user with the required permissions can create more records, provided the account has not reached its total record limit. If you need to increase the data limit on your account, we have your back with our 'Additional Records Limit'! An 'Additional Records Limit' is a monthly add-on to your subscription. It allows you to increase the storage limits for your account by adding 10,000 more candidates, contacts, and company records each, without you having to pay for a complete additional user. The Add-Ons will also sync with the account renewal dates.

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: If 3 add-ons of $25 each are subscribed to on the 20th of the month and the renewal date is the 1st, only one-third of the amount (prorated) i.e., $25, will be charged immediately. On the 1st of next month, the entire amount of $75 will be charged along with the user subscription fee. A similar prorated calculation will be done for the annual purchase of Add-ons. Click here to learn how to purchase an add-on! Please note that any changes to the account or any payment-related issues should be done/communicated to us before the renewal date to avoid getting charged on your renewal.

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: Upon cancellation of your account, you will not incur any charges from the next billing date onward. However, it's important to note that as per our Terms and Conditions , no refunds will be issued for any unused portion of your subscription. Q1. What plans does Recruit CRM offer? Recruit CRM currently offers three plans: Pro, Business, and Enterprise. Q2. How does monthly billing work? With monthly billing, you are charged for your provisioned seats at the beginning of your billing cycle every month.

chunks.t: Managing Your Recruit CRM Subscription
chunks.x: Q3. Can I get a refund if I deactivate a user or cancel early? No. While you can reassign deactivated seats to new users, Recruit CRM does not offer refunds or credits for unused time on those seats or for any unused portion of your subscription after cancellation. Managing your Recruit CRM subscription effectively means understanding your plan options, billing cycle, record limits, and cancellation terms so you can align the system with your recruitment needs and budget. If you have specific questions about your account, billing, or limits, reach out to Recruit CRM support for tailored assistance. Updating or Changing Your Recruit CRM Subscription/Account Plan

chunks.t: Follow-up Tasks
chunks.x: One of the most important things a recruitment professional needs to do to be successful is follow up with candidates & clients. Recruit CRM lets you set follow-up tasks for all your essential activities so, you don't ever miss anything even remotely important. Recruit CRM offers you a " Create Follow-Up Task" button on pretty much every possible action like sending emails, creating call logs or notes, changing hiring stages, etc. You can create follow-up tasks in the following events: You can create a follow-up task while sending an email to candidates/contacts.

chunks.t: Follow-up Tasks
chunks.x: Please Note: When sending bulk email and creating follow-up task, you will be able to see a toggle in the create follow-up task popup. When toggled ON it creates a follow-up task for all the recipients, and when OFF, it will create a follow-up task for the first recipient only. When you move a candidate from one Hiring Stage to another, you get an option to create a follow-up task. It is important to add notes on candidates to let your team know what is happening. You get an option of Creating a follow-up task on every note you add for any candidate. ​ While speaking to a candidate or contact you can add call notes inside the call log section and there too you can create a follow-up task ​

chunks.t: Parsing Failed
chunks.x: Recruit CRM uses a proprietary Resume Parser to help recruiters add candidates into the system faster. You can check these articles How does the resume parser work and Resume parsing on Recruit CRM to learn more about how it actually works! Recruit CRM only supports .DOC/.DOCX/.PDF file types for Resume Parsing, and will return an error message if the file type is anything other than the 3 mentioned above. ​ There could be multiple reasons why parsing fails, Below are some of the common reasons: Recruit CRM's Resume Parser does not support any file type other than PDF, Doc & Docx. If a Resume/CV is scanned and stored in any other format, it will Not Be Parsed.

chunks.t: Parsing Failed
chunks.x: ​ 2. If a Resume/CV file (.DOC/.DOCX/.PDF) contains images inside The parser might not parse data from the .DOC/.PDF file if the document has an image embedded in it. ​ While, OCR files are also supported by our resume parser, in some cases, parsing might fail for OCR files (image file converted to PDF). If your internet connection drops or your upload speed is slow while parsing, it can also break the parsing process and lead to a failed parse. You can try parsing after some time when your internet connection is stable. You can check download & upload speeds at https://www.speedtest.net/ ​ ​ Hope this helped :)

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Merge feature in Recruit CRM allows you to combine duplicate candidate, contact, company, or job records into a single primary record, helping maintain a clean and accurate database. When records are merged, the primary record is retained while the duplicate record is removed, reducing confusion in reporting, communication, and day-to-day operations. This feature is particularly useful when: Duplicate records are created through CSV/Excel imports or manual data entry. The same candidate, contact, or company exists with different email addresses, phone numbers, or other contact details.

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: You need to consolidate duplicate records to maintain a clean and accurate database. Duplicate records can be created in the following scenarios: The same candidate, contact, or company is added multiple times using different email addresses, phone numbers, or other unique identifiers. A CSV or Excel file containing duplicate entries is imported into Recruit CRM more than once. The same company is added under slightly different names, such as Apple Inc. and Apple Incorporation . The Allow Duplicates setting is enabled in Account Management Settings , allowing duplicate records to be created. The process for merging candidates, contacts, and companies is the same.

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: Navigate to the candidate, contact, or company record that you want to keep as the primary record . Click the three-dot menu located in the top-right corner of the record and select Merge . If you are unable to see the merge candidate option, then you have to first make it visible by customizing the options. ​ Click here to explore how you can customise the Candidate Actions for Quick Access view In the merge window, search for and select the duplicate record that you would like to merge into the primary record.

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: Please Note- When a merge is completed, the secondary record is permanently deleted from the system and cannot be restored. Please verify that you have selected the correct primary and duplicate records before proceeding. Once you have selected the duplicate record, click Merge to begin the merge process. Recruit CRM will display a confirmation message indicating that the merge request has been initiated. After the merge is processed, you will receive a notification confirming that the records have been successfully combined.

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: During the merge process, only empty fields in the primary record are updated with data from the secondary record. Any existing information in the primary record remains unchanged and will not be overwritten. It's also possible to merge jobs in Recruit CRM! How Recruit CRM Detects Duplicate Records Recruit CRM automatically checks for duplicate records when new candidates, contacts, or companies are added to your database. How duplicates are handled depends on the Allow Duplicates setting in your Account Management Settings . The following fields are used to identify duplicates: Email Address, Phone Number, LinkedIn Profile URL Company Name, Website URL, LinkedIn Profile URL

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: Recruit CRM checks new records against existing records in your database. If a match is found, the existing record is updated instead of creating a duplicate. Recruit CRM allows duplicate records to be created, even when matching information already exists in the database. Problem : A duplicate record was created even though details match. Likely cause: The “Allow Duplicate” setting is turned On. What to check: Open Account Management and confirm the toggle for "Allow duplicates" is set to off. Resolution: If you want to prevent automatic duplicate creation, set “Allow Duplicate” to Off. Then manually merge any existing duplicates. 1. What happens to the secondary record after merging?

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: The secondary record is permanently deleted from Recruit CRM once the merge is complete. Its data is combined into the primary record. 2. What happens to a candidate’s hiring stage when two candidates are merged? When duplicate candidate records are merged, assignment histories from both records are preserved to maintain a complete view of the candidate’s journey.

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: If both records contain assignments for the same job, all unique stage histories are retained under the Candidate History tab. When the same stage exists in both records, the system keeps the entry with the older Stage Updated On date. Any stage containing client feedback or internal remarks is always retained, even if the hiring stage appears duplicated. The candidate’s current hiring stage for a job is determined based on the stage with the most recent assignment date. These retained histories are also reflected in Candidate Lifecycle Reports , ensuring accurate reporting and full visibility after a merge.

chunks.t: Merging duplicate records
chunks.x: Merging duplicate records helps keep your Recruit CRM database clean, organized, and accurate. By understanding how duplicate detection works and using the Merge feature when needed, you can prevent duplicate entries, maintain complete record histories, and ensure reliable reporting across your account. chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Need to quickly loop in a teammate on a record? Use mentions to notify them instantly and avoid back-and-forth. The Mention feature in Recruit CRM lets you tag teammates or teams directly in notes on the records. When you mention someone, they receive an email notification that includes a direct link to the record where you added the note. You want to quickly alert a teammate about an update on a candidate, company, contact, or job record. You need a direct link to a specific record included in an email notification. Open the relevant candidate, company, contact, or job record where you want to collaborate. ​ Type your note and enter the @ symbol to start a mention. ​

chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Select the teammate you want to mention from the available options. Click + Add Note to save the note with the mention attached. ​ The mentioned teammate will receive an email notification containing a link to the record. ​ The teammate can click the View Mention button in the email to open the specific record in Recruit CRM. If you are on the Business plan or above , you can mention teams in notes by typing @ and selecting the relevant team. You can mention any team, even if you are not a member of that team. When you mention a teammate or team, Recruit CRM sends an email notification with a link to the record where the mention was added.

chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If it is the recipient's first mention email, they may need to check their Spam/Junk folder and mark it as Not Spam to ensure future mention notifications reach their inbox. Recipients can reply directly to the mention email to start an email thread with the person who mentioned them, or click View Mention to open the relevant record in Recruit CRM. A mention does not change the tagged user's existing record permissions . The tagged user can view the note in Recruit CRM only if their role has View Everything access. If the tagged user does not have the required access, they may still receive the mention email but may not be able to view the note or record in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Problem: A mentioned teammate does not receive the email notification. Likely cause: The email was filtered into spam or junk. ​ What to check: Ask the teammate to look for the mention email in their spam or junk folder. ​ Resolution: The teammate should mark the mention email as not spam so future mention notifications appear directly in their inbox. Problem: A tagged user cannot see the note in Recruit CRM after being mentioned.

chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: Their role does not have “view everything” access. ​ What to check: Confirm the user’s role and its access level, specifically whether “view everything” access is enabled. ​ Resolution: An Account Owner should adjust the role to have “view everything” access if appropriate, so the tagged user can view the note. Problem: A user on the account cannot mention teams. Likely cause: The account is not on the business plan or above. ​ What to check: Verify the current plan and confirm whether it is the business plan or above. ​ Resolution: Upgrade to the business plan or above if team mentions are required. Q1: Where can I use mentions in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can use mentions in the notes section of any record such as candidate, company, contact, or job. Q2: What happens when I mention a teammate in a note? The mentioned teammate receives an email notification that includes a link to the specific record where the note with the mention was added. Q3: Can I mention teams as well as individual teammates? Yes. If you are on the business plan and above, you can mention teams in notes, and you can mention any team even if you do not belong to that team. Q4: How can a mentioned teammate respond to a mention email?

chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: They can reply directly to the email to start an email thread with the teammate who mentioned them, or click the “View Mention” button in the email to open the record in Recruit CRM. Q5: How do I make sure mention emails do not go to spam? The first time a teammate receives a mention email, they may need to mark it as not spam in their email client. After that, future mention notifications should appear in the inbox.

chunks.t: Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Mentions in notes help your team collaborate faster in Recruit CRM by sending targeted email notifications that link directly to specific records, while respecting role-based visibility and plan-specific options. If you need further help using mentions for your workflow, contact your Recruit CRM support for additional guidance. chunks.t: Transferring ownership of records
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Transfer Ownership feature allows you to transfer record ownership from one user to another within Recruit CRM. This helps ensure that important records are actively managed and assigned to the appropriate team member when users leave the organization, are deactivated, change roles, or when teams are being restructured. • A team member leaves your organization and their records need to be reassigned. • A user is deactivated, and you want their records transferred to an active user. • You are restructuring teams and need to consolidate records under a different owner.

chunks.t: Transferring ownership of records
chunks.x: • You want to maintain continuity and ensure all records have an active owner responsible for managing them. ↔️ How to transfer the ownership of records in Recruit CRM? Follow the steps below to transfer records from one user to another in Recruit CRM: Navigate to Admin Settings and under Account Management , click Users . Locate the user whose records you want to transfer. • Filter users by Active or Deactivated status • Use the search bar to quickly find a user by name Once you have found the user, click the Pencil option next to their profile. On the Edit User tab, click on the Transfer button at the bottom right corner of the tab.

chunks.t: Transferring ownership of records
chunks.x: On the transfer screen, select the user who should become the new owner of the records. Once the transfer is completed successfully, a confirmation message will be displayed. After the transfer is complete, all records owned by the original user will be reassigned to the selected user, ensuring continued ownership and management of those records. Problem: You are unable to access the transfer option. Likely cause: You may not be in the correct section or may not have access to Admin Settings. What to check: •Confirm you are in Admin Settings > Users under Account Management .

chunks.t: Transferring ownership of records
chunks.x: •Confirm you have the necessary access level to view and manage users. ​ Resolution: •Navigate to the correct area and locate the user again. •If you still cannot see the transfer option, contact your account owner or administrator for appropriate access. Can I transfer records from a deactivated user? Yes. You can filter users by activated or deactivated status and then transfer records from either type of user. How can I quickly find a specific user to transfer records from? Use the search bar on the Users page and type the user’s name, or apply filters based on their activated or deactivated status. What happens after I click Submit on the transfer screen?

chunks.t: Transferring ownership of records
chunks.x: After you select the target user and click Submit , the records owned by the original user are reassigned to the user you selected. Do I need to reactivate a user to transfer their records? No. You can transfer records from users regardless of whether they are active or deactivated by using the status filters. Transferring ownership of records in Recruit CRM helps you manage team changes without losing track of important data. Deactivating an existing user & inviting a new user to your current plan How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM's Reporting Suite provides a comprehensive set of reports to help you monitor performance, analyze business activity, and make informed, data-driven decisions. You can generate reports on candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, deals, clients, and teammates, giving you valuable insights into every stage of your recruitment process. • You need an Account Overview report to understand overall business activity and performance. • You want a Team Performance report to monitor individual teammate or team performance. • You need a Candidate Lifecycle report to track candidate progression through your hiring pipeline.

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM
chunks.x: • You want Client Performance or Job Statistics reports to evaluate how your clients and jobs are performing. • You need reports such as Time to Hire , Deals by Teammates/Teams , or Deals by Revenue to measure hiring efficiency, pipeline health, and revenue performance. The Reporting Suite provides interactive charts, detailed tables, drill-down capabilities, and export options across all reports, making it easy to analyze your data from multiple perspectives. Reports are generated using the actual timestamps of activities and are adjusted according to each user's profile time zone, ensuring accurate reporting based on your account settings.

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM
chunks.x: ✅ When generating reports in Recruit CRM, it's crucial to remember the following key points: 1. Only the users on the Account Owner, Admin, and custom roles with relevant permissions will have access to the Reports section in Recruit CRM. 2. Recruit CRM's Reports feature is designed to run based on the actual timestamp of actions, taking into consideration the time zone specified in each user's Profile section. This means that if your team members are dispersed across various locations, there's a possibility of slight timing discrepancies in your reports.

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM
chunks.x: For instance, consider a scenario where a user with the time zone set to Australia generates a report for just one day. In this case, the results will reflect actions that occurred on that specific day in the Australian time zone. Consequently, it's entirely possible to observe actions performed by a user in New York on the preceding day, as it would have already been the current day in Australia due to the time zone difference. 📊 What are the different types of reports you can generate?

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM
chunks.x: To access the available reports, navigate to the Reports section from the left-hand navigation panel. Here, you'll find the complete list of reports available to you based on your subscription plan and user permissions. From this page, you can generate, customize, save, and schedule reports to analyze different aspects of your recruitment process. ​ Please note that the users in the "Team Member" role will only be able to see their performance report on the Dashboard . ​ 🕘 How to schedule reports in Recruit CRM? With our "Schedule Report" feature, you can effortlessly automate the delivery of your saved reports to users at the frequency that suits your workflow.

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Problem: Report shows actions on unexpected dates Likely cause: Time zone differences between users. What to check : Confirm the time zone set in your user profile and the time zones of teammates whose actions appear in the report. Resolution: Interpret the report dates based on the time zone in your profile. Remember that actions from users in other time zones may appear on the previous or next day compared to their local time. Problem: A user cannot access the reports section Likely cause: Insufficient role or permissions. What to check : Verify whether the user is an account owner, admin, or has a custom role with relevant permissions.

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Resolution : Update the user’s role or permissions so they meet the requirement for accessing the reports section, or have an Admin run and share the reports instead. Problem: Team member cannot see all reports Likely cause: Role limitation for team members. What to check: Confirm that the user is assigned the team member role. Resolution: Team members can only see their team performance report on the dashboard. For broader reporting access, consider changing their role or having an admin share required reports. Problem: Scheduled reports are not useful due to timing discrepancies Likely cause : Scheduled time does not align with relevant time zones.

chunks.t: Reports In Recruit CRM

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Radius search in Recruit CRM lets you find records (candidates, contacts, companies, or jobs) that are located within a specific distance from a chosen address or location. Use radius search in Recruit CRM when you want to: Find candidates or contacts who live within a certain distance of a client’s office or job location. Identify local talent around a specific landmark, city centre, or address. Filter jobs or companies by physical location proximity. Combine location-based filters with skill, role, or other criteria for targeted sourcing.

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Once radius search is enabled, users who can access those entities (candidates, contacts, companies, jobs) can use radius search on them. The Radius Search feature in Recruit CRM is powered by Google Maps which works well if you have a candidate/contact's address available inside the "Full Address" field of the candidate/contact. The Radius Search relies on accurate geocoding based on the "Full Address" field, which maps records to precise geographical locations. Step 1 - Enable radius search for your records: Only Account Owners, Admins, and users with custom permissions can perform these steps. Go to Admin Settings in your Recruit CRM account.

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Scroll down until you find the Radius Search Settings area. For each entity type where you want to use radius search (such as Candidates, Contacts, Companies, Jobs), switch the toggle to On. Radius search only works for record types where the radius search toggle is turned on in Admin Settings. Adding a full address through a CSV import does not automatically make those records available for radius search unless the relevant toggle is enabled, allowing the system to geocode the addresses. If you plan to import a large number of records and then run radius searches on them, you should inform us so we can help with the process and ensure geocoding is handled correctly.

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Step 2 - Prepare your list view for radius search: Navigate to the entity you want to search, for example, Candidates. In the list view, locate the small pencil icon next to the Resume Parser button. Click the pencil icon to edit the visible columns in your list view. In the column selection panel, find and tick the “Full Address” field. Save or apply your column changes so that the Full Address field is visible on the list view. ​ Step 3 - Run a radius search from Advanced/Filter Search: Go to the relevant module, for example, the Candidates page. Click on Advanced Search or Filter Search. In the search/filter panel, locate the Full Address field.

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: In the Radius Search option, start typing the location you want to search around. As you type, review the suggestions that appear under the Full Address field. Select the correct address from the dropdown suggestions. Once the location is selected, choose the radius (for example, 10 km) around that location. Optionally, add other filters along with the radius search, such as: Job title or keywords (e.g., “iOS Developer”). After setting your radius and additional filters in the Advanced/Filter Search panel, click Apply Filters and Save Search . Give the saved search a clear, descriptive name.

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Save it so you can quickly re-run the same radius-based search in the future without re-entering the filters. Problem: Radius search returns fewer records than expected Likely cause: Some records do not have a valid or complete Full Address, or geocoding has not occurred for those records. Confirm the Full Address field is visible in the list view and check if addresses are present. Verify that addresses are complete enough for Google Maps (e.g., street, city, state/region, postal code, country where applicable). Check if radius search is enabled for that entity type in Admin Settings > Account > Radius Search Settings. Problem: Radius search results do not match the expected area

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Likely cause: The starting location selected from the suggestions is not the correct one, or the addresses on the records are inaccurate. Confirm that you chose the correct location from the suggestions in the Full Address field (for example, if multiple cities share the same name). Review sample records in the results to verify that their Full Address values are accurate and correspond to the intended region. Re-run the search and carefully choose the correct address from the dropdown suggestions. Correct inaccurate addresses in the Full Address field on records. Run the radius search again to confirm that the results match the intended geographic area.

chunks.t: How to Use Radius Search in Recruit CRM?
chunks.x: Radius search in Recruit CRM gives you a powerful, Google Maps–powered way to find candidates, contacts, companies, and jobs based on real-world proximity, as long as your Full Address data is complete and the feature is enabled correctly. chunks.t: Verifying Your Email ID
chunks.x: Email verification in Recruit CRM confirms that the email address used during sign-up is valid and accurate. You can verify your account by clicking the verification link sent to your email. Verify your email address through the verification email Once you sign up for Recruit CRM, a verification email is automatically sent to your registered email address. Look for an email from Recruit CRM support@recruitcrm.io with the subject line Recruit CRM: Verify Your Email ID . Open the email and click the verification link to complete the verification process. If you do not see the email in your inbox, check your spam or junk folder.

chunks.t: Verifying Your Email ID
chunks.x: If you still have not received the verification email, use the Resend Verification Email option on the verification screen to request a new verification email. If the email address entered during sign-up is incorrect, update the email address and request a new verification email. Important Note: If you still have trouble finding the verification email please use the blue “chatbot” icon on the bottom right of your screen to send us a message and we’ll help you out! You can also verify your account using Mobile OTP (One Time Password). With this option, you can enter your phone number to receive a verification code on your mobile. ​ Problem: I did not receive the verification email.

chunks.t: Verifying Your Email ID
chunks.x: Likely cause: The verification email may have been delivered to your spam or junk folder, or the email address entered during sign-up may be incorrect. What to check: Check your inbox, spam, and junk folders, and confirm that the email address entered during sign-up is correct. Resolution: Resend the verification email, update your email address if needed, or use mobile OTP verification as an alternative. By following the steps above, you can verify your email ID. chunks.t: Deals Pipeline
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Deal Pipeline on Recruit CRM lets you keep a tab on all revenue opportunities and "deals" your team is working on. You can create deal stages, customize deal fields, and track any Job, Company, or Contact associated with a deal. The system also maintains deals pipeline metrics that are automatically updated as you create new deals, delete or archive old ones, and move deals through different stages. You want to track all revenue opportunities your team is working on. You need a structured deals pipeline with clear stages. You want to customize deal fields to capture specific information about each deal.

chunks.t: Deals Pipeline
chunks.x: You want to monitor your revenue pipeline on a total and weighted basis. Understanding the Deals Pipeline's Metrics There are 4 metrics you need to take into consideration while keeping track of your Deals in Recruit CRM:​ Represents how much you have earned or will earn according to the deals' current stages in the Deal Pipeline. Represents the sum of the total deals' values, regardless of their stage. Measures the total amount earned on deals in the "won" stage. Measures the total amount lost on deals in the "lost" stage. These metrics are automatically updated as you create new deals, delete/archive old ones, and move the deals through the different stages.

chunks.t: Deals Pipeline
chunks.x: The stages in the Deals Pipeline are responsible for the amount calculated in the Total Weighted Pipeline . Recruit CRM has two default stages in the Deals Pipeline that cannot be removed: You can customize your Deals Pipeline in the Admin Settings. Like every other record type on Recruit CRM, you can customize the data you want to see on deals as well from the "Deals Field" section within admin settings. 2. Choosing Default Deal Fields and Adding Custom Deal Fields You can set Default fields & make them visible and/or mandatory based on your workflow. For any additional information, you want your team to enter on deals, you can use up to 16 custom fields to collect extra information.

chunks.t: Deals Pipeline
chunks.x: Use the 'Deals Pipeline" option to view & customize the stages you'd like to move your deals through within your Workflow. Finalize the stages you'd like to see on your Kanban Board for Deals along with the probability of winning deals at every stage Your Deals Pipeline is now ready to use in both List & Kanban Views! ​ You can now track your revenue pipeline on both a total & weighted basis :) You have the flexibility to view your deal pipeline in both List and Kanban views. In the Kanban view, you can change the deal stage by simply dragging and dropping the deal to the desired stage.

chunks.t: Deals Pipeline
chunks.x: When you change the stage, a pop-up window will appear, allowing you to enter a remark or reason for the stage change. You can also change the deal stage by directly accessing the deal profile. ​ Click on the stage, and the same pop-up window will appear, prompting you to choose a new desired deal stage from the drop-down menu and enter a reason for the change. ​ Afterwards, click on submit, and the deal stage will be updated accordingly. ​ You can view the complete history of changes made to the deal stages, including remarks left, dates of updates, and the user who performed the stage change. Simply click on the remarks icon next to the deal stage to access this information. ​

chunks.t: Deals Pipeline
chunks.x: Problem: Team cannot find specific deal stages on the Kanban board Likely cause: The desired stages have not been configured or finalized for display. What to check: In the deals pipeline settings, review the list of stages and confirm which are included on the Kanban board and their probabilities of winning. Resolution: Customize or change the stages so that all required stages appear on the Kanban board with appropriate probabilities. What are the default stages in the deals pipeline? The deals pipeline in Recruit CRM has two default stages, won and lost, which cannot be removed. Can I customize the stages in my deals pipeline?

chunks.t: Deals Pipeline
chunks.x: Yes. You can use the deals pipeline option in admin settings to view and customize the deal stages you would like to move your deals through within your workflow and to set the probability of winning deals at every stage. How can I see who changed a deal stage and when? Click on the remarks icon next to the deal stage to view the complete history of changes, including remarks, dates of updates, and the user who performed the stage change. By setting up your deal stages, configuring deal fields, and using both list and Kanban views, you can manage your deals pipeline in Recruit CRM and track your revenue opportunities on a total and weighted basis.

chunks.t: Changing The System Language
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The system language (application language) setting controls the language used in the Recruit CRM interface for a specific user account. You can use this feature when you want to work with the Recruit CRM interface in your preferred language. You can enjoy Recruit CRM in the following 12 languages : Languages are displayed in their native form to ensure clarity and consistency across the list. This helps ensure that language options appear more accurately while maintaining the same functionality when selecting your preferred application language.

chunks.t: Changing The System Language
chunks.x: 1. Click the profile icon in the top-right corner of the Recruit CRM screen. Click Profile from the dropdown menu to open your profile page. 2. Scroll down till you find the "Application Language" option and select your preferred language from the list. 3. Click the Green "Save Profile" button and click on the Update/Refresh button to save changes. You're done! Your app is now available in your selected language. You can manually translate all the external forms into any other language: Translating External Forms For Candidates Does changing the system language affect all users in my account?

chunks.t: Changing The System Language
chunks.x: No. The system language (Application Language) setting described here applies to your individual user profile. Other users can choose their own preferred language in their own profiles. By updating the Application Language in your profile, you can use Recruit CRM in any of the eleven supported languages. chunks.t: Job Statistics Report
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Job Statistics Report provides a comprehensive view of how your jobs are performing. You can quickly run a report on all your Jobs with all the available KPIs to have a deeper understanding of whether everything is going as per the plan. This report enables you to compare various jobs and identify those performing exceptionally well. Additionally, you can search for specific jobs and download an Excel file containing the applicants' names and their current stages in the hiring process for the selected job.

chunks.t: Job Statistics Report
chunks.x: The Report includes all notes associated with a job not just those added directly to it. This means any notes originally added to other records (Candidate, company, contactor deal) but linked to the job are also counted, providing a complete view of all job-related activities. ​ • You want to measure the performance of one or more jobs using key hiring KPIs. Generate and Analyze the Job Statistics Report Navigate to the Reports section from the left-hand navigation menu and open the Job Statistics Report . Choose the jobs you want to include in the report. You can generate the report for all jobs or select specific ones.

chunks.t: Job Statistics Report
chunks.x: Use the available filters to quickly find jobs based on their status, including: To include every job in the report, select the checkbox at the top of the job list. Choose the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) you want to analyze. Available KPIs include: Choose the time period for the report. You can select one of the predefined ranges, such as Today, Yesterday, This Week, Last Week, This Month, or Last Quarter , or specify a Custom Date Range by selecting the required start and end dates. If required, select specific team members or teams to view report data only for their activities. After selecting the jobs, KPIs, date range, and team members, click Generate Report .

chunks.t: Job Statistics Report

This saves the report for future use while generating the report immediately. ​ Once the report is generated, you'll see: • A bar chart visualizing the selected KPIs. • Detailed summary tables displaying the report data, including the Fill Rate for each job if the Placed Hiring stage is selected as one of the KPIs. It also counts notes originally added to candidates, companies, contractors, or deals when those notes are linked to the job. How is fill rate calculated in this report?
