chunks.t: How to Select More Than 1000 Records at a Time?
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to perform certain actions in bulk on as many records as you want at once. However, if you're wondering how you can do this if you have more than 1000 records to select, you're at the right place. ​ Just follow these simple steps to easily select more than 1000 records at once! 1. Click the checkbox at the top-left of the ID column to bulk select all the records on the first page. (candidates/contacts/companies/jobs/deals). 2. After the first-page records are selected, click on the Select 1000 Records button to expand your selection to the first 1,000 records.

chunks.t: How to Select More Than 1000 Records at a Time?
chunks.x: 3. Once the first 1,000 records are selected, at the bottom of the page, go to page 41 . On page 41, click the Select 1000 Records button again to select the next batch of 1,000 records. You now have 2,000 records selected in total. 5. Repeat the previous step on page 81 to select the next batch of 1,000 records. ​ Note: Since 1 page contains 25 records, 1000 records are spread over 40 pages. So, just keep adding 40 to your current page number to select the next batch of 1000 records at once. Does this work the same way for candidates, contacts, companies, and jobs?

chunks.t: How to Select More Than 1000 Records at a Time?
chunks.x: Yes. The method of selecting the first page checkbox and using Select Thousand Records works similarly across list views, as long as the button is available in that view By using the Select 1000 Records button in combination with page jumps of 40 pages at a time, you can easily select more than 1,000 records at once in Recruit CRM. chunks.t: How to Archive/Unarchive Jobs?
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Job Archiving feature in Recruit CRM helps you manage jobs more efficiently by moving jobs from the active “All Jobs” list into an archived state while keeping the records accessible in a dedicated “Archived Jobs” view. You can also choose to delete any associated sponsored job campaign during the archiving process. The unarchive feature allows archived jobs to be restored to the active job list whenever needed. This functionality is especially useful when you want to: Clean up your active job list by archiving closed, filled, paused, or inactive roles. Temporarily archive jobs that are on hold and unarchive them later when hiring resumes.

chunks.t: How to Archive/Unarchive Jobs?
chunks.x: Review and restore archived jobs anytime from the dedicated “Archived Jobs” view onto the 'All Jobs' section. You can archive jobs in Recruit CRM either from the Jobs list page or directly from the Job Details page. Go to the Jobs list page and select the job or jobs you want to archive. Click the Archive button. A confirmation pop-up will appear. If any selected job has an associated sponsored job campaign or postings on LogicMelon and Broadbean will be closed by selecting the box 'Close job on External Job Board.' You can also choose to Disable the Job Application form by selecting the box 'Disable Job Application Form.'

chunks.t: How to Archive/Unarchive Jobs?
chunks.x: Click the Archive job to complete the action. The selected jobs will then be archived and removed from the active “All Jobs” list. Open the job and click the three ellipses (three-dot menu) on the Job Details page. From the drop-down menu, select Archive Job . A confirmation pop-up will appear. You can also choose to 'Close Job on External Job Board' and 'Disable Job Application Form' by selecting the boxes. Click Archive Job to complete the action. 1. Once archived, these jobs will not appear on your jobs list. 2. Archived jobs will still be visible in the 'Assigned jobs' section under candidate profiles. How to view archived jobs from the job list page

chunks.t: How to Archive/Unarchive Jobs?
chunks.x: Go to your Jobs list page. In the top-left area of the page, locate the quick view section. Click on Archived jobs in the quick view section. You will see a comprehensive list of all your archived jobs. You can unarchive jobs in Recruit CRM either from the Jobs list page or directly from the Job Details page. Go to the Jobs list page. In the quick view section at the top-left, click Archived Jobs to view all archived jobs. Select the job or jobs you want to restore. The selected jobs will be unarchived and moved back to the active “All Jobs” list. Open the archived job from the Quickview section. Click the three ellipses (three-dot menu) on the page.

chunks.t: How to Archive/Unarchive Jobs?
chunks.x: From the dropdown menu, select Unarchive Job . The job will be restored and will once again appear in the “All Jobs” list and other active job views. 1. Does archiving a job delete it from Recruit CRM? No, archiving a job does not delete it. The job is simply moved from the active jobs list to the Archived Jobs view, where it can still be accessed and unarchived later if needed. Archiving and unarchiving jobs in Recruit CRM helps keep your active job list organized while preserving important job history and associated data. chunks.t: Texting Laws and Consent in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Recruit CRM allows users on the Pro plan and above to send text messages directly to Candidates and Contacts. To use this feature, you'll need to purchase messaging credits. Recruit CRM uses Twilio to power its texting functionality. Before sending any text messages, you are responsible for obtaining the recipient's consent and ensuring that your messages comply with Twilio's Messaging Policy and applicable carrier regulations. The texting feature is currently available only for the following countries: USA, UK, ISRAEL, HONG KONG, CANADA, & SWEDEN. It allows for sending messages within the country, international messaging is currently disabled.

chunks.t: Texting Laws and Consent in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: US-based clients first need to register with Twilio to start texting. Here's how you can do this Users in the UK are required to complete a KYC form in order to use the texting feature. Texting will only be available after the KYC form is submitted and approved. ➡️ Learn more about KYC here . Failed SMS will be chargeable and can be viewed in the message log under Phone Calling and SMS Settings. An important intent of this step is to make sure that messages are sent with the consent of the message recipient, and that those messages comply with applicable laws, communications industry guidelines or standards, and measures of fairness and decency.

chunks.t: Texting Laws and Consent in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Twilio treats all messaging transmitted via Twilio’s platform as Application-to-Person (A2P) messaging. All A2P messages originating from Twilio are subject to this Messaging Policy, which covers rules and /or prohibitions regarding: This policy applies to all our customers who use our texting feature as we integrate texting with Twilio. U.S. Carrier Penalties for Non-Compliant Messaging

chunks.t: Texting Laws and Consent in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: U.S. carriers have created A2P messaging channels, such as shortcodes, Toll-Free numbers, and 10-digit long codes (A2P 10DLC) in order to give senders a sanctioned channel for messaging that will ensure consumers reliably receive wanted messages. A failure to comply with carrier requirements may be subject to carrier penalties. T-Mobile penalties for non-compliant Messaging Content violating carrier policies – as reflected in Twilio's Acceptable Use Policy and/or Messaging Policy – includes spam, phishing, and SHAFT violations (Sex, Hate, Alcohol, Firearms, Tobacco).

chunks.t: Texting Laws and Consent in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Using filtering evasion techniques, such as snowshoeing and recycling numbers (releasing/purchasing new numbers), to dilute number reputation. ​ This article has provided information about the law designed to help Recruit CRM's users better understand the legal issues surrounding texting. Legal information is not the same as legal advice, the application of the law to an individual's specific circumstances. Recruit CRM insists that you consult a lawyer if you want professional assurance that our information, and your interpretation of it, is accurate. chunks.t: How to remove Recruit CRM branding from external pages
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Remove Branding feature helps you control whether Recruit CRM branding appears on your external pages. You can use this feature when: You want to present a fully white-labeled experience to clients and candidates. Your agency or company branding must be the only visible brand on external pages. Note: This feature is available only on the Business plan and Enterprise plan. Follow these steps to remove Recruit CRM branding from your external pages: 1. Go to Admin Settings in your Recruit CRM account and click on ' Account ' under Account Management.

chunks.t: How to remove Recruit CRM branding from external pages
chunks.x: 2. You will find the "Remove Branding" section by scrolling down to the bottom of the page. Turn the toggle "ON" to remove Recruit CRM branding. When you turn the Remove Branding toggle on: Recruit CRM branding is removed from all supported external pages that are accessible to clients and candidates. When you turn the Remove Branding toggle off: Recruit CRM branding is shown on all supported external pages again. This is a single, global setting. chunks.t: How to remove Recruit CRM branding from external pages

It does not change the functionality of your Talent pool page, Public Jobs Page, Job Application forms, Online candidate list links, or Profile Update Request forms. chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The Work and Education History feature lets you store candidates' work or education details as separate categories in their profiles. You can easily add work and education history while adding a candidate by scrolling down the Add Candidate form. You can use this when: You are adding a new candidate and want to capture their work and education history immediately. You want to view all saved work and education details in a single place in the candidate profile. You need to add additional work experience or education entries to an existing candidate. You want to clean up a profile by deleting outdated or incorrect work or education records.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles
chunks.x: You should have access to add and edit candidate records in your account. Have the candidate’s work experience and education details ready (job titles, companies, dates, institutions, degrees, etc.). Remember that work and education details are stored as separate categories under the Work and Education History feature. How to Add Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles 📗 1. Click on the Global Add plus icon in the top-right corner of the screen. This opens the main menu to create a new record. 2. From the dropdown menu, select Candidate to open the Add Candidate form.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles
chunks.x: 3. In the Work History and Education History sections, enter all the required details for the candidate’s work experience and education. These two sections here store candidates' work or education details as separate categories with the Work and Education History feature. 4. When finished, click the Submit button to save the candidate record. How to View Saved Work and Education History in the Candidate Profile? 👀 Once the details are added and the record is saved, open the candidate’s profile. Within the All Details area, locate the Work History and Education History categories.

chunks.t: How to Unassign a Candidate from a Job
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Assigned a candidate to the wrong job? Recruit CRM lets you quickly unassign candidates from a job to keep your hiring pipeline accurate and organized. Unassigning a candidate removes the association between that candidate and the selected job, preventing further progress tracking for a role they should no longer be part of. A candidate was assigned to the wrong job by mistake. You want to clean up a job's candidate pipeline. You need to remove multiple candidates from the same job at once. Unassign a single candidate directly from a job's candidate pipeline. Unassign multiple candidates from the same job in bulk.

chunks.t: How to Unassign a Candidate from a Job
chunks.x: Unassign a candidate from a job through the candidate's profile. Step-by-step instructions to Unassign Candidates Choose the method that fits your situation: unassign one candidate from a job's pipeline, unassign several at once, unassign from a candidate's own profile, or use the steps below if you're on the older interface. Method 1: Unassign a single candidate from a job Open the Job from which the candidate needs to be unassigned. ​ Scroll down to the Candidate Pipeline section. ​ Locate the candidate to be removed from the job. ​ Click on the 3 dots right next to the candidate's name and click on the Unassign Candidate option.

chunks.t: How to Unassign a Candidate from a Job
chunks.x: When the confirmation dialog appears, review the message and click Unassign to complete the action. The candidate will be removed from the selected job while remaining available in Recruit CRM for assignment to other jobs. Method 2: Unassign multiple candidates from a job Scroll down to the Candidate Pipeline section and click View All Candidates to open the complete list of all the assigned candidates to the job. Select the candidates to unassign by clicking the checkbox next to each candidate. ​ Click the Unassign Candidate from Job button at the top. ​ Review the confirmation message and click Unassign . The selected candidates will be unassigned from the job simultaneously.

chunks.t: How to Unassign a Candidate from a Job
chunks.x: Method 3: Unassign a candidate from the Candidate profile Locate the job from which the candidate needs to be unassigned. ​ Click the More options (⋮) next to the job. Review the confirmation message and click Unassign . The candidate will immediately be removed from that job while remaining associated with any other assigned jobs. Method 4: Unassign Candidate from Jobs in the Old UI 1. Open the job profile and scroll down to the "Candidate Pipeline" section. 2. Hover your cursor over the candidate you wish to unassign. 3. Click on the " X " icon that appears in the top-right corner and hit the " Unassign " button.

chunks.t: How to Unassign a Candidate from a Job
chunks.x: Note: This method applies to accounts still using the older Recruit CRM interface. Problem: The candidate still appears in the job’s Candidates pipeline after trying to unassign. Likely cause: The unassign action or confirmation step was not completed. ​ What to check: •Confirm you clicked Unassign (for single unassign) or Confirm (for bulk unassign) in the pop-up. •Refresh the job profile page and check the Candidates pipeline again. ​ Resolution: Repeat the unassign steps and ensure you complete the confirmation in the pop-up, then refresh the page. Problem: Not seeing the Unassign candidate option in the three-dot menu.

chunks.t: How to Unassign a Candidate from a Job
chunks.x: Likely cause: You may not be in the correct location or looking at the correct menu. ​ What to check: Confirm you are clicking the three dots next to the candidate’s name in the Candidates pipeline, or next to the job’s name in the candidate’s Assigned jobs tab. ​ Resolution: Navigate back to the job profile or candidate profile and follow the steps exactly, making sure you open the correct three-dot menu. Q1: Does unassigning a candidate from a job delete the candidate? Unassigning a candidate from a job only removes their association with that specific job. It does not delete the candidate’s profile. Q2: Can I unassign multiple candidates from the same job at once?

chunks.t: How to Unassign a Candidate from a Job
chunks.x: Yes. Use the View all candidates button in the job’s Candidates pipeline, multi-select the candidates, and click Unassign candidate from job . Q3: Can I unassign a candidate from a job using only the candidate's profile? Yes, this is useful if you only know the candidate, not the job. Open the candidate's profile, go to the Assigned Jobs tab, click the three dots next to the job, and choose Unassign Candidate. Q4: Will I see a confirmation before candidates are unassigned? Yes. A confirmation pop-up box appears when unassigning both single and multiple candidates. You must confirm the action for the unassignment to complete.

chunks.t: Audit Log Functionality in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Audit Log in Recruit CRM lets you keep a log of actions performed by you and your team on Recruit CRM. Monitoring internal user activity, including presence, attendance, and daily actions. Reviewing recent changes made to records across different modules. Exporting logs for external review, reporting, or backup. This is a Business plan and Enterprise plan exclusive feature. Only Account Owner and Admin have access to the Audit Log. On the Business and Enterprise plans, a custom role can be created to grant access to the Audit Log. Audit logs are available only for actions performed in the last 30 days . You cannot view logs older than 30 days.

chunks.t: Audit Log Functionality in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Actions performed using the Recruit CRM API are not recorded in the Audit Log. Go to Admin Settings in your Recruit CRM account. In the Account Management section, click Audit Logs . Once you open the Audit logs, you will be able to see information about the: ​ 1. Module on which the action is performed ( Action ) 2. Name of the user performing the action ( Performed By ) 3. Type of action performed ( Action Type ) 4. Date and time when the action was performed ( Date/Time ) You can sort the logs based on any of the four fields (Action, Performed By, Action Type, Date/Time) in ascending or descending order by simply just clicking on the field name.

chunks.t: Audit Log Functionality in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Furthermore, you can run filters on the logs based on the four fields to narrow down your search. You also get the option to export the audit logs by hitting the " Export to CSV " button. Account owners can schedule an email report to receive the audit logs as a CSV attachment by clicking on the 'Schedule Audit Log Report' button, thus, streamlining historical data tracking, security auditing, and activity monitoring. They also have the flexibility to add additional recipients for the email and choose to schedule these reports to be sent daily, weekly, or monthly. How long are audit logs stored in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Audit Log Functionality in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Audit logs are available for actions performed over the last thirty days . Logs older than thirty days are not visible. This feature will help you monitor all internal activities within your system like monitoring employee/user presence, attendance, and daily activities. chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM provides a set of default fields for every record type, including candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, and deals , so you can start managing your data without having to build your account structure from scratch. These fields cover the common information recruiters and agencies typically need and are separate from custom fields created by your team. ​ Understand the built-in default fields available for each record type. Know which fields can be customized, hidden, or replaced with custom fields. Clean up or standardize data across candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, and deals.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Configure field visibility and structure for your team in Admin Settings . Default fields cannot be edited or deleted in Recruit CRM. However, you can hide a default field if you do not want your team to use it and create a custom field to store the information instead. How to identify default and custom fields You can identify default and custom fields from the relevant record in the Data Customisation section in Admin Settings . The fields page shows which fields are built into Recruit CRM and which ones have been created as custom fields.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Go to Admin Settings and open the Fields section for the relevant record type under the Data Customisation tab: Candidates , Companies , Contacts , Deals , or Jobs . Review the list of fields displayed on the page. Identify the field type based on how it is displayed: Default fields do not have a tag next to the field name. For companies, contacts, deals, and jobs, default fields appear on the left side of the page. Custom fields are identified by the Custom Field tag. For companies, contacts, deals, and jobs, they appear on the right side under Additional Information .

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Default fields are built into Recruit CRM and cannot be edited or deleted . If a default field does not suit your team's data structure, you can hide it and use a custom field instead. Identify the default field you do not want your users to see or use. ​ In Admin Settings , adjust the field's visibility by toggling it off to hide it where appropriate. Create a custom field to capture the information you need. ​ Use the custom field to store the data going forward, following your team's preferred naming and structure. Here are all the default fields available for each entity: First Name (Text) - This field is required by default and you can not add a candidate without a first name.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Email (Email Address) , Phone (Phone Number) , LinkedIn Profile (Text) - These are the unique identifiers to detect duplicate records for candidates. Full Address (Text) - Radius Search in Advanced Search is implemented using this field. The same is also applicable to Contact, Company, and Job Fields. Gender (Dropdown) - This field is only visible when the EEO toggle is turned OFF from the account management settings in admin settings. Birth Date (Date) - This field is used to calculate the value for the " Age " field which is also visible only when the EEO toggle is turned OFF from the account management settings.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Locality (Text) - This field is auto-populated using the " City " and " Country/Region " fields on LinkedIn using the Chrome Extension. The same is also applicable to Contacts. Summary (Long Text) - Data added to this field is used to populate the candidate summary field in the Executive Search Report . You can also add templates for candidate summary . Resume (File) - The Advanced Search query searches for the keywords only on the file added to the default "resume" field. Work History, Education History, Employment Information (Field Sections) - All the fields in these sections are auto-populated when parsing a resume.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Source (Text) - This field tracks the source of the candidate when added from different platforms, for example, LinkedIn, Talent Pool Page, Job Boards, etc. Click here to understand how to track the source of job applicants. Skills (Text) - This field tracks the skills of the record and is auto-populated when the Candidate is added from LinkedIn using the Chrome Extension. Company Name (Text) - This field is required by default and you can not add a company without a name. About Company (Long Text) , City (Text) - These fields are auto-populated when adding a company from LinkedIn using the Chrome Extension.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Industry (Dropdown) - You can select the relevant industry type for a company from this dropdown. Website (Text) , Linkedin Profile URL (Text) - These are the unique identifiers to detect duplicate records for companies. First Name (Text) , Last Name (Text) , Phone (Phone Number) - Basic information of your clients. Title (Text) - This field is auto-populated when adding a company using the Chrome Extension from the "Headline" field in LinkedIn. Email Address (Email Address) , Linkedin Profile URL (Text) - These are the unique identifiers to detect duplicate records for contacts.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Stage (Dropdown) - A contact can go through various stages while they are in your database, for example - going from a lead to a follow-up client. These stages can be customized from the Contact Stages section in admin settings following these steps . Job Title (Text) , Number Of Openings (Dropdown) , Company (Dropdown) - These fields are required by default. Contact (Dropdown), Secondary Contacts (Dropdown) - Once the company field is selected, you can select from the dropdown a contact associated with the respective company.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Job Description (File/Rich Text) - It is advised to add the job description as text. Most of the external job boards do not accept jobs where the job description is added in a file format. Currency (Dropdown) - While you can choose the currency for every job, the default currency can be changed from your profile settings . Select Owner (Dropdown) - Refers to the user who is the owner of a job. Collaborator (Dropdown) - You can add other users from your team to collaborate on your jobs . Enable Job Application Form (Checkbox) - Enabling/disabling this checkbox impacts the visibility of your jobs on external job sites.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Job Application Form Questions (Checkbox) - Enabling/disabling this checkbox impacts the visibility of additional questions on your Job Application URL. Account owners and admins have access to create these questions. Note For Candidates (Checkbox) - Enabling/disabling this checkbox impacts the visibility of the notes you add to your Job Applications. Pay Rate (Number) , Bill Rate (Number) - These appear only for Contract or Contract-to-Permanent job types and can be marked as required in Admin Settings, but not hidden. Name (Text), Deal Type (Dropdown) Owner (Dropdown) - The visibility of these fields can not be changed and they are required by default to track reports and conduct searches.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Value (Number) - Required field indicating the estimated amount the deal is worth. Close Date (Date) - This is a required field that indicates the date by which a deal is estimated to be closed. A deal will only show up in a report when its close date lies in the period you're running the report for. For instance, a deal created in January with a close date of February will not show up in the reports for the month of January. Stage (Dropdown) - Indicates the current stage of a deal to calculate its weighted value. Deal stages can be customized from the Deal Pipeline in admin settings following these steps . Problem: You cannot edit or delete a field you no longer want to use.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: The field is a default field provided by Recruit CRM. ​ What to check: Open the relevant entity’s fields page in Admin Settings. Confirm whether the field has a “custom field” tag (custom) or no tag (default). If it is a default field (no tag), hide its visibility instead of trying to delete or edit it. Create a custom field to replace it and use that new field going forward. Problem: You cannot find your custom fields for companies, contacts, deals, or jobs. Likely cause: You may be looking only at the default fields section. ​ What to check: On the relevant fields page, check both the left and right sides of the page.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Look under the “Additional Information” section on the right side for the custom fields you created. How the system identifies duplicates for Candidates, Contacts and companies records? Candidates → Email Address, Phone Number, LinkedIn Profile URL Contacts → Email Address, LinkedIn Profile URL Companies → Company name, Website URL, LinkedIn Profile URL Can I edit or delete default fields in Recruit CRM? No. Default fields cannot be edited or deleted inside Recruit CRM. You can only hide their visibility. What should I do if a default field does not fit my process? Hide the visibility of that default field and create a custom field that better matches your data and workflow needs.

chunks.t: Default Fields in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Default fields in Recruit CRM give you a ready-made structure for candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, and deals, while custom fields and visibility controls let you adapt that structure to your workflow. If you need further help configuring fields or planning your data setup, contact your internal administrator or Recruit CRM support for guidance. chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature allows you to add, view, edit, and manage a candidate’s Work experience and Educational details directly within the candidate's profile. Candidate Work and Education History can be edited in multiple ways: 1. Open the relevant candidate profile in Recruit CRM and click on the Edit Candidate button (pencil icon). 2. Scroll down to the Work History or Education History section you want to update. Click on the pencil icon within that section, make the required changes, and then click Save to apply them.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Note: In the Description box, you can also format text using Bold, Italics, Underline, Bullet points, Numbered lists, and even add Hyperlinks. Once you're done, hit the "Submit" button. You can also edit Candidate Work and Education History from the "Details" tab under candidate profiles by clicking on the "pencil" icon. Customizing the Candidate Work and Education History section You just need to follow these simple steps: 1. Go to Admin Settings and click on Candidate Fields under data customization.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 2. Click on the "pencil" icon against the work or education history section to change the section name. You can also show/hide the education or work history sections using the toggle beside the section name. 3. You can turn the visibility toggle on/off to show/hide a field on the "Add Candidate" and "Edit Candidate" forms. You can also make a field "Required" by hitting the checkbox against it. By making a field mandatory, you and your team will not be able to add/edit a candidate without filling in some data in these "required" fields.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Note: The "Educational Qualification" under the Education History section and the "Title" under the Work History section are default fields and can not be edited. P.S. You can see multiple cascading-type sections divided into different categories in the admin settings. How are Work and Education History entries handled within Recruit CRM? When a candidate's resume is updated, the system identifies any manually added or edited work and education history entries. We understand the importance of the effort put into customizing the profiles, so we retain these specific entries.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Simultaneously, we automatically replace the remaining entries with the most recent data from the uploaded resumes. This ensures that you have access to the most up-to-date work and education history. In cases where you use our Chrome extension to source and parse resumes, the override data option plays a crucial role. When the override data option is turned on, the system will replace all the work and education history entries with the data extracted from the resume, regardless of whether they were manually added or edited.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: However, when the override data option is turned off, no changes will be made to work and education histories. This gives you more control over the data allowing you to retain manually added or edited information. If a candidate manually enters their work and education history using the talent pool, or job application form, or when a candidate updates their resume from the profile update form, we preserve their entries in the original form. ​ However, when the work and education history details are sourced from a resume then the information provided by the external forms is replaceable. Do visibility and required settings apply to all users?

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Yes. Changes made in Candidate Fields apply account-wide to all users working with candidate profiles. chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Meeting type customization lets you create and manage custom meeting types in Recruit CRM. You can add new meeting types, name them, and set one as the default. This helps you tag and categorize meetings in a way that matches your recruitment process, making it easier for you and your team to identify and manage different types of communication. When you want to create custom meeting types that match your internal workflow. When your team needs clearer tagging and categorization of meetings. Only users with access to the admin settings on the Business plan and above can customize meeting types.

chunks.t: Meeting Type Customization
chunks.x: On the Pro plan, only Account Owners and users with the admin role can perform meeting type customization. On the Business plan and above, you can also grant access to meeting type customization to team members with custom roles. 1. Go to Admin Settings > click on Meeting Type Customization under CRM Process Customization. 4. Enter a name (up to fifty characters) for your meeting type. To make this the default meeting type, check the box next to it. Click the Save Status button to save your new meeting type.

chunks.t: Meeting Type Customization

chunks.t: Meeting Type Customization

chunks.t: Meeting Type Customization

On the Business plan and above, confirm that your custom role has the meeting type customization toggle turned on. Resolution: Ask an Account Owner to either perform the customization or update your role permissions as described in the steps above. Problem: You cannot add more meeting types. chunks.t: Meeting Type Customization

If you reach the total of thirty meeting types, you will not be able to add more until you remove or adjust existing meeting types. Customizing meeting types in Recruit CRM helps you better categorize and manage your meetings, giving your team clearer visibility into different types of communication. chunks.t: Email Sequencing Analytics
chunks.x: How do you measure the effectiveness of an email sequence ? ​ Email Sequencing Analytics in Recruit CRM provides performance metrics that help you understand how prospects are engaging with your email sequences. These analytics track key interactions such as total enrollment rate, open rate, reply rate, and unsubscribe rate, giving you a clear view of how individual sequence steps and entire sequences are performing. Each metric is calculated using a defined formula, allowing you to consistently evaluate results, compare performance across different sequences, and identify opportunities for improvement. • You are reviewing the performance of an existing email sequence.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing Analytics
chunks.x: • You are comparing different sequences or sequence steps to determine which performs better. You can view sequence analytics from either the Sequences section in Admin Settings or directly from your Mailbox . Navigate to Admin Settings → CRM Process Customization → Sequences . Open the sequence whose analytics you want to review. The sequence analytics will be displayed, allowing you to view performance metrics and engagement statistics. Open your Mailbox from the left navigation panel. Scroll down and select My Sequence Enrollments . Open the sequence whose analytics you want to review.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing Analytics
chunks.x: The sequence analytics will be displayed, allowing you to view performance metrics and engagement statistics. 📊 Understanding Sequence Analytics Metrics This refers to the total number of prospects who have been enrolled in the email sequence/step. ​ This number also indicates all the prospects who have been added to the sequence/step, even if they were manually or automatically removed at a later stage. Total Enrollment = Active Enrollments + Unenrolled Prospects The percentage of emails that were opened within a sequence/step by the prospects in the sequence. Opened Rate = (Total Mails Opened * 100) / Total Mails Sent

chunks.t: Email Sequencing Analytics
chunks.x: The percentage of emails that received a reply from the prospect in the sequence/step. Reply Rate = (Total Mails Replied * 100) / Total Mails Sent This is the percentage of prospects who unsubscribed from the email sequence. Unsubscribe Rate = (Total Prospects Unsubscribed*100)/ Total Prospects Enrolled Email sequencing analytics in Recruit CRM help you measure how many prospects you reach, how they engage with your emails, and where you may need to adjust your sequences. Use total enrollment, open rate, reply rate, and unsubscribe rate together to understand performance and guide improvements to your email outreach.

chunks.t: How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use this feature? Reactivating a deactivated user in Recruit CRM restores their access to the system and, if applicable, reassigns their previously owned records back to them. (While deactivating a user, you have the option to transfer the data under their ownership to another user . But, in case you've not already transferred the data, by reactivating the user, all the data previously added under their ownership will be mapped back to them.) It also uses one unused license from your purchased licenses. You can use this feature when: You need to restore access for a user who was previously deactivated.

chunks.t: How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 1. Go to Admin Settings > Users > User Management , locate the deactivated user you want to reactivate, and click the pencil (Edit) icon next to their name. 2. In the user details window, click Reactivate , confirm the user's email address, and then click Reactivate User to send the invitation. Note- If there are no available purchased licenses on your subscription, you will be prompted to purchase an additional license before you can continue. 3. Once the invitation is sent, a Resend Reactivation Email button will appear in the user profile, allowing you to resend the invite until the user accepts it and rejoins your team.

chunks.t: How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If you have purchased licenses that are not currently assigned to any users, a message at the top of the User Management page will display the number of available licenses in your account. Invite New Users to assign the available licenses. Clicking this option opens the Invite Teammate window. Reduce License Count to match the number of active users. Clicking this option takes you to the Payment and Billing page. Note: Only the Account Owner and other users on roles that have access to these sections will be able to complete the tasks. Additionally, the User Management page allows you to filter users by status, making it easy to view only Active or Deactivated users as needed.

chunks.t: How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can also use the search bar to quickly find a specific user instead of manually browsing through the entire list. Problem: You can’t reactivate a user because the Reactivate User action fails. Likely cause: There are not enough purchased licenses available on your subscription plan. What to check: The number of purchased licenses you have. Resolution path: If there is no available unused license, purchase an additional license from the plans and billing section. Problem: The user did not receive the reactivation email. Likely cause: Email address entered is incorrect, or the email went to spam/junk.

chunks.t: How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What to check: The email ID you added in the Reactivate User window. The user’s spam/junk folder and email filters. Resolution path: Correct the email if needed, then click the Send Reactivation Email button from the user’s edit window until the user successfully joins the team. 1. What happens to a user’s data when I reactivate them? If you did not transfer their data at deactivation, all the data previously added under their ownership will be mapped back to them when you reactivate the user. 2. Do I need an extra/unused license to reactivate a user?

chunks.t: How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Yes. Reactivating a user consumes one license. If there are not enough purchased licenses available on your subscription plan, you will need to buy a new license before you can complete the reactivation. Reactivating a deactivated user in Recruit CRM is simple. With built-in license visibility, user filters, and search functionality, Recruit CRM makes it easy to restore user access and manage your subscription seats efficiently. chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: This is a Business Plan feature and for the Pro/Free plan, users will have access to create only 1 sequence. Only the account owners, admins, and users on custom roles with access to sequences can create a sequence. You can send a series of precisely timed email templates to candidates and contacts over a specified period. Using sequencing, you can create a combination of tasks and emails steps, one by one, for your contacts or candidates . The sequence will continue until the recipient responds to any of the emails sent. 1. Go to Admin Settings > CRM Process Customization > Sequences . 3. Select either "Candidates" or "Contacts" as the recipient of the sequence.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 4. The next step is to name your sequence and select the task or email step that needs to be executed. You can choose to either select an existing email template or create a new one dedicated to the sequence. 5. Then, specify the number of days and the time when the sequence step should be executed. It is important to know exactly when an email will be sent in relation to the starting date of the sequence. To calculate this, you can use the following formula: Send Date = Start Date + Specified No. Of Days (Send Email In) Here, "Start Date" represents the date when the email sequence was initiated.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: "Specified Date" or "Send Email In" is the number of days you have indicated for the email to be sent after the start of the sequence. The resulting "Send date" is the calculated date on which the email will be sent. For example - If you start the email sequence on January 1st and specify that the email should be sent in 2 days, the Send Date would be calculated as follows: Send date= January 1st + 2 days =January 3rd. You can also set the " Send Email In " date as 0, establishing the beginning of your sequence in Day 0 . This way, the first email will be sent on the same day you enroll prospects into a sequence.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: In addition, we provide the option to execute email or task steps exclusively on business days. All you need to do is turn on this toggle : 6. When creating an email step, you'll have the option to include an unsubscribe/ opt-out link within each email. 7. Add steps to the sequence as required, up to a maximum of 40 steps , which includes a maximum of 10 email steps, 10 task steps , 10 LinkedIn steps and 10 SMS steps . You can easily rearrange the sequence steps by using the drag-and-drop functionality. 8. Set a specific number of days for each step to execute, with a range of 1 to 250 calendar days or business days.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Tasks can be created on the same day as the sequence initiation by setting the day as "0". ​ When implementing a task on the 0th day, it's crucial to align the step timing with the previous steps or set it for a later time than the preceding step to ensure a seamless workflow. 9. Refer to this article to know more about how you can enrol and unenroll records from a sequence: Note: If a candidate/contact is marked as Off limits and if they are enrolled in an active sequence, they will NOT be opted out of the sequence. The email signature used for sequences will match the one set in your system settings for regular emails.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If you’ve created a signature on this page: Email Signature Settings , it will also appear in your sequence emails. Enrolling contacts into a sequence while Pitching the Candidates to the Contacts 1. You need to click on the 'Enroll Selected Contacts to Sequence' option while pitching the candidates to the contacts After successful completion of sending the email/marking the candidates as pitched, you will be automatically redirected to the page where you can enroll them into the sequence. What are the time slots/execution times of the sequences? Emails in a sequence are fired in 30-minute slots (e.g. 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM, etc.).

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Also, the email's timestamp is based on the timezone set in the user profile who initiated the enrolment . ​ Here's how a user can check their timezone: How many prospects can be enrolled in a sequence at a time? The limit on the number of prospects that can be enrolled in a sequence depends on the number of users in the account. Each user can enrol up to 500 prospects in a sequence at a time. Is there any limit on the number of candidates/contacts that a user can enroll in a sequence? A user can enrol up to 500 candidates/contacts in either 1 or across multiple sequences at any given point in time.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once a user reaches the maximum active + paused enrollments i.e. 500, they will not be able to enrol any further records until the active sequence(s) are completed or they manually unenroll some records. How many steps can you have in a particular sequence? Add steps to the sequence as required, up to a maximum of 40 steps , which includes a maximum of 10 email steps, 10 task steps , 10 LinkedIn steps and 10 SMS steps . You can easily rearrange the sequence steps by using the drag-and-drop functionality. What happens when a user edits a running sequence? If someone edits the sequence that is already running, then the changes will apply to only future enrollments.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: How many sequences can be created on an account? In total, you can add up to 1000 sequences to a business plan account. However, on the pro plan, you can test the feature with 1 sequence. When does a prospect get unenrolled from the sequence? 1. Whenever someone replies to the email sequence , the sequence gets paused for that specific prospect and it gets unenrolled from the sequence. 2. If the candidate/contact chooses to opt out of the email they will get automatically unenrolled. 3. If you manually unenroll them from the sequence. Can we add a candidate/contact to multiple sequences? No, each candidate/contact can only be a part of a single sequence at a time.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Is there a time gap between each email sent in a sequence? Yes, consecutive emails will experience a delay ranging from 3 to 5 seconds. This measure has been implemented to prevent email throttling. How to add an image and resize it on the signature? You can click on the 'Insert image' option under the 'Email Signature' section and add the image: You can even re-size it by clicking it and dragging it at the bottom right of the image: Here's how you can stop a sequence: 1. Go to Admin Settings → Sequences . Find the sequence you want to stop and click on the three dots on the top-right of its card. Select "Unenroll All enrollments"

chunks.t: Call Type Customization
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to customize call types to better match your team's workflows and communication processes. By creating personalized call type statuses, you can tag, organize, and categorize calls more effectively, making it easier to track different types of conversations, improve reporting, and streamline follow-up activities. • You want to create call types that reflect your team's specific workflows. • You need a clearer way to categorize and organize calls. • You want to improve call tracking, reporting, and follow-up processes.

chunks.t: Call Type Customization
chunks.x: 📌 Important: Call type customization can only be performed by users with access to the Admin Settings. On the Pro Plan , this includes the Account Owner and users with the Admin role. On the Business Plan and above , access can also be granted to custom roles. Follow along to add custom tags for your call types: ​ 1. Go to Admin Settings > Click on Call Type Customization under CRM Process Customization. 3. Click Add New Status . In the blank box that appears at the bottom of the list, enter the name of your new call type (up to 50 characters). 4. You can make it your default call type by checking the box next to it. You can click and drag the '=' icon beside the Note type to reorder them.

chunks.t: Call Type Customization
chunks.x: Please Note - Recruit CRM allows you to have up to 30 Call Types. This offers more flexibility and options to efficiently organize and manage your communication, allowing for better categorization and streamlining of your workflow. ​ Additionally, on the Business plan, you can grant access to the "Call Type Customization" option to your team members on custom roles as well. Here's how you can do this: 1. Go to your User Management settings in the admin settings . ​ 2. Go to the " Roles & Permissions " section and click on the pencil icon next to the role you want to grant access to. 3. Now, scroll down and turn ON the toggle for "Call Type Customization" and hit the " Save Role " button.

chunks.t: Call Type Customization
chunks.x: Problem: Unable to see the Call Types Customization option in Admin Settings Likely cause: Your user role does not have permission to access call type customization. Confirm whether you are an account owner, admin, or a user on a custom role with call type customization enabled. If you are not an admin or account owner, contact someone with admin access to update your role or adjust permissions. On the Business Plan, ask an admin to enable the call type customization toggle for your custom role in the Roles and Permissions section. Likely cause: The maximum number of call types has been reached. Review the total number of call types currently listed in Call Types Customization.

chunks.t: Call Type Customization
chunks.x: Remove or consolidate unused call types to free up space, then add new ones. Recruit CRM allows a maximum of thirty call types. What is the maximum number of call types I can create? Recruit CRM allows up to thirty call types. Who can customize call types on the Pro Plan? On the Pro Plan, only account owners and users with the admin role can customize call types. Who can customize call types on the Business Plan? On the Business Plan, users with access to the Admin Settings can customize call types. Additionally, Account Owners can grant call type customization access to users on custom roles.

chunks.t: Call Type Customization
chunks.x: Yes. When you add or edit a call type, you can check the box next to it to make it your default call type. Can I allow only specific team members to manage call types? Yes. On the Business Plan, you can enable the call type customization permission for selected custom roles in the Roles and Permissions section. Call type customization in Recruit CRM helps you better organize and categorize your calls so your team can work more efficiently. If you need further assistance with permissions or setup, contact your account admin or reach out to Recruit CRM support. How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Selecting custom fields on the Chrome Extension
chunks.x: Customize your Chrome extension to record the most relevant information for candidates, companies, and contacts! You can add more fields of your choice directly to the extension, in addition to the existing ones. Whether it's a default field or any of the custom fields, the Chrome extension can be aligned perfectly to suit your unique requirements. How to add custom fields to the Chrome extension? 1. Go to Admin Settings >> Data Customization >> Candidate Fields / Company Fields / Contact Fields to view a list of default and custom fields that can be displayed on your extension.

chunks.t: Selecting custom fields on the Chrome Extension
chunks.x: 2. To show a field on the extension, simply check the corresponding checkbox under the ' Extension ' column, and uncheck it to hide the field. Note: The fields that are already available by default in the extension cannot be deselected. These default fields will appear as greyed out for easy identification. Additionally, you can select up to 15 fields that can be displayed on the Chrome extension. For candidates, the Work and Education History sections are available by default on the extension. How to reorder sections on the Chrome extension?

chunks.t: Selecting custom fields on the Chrome Extension
chunks.x: You can change the order of sections on the Chrome extension by heading to the ' Settings ' tab (gear icon) on the Chrome extension and using the ' hamburger menu ' icon to drag them across the list. FAQs on selecting additional/custom fields in the Chrome extension What happens if I select more than 15 fields? Since we have set up the Chrome extension to display only 15 additional fields, the system will restrict you from selecting more than 15 checkboxes in the 'Extension' column within Admin Settings. Can I add file-type custom fields to the Chrome extension?

chunks.t: Selecting custom fields on the Chrome Extension
chunks.x: Yes, you can add a file type custom field to appear on the Chrome extension. However, please note that the extension won't show a preview of the file due to technical constraints, you'll only be able to see the file name. How does the override data setting work with the new features? The override data settings do not affect the additional fields within the Chrome extension. These fields will always be overwritten, except for Current Organization and Skills. This design enables users to make updates to the data without constraints, particularly for custom fields where data isn't sourced from LinkedIn.

chunks.t: Revoking your subscription cancelation & reactivating your canceled subscription
chunks.x: Recruit CRM makes it very simple to get back and restart your Recruit CRM subscription or revoke the cancelation if you decide to cancel your subscription. Revoke the subscription cancelation before the subscription expiry In case you decide to schedule a cancelation for your subscription, you can easily revert the cancelation by following these steps: 1. Go to your admin settings and click on Account . 2. Scroll down, and click on "Revoke Cancelation".

chunks.t: Revoking your subscription cancelation & reactivating your canceled subscription
chunks.x: For instance, if your subscription expires on October 30 of the current year, and you cancel your subscription on October 20 of the same year, you will have complete access to your data till October 30 and you can choose to revoke the cancelation anytime during this period. Once you revoke the cancelation, the subscription will renew on the next renewal date and your account will be charged per usual. Restarting the subscription after the subscription expiry In case your subscription has already expired, you can restart the subscription anytime before deactivating the account :

chunks.t: Revoking your subscription cancelation & reactivating your canceled subscription
chunks.x: Your data will still be saved on our servers after the subscription expiry, but you will not be able to access it without restarting the subscription. However, once you deactivate the account, all your data will be permanently deleted from our servers. Canceling your subscription and permanently deactivating the Recruit CRM account How to reactivate a deactivated user in Recruit CRM Learn how to upgrade/downgrade or cancel your Job Advertising subscription Upgrading/Downgrading or Canceling your Advanced Analytics Subscription

chunks.t: Kanban View for Jobs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Job Kanban View displays your jobs in separate columns based on their current status. You can use it to: Move jobs between statuses using drag and drop. Quickly access actions and candidate pipelines for individual jobs. Click Kanban View at the top of the Jobs list to switch to the Kanban View. Jobs will be grouped according to their respective statuses, and you can drag and drop a job to move it to another status. You can select multiple jobs directly from the Kanban View: To select all jobs under a status, click the checkbox next to the status name.

chunks.t: Kanban View for Jobs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: To select specific jobs across different statuses, hover over the job cards and click the checkbox that appears in the top-left corner. Once selected, you can perform bulk actions on the jobs, such as adding them to a Hotlist. Click the three-dot menu on a specific job card to access actions such as assigning candidates, emailing job contacts, adding notes, tasks, or meetings, and adding the job to Hotlists. You can also click View Candidates from this menu to access the candidate pipeline for that job. Problem: Your jobs are not appearing in the expected Kanban column. Likely Cause: Jobs are grouped according to their current job status.

chunks.t: Kanban View for Jobs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What to Check: Check the current status assigned to the job. Resolution: Update the job status if required. The job will then appear under the corresponding Kanban column. The Job Kanban View provides a visual way to organize jobs by status while making it easier to manage individual jobs and perform bulk actions. Accessing the Kanban/Board/Trello view on Jobs? chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What This Feature Does and when to use it? AI candidate-to-candidate matching in Recruit CRM helps you find ideal candidate matches by analyzing a reference candidate’s profile and searching for similar candidates across your candidate database. Once you identify a strong-fit candidate for a role, you can use AI to discover more candidates with similar skills, experience, education, location, languages, job titles, and industry background. This feature is especially useful when you want to: • Find more candidates similar to a strong-fit candidate already identified for a role. • Discover candidates based on overall profile similarity rather than keywords alone. ​

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Note: This is a Business and Enterprise plan exclusive feature. However, users on the Pro plan can view up to 2 candidate matches to have an overview of the feature. AI Matching in Recruit CRM uses AI capabilities to perform bimetric scoring, a two-way matching algorithm based on holistic profiles rather than a string of keywords, to generate the match rate between two candidate profiles. ​ The bimetric scoring uses details available on the candidate's resume such as skills, experience, education, location, language, job titles, industry, etc. Candidates are ranked on a scale from 0 to 100, where a higher score indicates a stronger match.

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Resume requirement: As the AI utilizes data from candidate resumes to identify matches, this feature is only available for the candidate profiles that have a resume uploaded to the default resume field . Data completeness: The more complete the reference candidate's profile, the more accurate the matching algorithm will be. Profiles with detailed resume information, skills, experience, education, and location produce better match results. The system will return up to 50 candidate matches ranked by match score. A match score of 100 represents the closest match; 0 represents no match. Method 1: Launch Matching from a Candidate Profile

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Open the candidate profile you have identified as an ideal fit for the role. ​ Look for the Find Candidate Matches option represented by a shining star icon ✦ at the top of the candidate profile. If the star icon is not directly visible, click the three dots icon (More options) in the actions area to view additional options. Then select Find Candidate Matches from the dropdown menu. ​ The system will analyze the candidate's profile and display a list of similar candidates ranked by match score. ​ Once matching is complete, you will see a list of up to 50 candidates with their match scores.

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can search within AI Matching results using the search bar without manually scrolling through the candidate list. By default, AI analyses and compares candidate profiles based on skills, experience, education, location, language, job titles, and industry to identify the most relevant matches. Method 2: Launch Matching from a Job Profile 1. Go to the relevant Job in Recruit CRM and open the Candidates Pipeline tab for that job. 2. Identify the ideal candidate within the job’s candidate list and click on the three dots next to that candidate’s name. 3. Choose Find Matching Candidates from the menu to view AI-generated matches based on that candidate’s profile. ​

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once matching is complete, you will see a list of up to 50 candidates with their match scores. AI Matching provides detailed reasoning behind each candidate match, helping recruiters understand why a candidate is considered a good fit. For every matched candidate, AI-generated insights are available across: Function – Shows how closely the candidate’s role and responsibilities align with the requirement. Skills – Shows how well the candidate’s skills match the required skills. Level – Shows how closely the candidate’s experience and seniority match the role. Trajectory – Shows how the candidate’s career progression aligns with the expected growth path.

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Domain – Shows the relevance of the candidate’s industry and domain experience. Location – Shows how well the candidate’s location and work preferences match the requirements. Each section includes a score and explanation, helping you quickly evaluate candidate strengths and gaps. You can also assign a candidate to the job directly from the Match Analysis panel without leaving the AI Matching screen. You can refresh AI Matching results to generate an updated list based on the latest available candidate information. Refresh is useful when new candidates are added, profiles are updated, or additional information becomes available after the previous matching run.

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When refreshed, AI Matching re-evaluates the data and updates the results based on the latest match scores. The Refresh option can be used once every 5 minutes for the candidate. You can quickly review multiple matched candidates using: Candidate selection from the results list Previous and Next buttons available in the Match Analysis panel When a candidate is selected, their Match Analysis is displayed automatically. Click here to learn more about the actions that can be performed on Matched Candidates. Once you have identified promising matches, you can take the following actions directly from the matches list after selecting the specific candidates:

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Request Updated Profile : Ask candidates to update and submit their latest information and documents. Send emails: Reach out to matched candidates with personalized or template-based mails. Add Notes : Add important comments or feedback about candidates for your team to review. Update Field : Change specific candidate details, such as skills, source. Enroll in a Sequence: Add candidates to an automated series of follow-up emails and tasks. Pitch to contacts: Submit matched candidates to client contacts for consideration. Add to hotlists: Create or manage lists of top candidates for future reference. Export : Download selected candidate records and data for reporting or offline use.

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can provide feedback on AI-generated matches directly from the Match Analysis panel. Available feedback options are: Feedback can be submitted once per candidate match and helps improve future AI Matching experiences. Please Note: AI Matching supports multiple languages. Match analysis is generated in the same language as the source content used for matching, such as the candidate profile details. Problem: The Candidate Matching button is greyed out and cannot be clicked.

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: A resume is not attached to the candidate profile. ​ ​ What to check: Verify whether a resume file is attached in the candidate’s default resume field. ​ ​ Resolution path: Upload the candidate’s resume file, as the AI matching score is calculated based on the attached resume. Who can use candidate-to-candidate AI matching in Recruit CRM? Any user with access to candidate profiles and jobs can use AI matching, but the number of visible matches depends on your plan. Business and Enterprise users see up to 50 matches; Pro users see up to two. Will refreshing always produce new matches?

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: No. Refreshing re-runs the matching process using the latest data. If no better or additional matches are identified, the existing results remain unchanged. Why did a candidate receive a high score even if they do not match every requirement? AI Matching evaluates multiple factors together. A candidate may score highly because they strongly match several important areas, even if they do not perfectly match every requirement. The Match Analysis panel explains the reasoning behind the score.

chunks.t: Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Candidate-to-candidate AI matching in Recruit CRM helps you quickly find and act on lookalike candidates based on an ideal profile, using rich resume data to drive accurate match scores. Use it from both candidate profiles and job records to build better shortlists, rediscover strong talent in your database, and streamline your outreach and placement workflows. Generate a Branded Candidate Summary with Claude Using Recruit CRM MCP

chunks.t: Understanding the Reports and Statistics on the Dashboard
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Dashboard in Recruit CRM provides a centralized view of your recruitment activities through 11 interactive reports , giving you quick insights into your hiring pipeline, deals, jobs, tasks, meetings, and candidate activity. These reports help you monitor performance, identify trends, and stay on top of your recruitment process without having to generate individual reports. • Get a high-level overview of your candidate hiring pipeline. • Track deal stages, pipeline value, and overall sales performance. • Monitor the status of your open, closed, and active jobs. • Stay updated on upcoming or overdue tasks and meetings.

chunks.t: Understanding the Reports and Statistics on the Dashboard
chunks.x: • Analyze candidate pipelines by job, company, candidate owner, or assigned recruiter. Each dashboard report provides a different perspective on your recruitment data, helping you quickly assess performance and make informed decisions. This article gives an overview of all the dashboard reports available in Recruit CRM, explains what each report represents, and helps you understand how the displayed statistics are calculated. The Total Candidates Statistics card provides a comprehensive overview of the entire candidate hiring pipeline.

chunks.t: Understanding the Reports and Statistics on the Dashboard
chunks.x: Whenever you click on any particular stage you'll be redirected to a list of candidates currently present in that stage. You will also get an option to select any particular job status or generate a report for all job statuses. Additionally, this card also provides an overview of the total number of candidates present within the system as well as the total assigned and unassigned candidates. You can click on the 'All Unassigned' and 'All Assigned' numbers to get a comprehensive list of candidates under each of the categories. ​ All Unassigned = Total number of candidates that are not assigned to any jobs. ​ All Assigned = Total number of candidates in every hiring stage across all jobs

chunks.t: Understanding the Reports and Statistics on the Dashboard
chunks.x: You will also be able to see all assigned candidates in Kanban View for specific stages, across all jobs. The "All Assigned Candidates" list, accessed from the Dashboard, the "Owner" field - you can add it as a column, filter by it, and include it in CSV exports, just like on other candidate list pages. When you click on a stage statistic on the Dashboard (e.g., "Sourced"), select candidates from that filtered list, and open "Update Candidate Stage," the Stage field pre-fills with that stage and shows it highlighted in the dropdown, instead of showing a blank field. The Total Deals Statistics report displays all deal stages, pipeline amounts, and provides us with the status of each deal.

chunks.t: Understanding the Reports and Statistics on the Dashboard
