chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Job Board XML Feed feature allows you to automate job postings to external job boards and receive applicants directly into Recruit CRM. While Recruit CRM offers native integrations with select job boards , XML feeds provide the flexibility to connect with additional job boards that support XML-based job imports. • You want to automate posting jobs to job boards that do not have a native Recruit CRM integration. • You manage multiple job boards and need a standardized way to distribute jobs. • You want applicants from external job boards to be captured directly in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: • You need more control over the XML structure required by a specific job board. • You want to reduce manual job posting efforts and minimize data entry errors. The XML feed is generated dynamically using your job data and configured placeholders, ensuring that job information stays up to date automatically whenever changes are made within Recruit CRM. 1. By default, only the Account Owners and Admins can create XML feeds. You can also grant access to build XML feed to users on custom roles. 2. You can only create 10 XML feeds at a time on the Business Plan. On the Pro plan, you can only build 1 XML feed. 3. Only available on the Pro, Business and Enterprise Plan.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: An XML feed is a structured data format used to distribute job listings across different platforms, including job boards. It provides a standardized and machine-readable way to share job-related information. The XML feed follows a specific format organizing details like job titles, descriptions, locations, requirements, and application instructions. Job boards consume the feed to display job listings consistently on their platforms. With the automatic transfer of applicant information, this functionality saves time and reduces errors. 1. Head over to Admin Settings >> Job Settings >> Build Job Feed XML >> click on the " Create Your XML Feed " button to get started.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: 2. Add a name to your feed to identify the feed and to track candidates, as it also serves as the ' Source ' of the applicants applying from the job board. Thus, an ideal choice would be to use the name of the job board itself. The XML header is the static component of the XML feed and remains consistent across all jobs, as it is used to define the structure and formatting of the XML file. You will find it in the XML documentation provided by the job board you wish to integrate with. You can use the "Last updated on" placeholder in the XML header to allow job boards to fetch the time at which the XML was updated.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: Ensure that you include the XML body before closing the tags in the XML header. The XML body contains variable information that requires placeholders. To easily add these placeholders, utilize the ' Add XML Body Placeholder ' button located at the top right of the window. The XML body is the main content of the XML feed as it contains It includes the actual job posting details, such as job title, description, location, requirements, job slug and application instructions. Click here to know how to find the Job Slug A slug is a unique code that Recruit CRM uses to identify each record. Look at the web address (URL) at the top of your browser.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: The text that comes after the last “/” in the URL is the slug. For example: For example, if your job URL is https://app.recruitcrm.io/jobs/12345 , then 12345 is the job slug. The image below will give you more clarity on the same: ​ To add the content under the ' XML Body ', you can refer to the sample code provided by the job board in their documentation. Input the required data for a single job here, and the system will automatically regenerate it for the remaining jobs.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: Only utilize fields in the XML that correspond to the available job data. For instance, if the XML includes a field named <Post Code>, but your job posting does not have this information, you should exclude the postcode field from the XML. Replace the sample data or empty spaces in the XML feed with the appropriate placeholders. By doing so, the XML feed will dynamically incorporate the relevant details from Recruit CRM for each job, eliminating the need for manual entry.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: When replacing values in the XML feed with placeholders, only replace the pre-filled values with the corresponding placeholders. This ensures that the dynamically populated job data from Recruit CRM is correctly integrated while retaining any other existing values or content in the XML feed. You can also add the Job's company logo to the custom XML feed. By adding the logo URL to the feed, the jobs will appear with the company logo on job boards. 5. Please ensure the XML body has been set up accurately, as the syntactical errors can be identified, however, errors in missing data or fields are not identifiable.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: 6. You can preview the XML feed to ensure that it meets all the requirements in terms of structure, content, and overall appearance. 7. Once you have set up your XML content, proceed to generate the feed by using the 'Submit' button. The generated XML feed once saved, allows you to make edits or updates as necessary through the Admin Settings. Here's an example of how you can create the XML feed for Xing To access the documentation for the Xing e-recruiting feed, please visit the following link: https://dev.xing.com/partners/job_integration/feed_docs#parameter-country

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: 1. Navigate to the example feed and locate the static part, which encompasses the feed's format, structure, and type. Paste this static component into the header section of your feed. 2. The XML header encompasses the content from the beginning of the feed until the opening tag <postings> is encountered. It concludes with the closing tag </postings> and is followed by the closing tag </feed> to finalize the feed structure. 3. Ensure that you place the 'XML Body Placeholder' between the opening tag <postings> and the closing tag </postings>. This will indicate the specific section where the dynamic content will be inserted within the XML header.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: <?xml version="1.0"?> <feed xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="https://dev.xing.com/jobs/xsd"> <postings> {xml_body} </postings> </feed> 4. The XML body, which contains the variable information related to individual jobs, begins with the opening tag <posting>. Within this tag, you will find various job details that can be customized for each specific job entry. 5. You can find out which of the fields are necessary for job postings in Xing, and create your feed in accordance with that. 6. Here, some data can be static, that you want to keep contact for all jobs, others could be dynamic which are to be replaced by placeholders.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: 7. In this example, the value associated with CDATA is to be replaced by placeholders in the parentheses is to be replaced by placeholders to dynamically generate these values from job profiles and post them on the job board. 8. Once all the relevant data is added, do not forget to close the tag on the posting. The XML body will identify any errors in the syntax. However, if the error is an error in the posting or anything else other than the syntactical error, it will not be identified. 9. You can refer to the image below for more notes by Xing: Here's an example to create the XML feed for Jooble To access the documentation for the Jooble XML feed, please visit the following link:

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: https://jooble.org/files/XML-feed/EN/jooble-xml-4job.pdf 1. Add the static component of the feed as reflected below: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <jobs> {xml_body} </jobs> 2. The beginning of the variable component that is to be added to the XML body is signified by the <jobs> tag. Remember to close the tags after filling in the job details. <job id=" "> <link><![CDATA[{job_application_url}]]></link> <name><![CDATA[{job_title}]]></name> <region><![CDATA[{job_locality}]]></region> <description><![CDATA[{job_description}]]></description> <company><![CDATA[]]></company> <pubdate>...</pubdate> </job>

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: 3. In the XML body, replace the sample data with placeholders from the drop-down menu on the top right of the window. 4. It is important to note that not all data requires CDATA. When replacing the 'Pubdate' field with a placeholder, ensure that the placeholder is in the correct format specified for the field. In order for the jobs to be visible on the XML feed you have created, certain criteria need to be fulfilled first: Please note that it's not necessary to fill the fields with the message "Required To Post On Partner Job Boards" (City, State, Country, Maximum Salary, Job Description, Currency, Salary Type) for the jobs to be posted in the custom XML feed.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: However, if you’re posting to Free Job Boards , all fields marked "Required To Post On Partner Job Boards" must be completed . The job application form should be enabled; The Updated On date should be within the last 30 days; 'Note for candidates' should be filled in (only if the Job Description is uploaded as a file); The "Post On Job Boards" option should be selected inside Admin Settings >> Job Custom Fields ; The job status should not be 'closed', 'on hold' or 'cancelled'; Select the custom XML feed you have created under the XML Feeds section ⬇️⬇️⬇️ You have the ability to selectively push job postings to specific XML feeds.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: While adding/editing a job, you'll get an option to select the XML feeds from both the default and custom XML feeds that you have built, provided the 'Post on Job Board' option is enabled from the Job Fields settings . While creating a new job or editing an existing one, make sure to select the custom XML feed you created in the XML Feeds section to get your jobs posted on the correct XML Feed. ​ By selecting the appropriate XML feeds, you can ensure that your jobs reach the intended audience through the most relevant job boards.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: You also have the option to preselect the XML feeds in the Build Job Feed XML page. This means the XML Feed will automatically be selected for all the new jobs created. ​ If you don't want a job to be automatically posted on the custom XML Feed you can simply disable the preselection on the Build Job Feed XML or uncheck the XML Feed while creating/editing the job: The jobs will be indexed to the job board only if the requirements given above are met. Once the XML is created and the jobs appear on it, you can share the XML Feed URL with your point of contact at the job board to proceed. ​

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: You can either reach out to your account manager if you already have a paid account with the job board or reach out to their support team. How to check if your job is visible in the custom XML Feed You can check the list of jobs being pushed to your custom XML Feed by going to Admin Settings >>>>>> Build Job Feed XML . Here you can click on "View Listed Jobs" to get a list of all the jobs in your account that currently meet the required criteria: If the job is not visible on the XML Feed it means one of the mandatory criteria wasn't met. Please review them again here .

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: You can also run an Advanced Search inside the Jobs List Page to see all the jobs that have been posted on Indeed (including old jobs that are no longer being pushed to the XML feed). ​ Recruit CRM has the requirements mentioned above for pushing jobs to the XML feed, job boards may have additional mandatory fields such as 'Company ID'. If such fields are not available in Recruit CRM by default, you can create a custom field and input the necessary values in the relevant format to ensure they appear correctly in your XML feed. Problem: Jobs are not appearing in the XML feed Likely cause: One or more posting criteria for inclusion in the XML feed have not been met.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: Confirm that the job application form is enabled for the job. Check that the job’s Updated on date is within the last 30 days. Verify that the job status is not Closed, On Hold, or Canceled. Ensure the Post on Job Boards option is selected inside Admin Settings > Custom Fields. Confirm that the correct XML feed is selected for the job under the XML field section. Update the job fields so that all required conditions are satisfied. Re-save the job so the Updated on date is refreshed if needed. Recheck the XML feed preview to confirm the job now appears. Problem: XML feed fails validation or is rejected by the job board

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: Likely cause: XML syntax errors or mismatched structure compared to the job board’s specification. Review the XML header and body for missing or extra tags. Confirm that opening and closing tags match. Check that you did not accidentally remove or misplace mandatory elements required by the job board. Correct any syntactical errors in the XML. Compare your XML to the job board’s sample XML. Use the preview again to verify that the structure is valid before sharing the URL. How many XML feeds can I create in Recruit CRM? On the Pro plan, you can create only one XML feed at a time. On the Business plan, you can create up to 10 XML feeds at a time.

chunks.t: Build your own XML feed for job boards
chunks.x: By default, only Account Owners and Admins can create XML feeds. However, you can grant access to build XML feeds to users who are assigned to custom roles in the Business and Enterprise Plans. 🎥 Here's a tutorial to help you get started! By setting up a custom XML feed in Recruit CRM, you can automate job distribution to virtually any job board while keeping all applications centralized in your database; if you need further help tailoring the XML format for a specific job board, contact your internal administrator or the Recruit CRM support team for guidance. chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Sequence Enrollment feature allows you to enroll one or multiple candidates or contacts into a predefined multi-step email sequence and customize the timing, sender email address, content, and starting step during enrollment. It supports bulk enrollment and un-enrollment, automatically pauses and removes records from a sequence when a recipient replies, and lets you track active enrollments and remaining capacity. Run structured multi-step email outreach campaigns. Enroll multiple candidates or contacts into a sequence in bulk. Automatically stop follow-ups when a recipient replies. Monitor active enrollments and remaining sequence capacity.

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: This is a Business Plan feature and above, and in the Pro/Free plan, users will have access to create only 1 sequence. Only the account owners, admins, and users on custom roles with access to sequencing can create a sequence. Enrolling Candidate/Contacts in a sequence Navigate to the Candidates or Contacts list page and select the record(s) you want to enroll in a sequence. Click Enroll In Sequence from the header bar at the top of the list. In the pop-up window, select the sequence you want to use. You can search for a sequence by name or use filters to quickly find the right one. Once selected, the system will display the records eligible for enrollment and automatically exclude:

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: Please note- If a record is missing an email address, you can add or update it directly from this screen by clicking the edit (pencil) icon . Any changes made here will also be saved to the record. Click Continue and review the sequence steps. To customize a specific step for this enrollment, click the pencil icon beside the step. Set the preferred execution timing for each step Select the connected email address that should send the sequence (if multiple email accounts are connected) If you want to execute the first stage of the sequence today, then click on the " Send Today " button and the rest of the steps will be rolled out accordingly.

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: Optionally, customize the content of each step by editing the email subject, body, and attachments. Note- The customization is limited to steps that haven't been executed yet. To begin the sequence from a later step, use the Start Sequence From dropdown and select the desired step. Any preceding steps will be skipped. While enrolling records in the sequence, you'll be able to see a preview of the placeholders used in each step. The placeholders will be highlighted in yellow in the preview, but not in the email sent in the sequence. If you're enrolling multiple records in the sequence, the placeholders will reflect the information of the first person enrolled.

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: 9. Once you're satisfied with the configuration, confirm your settings and hit the "Enrol in sequence" button 10. You can also enroll candidates or contacts directly from the Sequences section. Simply open the desired sequence and click the Enroll button to add records to it. You can also enroll records in a sequence from the jobs page . This will enroll all the primary contacts for that job in the selected sequence. Unenrolling Candidates/Contacts from the sequence You can bulk unenroll candidates or contacts from a sequence by opening the desired sequence and navigating to the Enrollments tab. From there, select the records you want to remove and unenroll them in bulk.

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: Alternatively, you can unenroll an individual candidate or contact directly from their detailed profile page if you only need to remove a specific record from the sequence. The user who has initiated the enrollment process should have his/her email settings connected with Recruit CRM. This is mandatory since the emails will be sent out using the enrolled user’s email settings. Tracking the number of active enrollments You can see how many records you currently have enrolled in a sequence inside your Recruit CRM mailbox in the "My Sequence Enrollments" tab.

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: This section provides a clear overview of the number of candidates and contacts currently enrolled in active sequences, as well as how many you can still enroll. Problem: A candidate/contact does not appear in the enrollment list Likely cause: The record has opted out of emails, is already enrolled in a sequence, or does not have an email address. What to check: Verify that the record has a valid email address, has not opted out of email communication, and is not already enrolled in another sequence.

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: Resolution: Add a valid email address if one is missing, update email preferences if consent has been obtained, or un-enroll the record from the existing sequence before enrolling them in a new one. What happens if I edit a sequence that already has active enrollments? Changes made to a sequence will only apply to future enrollments. Candidates or contacts who are already enrolled will continue following the version of the sequence they were enrolled in. What happens when a candidate or contact replies to a sequence email?

chunks.t: Managing Your Email Sequence
chunks.x: When a recipient replies to an email in the sequence, the sequence is automatically paused and the candidate or contact is unenrolled to prevent further automated follow-ups. Using sequence enrollment in Recruit CRM, you can automate structured outreach, customize messages at enrollment time, and stay in control of who is enrolled and when. If you need more help with a specific sequence or enrollment scenario, please reach out to Recruit CRM support for further assistance.

chunks.t: Adding a data add-on to your subscription
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? An Additional Records Limit is a monthly add-on that increases your Recruit CRM account's storage capacity without requiring you to purchase an additional user. Each add-on expands your account limit by 10,000 candidates, 10,000 contacts, and 10,000 company records , and the additional capacity is available across the entire account. You've reached, or are close to reaching, your account's maximum record limit. You want to increase your storage capacity without paying for an additional user. You need to expand your account's record limit for the entire team.

chunks.t: Adding a data add-on to your subscription
chunks.x: Please note: Additional Records Limits are applied at the account level , not per user. For example, purchasing one add-on increases your account capacity by 10,000 candidates, 10,000 contacts, and 10,000 company records for everyone using the account. Step-by-step instructions to add the Data Add-On Follow these steps to purchase an additional records limit for your account: Go to Admin Settings in your Recruit CRM account and under Account Management , click Plans and Billing . ​ Scroll down to the Additional Records Limit section. Now, select the number of add-ons you want to purchase. ​

chunks.t: Adding a data add-on to your subscription
chunks.x: Once you've chosen this, you can click on the ' Review Order ' button on the right side of the screen, under the 'Bill Summary', to proceed with the payment. ​ On the order review page, select the required checkbox and click Update Plan and Pay to complete your purchase. The prorated amount is calculated automatically based on your Recruit CRM subscription renewal date. Once the payment is complete, the additional records limit is applied immediately to your account. Problem: Applicants cannot submit job applications, or new candidates and records cannot be added through the Recruit CRM Chrome Extension because a limit reached error is displayed.

chunks.t: Adding a data add-on to your subscription
chunks.x: Likely cause: Your account has reached its maximum records limit for candidates, contacts, or companies. What to check: Go to Admin Settings → Account and review your account's current records usage to confirm whether the record limit has been exhausted. Resolution: Purchase an Additional Records Limit add-on to increase your account's capacity. Once the add-on is applied, applicants will be able to submit new applications again, and records can be added through the Recruit CRM Chrome Extension and other record creation methods without encountering the limit reached error. Q1: What is an additional records limit in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Task Sequencing in Recruit CRM: How to Create and Use Task Sequences
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Task sequencing is a powerful method to automatically set up tasks for your candidate and contact profiles in Recruit CRM, along with other follow-up steps (emails, LinkedIn steps, SMS steps). A sequence defines a series of steps and the number of days after the sequence start when each step should occur. Once a record is enrolled in a sequence, Recruit CRM creates the tasks according to the task steps you configured. You want to automatically set up tasks for candidate profiles. You want to automatically set up tasks for contact profiles. You need a structured, multi-step follow-up process using tasks, emails, LinkedIn steps, and SMS steps.

chunks.t: Task Sequencing in Recruit CRM: How to Create and Use Task Sequences
chunks.x: You want consistent timing between outreach steps without manually creating each task. Task sequencing is available as a Business plan and above. Users on Pro or Free plans can create only one sequence. Only account owners, admins, and users on custom roles with access to sequences can create task and email sequences. Decide whether you want to build the sequence for candidates or contacts before you start. Plan your steps (tasks, emails, LinkedIn steps, SMS steps) and their timing, including how many days after the sequence start each step should occur. Under CRM Process Customization , click on Sequences .

chunks.t: Task Sequencing in Recruit CRM: How to Create and Use Task Sequences
chunks.x: Select either Candidates or Contacts as the record type for which you want to create the sequence. Enter the Sequence Title to name your sequence. For each step, specify the number of days after the start of the sequence when that step should be set up. ​ Confirm the days you set for each task step, as this defines when the task will be due relative to the sequence start date. ​ Understand how timing is calculated: ​ Task due date = Start date + Specified number of days. ​ Start date is the date when the task sequence is initiated. ​ "Specified Date" is the number of days you have indicated for the task to be set up after the start of the sequence. ​

chunks.t: Task Sequencing in Recruit CRM: How to Create and Use Task Sequences
chunks.x: Add steps to the sequence as required, up to a maximum of 40 steps in total. ​Within those forty steps, you can include up to ten task steps, ten email steps, ten LinkedIn steps, and ten SMS steps. ​ Rearrange the order of sequence steps using the drag-and-drop functionality to match your desired workflow. ​ For each step, set a specific number of days for it to execute, choosing between a range of 1 to 250 calendar days or business days. ​

chunks.t: Task Sequencing in Recruit CRM: How to Create and Use Task Sequences
chunks.x: To create tasks on the same day the sequence is initiated, set the day value to 0 for that step. ​When using a step on day 0, align the timing carefully with any previous steps or schedule it for a later time than the preceding step to keep the workflow seamless. ​ Enroll contacts into a sequence while pitching candidates: When pitching candidates to contacts, complete the process of sending the email or marking the candidates as pitched. ​ After the successful completion of sending the email or marking candidates as pitched, you will be automatically redirected to a page where you can enroll those contacts into a sequence. ​

chunks.t: Task Sequencing in Recruit CRM: How to Create and Use Task Sequences
chunks.x: On the redirected page, follow the on-screen options to enroll the relevant contacts into your chosen sequence. ​ Once enrollment is complete, your configured steps will run according to the days and step types you have set in the sequence. ​ How is the task due date calculated in a sequence? The task due date is calculated as: Task due date = Start date + Specified number of days , where the start date is when the sequence is initiated. ​ "Specified Date" is the number of days you have indicated for the task to be set up after the start of the sequence. ​

chunks.t: Task Sequencing in Recruit CRM: How to Create and Use Task Sequences
chunks.x: Task sequencing in Recruit CRM helps you automate structured follow-up for candidates and contacts by defining clear steps and timing. Configure your sequences carefully, especially the day values for each step, and you will maintain a consistent, efficient workflow with minimal manual effort.

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: 1. Does Recruit CRM provide a free trial, and how long can I use the free trial? Yes, Recruit CRM offers a usage-based free trial , not a time-limited one. On the free plan, usage is counted even if records are deleted. ​ Once these limits are reached, you’ll need to upgrade to a paid plan. On paid plans, deleting records frees up space. ​ You can sign up for a free trial using the link below: 2. Can I log into Recruit CRM from multiple devices? Logging in from multiple laptops or desktops at the same time is not supported. Below are links to download our mobile apps: ​ iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/recruit-crm/id1532855707#?platform=iphone

To add another license to your account, please follow the steps below: Go to Admin Settings >>> Plans & Billing and then click on the " Edit Current Plan " button. ​ Increase the number of users by the number of users you want and click on "Review Order" and "Update Plan & Pay" ​ Once you do that, you'll then be charged for the additional seat that you bought for the remaining period of your billing cycle. Once this is done, go to Admin settings >>> Users to invite your teammates. ​ This article will help you with that .

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: Here's a Webinar Registration form. You can have them fill up for a Webinar to train them on using Recruit CRM! ​ 7. Does Recruit CRM have a search functionality? Yes, Recruit CRM includes advanced search capabilities across all record types. You can use advanced filters and Boolean operators to find records based on specific keywords and conditions. ​ ​ Here is an article to help you do this: Recruit CRM uses Amazon Web Services (AWS) for its infrastructure. For Pro and Business plans, data is stored and replicated across multiple AWS data centers, including regions in Ireland, Singapore, and the United States. ​

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: Data is automatically served from the nearest data center to reduce latency and improve uptime. ​ ​ Important note: Recruit CRM is fully GDPR compliant , with strict controls for global data handling and deletion. You can read our Data Processing Agreement & GDPR policy at the bottom of our website to confirm this. ​ ​ Here’s a link: ​ https://recruitcrm.io/legal/data-processing-agreement

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: We ensure that we strictly adhere to GDPR rules for data globally, which includes deleting data across global data centers if requested by an end candidate or user of Recruit CRM. We specifically comply and have European SCCs (Standard contractual clauses) that are a framework to stay compliant while transferring data outside the EU for data processing. ​ You can learn more about this from the website below:

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: For Enterprise customers, there is an option to set up a custom server or database in a specific AWS data center of your choice, such as Germany or Dublin. This setup is typically only required for organizations with specific regulatory or government-related data residency requirements within the EEA and is not mandatory for standard GDPR compliance. ​ 9. How can I change the default owner of a candidate who applied via the talent pool? By default, candidates who apply through external pages are assigned to the account owner . There is currently no direct option to change this behavior.

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: As a workaround, you can: Run an advanced search where the "source" is " Talent Pool" and bulk update the owner of those candidate records. 12. How many GB of storage do we get on RCRM? Each paid license includes 50 GB of storage per user . Total available storage increases with the number of licenses purchased. 13. I s there a way I can tell who has unsubscribed? Yes, you can do this using Advanced Search . Run an Advanced Search on the default Opt-out field If the value is Yes , the person has unsubscribed If the value is No , the person is still receiving emails ​ This allows you to clearly identify unsubscribed users.

Is it possible to choose the owner when importing a file of candidates?

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: No, it is not possible to choose a different owner during bulk import. The person who imports the file becomes the default owner​. ​ ​However, there is a workaround for this: ​ After the candidate is added to the system you can bulk-update the owner of that candidate. Now to keep track of the owner of that candidate on the CSV sheet before importing you can create a custom field for the "owner of candidate". This way you can run an Advanced search on the custom field you added so for example 100 records from your CV belong to teammate A and 200 to B. Then after uploading this to the system you can run a search on this field and search for the records where on the custom field the owner is A.

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: So only the records with A on the custom field "owner of candidate" will appear and then you can bulk update the record/default owner since it was the person who imports to the person who owns that candidate/contact on CSV. 27. Is the extension capable of capturing the candidate's email address through their LinkedIn profile? Yes! If the email is visible on the profile on LinkedIn then the extension will also capture their email/phone information.

So you need to have access to their email information to the extension to be able to catch this. 32. Can I add a monthly add-on to my annual subscription? I'm afraid it's not possible to have monthly Add-Ons to your annual since your main subscription is annual, the add-on will be charged annually as well.

chunks.x: 33. On the Candidate Page under the tab "Assigned Jobs" is there a way to have the Job ID show next to the Job Name that they are assigned to? I'm afraid currently, Job ID is not visible in the Assigned Jobs tab. To view the Job ID you would need to navigate to the job details page by clicking on the specific job to check the ID. 34. If I have a candidate record in the system and I then parse the same candidate into the system... is the first record replaced by the 2nd record?

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: If you have an existing candidate in your database and you try to parse the resume of the same candidate, the system will recognize them as duplicates and automatically update their existing profile (only updating the empty fields). To ensure the system identifies duplicates, make sure the following toggles are turned off: https://app.recruitcrm.io/v1/account-management Please note that we detect duplicates based on 3 unique identifiers: 1. Email Id ﻿2. Contact no. ﻿3. LinkedIn URL

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: If you want existing candidates to be identified as duplicates when you parse them again, the new resume/candidate you add must have one of these three unique identifiers exactly the same as the existing candidate in your database. 35. How to add new fields to the Profile Update Request form? The form uses Candidate fields from Admin Settings . First, add a custom field on the Candidate page Then enable its visibility on the Profile Update Request form The article below will show how you can set it up and customize the form according to your needs: ​ Customize Profile Update Request Form | Help Center

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: Note: The fields used for this form are the ones on the candidate fields section page in Admin Settings. So if you want to add new ones you need to first add a custom field to the candidate page and then make them available by turning on the visibility in the Profile Update Request Form . 36. What happens when 2 records are merged? Only the empty fields in the primary record will be updated with new data from the selected candidate/contact/company. No existing data on the primary record will be overridden while merging. Along with updating data fields, the merge process also moves all related information from the duplicate record to the primary one. This includes-

Note: If any team member has enabled the "Hide Your Mails" option, their emails with the candidate or contact will not be visible in the Related Emails Tab. 38. Can you send the actual dimensions for the logo and banner images for the job page? chunks.x: 42. How can my team members have the same profile view as me? All the changes you make to the candidate custom fields/default fields on the Admin settings will be reflected in all the user profiles in your account and all the users will be able to access this from their profiles. ​﻿ ﻿However on the candidate details page to change the view of all the fields they would need to do this on their own profiles. The arrangement of all the fields is profile-specific . So what you can do is take a screenshot of the view you want them to have and ask them to set it up. Field visibility and rearrangement on lists Replacing/Reordering Fields on profile pages

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: 43. Can I get a refund/ Can I revoke my license and get my money back/ I don't need this seat, can I request a refund? Recruit CRM, just like any other SaaS product works on a prepaid subscription model. And, as per our company’s terms, all Recruit CRM subscriptions are non-refundable. ​ You can Refer to point 9.5 of Recruit CRM terms for the same. Any changes to the account or any payment-related issues should be done/communicated to us before the renewal date. Now, since your card has already been charged, a refund won’t be possible binding the company’s policy. ​ 44. How do I change the currency in RCRM?

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: The default currency of the whole account is set up by the Account Owner inside the Account Settings. The deal's currency is the same as the account's currency. However, you can also change the currency of your user/profile. ﻿​﻿ ﻿To change your Currency, you need to go to the Profile Page by clicking on the avatar at the top right corner of your screen and hitting “Profile”. You can use this link . Then, go to the "Default Currency" field and choose the option from the drop-down. This will automatically take it as a default currency wherever required in Recruit CRM (except for Deals). NOTE: You can also have separate currency for each candidate and each job.

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: You can change that by going inside the candidate's profile or inside that job. You can learn more about it here: Setting up your profile section and Deals in Recruit CRM . ﻿​ As for the records you already have a "currency", only the sign will change as we do not convert the values added, so if you want to change the "values" as well for those old records, you would need to use our automation tool for this!

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: Recruit CRM has an in-built automation tool called “ Workflow Automation ” that helps you automate repetitive tasks between two or more apps - no code necessary. ﻿​﻿ ﻿Workflow Automation comes with an add-on subscription, which is separate from the standard Recruit CRM subscription. If you are interested in discussing this further, please feel free to reach out via the chatbot. ​ 45. What does the candidate history section do? The candidate history displays all jobs to which the candidate has been assigned or applied, including multiple instances of the same job. Conversely, the "Assigned Jobs" tab exclusively lists current assignments.

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: Closed jobs or those from which candidates have been unassigned will appear in the "candidate history tab" not the "assigned tab". Note: when unassigning a candidate, all notes and remarks associated with the job remain intact in the history tab, ensuring data integrity and continuity. I am afraid that it is not possible to set a font style as a default font. Once you have generated a Resume/CV and saved how do I find this in the system?

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook

Does the AI matching function match candidates within the database or from LinkedIn?

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: The AI Candidate Matching feature searches through your whole database in Recruit CRM, but it doesn't have direct access to any information on LinkedIn unless you upload it to your database. ​﻿ ﻿The AI analyses candidate's profiles and their CVs looking for information such as skills, experience, education, location, language, job titles, industry, etc. ​﻿ ﻿You can more information regarding this feature in this article: ​﻿​﻿ Use AI to find candidate matches in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: 52. If I delete meetings within RCRM (because the candidate or client changed their mind) it's still on my calendar. Is there some different/preferred method of deleting canceled meetings within RCRM so it also reflects on my calendar? Currently, if you add a meeting in Recruit CRM, you'll need to delete it from both Recruit CRM and your calendar. This is because our calendar feature operates as a one-way sync: meetings added appear in the system, but deleting a meeting from Recruit CRM won't remove it from your calendar. Since it's a one-way integration, currently, to delete meetings from both the calendar and RCRM, you have to delete them from both places.

How to assign tasks to someone in Recruit CRM: When creating a new task, you can assign it by simply selecting the desired person as the owner of the task. ​

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook
chunks.x: If the task has already been created and you want to assign it to someone else, you can update it manually by editing the task and changing the owner. You can do this either individually or in bulk. To update tasks in bulk, go to the Tasks and Meetings page , select the tasks you want to reassign, and click Update Field to change the owner. ​ 58. I'm not able to see a field when adding a candidate/job/contact/company/deal and I used to be able to add this field. In this case, there are a few things you need to check that might solve the issue!

chunks.t: FAQ Handbook

We need Recruit CRM's VAT/TAX. How can we get it? Recruit CRM is a US corporation and doesn’t have a VAT registration in Europe or the UK. The invoice has VAT set to 0, and the “Reverse Charge” mechanism can be used to report this in your tax filing. chunks.t: AI Assist for Notes and Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? AI Assist for notes and call logs in Recruit CRM uses AI to help you manage and improve written information in notes and call logs across all major entities (candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, and deals). You can use this feature when you want to: Turn long, unstructured notes into short, readable summaries. Extract key points from a conversation or call into bullet points. Improve the clarity and tone of your notes before saving them. Standardize note-taking across your team with shared, reusable prompts. AI Assist is available while adding notes and call logs on entities such as candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, and deals.

chunks.t: AI Assist for Notes and Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You access AI Assist by clicking the AI Assist icon in the note or call log area. You can only delete prompts that you have created yourself. Prompts created by teammates must be deleted by those teammates. Open the relevant record (candidate, company, contact, job, or deal). Click the AI Assist icon within the note editor to open the AI Assist panel. In the AI Assist panel, choose one of the three default prompts : Summarize : to simplify and shorten the text you entered. Extract key points : to turn the main information into bullet points. Improve it : to refine and enhance the existing note. Wait for AI Assist to generate the output based on the selected prompt. Review the generated text.

chunks.t: AI Assist for Notes and Call Logs in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Apply AI-generated content (Replace, Copy, Regenerate) To update your note with the AI version, click Replace to overwrite the original content. To keep your original note but reuse the AI content elsewhere, click Copy to copy the AI output. If you are not satisfied with the AI result, click Regenerate to produce a new version. chunks.t: How to access the XML feed
chunks.x: An XML feed is a structured data format used to distribute job listings across different platforms, including job boards. It provides a standardized and machine-readable way to share job-related information. The XML feed follows a specific format organizing details like job titles, descriptions, locations, requirements, and application instructions. Job boards consume the feed to display job listings consistently on their platforms. With the automatic transfer of applicant information, this functionality saves time and reduces errors. You can access the XML feed when: You want to verify which jobs are being sent via XML. Navigate to the Admin settings > Build Job Feed XML .

chunks.t: How to access the XML feed
chunks.x: Copy the XML feed URL and paste it into the new tab. You'll see a page with a list of all the jobs eligible to be posted on the job board, provided they fulfil the necessary criteria. Right-click anywhere on the page and select "View Page Source". Problem: A job is not visible in the XML feed. Likely cause: The job does not meet the necessary criteria for eligibility. What to check: Confirm if the necessary criteria are met for the jobs to be visible on the XML feed you have created. Click here to learn more about the criteria . Resolution path: Update the job so it fulfils the necessary criteria, wait for the feed to refresh, then check the XML feed again.

chunks.t: How to access the XML feed
chunks.x: 1. Are jobs posted to the job board immediately after they are updated in the XML feed? No. The XML feed is updated automatically, but the timing of when the jobs are actually posted depends on the specific job board. 2. How often does Indeed check the XML feed for new or updated jobs? Indeed uses automated crawlers to check the XML feed approximately every 6 hours (about four times a day). If you add or update a job, Indeed will usually pick up the changes during the next crawl. However, the final decision on whether and when the job is published is entirely up to Indeed. 3. Does every job appear in the Indeed XML feed?

chunks.t: How to access the XML feed
chunks.x: No. Only jobs that fulfil the necessary criteria are eligible and will appear in the feed. By following these steps, you can easily access and review your XML feed, verify which jobs are eligible for posting, and share the feed URL with the job board when required. If you have any questions please feel free to reach out to our chatbot located in the bottom-right corner of the page. chunks.t: How to grant admin access on the Microsoft Azure portal
chunks.x: If users in your organization see a "Need admin approval" error when connecting their email to Recruit CRM, an Azure admin needs to grant the required permissions in the Microsoft Azure Portal. This article walks you through the complete process — from signing in to confirming that access has been successfully granted. Please note: You need to have Admin permissions in your Microsoft Account to grant Admin Consent to an enterprise application in the Azure Portal.

chunks.t: How to grant admin access on the Microsoft Azure portal
chunks.x: Important: The Recruit CRM application (labeled Recruit CRM-v3) will only appear in the Enterprise Applications list if a user has already attempted to connect their email in Recruit CRM. Make sure a user triggers that connection request before you proceed. Grant Admin Consent Directly to the Application This is the primary method for granting Recruit CRM the permissions it needs. Follow these steps as an Azure admin. Go to portal.azure.com and sign in using your administrator account credentials. Click Sign in now . Step 2: Navigate to Enterprise Applications

chunks.t: How to grant admin access on the Microsoft Azure portal
chunks.x: From the Azure home screen, search for "Enterprise applications" in the top search bar, or locate it in the left-hand navigation menu. Click on Enterprise applications . You will land on the Enterprise applications | All applications page, listing every application connected to your organization's tenant. In the applications list, locate Recruit CRM-v3 . Click on the application name to open it. Inside the Recruit CRM-v3 application page, click on Users and groups in the left-hand menu under the Manage section. This shows which users and groups currently have access to the application.

chunks.t: How to grant admin access on the Microsoft Azure portal
chunks.x: 📝 Note: If you cannot find Recruit CRM in the list, make sure a user in your organization has first attempted to connect their email within Recruit CRM. This action registers the application in your Azure tenant. If you need to add more users or groups to the application, use the + Add user/group button at the top of this page. In the left-hand menu, scroll down to the Security section and click on Permissions . This page lists all permissions that have been granted to Recruit CRM for your organization.

chunks.t: How to grant admin access on the Microsoft Azure portal
chunks.x: On the Permissions page, click the "Grant admin consent for [your organization]" button. A confirmation dialog will appear — review the requested permissions and click Accept to grant consent on behalf of all users in your organization. ✅ Tip: Granting admin consent means all users in your organization can use Recruit CRM with the required Microsoft permissions (such as accessing email and calendar data) without needing to individually consent. This is a delegated permission granted at the tenant level. After granting consent, check both the Admin consent and User consent tabs to verify that permissions are correctly listed.

chunks.t: How to grant admin access on the Microsoft Azure portal
chunks.x: Click on Admin consent requests . Under My Pending Tab, click on "RecruitCRM-v3" and then click Review permissions and consent. ✅ Tip: After granting admin consent, navigate back to the Recruit CRM-v3 Permissions page and confirm that permissions appear under the Admin consent tab. Users in your organization can now connect their email in Recruit CRM without the "Need admin approval" error. Once admin consent has been successfully granted, your team members will be able to connect their email accounts to Recruit CRM without any interruptions. chunks.t: Deal Split
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? With the deal split feature, you can collaborate with your teammates, assign split percentages, distribute the commission, and generate comprehensive reports for better insights. You need to split a deal amount or commission between multiple teammates. You want to include teams (not just individuals) in a deal split. You need accurate reporting and dashboard insights based on deal splits. Learn more about: ​ ​ Deal splits in reporting. Adding team members and/or teams to a split 1. Open the relevant deal in Recruit CRM. 2. Click the Deal split tab on the deal details page.

chunks.t: Deal Split
chunks.x: 2. If there are no collaborators yet, this section will show the deal owner with a 100% deal split percentage. 3. Now, click on the ' Edit Deal Split' button. In the search field, search for the teammates and/or teams you want to add to the split. 4. Select the teammates and/or teams to include them in the deal split. Once added, they automatically become collaborators on the deal. ​ The user will also receive an email informing they have been added as a collaborator in the deal. ​ 1. By default, the deal is set on ' Equal Split '. This means that each collaborator will be assigned an equal split percentage.

chunks.t: Deal Split
chunks.x: 2. To customize the split percentages, select ' Custom Split ' from the drop-down menu. Now, you will be able to make changes and assign split percent values for each teammate or team. 3. Once the percentages are assigned, you can track the Commission for each teammate throughout the deal's progress through stages under the ' Weighted Deal ' column. With the ' Deal by Teammate/Team Report ,' you can gain a comprehensive overview of all deals in all stages in two distinct tables- one for teammates and another for teams. Additionally, the bar graphs provide a clear visual distinction between the teammates and the teams.

chunks.t: Deal Split
chunks.x: The "Unallocated" row ensures transparency in deal splits. Any split percentage that hasn't been distributed to specific team members or teams is shown in this row. It ensures that the total split value always sums up to 100%. The "Total" column represents the overall deal value, calculated as: Sum of all stage values - Sum of lost stage value = Total On the dashboard , the Total Deals Statistics report displays all deal stages and provides us with the status of each deal.

chunks.t: Deal Split
chunks.x: In addition to viewing the overall statistics, you can also generate reports specific to individual teammates or teams where you can see metrics of split amount and weighted split amount , allowing for more targeted analysis. Here is a quick video to get you started: Problem: Only the deal owner appears in the Deal split tab with 100% split. Likely cause: No collaborators have been added yet. What to check: Open the Deal split tab and look for the Edit deal split button. Resolution: Click Edit deal split, search for the required teammates and/or teams, and add them to the split. Where do I manage deal splits for a specific deal?

chunks.t: Deal Split
chunks.x: You manage deal splits from the Deal split tab on the deal details page. What happens if there are no collaborators on a deal split? If there are no collaborators, the Deal split tab shows the deal owner with a 100% deal split percentage. What is the default behavior when I add multiple collaborators? By default, the deal is set to equal split, so each collaborator is assigned an equal split percentage. Do collaborators get notified when they are added to a deal split? Yes. When you add teammates or teams to a split, they automatically become collaborators on the deal and receive an email informing them they have been added.

chunks.t: Deal Split
chunks.x: Using the deal split feature in Recruit CRM helps you share deal amounts fairly, keep collaborators informed, and track commission accurately as deals progress.

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The sequence is a powerful strategy that enables you to streamline your communication efforts and optimize task management. In this article, we will talk about the various sequence capabilities Recruit CRM offers. When a candidate or contact is enrolled, Recruit CRM begins executing the sequence from the first configured step. Each step executes in sequence according to its configured timing and channel. The next step is triggered based on the delays and schedule defined within the sequence. This allows you to automate outreach, follow-ups, and internal actions without manually managing each interaction.

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If a step fails due to issues such as a disconnected email account, insufficient SMS credits, or invalid contact information, the enrollment may pause until the issue is resolved. A candidate or contact can only be actively enrolled in one sequence at a time. What this feature does and when to use it? Sequences in Recruit CRM help you automate communication and follow-ups across multiple channels such as email, SMS, LinkedIn, and internal tasks. Instead of manually reaching out at every step, you can set up a structured workflow that runs automatically over time. This ensures consistent outreach, better engagement, and fewer missed follow-ups while managing candidates or contacts at scale.

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM
chunks.x: • You want to automate candidate follow-ups after sourcing. • You want to Reactivate an existing talent pool. Please note : This is an exclusive feature which is available on Business plan and above. Users on the Pro plan/Free Trial can create only 1 sequence on their account at a time. • Ensure your email, SMS provider, and LinkedIn integrations (where applicable) are connected and active. • Confirm that you have the required permissions to access Admin Settings > Sequences if you plan to manage sequence configurations. • Make sure candidate and contact records have valid email addresses, phone numbers, and LinkedIn URLs (if used in sequences).

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM
chunks.x: • Check that your account has sufficient SMS credits if you are using SMS sequences . • Be aware that opted-out contacts (email/SMS) and candidates already in another sequence will not be enrolled again. Understand sequence types and capabilities Recruit CRM supports multiple types of sequencing that you can use individually or in combination: Send a series of scheduled email templates to candidates and contacts over a defined period. This ensures consistent, timely, and personalized outreach, with emails going out one after another as configured. ​ ​ Click here to read more about Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Create SMS sequences to automatically send timely text messages to candidates and contacts. This helps automate communication, improve engagement, and streamline your recruitment process. Click here to read more about SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM Create a sequence of LinkedIn messages to be sent to candidates and contacts at scheduled intervals. This keeps you in touch with prospects automatically, improving response rates and smoothing your recruitment workflow. Click here to read more about LinkedIn Sequencing in Recruit CRM

These automatically create and assign tasks on candidate and contact profiles, helping you manage follow-ups and internal actions consistently. Q1. Can a candidate or contact be enrolled in multiple sequences at the same time? No. Records that are already enrolled in another sequence are excluded during bulk enrollment, so a candidate or contact can only be actively enrolled in one sequence at a time. Q2. Do changes to a sequence affect enrollments that are already in progress?

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM
chunks.x: No. Edits to a sequence only apply to future enrollments. Existing enrollments continue using the version of the sequence that was active when they were enrolled. Q3. What happens if my email account disconnects during a sequence? If your email account disconnects or the token expires, affected email steps will fail and enrollments will be paused. Once you reconnect your email, you can choose to reschedule failed steps in the next 30 minutes or allow them to run on their original schedule. Q4. Can I choose which email address a sequence sends from? Yes. If you have two email IDs configured, you can choose which email ID to use when enrolling records into a sequence.

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: Recruit CRM's advanced search feature lets you combine a powerful Boolean search with column-level filters. You can use this feature when: You want to narrow down large lists of candidates, contacts, companies, or jobs. You need to find records that match (or exclude) specific keywords, locations, or skills. You’re combining Boolean search with field-level filters for more precise results. You’re analysing activities (notes, calls, tasks, meetings) linked to your records. You want to quickly identify records with empty or filled-in fields. Open the Add Filters in Recruit CRM’s to access the full list of filter types you can apply to your search criteria.

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: Use the “ Is ” Filter for Exact Matches of a keyword. The Is filter looks for an exact match of a keyword. You can use it to find all the candidates who are located in a specific state or city, and it will exactly match the word you're searching for. Example, you can search for all the candidates located in Delhi using the Is filter. ​ Use the “ Is not ” Filter to Exclude Values . The Is not filter excludes records that do not fit a certain set of criteria. You might use the Is not filter to remove candidates who do not meet a particular requirement. For example, you could use the Is not filter to find any candidates who are not specified in a skill set. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: The Contains filter helps identify partial Keyword Matches. The Contains filter identifies records containing a specific keyword or criteria. For example, you could search for all candidates who have the word marketing in their resume using the Contains filter. ​ Use the “ Does not contain ” Filter to Omit Keywords. The Does not contain filter allows you to search for records that don't have a specific word or criteria. For example, you could search for contacts that don't have the title of manager. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: Use the “ Contains Exact Word ” Filter for Precise Word Matches. This filter looks for the exact word you enter, but allows it to appear anywhere within the field as a standalone word. Unlike the regular Contains filter, it will not return results where the keyword is part of a larger word. For example, if you search for “Shravya” using the Contains Exact Word filter, it will return results like “Shravya Verma” or “Shravya M”, but will exclude variations where the word is embedded within another term or formatted differently. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: Use the “ Contains at least one ” Filter for Multiple Keywords. Use this filter to find records that match at least one keyword from a list. For example, you could search for all candidates who have either marketing or accounting skills using the Contains at least one filter. ​ Use the “ Begins with ” Filter for Starting Text Begins with the specific keyword. The Begins with filter finds records starting with a keyword or a phrase. For example, you can search for all jobs that begin with the word product using the Begin with filter. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: Use the “ Ends with ” Filter for Ending Text Ends with a specific keyword. Use this filter to find records ending with a specific keyword. For example, you could search for all jobs that ends with the word manager using the Ends with filter. ​ Use the “ Has any value ” Filter for Non-Empty Fields that have any value. Use this filter to find records where the selected field is not empty. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: Use the “ Is empty ” Filter and Apply Your Filters. You can use the Is empty filter to search for records that have the specific field selected as empty, and then click on Apply to save these changes and save the filter and use it. Now that you know everything about filter types, you should try to run a search. ​ Understand Record Fields vs Activity Fields Across all entities, filters are broadly divided into two main categories. One is record fields. These are core details of records like candidate, company, contact, or job.

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: And the second is activity fields such as notes, calls, tasks, and meetings. Each activity type can be further filtered using added on, updated on, added by, or updated by the type associated with, collaborated with, and whether it exists or not. How is “Is” different from “Contains” in Advanced Search? The Is filter looks for an exact match of a keyword in the selected field, while Contains finds records where the keyword appears anywhere in that field, even as part of a longer phrase. Can I combine Boolean search with these filter types?

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search
chunks.x: Yes. Recruit CRM's advanced search feature lets you combine a powerful Boolean search with column-level filters. You can run a Boolean query and then refine the results using filters like Is , Contains , Is empty , and more. Using the right filter types in Recruit CRM’s Advanced Search helps you quickly narrow down large datasets, find exactly the records you need, and spot gaps or patterns in your data. chunks.t: Understanding bulk email limits in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Recruit CRM offers a bulk emailing/email shot option so you can send out bulk emails to your candidates/contacts in a single shot. Click here to learn how to bulk-email your candidates and contacts While Recruit CRM allows you to send an email shot to 500 candidates/contacts at a time, it is important to understand that most email service providers (like Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, etc.) impose certain restrictions on the number or volume of emails that can be sent in a single batch AND/OR within a day . ​ Sending bulk emails beyond these limits may result in temporary account suspension and the classification of your emails as spam.

chunks.t: Understanding bulk email limits in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Here are a few limits set by different email providers for your reference: To help improve email deliverability and reduce the risk of sender accounts being restricted, Recruit CRM sends bulk emails with a randomized delay of 5–10 seconds between each email instead of using a fixed interval. ​ This creates a more natural sending pattern, which helps prevent email providers such as Microsoft Outlook and Office 365 from identifying bulk email campaigns as automated activity. ​ ​ Please note: Because of this randomized delay, bulk email campaigns may take slightly longer to complete. However, this safeguard helps protect your account reputation and improves overall email deliverability.

chunks.t: Understanding bulk email limits in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: While you can choose up to 500 records at a time (in Recruit CRM) to email at once, it's not recommended to send emails to a large number of recipients all at once. ​ It's advisable to keep your email batches relatively small, typically no more than 30 to 50 emails at a time, based on the restrictions set by your email service providers. After sending each batch, we recommend waiting 20 to 30 minutes before sending the next batch. Recruit CRM also spaces individual emails within a bulk campaign using a randomized 5–10 second delay to create a more natural sending pattern and help improve email deliverability.

chunks.t: Understanding bulk email limits in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: This strategy can lower the risk of your email account being flagged by your service provider, thus reducing the chances of these emails landing in the spam folder of your candidates or contacts. Why shouldn’t I send to all 500 recipients at once? Most email service providers (like Gmail, Outlook, and Yahoo) have their own sending limits. Sending to a very large number of recipients in a single batch can trigger these limits, cause temporary account suspension, or lead to your emails being marked as spam. What batch size does Recruit CRM recommend for bulk emails?

chunks.t: Understanding bulk email limits in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: It is advisable to keep your email batches relatively small, typically no more than 30–50 emails at a time, based on the restrictions set by your email service provider. How long should I wait between bulk email batches? After sending each batch, it is recommended to wait for a 20–30 minute interval before sending the next set of emails. By understanding Recruit CRM’s bulk email capacity and your email provider’s limits, you can plan safe, effective email shots that reach candidates and contacts. chunks.t: Secure your account using Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Two-Factor Authentication (2FA), or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), adds an additional layer of security to your Recruit CRM account by requiring a verification code from an authenticator app in addition to your username and password when signing in. When 2FA is enabled, your Recruit CRM account is linked to an authenticator app using a QR code or setup key. The authenticator app generates a time-based, one-time six-digit verification code that must be entered during login.

chunks.t: Secure your account using Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
chunks.x: When 2FA is enforced at the account level, all users are required to configure and use 2FA unless they have been specifically excluded. Users receive an email notification prompting them to complete the setup and can configure it during their next login. • You want to add an extra layer of protection to your Recruit CRM account • Your organization has security or compliance requirements that mandate 2FA or MFA. • You need to enforce 2FA for all users, or all users except selected individuals. 1. To set up 2FA/MFA for your account, click on your Profile icon in the top-right corner of Recruit CRM and select Profile . ​

chunks.t: Secure your account using Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)/Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)

What to check: Look at the 2FA status column for each user. Resolution: Use these definitions: Disabled = 2FA is not enabled Enabled = user turned on 2FA Enforced = 2FA is mandatory for that user. chunks.t: Recent policy changes from Google,Yahoo & Microsoft
chunks.x: Google , Yahoo , and Microsoft announced an upcoming change to their policies to enhance security, privacy, and overall user experience. These changes aim to create a safer online environment for users and reduce the risks associated with email communication. As a result, it is crucial for you to ensure that your email practices align with these updated policies to avoid any disruptions in communication. To maintain a seamless and secure exchange of emails, we kindly request your cooperation in adhering to the following guidelines:

chunks.t: Recent policy changes from Google,Yahoo & Microsoft
chunks.x: Ensure that your email server supports industry-standard authentication protocols such as SPF (Sender Policy Framework), DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail), and DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance). This helps in verifying the authenticity of the sender and prevents email spoofing. SPF is an email authentication protocol that allows the domain owner to specify which mail servers are authorized to send emails on behalf of their domain. Add a TXT record containing your SPF information. For example: v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all Customize the "include" values based on the email service providers you use.

chunks.t: Recent policy changes from Google,Yahoo & Microsoft
chunks.x: DKIM adds a digital signature to outgoing emails, allowing the recipient to verify that the email was genuinely sent by the domain owner and has not been altered during transit. Generate a DKIM key pair, usually provided by your email service provider. Add the public key as a TXT record in your domain's DNS. selector._domainkey.yourdomain.com IN TXT "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=MIGfMA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUAA4GNADCBiQKBgQC2Gv1u0Awuzx2pLkoHw84BYz0RL1D8lPKQxdJmy8QF3gIytkTcSkVLrLeQsWMx5bV8TVTIh6aBREwhHwV7PLUzB4JY0ULdnG0sW/W3UrcLCYQWqBA2vq8+jOuj6DUMcBoFwP5rtbCm0LiPy1f+yaq2KFEnq5XkFDnETUpTTekQIDAQAB" Adjust the "selector" and "p" values accordingly.

chunks.t: Recent policy changes from Google,Yahoo & Microsoft
chunks.x: 1.3 DMARC (Domain-based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance) DMARC builds on SPF and DKIM to provide a policy framework for domain owners to specify how email receivers should handle messages that fail authentication. Create a TXT record in your DNS with the DMARC policy. For example: _dmarc.yourdomain.com IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@example.com; ruf=mailto:dmarc@example.com; fo=1" Customize the "p" value based on your desired policy (none, quarantine, or reject). 1. Regularly monitor DMARC reports and adjust policies accordingly. 2. Test your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configurations using online tools.

chunks.t: Recent policy changes from Google,Yahoo & Microsoft
chunks.x: 3. Keep your DNS records up to date as your email infrastructure evolves. If you encounter any challenges during the implementation process or have questions, please reach out to your Email Administrator/ Email Service Provider. Email recipients must be able to unsubscribe from unwanted emails without any hassle. It should just take one click. Based on email sender guidelines from Google , you should maintain a spam rate of 0.1% or less to verify recipients of your email successfully receive your emails. If your spam rate is consistently 0.3% or more, you may experience email performance issues, including delays, spam filtering, or bounces.

chunks.t: Recent policy changes from Google,Yahoo & Microsoft
chunks.x: Likely Cause: SPF, DKIM, or DMARC records are missing or incorrectly configured, or your spam complaint rate is too high. What to Check: Verify that your SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records are valid and active. Review your spam complaint rate and email engagement metrics. Resolution: Correct any authentication issues, send emails only to recipients who expect them, and regularly clean your mailing lists to maintain a healthy sender reputation. Do I need all three authentication methods? Yes. Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft strongly recommend implementing SPF, DKIM, and DMARC together for the best protection and deliverability. How often should I review my authentication settings?

chunks.t: Recent policy changes from Google,Yahoo & Microsoft
chunks.x: Review your settings whenever you change email providers, update infrastructure, or experience deliverability issues. Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft have strengthened their email sender requirements to improve security and reduce unwanted email. To maintain reliable email delivery, ensure your domain is authenticated with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, provide a one-click unsubscribe option, and follow email-sending best practices.
