chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do and when to use it? AI Job Candidate Matching helps you find and rank candidates for a specific job using AI. You can search either from your existing Recruit CRM database (My Database) or Recruit CRM's Global Database , which contains 800 million+ external candidate profiles . Recruit CRM extracts relevant Search Filters from your query or Job Description and uses the Matching Criteria to evaluate candidates. Each candidate is ranked and scored from 0–100 based on how closely they match the defined criteria, with reasoning provided for each score. You can review and customize the Matching Criteria before running the search.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When matching against My Database, recent notes and call logs can be used as additional context when ranking candidates and generating the reasoning for their match score, alongside information from their resume or profile. Get an AI-ranked shortlist of candidates already available in your database for an open job. Search the Global Database directly using the job description. Use AI Job Candidate Matching from a job to find candidates who best match the role. You can search either your own candidate database or Recruit CRM's Global Database, review and customize the search parameters, and then use AI-powered Matching Criteria to evaluate and rank the results.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Open the specific job for which you want to find and match candidates. Please note: The job must have a Job Description for AI Job Candidate Matching to generate the Search Filters and Matching Criteria. If the selected job does not have a Job Description, Recruit CRM will prompt you to add one before you can continue with the search Click the star icon at the top of the job to open AI Job Candidate Matching . ​ My Database – Finds candidates from your own candidate database in Recruit CRM. Global Database – Finds candidates from Recruit CRM's global candidate database. ​

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: After selecting your preferred database, you will be presented with AI Clarifying Questions . Recruit CRM reviews the Job Description and asks for additional information when something is ambiguous, incomplete, or needs clarification before the search can be generated. ​ For example, the questions may ask you to clarify a missing work location, an unclear requirement, or whether a particular skill should be considered mandatory. You can select one or more available answers, provide additional information in free text where applicable, or skip the questions if you do not want to provide the suggested information. Clarifying the requirement helps produce more relevant results. ​

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once you have provided the required details, click Continue . You will then have the option to review the Search Filters and Matching Criteria that Recruit CRM has generated for the search. These define the parameters Recruit CRM will use to find, evaluate, and rank candidates. ​ Search Filters determine which candidates enter the search pool, while Matching Criteria determine how candidates within that pool are evaluated and ranked. To make changes to the Search Filters, click Edit Filters .

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The Filters panel will open on the right, where you can configure filters such as Employment Information, Skills and Keywords, Location, and Education . You can also add other filters based on your requirements using the option at the bottom of the panel. For Job Title and Company , you can enable the Current Only toggle to limit the search to candidates whose current job title or company matches the entered filters. Once you have configured the filters, click Save .

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Next, review the Matching Criteria generated from your query. These criteria are separate from the Search Filters and are used to evaluate how closely each candidate matches the requirements of the role. Each criterion contributes to the candidate's overall match score out of 100 . Recruit CRM assigns each criterion a suggested weight from 1 to 10 , where 10 is the highest importance . Criteria with a higher weight have a greater influence on the candidate's final ranking. You can change these weights based on the priorities of the role.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can also add, edit, or delete Matching Criteria based on your requirements. To add a new criterion, click Add Criterion , enter the requirement Recruit CRM should consider, and assign a weight based on its importance to the role. Each candidate receives a 0–100 match score based on how they perform against the Matching Criteria and the weights assigned to those criteria. A criterion with a higher weight has more influence on the final score than a criterion with a lower weight. ​

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: For example, if relevant experience is given a weight of 10 and a nice-to-have certification is given a weight of 2, performance against the experience criterion will have a much greater effect on the candidate's overall score. While you are configuring the filters and Matching Criteria, you will see the total number of candidates matching your Search Filters at the bottom of the page. This live count helps you understand the size of your candidate pool before running the AI match. The search usually takes 2–3 minutes to complete. ​

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once the search is complete, Recruit CRM displays up to 100 candidates per page . You can review the matched candidates and take action directly from the results page: Select individual candidates or use the bulk selection option to select multiple candidates. Add the selected candidates to your Recruit CRM database. Please note: When My Database is selected, the results include up to 100 candidates on a single page .

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When you select a candidate, the panel on the right provides a detailed view of the candidate's profile , along with the Matching Criteria that contributed to their match score. This helps you understand why the candidate was ranked for the search and how closely their profile matches the requirements of the role. ​ Understand Search Filters and Matching Criteria Search Filters and Matching Criteria work together, but they serve different purposes. Search Filters are the initial criteria used to determine which candidates enter the search pool. For example, you can filter candidates based on their title, experience, skills, or location.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Matching Criteria: Matching Criteria are applied after the candidate pool has been created. They help evaluate and rank candidates based on how well their profiles match the job. Each criterion has a weight that contributes to the candidate's overall match score out of 100. For example, suppose you're hiring for a Customer Success role and want candidates with at least five years of total work experience. You could use a Total Experience filter to require candidates to have at least five years of experience. You could then use a Matching Criterion to evaluate how much of that experience is specifically relevant to Customer Success.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: A candidate with five years of experience may meet the filter, but if only one of those years were spent in Customer Success, they may receive a lower match score than a candidate whose five years of experience are primarily in Customer Success. Title searches the candidate’s current role and previous roles they have held in the past. To search for only the current roles, you need to enable/turn on the 'Current Only' toggle. Set a minimum and/or maximum number of years of experience.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Searches for skills across the candidate’s entire profile rather than a single field. Mark specific skills as Must-have to make them require, or leave them as Good-to-have to improve ranking without making them mandatory. Set the required proficiency level and optionally mark a language as Must-have . Matches any of the locations you enter. You can enter a city, locality, state, or country. Location matching is based on the candidate's current profile location rather than their employer's location. Recruit CRM can recognize known location synonyms in natural-language searches.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Use Boolean search operators such as AND, OR, and NOT , including grouped searches, across the candidate’s full profile. University, Graduation Year, Degree, Name These fields are also available for searching. Limits results to candidates who currently hold the searched Job Title or currently work at the selected Company , rather than candidates who held the title or worked at the company in the past. Recruit CRM may automatically enable this option when it is relevant to the search. When matching against My Database , you can also filter and use Boolean search across custom fields, notes, and calls, using the same Boolean search functionality available in Candidate Search.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Candidates who are already assigned to the selected job or marked as off-limit are automatically excluded from My Database matching results. When notes and call logs are available as additional context for ranking, only the latest 3 notes and latest 3 call logs from the past 3 months are considered. Recruit CRM evaluates their relevance to the role rather than automatically treating every recent activity as relevant.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: For most Search Filter fields, selecting multiple values matches candidates who meet at least one of the selected values rather than requiring every value. If you need stricter combinations, you can use Boolean AND/OR/NOT logic in the Keywords search. Skills and Language Skills have separate Must-have and Good-to-have controls for more specific matching. AI Job Candidate Matching uses credits based on the type of action performed. 3 credits per page, which returns up to 100 results. 3 credits for up to 100 results per search. 2 credits, which return up to 100 results. (Credits are consumed only when new candidates are found).

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 3 credits per page, which returns up to 100 results. Since it will be a totally new search when filters/matching criteria are refined, it will consume 3 credits. Free when revisiting previously unlocked results. 📌 Please note: AI Job Candidate Matching and AI Sourcing use the same Recruit CRM Credit pool . ​ Recruit CRM saves previously unlocked AI matching results in Search History , allowing you to return to them without consuming additional credits. Previously unlocked result pages can be revisited without using additional credits. You can pin or delete searches from Search History. For job-based searches, Search History is shared with other users who have access to the same job.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If another user has already run an AI match for the same job, you can access the existing search history rather than starting a completely new search. Using Refine Matches changes the search and runs the AI matching process again, so it consumes additional credits. Refresh Matches is available for My Database searches and allows you to check whether new or updated candidates have become available since the original search was run. When you refresh a search, Recruit CRM checks newly added or updated candidates using the same Search Filters and Matching Criteria. Candidates that qualify for the top 100 results can then be evaluated and added to the results.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Refresh Matches costs 2 credits. Credits are consumed only when new candidates are found. Use Refine Matches when you want to modify the requirements of an existing search and generate updated results. You can refine the search by changing the clarifying answers, Search Filters, Matching Criteria, or Criterion Weights. Recruit CRM then runs the AI matching process again using the updated requirements. Refine Matches costs 3 credits per new page of results. Matching Criteria and match explanations are currently generated in English, regardless of the language used in the Job Description. You can select and add up to 100 candidates at a time from the results.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Does matching search only candidates already assigned to my job? No. AI Job Candidate Matching searches the entire database you selected, while automatically excluding candidates already assigned to the job and any off-limit candidates. What happens if the Job Description is updated? If you edit a job's Job Description after an AI match has already been run, Recruit CRM will ask whether you want to keep the existing results or rerun the search using the updated description. If you choose to rerun the search, Recruit CRM goes through the AI Clarifying Questions, Search Filters, and Matching Criteria process again. The rerun consumes credits because the AI matching process is executed again.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Can I edit the Search Filters and Matching Criteria generated by AI? Yes. You can edit, add, or remove Search Filters and Matching Criteria before running the search. You can also adjust the weight assigned to each Matching Criterion based on its importance to the role. What's the difference between Refresh Matches and Refine Matches? Refresh Matches checks for new or updated candidates in My Database that may now match an existing search. It costs 2 credits. Refine Matches allows you to change the search requirements, such as the clarifying answers, Search Filters, Matching Criteria, or weights, and rerun the AI matching process. It costs 3 credits.

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Can I revisit an earlier AI matching search? Yes. Previously unlocked results are saved in Search History and can be revisited without consuming additional credits. Job-based search history is shared with users who have access to the same job. ​ Does candidate feedback affect future AI matching? Not currently. Upvote and downvote feedback is captured, but it is not currently used to influence AI ranking. Where are the candidate profiles in the Global Database sourced from? Candidate profiles in the Global Database are sourced from publicly available profiles provided by third-party data partner .

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Does Recruit CRM add candidate data from a customer’s Recruit CRM database to the Global Database? No. Recruit CRM never aggregates or adds data from a customer’s Recruit CRM database to the Global Database . Your Recruit CRM database belongs exclusively to your company or agency and is not made available to other customers. Can data from one customer’s Recruit CRM database be made available to other customers through the Global Database? No. Data from one customer’s Recruit CRM database is never made available to other customers through the Global Database .

chunks.t: AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: AI Job Candidate Matching helps you build an AI-ranked shortlist for a specific job by combining flexible Search Filters, weighted Matching Criteria, and relevant candidate context. Whether you search your existing Recruit CRM database (My Database) or Recruit CRM's Global Database , you can use the results to identify and prioritize candidates who best match the requirements of the role. chunks.t: Job Description Parsing on Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Recruit CRM's AI-powered Job Description Parser automatically extracts important information from a job description and populates the supported job fields, helping you create jobs faster while reducing manual data entry. Want to quickly create a new job from an existing job description. Want to save time by automatically filling supported job fields instead of entering them manually. Need to parse job descriptions that are in different formats, including structured or multilingual job descriptions. Want more accurate skill extraction from the entire job description for improved search and matching capabilities.

chunks.t: Job Description Parsing on Recruit CRM
chunks.x: All supported job fields continue to be parsed automatically. If you manually clear a parsed field after parsing, Recruit CRM will not automatically populate that field again when the job description is reprocessed. Upload the Job Description File in the 'Upload File' option under the Job Description section. ​ Recruit CRM will automatically extract the supported job details and populate the relevant fields. Recruit CRM automatically extracts supported information from the job description and fills in the corresponding job fields such as: Note: The exact information extracted depends on the content available in the job description.

chunks.t: Job Description Parsing on Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Recruit CRM's AI-powered parser can accurately process a wide variety of job description formats, including: Structured job descriptions with sections such as Responsibilities, Requirements, and Qualifications. Table-based job descriptions (where supported) Recruit CRM extracts skills from the entire job description , rather than only from a dedicated Skills section. This allows the parser to identify relevant skills even when they appear within responsibilities, qualifications, or other sections of the job description, resulting in more accurate and standardized skill extraction.

chunks.t: Job Description Parsing on Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The Job Description Parser supports all system-supported languages. Recruit CRM automatically parses supported job information while maintaining the same parsing experience across different languages. Once your job has been parsed, you can use AI Job-to-Candidate Matching to automatically find candidates whose profiles best match the job requirements. AI Matching analyzes the job details and candidate profiles to identify the most relevant matches, helping you shortlist candidates faster. Click here to learn more about AI Job Candidate Matching in Recruit CRM Why wasn't a field repopulated after I re-parsed the job description?

chunks.t: Job Description Parsing on Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If you manually clear a field that was previously populated by the Job Description Parser (for example, Job City ), Recruit CRM will not automatically fill that field again when you re-parse the same job description. This behavior is intentional to ensure that your manual changes are not overwritten. The AI-powered Job Description Parser helps you create jobs faster by automatically extracting supported information from a variety of job description formats. chunks.t: Define target companies for a job
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? With this feature, you can select target companies for any of your jobs. This allows you to get recommendations for candidates currently related to those companies when sourcing and assigning candidates from your account to a specific job. This aims to streamline the candidate selection process by focusing on applicants from preferred target companies, thus enhancing the quality and relevance of the applicants. View recommendations based on a candidate's current organization. Bulk assign candidates from target companies. Before you can use Target Companies while assigning candidates, you'll need to enable the Target Companies field.

chunks.t: Define target companies for a job
chunks.x: Navigate to Admin Settings > Data Customization > Job Fields . Under the Job Details section, locate the Target Companies field and enable its visibility, and click Save to apply the changes. Once enabled, the Target Companies field will be available while creating and editing jobs, and the Candidates From Target Companies tab will appear when assigning candidates to a job. If you no longer wish to use this feature, simply disable the Target Companies field visibility in the admin settings, and both sections will be hidden. Add target companies and assign candidates Create a new job or edit an existing one.

chunks.t: Define target companies for a job
chunks.x: In the Target Companies field, add one or more companies from your Recruit CRM database. Please note: The Company field and Target Companies field serve different purposes. The "Company" field specifies the employer for the job being created (in other words, your client). On the other hand, the "Target Companies" field specifically means adding companies where candidates currently employed may be relevant to the position you are creating. When assigning candidates to the job, open the Candidates From Target Companies tab.

chunks.t: Define target companies for a job
chunks.x: Recruit CRM will display candidates whose Current Organization matches the target companies you've selected. You can select multiple candidates and assign them to the job in bulk. You can also edit or remove the selected target companies at any time by clicking Edit . You'll only be able to see candidates from the targeted company if they have that specific company as their current organization in Recruit CRM. ​ ​ Please refer to this article to learn how to link a candidate to their current organization. Problem: I can't see the Target Companies field while creating a job. Likely Cause: The field visibility is disabled.

chunks.t: Define target companies for a job
chunks.x: What to Check: Verify that the Target Companies field is enabled under Admin Settings > Data Customization > Job Fields. Resolution: Enable the field visibility and save your changes. Problem: Expected candidates aren't appearing under Candidates From Target Companies. Likely Cause: The candidate's Current Organization doesn't match any of the selected target companies. What to Check: Verify the candidate's Current Organization field and ensure it matches one of the configured target companies. Resolution: Update the candidate's current organization if necessary and refresh the assignment page.

chunks.t: Define target companies for a job
chunks.x: The Target Companies feature helps recruiters focus on candidates from preferred organizations by automatically recommending relevant profiles during candidate assignment. By configuring target companies for each job, you can streamline sourcing, improve candidate relevance, and speed up your recruitment workflow. How to Run Target Company Prospecting & Pitching Using Recruit CRM MCP

chunks.t: Job campaign analytics
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Job Campaign Analytics in Recruit CRM helps you track and measure the performance of job advertisements across different job boards. It provides insights into campaign reach, visitor engagement, applicant activity, conversion rates, and advertising costs, helping agencies identify the best-performing recruitment channels and optimize hiring strategies. This feature is especially useful when you want to: Compare performance across multiple job boards Measure campaign effectiveness using conversion data Make data-driven recruitment advertising decisions Click here to learn how to advertise your jobs through Recruit CRM's Job Marketplace ​

chunks.t: Job campaign analytics
chunks.x: Click here to learn how to bring your job board contracts to Recruit CRM ​ Click here to learn how to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription Once your job has been advertised through Recruit CRM’s Job Advertising feature, you can track campaign performance from two different locations. Track analytics from the Job Details page Open the relevant job record. Navigate to the Job Campaigns tab. Locate the campaign you want to analyze. Click on the Analytics button. Navigate to Admin Settings > Job Advertising > Go to the All Campaigns tab.

chunks.t: Job campaign analytics
chunks.x: You can sort your ads based on 'Active Campaigns' or 'Drafts'. You also have the ability to sort them based on the 'Created On', 'Start Date', 'End Date', 'Total Cost', 'Visitors', and 'Applicants', and apply different filters. Click on the Analytics button to open the analytics dashboard, where you can view detailed insights and metrics related to your job advertisements. Displays the total expense incurred for posting the job. Shows the number of job boards where the campaign is currently active compared to the total number of boards where the job has been posted. Displays the total number of days the job post will remain active.

chunks.t: Job campaign analytics
chunks.x: Shows the number of individuals who have viewed your job post. Displays the number of applicants who applied to the job. This ratio is calculated using the formula: (Number of Applicants / Number of Visitors) x 100. It indicates the percentage of visitors who applied for the job. In addition to campaign metrics, Recruit CRM also provides graphical reports to help recruiters better understand campaign performance over time. You can have a graphical analysis of visitor and applicant traffic, segmented by the different channels where your job is posted and over various time ranges.

chunks.t: Job campaign analytics
chunks.x: Additionally, the dashboard provides an overview of the top sources of your applicants, giving you valuable insights into where your candidates are coming from. Additionally, you can export the analytics data in CSV format directly from the Analytics dashboard. This allows you to download detailed tabular reports containing metrics such as visitors, applicants, and conversion ratios across different job boards and time ranges. It's important to note that the Visitor count data is auto-updated every 24 hours at 00:30 GMT. To pull the latest numbers at any time during the day, you need to click the ' Refresh Data ' button and this will update the numbers to reflect the most current data.

chunks.t: Job campaign analytics
chunks.x: Can I track campaigns across multiple job boards? Yes. Recruit CRM allows you to monitor job advertising performance across all supported job boards where your jobs are published. Why are analytics numbers not updated instantly? Visitor data is automatically refreshed every 24 hours. However, you can manually update the data anytime using the Refresh Data button. Job Campaign Analytics in Recruit CRM helps you make more informed recruitment advertising decisions. By regularly reviewing these insights, agencies can optimize recruitment marketing strategies, improve advertising ROI, and focus on the job boards that generate the strongest hiring results.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: Please follow the steps below to connect your LinkedIn contract with your Jjob advertising subscription. ➕ Adding the LinkedIn contract in Recruit CRM 1. Navigate to the Admin Settings --> Job Advertising : 2. Under the 'Added Contracts' section, click on the 'Add Contracts/Job Board' button: 3. Type 'LinkedIn' in the contract provider's search bar and select the 'LinkedIn' option. If you have a free LinkedIn account or LinkedIn Recruiter Lite, you will need to choose the "LinkedIn Limited Listings" option. Then you just need to fill in your LinkedIn contract information. ​

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: Please add the 'Company ID' of your LinkedIn account to proceed with the connection. Here is an article that will guide you on how to find the correct company ID for your LinkedIn account. ​ ​ 4. You will then see instructions on how to authenticate your LinkedIn account for posting jobs. Click on the green "Initialize Authentication" button: 5. You will be redirected to a new tab where you'll be prompted to log into your LinkedIn account. Please log in with the credentials of the account where you wish to post your jobs. 6. Once logged in to LinkedIn, you need to select the contract that you intend to connect to Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: Please note that if you have multiple accounts tied to your login, they will be presented here. 7. After selecting the correct account, you must edit the Job Poster information. The job poster is the name of the user under which the jobs will be posted. If you have an enterprise LinkedIn account, you can choose any user for which the jobs will be posted. Please note that the system may already display the name correctly. However, it is essential to complete this step to ensure the connection is set up correctly. Click the "Edit" button located to the right of the "Job Poster" section, under the displayed name.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: 8. After clicking the 'Edit' button, you will need to retype your name and then press 'Save'. This will initialize the connection between your LinkedIn posting account and the Recruit CRM job advertising system/Contract Posting Credits. You'll be redirected back to the Recruit CRM contract instructions, where you'll need to add the remaining information after authenticating your LinkedIn account. 9. Please add the 'Company ID' of your LinkedIn account to proceed with the connection. Here is an article that will guide you on how to find the correct company ID for your LinkedIn account. 10. Once you add the company ID, you need to select/create a contract group:

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: Groups function as folders where you can organize your contracts. It's important to note that in each group you can't have more than one contract of the same type . Eg. Let's say you want to add two LinkedIn accounts. In that case, you'll need to create a separate group for each account. 11. In the 'Optional Details' section, you can include additional information and click on the green "Add To My Contracts" button to add the contract: The optional details are just for reference purposes and won't impact your ability to post jobs on job boards in any way. The details of the fields can vary based on the requirements of the different job boards.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: 12. You can now click on "Add to My Contracts" to conclude the connection :) 💼 Posting jobs through your LinkedIn contract First, make sure you have Job Advertising/Recruit CRM credits for posting jobs. Pro Plan and Business Plan : Users can try the Job Advertising via Added Contracts feature using the free Recruit CRM Credits . Enterprise Plan : Users will receive the Job Advertising credits included with their Recruit CRM subscription. Please note: When you try to advertise a job via Added Contracts using Recruit CRM Credits, 25 credits are utilized when posting a job on one or more of the contracts (job boards added by the user) for a job campaign.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: Click here to learn how to buy Job Advertising credits! Here's how you can post jobs through your contracted job boards: 1. Go to Admin Settings >>>> Job Settings >>>> Job Advertising . ​ 2. Click on "Advertise Job" to start a new ad. ​ 3. A pop-up will appear prompting you to fill in the basic information for the job campaign. Search for an existing job in your database Give your job advertising a name for future tracking All the fields except "Job Name" and "Campaign Name" do not impact the ability to post the job on the job boards. They are used just for filtering and recommending job boards.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: 4. Click on "Continue" and select your preferred contract to add to the campaign. In this case, you would need to select your "LinkedIn" contract. 5. Once you've selected your preferred contract (LinkedIn), click on "Continue to Review Details" to proceed: 6. Fill in and review the necessary details of your campaign and hit the "Confirm & Post Job" button: Jobs that have the status: "on hold", "closed" or "canceled" cannot be advertised. 7. You can keep track of all your existing ads by going to the "All Campaigns" tab and sort based on active campaigns or drafts.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: You also have the ability to sort them based on the 'Created On', 'Start Date', 'End Date', 'Total Cost', 'Visitors', and 'Applicants', and apply different filters. You can effortlessly advertise your jobs from the job details page as well by simply clicking on the 'Advertise Job' button and the rest of the process remains unchanged: Furthermore, you can also track the job campaigns on the same page under the 'Job Campaigns' tab: And that's it! You now have that contract connected to your Recruit CRM account and you can start sharing your jobs via LinkedIn! 😊 ​ Understanding LinkedIn's Invited Candidates Feature

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: The Invited Candidates feature gives you a way to reach people who are a strong match for your open role, rather than waiting for applicants to find the posting on their own. It is available when a job is promoted through select Job Distributor or Applicant Tracking System partners. This feature is only available when the LinkedIn offering is purchased through the marketplace, and is supported only on the Medium and Large promotion offerings. Once the feature is enabled, LinkedIn begins identifying a curated group of potential applicants and automatically sends them an invitation to consider the role. Eligible candidates receive a notification on LinkedIn encouraging them to review and apply.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: The selection of candidates is driven by an AI matching system that looks at attributes such as skills, experience, location and behavioral hiring signals. This allows the system to surface people who closely reflect what the job requires. LinkedIn sends invitations in batches of up to 25 per day for a period of up to 14 days, which means as many as 350 individuals can be invited over the full cycle. Keeping the role active for the entire period ensures that all potential invitations can be delivered. This feature is not supported for contract or temporary job postings and will only work for full time or permanent roles.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: Access to this feature is tied to the job promotion process and is available when purchased alongside job distribution through approved partners. The amount paid for the promotion is added directly to the LinkedIn job promotion budget for that posting. Some partners also offer an optional daily email digest linked to the job poster’s LinkedIn account. When available, these emails provide a simple overview of the individuals who were invited to apply that day. This option may vary by partner and region.

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: Overall, Invited Candidates is designed to expand the reach of a job posting by connecting it with people who are already strong fits. It supports both visibility and applicant quality by making sure well-matched individuals are aware of the opportunity, even if they were not actively searching for it. Where do I add my LinkedIn contract in Recruit CRM? You add it under Admin Settings → Job Advertising , in the Added Contract section using the Add Contract/Job Board button. What happens if I have multiple LinkedIn contracts or accounts?

chunks.t: How to add your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription
chunks.x: If multiple accounts are tied to your LinkedIn login, LinkedIn will present them during authentication. You must select the specific contract you intend to connect to Recruit CRM. Can I add extra details to my LinkedIn contract in Recruit CRM? Yes. In the Optional Details section, you can include additional information before clicking Add to My Contracts to save the contract. By following these steps, you can connect your LinkedIn contract to your job advertising subscription in Recruit CRM and post jobs directly to LinkedIn. chunks.x: This feature helps you track and analyze interactions with candidates and contacts by showing details like last call log added, last email sent on, last SMS sent on, last meeting added, last note added on and last LinkedIn message sent on. It gives clear visibility into recent communication, making it easier to manage relationships and stay updated on outreach. Check the last interaction with a record. Quickly review interaction history in a list view. Recruit CRM allows you to customize and arrange the fields (for Candidates/Companies/Contacts/Jobs) in the list view in any way you want!

chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts
chunks.x: To view the last communication data, all you have to do is, make the columns Last Email Sent On, Last Communication, Last Call Log Added, Last Note Added On, Last SMS Sent On , 'Last Meeting Added' and 'Last LinkedIn Message Sent On' visible on the list page. Once these columns are visible on the list page, you can easily see the latest interactions for each record. Click here to learn more about how to enable field visibility and rearrangement on the lists Last Call Log Added: Displays the timestamp of the last call log added for a candidate or contact. Last Communication: Reflects the most recent communication method (call, SMS, or email) based on the latest timestamp.

chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts
chunks.x: Last SMS Sent On: Shows the date and time of the most recent SMS sent. Last Email Sent On: Captures the date of the last email sent only from Recruit CRM. Last Meeting Added (only for candidates, contacts, and companies) : Captures the time stamp when the meeting was added. Last LinkedIn Message Sent On : Tracks the LinkedIn Messages sent using the LinkedIn Integration feature. ​ Last Note Added On: Tracks the timestamp of the most recently added note for the specific entity. If no note exists, the field will display Not Available .

chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts
chunks.x: Please note: The Last Note Added On field is not considered a last communication tracking field, as it only records internal note activity added within the record’s profile. Click here to learn more about texting Candidates/contacts in Recruit CRM Below, you'll find an example of how to perform an Advanced Search on this. Select the relevant communication column (e.g., Last Communication, Last Email Sent On, Last SMS Sent On, etc.). You can customise your search by selecting the columns and choosing different filter types, such as is, is not, is visible, between, before, after, etc, depending on your specific needs and dates. Specify the date or date range to narrow down your results.

chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts
chunks.x: This empowers you to filter candidates and contacts based on their most recent interactions, making the recruitment process more efficient and targeted. Click here to learn more about how to run search in Recruit CRM Problem: The communication columns are not appearing in the list view. Likely cause: Columns have not been added to the visible list view layout. What to check: Open the list view customization and confirm whether the columns are selected. Resolution path: Add Last Call Log Added, Last Communication, Last SMS Sent On, Last Email Sent On, Last Meeting Added, and Last LinkedIn Message Sent On to your list view and save the layout.

chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts
chunks.x: 1. What happens to the Last Note Added On field if I delete the latest note? If the latest note is deleted, the field recalculates to the next latest note, and if no notes remain, the value becomes Not Available. 2. Is there another way to track this information instead of using columns? Yes! When you enter a candidate or contact's profile and click on the 'Last Updated' icon, you can see the most recent interaction method, its timestamp, and the person who performed the action; all displayed just by clicking the 'Last Updated' icon on the candidate/contact details page. 4. Is it possible to view the communication tracking columns in the candidate/contact list views within the Reports?

chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts
chunks.x: Yes, when generating a report for the following KPIs in these specific reports: If you hover over the bars showing the results from the report, you can click on them to open a new window. chunks.t: Customize your content with the fonts available in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to customize the appearance of your content using different fonts. You can select WebSafe fonts directly from the in-app editor or use custom HTML source code for additional font options. Font customization is available when creating content such email templates , job descriptions , candidate summaries, or executive search reports. Customize the appearance of your content. Choose fonts directly from the Recruit CRM editor. Apply custom fonts using HTML source code. You can customize fonts in Recruit CRM in two ways: Open the content you want to create or edit in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Customize your content with the fonts available in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: From the formatting toolbar above the text editor, click the Font dropdown. Select your preferred font from the available options. Please note: Only WebSafe fonts are available in this dropdown to ensure consistent viewing across all devices, operating systems, and browsers. Open the content you want to create or edit. Click the Source icon from the formatting toolbar. Enter or paste your custom HTML source code into the editor and apply your changes. Please note: While you can use any font in the source code, we recommend sticking to WebSafe fonts (such as Arial, Times New Roman, Verdana) to ensure consistent appearance across different devices, operating systems, and browsers.

chunks.t: Customize your content with the fonts available in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What happens when you use non-WebSafe fonts? How operating systems, devices or browsers affect the font: When content is delivered/accessed, the operating system, browser, or device checks if the specified font is available. If not, it substitutes it with a similar available font. Using non-WebSafe fonts like Calibri, Ink-Free, Roboto, Proxima-Nova, or Ronnia may cause inconsistencies in how your content appears to users depending on their device, operating system, or browser. To ensure consistent styling and avoid potential visibility issues, we recommend using WebSafe fonts whenever possible. Problem: My custom font looks different on another device.

chunks.t: Customize your content with the fonts available in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely Cause: The selected font isn't available or supported on the device, operating system, or browser being used. What to Check: Confirm whether you're using a non-WebSafe font through the source code. Resolution: Use a WebSafe font to ensure a more consistent appearance across devices, operating systems, and browsers. 1. Where can I customize fonts in Recruit CRM? You can customize fonts in supported content editors, including email templates, job descriptions, candidate summaries, and executive search reports. 2. Can I use fonts that aren't available in the Font dropdown? Yes. You can apply other fonts using custom HTML source code through the Source option in the formatting toolbar.

chunks.t: Customize your content with the fonts available in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 3. Will custom fonts always appear the same for every user? No. If a font isn't available on the recipient's device, operating system, or browser, it may be replaced with a similar available font. Recruit CRM provides two ways to customize fonts: selecting WebSafe fonts directly from the in-app editor or applying additional fonts through custom HTML source code. For the most consistent appearance across devices, operating systems, and browsers, we recommend using WebSafe fonts whenever possible. chunks.t: Bulk-Select Up to 500 Records in Candidate Kanban View
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Candidate Kanban View allows you to select up to 500 candidates at once within a hiring stage, making it easier to perform bulk actions without selecting candidates individually. Save time when managing large candidate pipelines. Perform bulk actions directly from the Kanban View. Update or manage up to 500 candidates simultaneously. Bulk-select candidates in the Kanban View Open the Kanban View using either of the following methods: From a Job: Navigate to Jobs, open the required job, go to the Candidate Pipeline tab, click View All Candidates, and switch to the Kanban View.

chunks.t: Bulk-Select Up to 500 Records in Candidate Kanban View
chunks.x: From the Dashboard: Navigate to dashboard statistics pipeline ., and switch to the Kanban View. Click the checkbox at the top of the hiring stage to select all candidates within that stage. Please note: If the stage contains more than 500 candidates, only the first 500 candidates will be selected. Once the candidates have been selected, you can perform a variety of bulk actions directly from the Candidate Kanban View. These include assigning candidates to jobs, sending profile update requests, composing emails, adding notes, unassigning candidates from jobs, updating fields, enrolling candidates in sequences, adding candidates to hotlists, and updating their hiring stage.

chunks.t: Bulk-Select Up to 500 Records in Candidate Kanban View
chunks.x: Bulk selection in the Candidate Kanban View helps you manage large candidate pipelines more efficiently by allowing you to perform multiple actions on up to 500 candidates simultaneously, reducing repetitive work and improving productivity. chunks.t: Bulk texting candidates and contacts
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Bulk texting in Recruit CRM lets you send a single SMS message to multiple selected candidates or contacts at once. The feature supports up to 300 words per bulk text, allows you to use SMS templates and placeholders, and lets you include opt-out text and create follow-up tasks as part of the workflow. You can use this when: You want to quickly reach multiple candidates with the same update or reminder. You need to send bulk messages to contacts for coordination or follow-ups. You are running campaigns that require simple, short, text-based communication. Bulk texting is available on all paid Recruit CRM plans: Pro, Business, and Enterprise.

chunks.t: Bulk texting candidates and contacts
chunks.x: All users from the US must obtain consent from each prospect before texting them. Ensure that the candidates or contacts you want to message have valid phone numbers. Confirm that the phone numbers are in countries where texting is allowed. Make sure you have sufficient phone calling and SMS credits, as bulk texting will be charged according to Twilio’s volume pricing. Click here to learn more about Texting Cost Overview. Go to the candidate or contact list page where your target records are listed. ​ Select the candidates or contacts you want to send bulk text messages to. ​ Click on the message icon to open the messaging options. ​

chunks.t: Bulk texting candidates and contacts
chunks.x: From the three options that appear, choose whether to send SMS, request consent via SMS, or request consent via mail. ​ Check for any errors in the phone numbers and verify that they are valid numbers in countries where texting is allowed. ​ Click on the “Continue with the Candidates” option to proceed with the selected recipients. ​ Recruit CRM now checks for SMS consent when sending messages in bulk. Candidates/Contacts without recorded consent will show an “SMS consent pending” validation and must have their consent recorded before they can receive bulk SMS messages. 7. Write the body of the text message, keeping in mind that you can text up to 300 words in bulk at a time. ​

chunks.t: Bulk texting candidates and contacts
chunks.x: 8. Insert existing SMS templates into your message if you want to reuse saved content. Create new SMS templates if you need reusable content for future bulk messages. Use placeholders to personalize your SMS content with dynamic fields such as candidate or contact details. ​ 9. Choose whether to include an opt-out option in the text message so recipients can stop receiving further texts. ​ 10. Select the option to create a follow-up task related to the bulk SMS if you want to track next steps. ​ 11. Click the “Send SMS” button to send your bulk text. ​

chunks.t: Bulk texting candidates and contacts
chunks.x: 12. Review the pop-up that appears, which states that you will be charged 0.05 for each unique recipient per month and that this will be deducted from your phone calling and SMS credits according to Twilio’s volume pricing. ​ 13. After sending, note that you will also be charged for failed messages, and these will be visible under the message logs. Problem: Bulk SMS fails for multiple recipients and shows as failed in message logs.

chunks.t: Bulk texting candidates and contacts
chunks.x: Likely cause: Issues with phone number validity, carrier restrictions, or insufficient credits. ​ What to check: Look at the message logs to see which messages failed and confirm your current phone calling and SMS credit balance. ​ Resolution: Fix invalid numbers where possible, confirm that the destination countries allow texting, top up your credits if needed, and attempt sending again. Q1. How many words can I send in a single bulk SMS? You can send up to 300 words in bulk at a time. Bulk texting in Recruit CRM makes it easy to reach many candidates and contacts at once while staying within plan limits and consent requirements.

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? SMS Sequences allow you to send a series of scheduled text messages to Candidates or Contacts over a defined period. You can combine SMS, Email, Task, and LinkedIn steps into a single sequence to automate follow-ups and improve engagement. Automate SMS follow-ups with Candidates or Contacts. Combine SMS, Email, Task, and LinkedIn steps in a single sequence. Schedule messages for specific dates and times. Personalize messages using SMS templates. Build structured communication workflows. SMS Sequencing is available on the Business Plan and above . Users on the Free and Pro plans can create one sequence .

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Only Account Owners, Admins, or users with the required Sequences permissions can create sequences. SMS sequencing is available only in supported regions: USA, UK, Israel, Hong Kong, Canada, and Sweden . Recruit CRM uses Twilio to power SMS messaging. US customers must complete Twilio registration before sending SMS. UK customers must complete and receive approval for the required KYC before texting is enabled. Learn more about KYC here . SMS credits are required to send messages. Navigate to Admin Settings → CRM Process Customization → Sequences . Select whether the sequence is for Candidates or Contacts .

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Enter a name for the sequence, add an SMS step, and choose an existing SMS template or create a new one. Please note: Messages longer than 160 characters are split into multiple segments and charged accordingly, as per Twilio guidelines . Specify when the SMS should be sent by selecting the number of days and the execution time. Setting the value to 0 sends the SMS on the same day the record is enrolled in the sequence. It is important to know exactly when the SMS will be sent in relation to the starting date of the sequence. To calculate this, you can use the following formula: Send Date = Start Date + Specified No. Of Days (Send SMS In)

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Here, "Start Date" represents the date when the sequence was initiated. "Specified Date" or "Send SMS In" is the number of days you have indicated for the SMS to be sent after the start of the sequence. The resulting "Send date" is the calculated date on which the SMS will be sent. For example : If you start the sequence on January 1st and specify that the SMS should be sent in 2 days, the Send Date would be calculated as follows: Send date= January 1st + 2 days =January 3rd. Enable the Opt-out/Unsubscribe text if required. This is recommended to comply with Twilio's messaging guidelines .

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Continue adding additional SMS, Email, Task, or LinkedIn steps as required. You can rearrange the sequence using drag-and-drop. Please note: A sequence can contain up to 40 steps , including a maximum of 10 SMS , 10 Email , 10 Task , and 10 LinkedIn steps. Set the execution day for each step (between 0 and 250 calendar or business days) and save the sequence. Please note: Tasks can be created on the same day as the sequence initiation by setting the day as "0". ​ When implementing a task on the 0th day, it's crucial to align the step timing with the previous steps or set it for a later time than the preceding step to ensure a seamless workflow.

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once the sequence is created, enroll Candidates or Contacts into it. Refer to the Managing Sequences article to learn how to enroll and unenroll records from a sequence. Enroll Contacts while pitching Candidates When pitching Candidates to Contacts, you can immediately enroll the selected Contacts into a sequence. While pitching Candidates, click Enroll Selected Contacts to Sequence . After the email is sent or the Candidates are marked as pitched, you'll be redirected to enroll the selected Contacts into a sequence.

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When the SMS credit balance approaches around 20 credits, a warning message will be displayed, prompting you to recharge. Failure to recharge will result in the sequence being paused. You will receive email and in-app notifications when the sequence is about to pause due to a low SMS balance. During enrollment, you can only enroll candidates or contacts who meet the following criteria: For the US region, have given consent to receive SMS. In SMS sequencing, metrics like 'Open rate,' 'Reply rate,' and 'Unsubscribe rate' cannot be tracked. 1. What are the time slots/execution times of the sequences? SMS/Emails in a sequence are fired in 30-minute slots (e.g. 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM, etc.).

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Also, the timestamp is based on the timezone set in the user profile who initiated the enrolment . ​ Here's how a user can check their timezone: 2. How many prospects can be enrolled in a sequence at a time? The limit on the number of prospects that can be enrolled in a sequence depends on the number of users in the account. Each user can enroll up to 500 prospects in a sequence at a time. 3. Is there any limit on the number of candidates/contacts that a user can enroll in a sequence? A user can enroll up to 500 candidates/contacts in either 1 or across multiple sequences at any given point in time.

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once a user reaches the maximum active + paused enrollments i.e. 500, they will not be able to enroll any further records until the active sequence(s) are completed or they manually unenroll some records. 4. How many steps can you have in a particular sequence? Add steps to the sequence as required, up to a maximum of 40 steps , which includes a maximum of 10 email steps, 10 task steps , 10 LinkedIn steps and 10 SMS steps. You can easily rearrange the sequence steps by using the drag-and-drop functionality. 5. What happens when a user edits a running sequence? If someone edits the sequence that is already running, then the changes will apply only to future enrollments.

chunks.t: SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 6. How many sequences can be created on an account? In total, you can add up to 1000 sequences to a business plan account. However, on the Pro plan, you can test the feature with 1 sequence. 7. Can we add a candidate/contact to multiple sequences? No, each candidate/contact can only be a part of a single sequence at a time. 8. When does a prospect get unenrolled from the sequence? 1. Whenever someone replies to the SMS sequence , the sequence gets paused for that specific prospect and it gets unenrolled from the sequence. 2. If the candidate/contact chooses to opt out of the SMS they will get automatically unenrolled. 3. If you manually unenroll them from the sequence.

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The bulk job import feature lets you upload a CSV or XLS file with job data in Recruit CRM to create multiple job records at once. Migrating data from another ATS or CRM into Recruit CRM. You want to upload a large number of jobs at once instead of creating them manually. If you have a file in XLSX format, you'll first need to convert it into XLS. ​ Here's how you can do this Before you import a file, please make sure it has column headers . If your spreadsheet has additional columns that are not available in Recruit CRM, you first need to create custom fields to map those columns into the system.

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Special characters like "<,>, & OR;" present in the file, crash the code for import. You need to remove these before importing the file. We do not have the option to import profile pictures into the CRM. Ensure that the date fields follow the DD/MM/YYYY format. 🗒️ How to import your spreadsheet to Recruit CRM? Navigate to the Jobs section in Recruit CRM. ​ Click the dropdown arrow on the right side of the Add Job button. ​ From the dropdown menu, select Import CSV/XLS . ​ In the file upload dialog, choose the CSV or XLS file that contains your job data and upload it. After the file is uploaded, proceed to the field mapping screen. ​

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: For each column in your spreadsheet, select the corresponding Recruit CRM field from the dropdown list. Mapping your Recruit CRM fields with the columns in your CSV/XLS file is crucial to make sure that the information in those columns is correctly saved in Recruit CRM. ​ When you upload a file and reach the field mapping stage, ensure that after completing the mapping process, you click on the "Save Mapping" button: It will allow you to save the mapping fields as a template. This way, you can easily select it each time you upload a file, eliminating the need to manually map the fields every time. On the mapping screen, hover your cursor over the mapping template you want to update. ​

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: To edit a template, click the pencil (edit) icon. ​ To delete a template, click the trash can (delete) icon. ​ Only the creator of a mapping template can edit or delete that template. If there are columns in your spreadsheet that you do not want to import, select Don’t Import This Column from the field dropdown for those specific columns. Once a Recruit CRM field has been mapped to a column, it will no longer appear as an option in the dropdown for other columns, preventing duplicate mapping. Always verify that the data type of the column (text, number, date) matches the data type of the Recruit CRM field you select.

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: If needed, revisit your custom fields in Recruit CRM and create new ones before attempting to map unmatched columns again. If you choose the "Include First (Header) Row of CSV or XLS file" option, you won't be able to save the template. This is because selecting this option indicates that there are no columns (column names) available for mapping, rendering the template unable to identify which columns to map. Finalize the import (Add to Hot List or Import Now): After completing all field mappings, proceed to the final step of the import process. ​

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Choose Add to Hotlist if you want to tag the imported records into a specific hot list immediately after import. On the Hotlist page, you can select from existing hotlists in your account or create a new hotlist. ​ Choose Import Now if you want to directly import all records into Recruit CRM without assigning them to a hot list. 🗒️ How does the Contact & Company matching work? If the Company Name matches exactly with an existing Company If the Company Name does not match any existing Company A new Company is created and linked to the Job . If the Contact's Email is provided and matches an existing Contact’s Email

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The system searches for the Contact by First and Last Name (only under the mentioned Company ). If a matching Contact is found based on First and Last name If a matching Contact is found by Email but that isn’t linked to the mentioned Company The Contact is linked to the mentioned Company , and then linked to the Job. If no matching Contact is found based on Email/First and Last name A new Contact is created and linked to the Job . Likely cause: The file contains unsupported special characters or formatting issues. Look for special characters such as less than (<), greater than (>), and “and/or” symbols in the data. Confirm that date fields follow the DD/MM/YYYY format.

chunks.t: Bulk Importing Jobs into Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Remove or replace the problematic special characters in the spreadsheet. Correct any dates that do not follow the required format and re-import the file. Problem: A column cannot be mapped to any existing field Likely cause: There is no standard Recruit CRM field that matches the data in that column. Review available standard fields on the mapping screen. Create a custom field in Recruit CRM that matches the data type and purpose of the column. Return to the import process and map the column to the new custom field. Can I import profile pictures with my job records? No, importing profile pictures into the CRM is not supported via the bulk import process.

You can also check in the details page if they have not given consent, next to meetings: In this scenario, it is necessary for you to include additional information on how to opt out of receiving SMS messages. The initial message that you send to take consent needs to include the following OPT IN and OPT OUT keywords: OPT-IN keywords: 'START' or 'YES' or 'SUBSCRIBE', or 'JOIN'.

chunks.t: Obtaining consent for texting prospects
chunks.x: OPT-OUT keywords: 'STOP' or 'STOPALL' or 'UNSUBSCRIBE' or 'CANCEL' or 'END' or 'QUIT'. Once the text receiver replies with STOP or similar opt-out messages, Twilio blocks them from their end: You can also see a message on the details page indicating whether they’ve opted out of messages or emails: You can also request opt-in through email from prospects by sending bulk emails. Recruit CRM also lets you obtain texting consent from prospects from different sections including the job application form, talent pool page, and profile update request form. chunks.t: Nested Custom Fields
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Nested Custom Fields feature allows you to create parent-child relationships between custom fields, ensuring that only relevant field options are displayed based on selections. This helps organize complex data more effectively, improves data accuracy, reduces input errors, and provides a more guided data entry experience for your team. • You want to improve data organization across Candidates, Companies, Contacts, Jobs, or Deals. • You want to reduce data entry errors by displaying only relevant choices. • You are managing complex data sets that require multiple levels of field dependencies. ​

chunks.t: Nested Custom Fields
chunks.x: Nested Fields are available for all entities (Candidates, Companies, Contacts, Jobs, and Deals) in the Admin Settings under the respective Custom Fields section. One Child field can have only one direct Parent field. Multi-level dependencies are supported up to 5 levels deep, i.e., each parent field can have up to 5 child fields (siblings). ​ Unlinking a Parent-Child Relationship is possible only if the child field has no dependencies. ​ Deleting Parent Fields is restricted until all child fields are unlinked. 2. Under 'Data Customization ', choose the entity to which you want to add nested custom fields.

chunks.t: Nested Custom Fields
chunks.x: 3. As usual, create the custom fields that you would like to link/connect by clicking on the '+ New Custom Field'. Note : Parent Fields support only Checkbox (Yes/No), Dropdown, and Multiselect custom field types, whereas Child Fields support all custom field types. 4. Now, to establish the parent-child relationship between the custom fields created, you need to click on the 'Add' option next to the 'Field Dependency' section. 5. Select the 'Parent field' and the 'Child field' from the dropdown list.

chunks.t: Nested Custom Fields
chunks.x: 6. Now you can 'Map the Dependency' according to your requirements i.e., you can select the 'Child field' options that need to be shown when a specific option is selected under the 'Parent field' and click on 'Save'. 7. To view the linked fields, you can click on the 'View' option next to the 'Field Dependency' section. 8. You can unlink/edit/add more fields by selecting the respective option under the 'Dependency Actions' column. 9. All the created nested custom fields will be visible under the Additional Information (Custom Fields) section: Problem: Child options are not appearing when a parent value is selected

chunks.t: Nested Custom Fields
chunks.x: Likely cause: The dependency mapping between the parent and child options is incomplete or incorrect. What to check: Open the dependency configuration and verify that each relevant parent option has the correct child options mapped. Resolution: Update the mappings so that the desired child options are associated with the appropriate parent options, then save and retest. Problem: Parent field type cannot be selected in dependency setup Likely cause: The field type is not supported as a parent. What to check: Confirm the field type of the intended parent field in the custom field settings.

chunks.t: Nested Custom Fields
chunks.x: Resolution: Use only supported parent field types (checkbox, yes/no, drop-down, or multi-select). If needed, recreate the parent field using one of these types. Flat custom fields make data entry disorganized. Nested fields allow logical structuring , reducing errors and improving efficiency. Can I create dependencies for default fields? No, only custom fields can be used for nested relationships. Can a child field have multiple parent fields? No, a child field can have only one parent , but a parent can have multiple child fields . You cannot delete a parent field until all its child fields are unlinked. What happens if I edit dropdown options in a parent field?

chunks.t: Nested Custom Fields
chunks.x: If an option is already used in a dependency, editing/removal is restricted to prevent breaking the nested structure. Is there a limit to how many nested levels I can create? Yes, 5 levels deep per nested relationship and 5 child fields per parent . Nested custom fields in Recruit CRM help you control which options and fields appear based on previous selections, making data entry cleaner, more accurate, and easier to manage. How to Set Up Parent and Child Company Relationships in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Fonts Deprecation for Unified User Experience
chunks.x: To enhance font consistency across browsers and devices, we've removed non-web-safe fonts from our app. This ensures that content appears as intended, regardless of where it's viewed, improving the overall user experience for both you and your prospects. Non-web-safe fonts like Calibri, Roboto, Montserrat, and others often render differently across devices, operating systems, and browsers. This inconsistency can lead to situations where you see one font, but your candidates and clients see another. By standardizing the use of web-safe fonts, such as Arial, Times New Roman, and Verdana , we ensure content is displayed uniformly for all users.

chunks.t: Fonts Deprecation for Unified User Experience
chunks.x: Inconsistent font rendering can negatively affect the professionalism and readability of your communications, whether it's an email, job description, or other content. Editor Fonts: These deprecated fonts are no longer available directly in our text editors. However, you can still use them by manually adding the font in the source code. Existing Templates: If you have existing email templates using non-web-safe fonts, those will remain unchanged. Emails sent from those templates will continue to display in the selected font style. Although these fonts have been removed from the editor, you can still use them if needed by following these steps:

chunks.t: Fonts Deprecation for Unified User Experience
chunks.x: Manually add the desired non-web-safe font from the list above. Keep in mind, that users viewing the content on devices or browsers that do not support the font may see an alternate font. For more detailed instructions, refer to our article on customizing fonts in Recruit CRM. ⚠️ Considerations for non-web-safe fonts in the source code How operating systems, devices or browsers affect the font: When content is delivered/accessed, the operating system, browser, or device checks if the specified font is available. If not, it substitutes it with a font that is similar to the one available.

chunks.t: Fonts Deprecation for Unified User Experience
chunks.x: For example, using fonts like Calibri, Ink-Free, or Proxima-Nova may cause your content to display differently depending on the viewer's device or browser. This can affect readability and the overall presentation of your content. To avoid such issues, we highly recommend sticking to web-safe fonts like Arial, Courier New, Georgia, and Tahoma for maximum consistency. Customize your content with the fonts available in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration
chunks.x: Our LinkedIn messages integration, powered by Unipile , helps you manage your LinkedIn conversations seamlessly within Recruit CRM. It provides a complete view of all interactions with candidates and contacts, enabling you to communicate with them directly through LinkedIn without leaving Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration
chunks.x: LinkedIn Messages Integration is included with the Enterprise plan and can also be added to Pro or Business plan subscriptions as a per-seat, credit-based add-on. The option to add the LinkedIn Messages Integration feature as a per-seat, credit-based add-on is currently in Beta and will be gradually rolled out to all users in the upcoming weeks. For the remaining paid plan accounts that are not in the Beta release , the LinkedIn Messages Integration can be added at an additional cost as an account-wide add-on to the Pro or Business plan subscriptions. The LinkedIn Messages Integration is powered by Uniplie and it is GDPR compliant .

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration
chunks.x: The LinkedIn Messages Integration supports the following plans, i.e, LinkedIn Recruiter, Recruiter Lite, Sales Navigator core, business, and career plan. 🎥 Here is a tutorial on how to send and receive LinkedIn messages: 🔗 Connecting your LinkedIn account to Recruit CRM 1. Click on the 'Profile' icon and select the ' LinkedIn Integration ' tab. 3. Enter your LinkedIn account credentials and verify the details. If you haven’t connected your LinkedIn account through the profile settings, you’ll see a button to connect it under the LinkedIn Messages tab inside any candidate or contact profile.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration
chunks.x: How to use the Cookie login method to avoid multiple LinkedIn login sessions being detected in the app? chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration

Here is a tutorial on how to log in via the Cookie Method: 🤝 Send and Manage LinkedIn Connection Requests You can send and manage LinkedIn connection requests directly from Recruit CRM without leaving the platform, helping you keep your sourcing and outreach workflow in one place.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration
chunks.x: Open the candidate or contact profile and navigate to the LinkedIn Messaging tab. You might need to scroll a bit towards the right in the Widgets section at the bottom of the page. If you are not already connected with the person on LinkedIn, click Send Request . You'll now be prompted to add a personalized note to your connection request. While this is completely optional, including a brief, relevant message can improve the chances of your connection request being accepted. ​ ​ Please note: LinkedIn allows a maximum of 200 characters for connection request notes. chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration
chunks.x: Once the request is sent, its status will be displayed within the LinkedIn tab. ​ If needed, you can withdraw a pending connection request directly from Recruit CRM. chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration
