chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: This guide covers Boolean search functionality, filtering options, known limitations, and common questions to ensure you get the most out of these features. ​ The Search and filtering feature is available to users across all plans - Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise. 🔄 Switching Between Classic and Compact views of Search Recruit CRM allows you to switch between the Classic and Compact search interfaces based on your preference and the type of search you want to perform. Both views offer different ways to search and filter records, and you can switch between them at any time depending on your workflow.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The Compact View offers a more modern and flexible search experience. It supports a wider range of features, including group filters, cross-entity filters, and activity-based filtering , allowing you to build more refined searches. You can search across activity fields such as notes, call logs, meetings, and tasks, while also combining multiple filter conditions to narrow down results more effectively. Here is how you can switc h from the Classic View to the Compact View - ​

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The Classic View allows you to add multiple filters at once within a single interface, making it useful for building and applying filters quickly while managing your search criteria in one place. Here is how you can switch from the Compact View to the Classic View- Please note: To ensure optimal performance and provide a smoother user experience, Revamped List Pages (Candidates/Contacts/Companies/Jobs) support a maximum of 100 filter selections across all entities. This limit applies to both Classic and Compact filter views. Existing Saved Searches with more than 100 filters will continue to work and will not be affected by this change.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Boolean Search helps you create more powerful and precise search queries by using logical operators. It allows you to refine your searches and find the most relevant records by combining operators such as AND, OR, NOT , along with wildcards (*) and parentheses to structure more complex search conditions. ​ Boolean Search works across multiple areas in Recruit CRM, enabling you to search through various types of information stored in the system, including: Candidate attachments (PDF, DOC, and DOCX files) This makes it easier to locate specific records based on keywords, skills, job titles, or any other relevant information present across these sources. ​

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Newly added or updated data may take 5 to 10 minutes to become searchable through Boolean Search. When the Files option is selected, Boolean Search only searches the 10 most recent PDF, DOC, and DOCX attachments for each candidate. The default resume is searched separately through the Candidates option. Boolean Search lets you choose which sources to search using the available checkboxes. Candidates – Searches candidate fields (default and custom) and the resume stored in the default Resume field. Files – Searches the candidate's attached PDF , DOC , and DOCX files, excluding the default resume. The search covers up to the 10 most recent supported attachments for each candidate.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The Candidates and Files options work independently, allowing you to search candidate profiles, attachments, or both together depending on your requirements. Below are some examples to help you run Boolean searches effectively. ​ By default, Boolean searches in Recruit CRM work on exact matches for phrases. This means when you search for a phrase like product manager , the system will return only those profiles where the exact phrase “product manager” appears, not profiles where “product” and “manager” are listed separately. The words must appear together, in the exact order, for the profile to be included in the search results.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Please note that stopwords (commonly used words like “the,” “is,” “and,” etc.) are excluded from search queries by default, meaning that these words will be ignored in the search. For more details on stopwords and their behavior, you can refer to the official stopwords documentation . Expected Result: Retrieves profiles where the exact phrase “product manager” appears in the resume or profile. Example Output: Profiles with titles or experiences like “Product Manager at XYZ Corp.” Not Included: Profiles where “product” and “manager” are mentioned separately, such as a candidate being a “Product Specialist” and also having experience as a “Team Manager.”

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The AND operator helps you find profiles that contain all the specified keywords. It will only return profiles that include both terms. Expected Result: Retrieves profiles containing both the terms "developer" and "manager." Example Output: Profiles mentioning "Software Developer Manager" or candidates with "developer" in one section and "manager" in another. Expected Result: Returns profiles where both "Python" and "JavaScript" are listed as skills. Example Output: Profiles for candidates proficient in both Python and JavaScript programming languages. Expected Result: Retrieves profiles that include both marketing and strategy-related terms.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Example Output: Profiles mentioning "Marketing Strategy Consultant" or "Marketing and Strategic Planning." The OR operator allows you to search for profiles that contain any one of the specified terms. It is useful when you want to search for multiple variations of a role or skill. Expected Result: Retrieves profiles containing either "developer" or "engineer" or both. Example Output: Profiles for "Software Developer" or "Systems Engineer." Search Query: recruiter OR talent acquisition Expected Result: Profiles mentioning either "recruiter" or "talent acquisition." Example Output: Profiles mentioning "Senior Recruiter" or "Talent Acquisition Manager."

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Search Query: data analyst OR data scientist Expected Result: Finds profiles that match either "data analyst" or "data scientist." Example Output: Candidates with roles involving "Data Analysis" or "Data Science." The NOT operator excludes profiles that contain a specific term, returning profiles that include one term but not another. Expected Result: Retrieves profiles mentioning "developer" but excludes any profile that includes "junior." Example Output: Candidates with titles like "Senior Developer" while excluding "Junior Developer." Search Query: project manager AND NOT construction

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Expected Result: Returns profiles mentioning "project manager" but excluding those in the construction industry. Example Output: Profiles like "IT Project Manager" excluding "Construction Project Manager." Expected Result: Retrieves profiles that contain "sales" but exclude any mention of "assistant." Example Output: Profiles for "Sales Manager" or "Sales Executive" excluding "Sales Assistant." Wildcards allow you to search for different variations of a word by including the root word followed by an asterisk (*). Expected Result: Finds profiles containing any word that starts with "develop", such as "developer," "development," "developing."

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Example Output: Profiles mentioning "Software Developer" or "Business Development Manager." Expected Result: Retrieves profiles containing words like "manager," "management," or "managing." Example Output: Profiles with titles such as "Team Manager," "Management Consultant," or descriptions like "managing teams." Expected Result: Profiles containing words starting with "design," such as "designer," "designing," or "designs." Example Output: Profiles mentioning "Graphic Designer" or "UX Designing."

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Using parentheses allows you to group multiple conditions together, controlling how the Boolean search is executed. This is particularly useful when you want to combine AND , OR , and NOT operators. Search Query: (developer AND senior) OR (engineer AND manager) Expected Result: Returns profiles that either include both "developer" and "senior" or both "engineer" and "manager." Example Output: Profiles mentioning "Senior Developer" or "Engineering Manager." Search Query: (marketing OR sales) AND (manager OR director) Expected Result: Retrieves profiles mentioning either "marketing" or "sales" and either "manager" or "director."

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Example Output: Profiles like "Marketing Manager," "Sales Director," or "Sales Manager." Search Query: ((product OR project) AND (manager OR leader)) AND NOT assistant Expected Result: Retrieves profiles mentioning either "product" or "project" along with either "manager" or "leader," while excluding "assistant." Example Output: Profiles like "Product Manager," "Project Leader" excluding "Assistant Manager." Combined Examples of AND, OR, NOT, Wildcard, and Parentheses Se arch Query: (developer OR engineer) AND (python OR java) AND NOT junior AND design*

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Expected Result: Retrieves profiles that contain either "developer" or "engineer," and either "python" or "java," excluding profiles that mention "junior," and including any word starting with "design" (such as "designer"). Example Output: Profiles for "Software Engineer with experience in Python and Java with UX Designing skills," excluding junior-level candidates. ​ Boolean Search includes AI-powered Natural Language Search, making it faster and easier to find records without manually building complex Boolean queries. You can simply type what you’re looking for in plain language, just like having a conversation (for example, “senior sales manager in New York with SaaS experience” ).

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The system automatically understands your intent, converts it into the correct Boolean logic, and delivers accurate results with the same reliability as traditional Boolean search. Understands complex logic such as AND / OR / NOT, exclusions, and grouped conditions. Automatically expands synonyms and role variations (for example, “VP of Sales” may also include “Vice President of Sales” or “Sales Director”). Supports multi-language and voice-to-text searches with consistent behavior. Displays the generated Boolean query so you can review or edit it before running the search. Handles incomplete inputs intelligently and prompts you if more details are needed.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: A toggle in the search bar allows you to switch between: AI Boolean Search (Default – ON) When AI Mode is ON, natural language queries are converted into Boolean automatically. If you type a valid Boolean query, it runs exactly as written. ​ Manual Boolean Search (AI Toggle OFF) When AI Mode is OFF, the system executes your query strictly as typed, with no AI interpretation. This applies only to that search. Once you reset the search, AI Mode turns back ON automatically. Viewing matched results in Boolean Search You can view where your Boolean search keywords matched using the “Matched On” column in the results.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: This column appears at the beginning of the results and displays icons to indicate where matches were found. It covers the following sections: Activities (Notes, Tasks, Call Logs, Meetings) Multiple icons may appear if matches are found in more than one section. Matching keywords are also highlighted in yellow, making it easier to quickly identify relevant information. You can click on any icon to open the corresponding section in the candidate profile and view the highlighted keyword. When you run a Boolean search and open a resume, the matched keywords will be automatically highlighted within the resume as well for quicker review and better visibility.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When you open a resume from the "Matched On"column in Boolean search results, you can use Next/Previous to move between candidates. If a candidate's resume has no keyword match, you'll see a note saying 'No matches were found in the candidate's resume.' If no resume exists at all, it'll show 'No Resume Found'. The results displayed in the Matched On column reflect the search scope selected in Boolean Search, including Candidates , Files , Notes , Call Logs , Tasks , and Meetings . Note: This feature is currently available for Boolean Search on Candidates only.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Filters help you narrow down results based on specific record fields and conditions. Recruit CRM’s Filters search allows you to filter results based on various fields. You can filter records using: • Custom fields • Default fields • Activity fields Here are some examples of how you can use the filter search to narrow your search: is : Searches for an exact match. ​ Example: Current Company is "Google" ​ Result: Retrieves profiles where the current company is exactly "Google." contains : Partial match search. ​ Example: Job Title contains "developer" ​ Result: Retrieves profiles where "developer" is part of the job title, such as "Full-stack Developer" or "Software Developer."

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: does not contain : Excludes profiles containing specific text. ​ Example: Current Company does not contain "Amazon" ​ Result: Excludes profiles where "Amazon" is mentioned in the current company field. ​ is between : Retrieves profiles where the date falls between two specific dates. ​ Example: Last Contacted Date is between "01/01/2023" and "31/12/2023" ​ Result: Retrieves profiles where the last contacted date is within 1st January 2023 and 31st December 2023. is before : Finds results before a specific date. ​ Example: Date Updated is before "01/01/2023" ​ Result: Retrieves profiles last updated before January 1, 2023. ​

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: greater than : Searches for profiles where the value is greater than a given number. ​ Example: Years of Experience greater than "5" ​ Result: Retrieves profiles of candidates with more than 5 years of experience. between : Retrieves results within a specific numerical range. ​ Example: Salary between "50000" and "100000" ​ Result: Retrieves profiles with salaries between 50,000 and 100,000. ​ 1. Filter Candidates by Call Type and Date Added On Objective : Identify candidates who have had a specific type of call within a defined time frame. Select call type (e.g., "Phone Screening").

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Add a group filter for call log added on is "Last Month" using the 'AND' condition between them as shown in the image below: Expected Outcome : Results displayed will include candidates who had a "Phone Screening" call, added in the last month. 2. Combine Call Type and Note Type Filters Objective : Search for candidates that meet multiple criteria for call and note types. Select call type (e.g., "Phone Screening"). Add a group filter for call log added on is "Last Month" using the 'AND' condition between them. Add another group filter for note type (e.g., "Screening Notes") 'AND' for note added on is "This Week" as shown in the image below:

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Expected Outcome : Results displayed will include candidates who had a "Phone Screening" call, added in the last month, and "Screening Notes" added in the current week. You can filter based on activities like notes, call logs, tasks, or meetings. ​ Here are some examples of how to apply filters based on activity fields: Example 1: ​ Filter: Task added by "John Doe" ​ Result: Retrieves all records for which tasks are created by John Doe. If you are on the candidate list page , it will return all candidates' records matching the search criteria, and it will be similar for other record types such as contacts, companies, etc.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Example 2: ​ Filter: Call Outcome is "Positive" ​ Result: Retrieves all records where a call resulted in a positive outcome. Example 3: ​ Filter: Note Type is "Follow-up" Result: Retrieves all records where notes are categorized as “Follow-ups." Filter: Meeting Type is "Sales Presentation" Result: Retrieves all records where scheduled meetings are classified as sales presentations. Cross Entity Search allows you to retrieve records using fields from associated entities while keeping the primary entity view focused. ​ You can search contacts based on their associated company fields . • Contacts • Companies • Deals • Candidates You can perform the Search on the 'Kanban View' as well. ​

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 📌 Saving, Applying, and Resetting Searches Recruit CRM allows you to save search queries for future use , making it easier to revisit commonly used searches without rebuilding the filters each time. Saved searches can also be shared with specific teammates, teams, or all users , helping maintain consistency when multiple users need access to the same search criteria. Once saved, these searches can be quickly accessed from the List Page Quick View , allowing you to run them instantly. ​

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When working with filters or Boolean searches, it is important to apply your changes correctly so the updated results are displayed. After adding or modifying any filters, click the Apply button for the changes to take effect. Alternatively, you can press Enter to run the newly added filters without clicking Apply. However, if you remove an existing filter, pressing Enter will not apply the change; you must click Apply Filters to update the results. For changes made inside the Boolean Search field, you can execute the search by clicking Search or pressing Enter . ​ To make the process faster, Recruit CRM also supports keyboard shortcuts: • Mac: Command + Return • Windows: Control + Enter

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can also duplicate existing filters to quickly recreate similar filter conditions without starting from scratch. If you want to clear all the applied filters and start over, you can use the Reset option. This will remove all currently applied filters and return the list to its default state. ​ Recruit CRM also supports persisting filters , which means your applied filters remain active even if you: • Navigate to another tab • Refresh the page • Log out and log back into the system This behavior ensures that your search context is preserved, allowing you to continue working with the same filtered results without needing to rebuild your search every time.

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: While running a Boolean search, keywords won't get highlighted on the Resume file and in Notes. Can I use multiple filters on the same field? Yes, you can apply multiple filter conditions to the same field and use Boolean operators to create more refined searches. What are stopwords , and how do they affect my search? Stopwords are common words (e.g., “the”, “and”, “is”) that are excluded from search queries. This means that these words will not affect your search results. For more details, refer to the official stopwords documentation .

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Stopwords : a, an, and, are, as, at, be, but, by, for, if, in, into, is, it, no, not, of, on, or, such, that, the, their, then, there, these, they, this, to, was, will, with Wh y can’t I combine both AND and OR conditions in the same filter search? At the moment, filters support only one condition type within a filter group, either AND or OR . Mixing both in the same search can create ambiguity and lead to unpredictable results. Title = Product AND Title = Manager OR Title = Lead This query can be interpreted in two different ways: • (Product AND Manager) OR Lead • Product AND (Manager OR Lead)

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Both produce very different results. In many cases, one query may return only “Lead” records, while the other may return no results at all. Since the system cannot reliably determine the intended grouping automatically, Recruit CRM currently supports only one condition type per filter group to ensure consistent and predictable search results. Can I search within candidate attachments other than the default resume? Yes. Select the Files option in Boolean Search to search the contents of a candidate's attached PDF , DOC , and DOCX files. The search includes up to the 10 most recent supported attachments for each candidate and excludes the default resume, which is searched under Candidates .

chunks.t: Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What's the difference between the Candidates and Files search options? Candidates searches candidate fields (default and custom) and the resume stored in the default Resume field. Files searches other supported candidate attachments (PDF, DOC, and DOCX). You can select either option individually or use both together, depending on where you want Boolean Search to look. chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The Target Reporting feature in Recruit CRM empowers you with advanced tools to set, monitor, and report on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) . This feature allows users to create comprehensive target reports for company members, roles, teams, and individuals, providing detailed insights into performance against set targets. With customizable KPIs, reporting permissions, API support, and automation capabilities , you can effectively track goals and enhance performance management across teams. Targets have default statuses such as upcoming, active, or completed, and they automatically stop tracking after the end date unless you extend them.

chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Only account owners, admins, and custom roles with access to Target reports can view and create targets. Ensure you know which target type you want to set (individual, teams, roles, or company-wide). Decide the KPIs you want to track. The KPIs available in target reports are the same as those in the team performance report. Confirm the target frequency and the start and end dates for tracking. Decide whether you want email notifications sent to assignees when targets are completed. Go to Admin Settings and click on Target Reports . Target type (individual, teams, roles, or company-wide) For Frequency , choose how often the KPI is tracked (for example, weekly or monthly). ​

chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: For Start and End Date , define when to begin and stop tracking. Targets automatically stop tracking after the end date, but you can extend a target by editing the end date. ​ For KPI selection , choose one or more KPIs (such as calls per week or meetings per month) and assign values. The KPIs available are the same as those in the team performance report. ​ To add more than one KPI to a single target report, click Add Another KPI . ​ Review the status behavior: targets will move through statuses such as upcoming, active, or completed based on dates and progress. ​ Search, filter, and customize target list view In the Target Reports list, use the search bar to search for targets by name. ​

chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Use filters to filter targets by frequency . ​ Click Show or Hide Column to customize which columns are visible in the list view. ​ 📊 Viewing and Generating a Target Report Go to the Reports section and open Target Reports . ​ In the target report view, track performance by monitoring teams, individuals, or roles against assigned KPIs within the set dates and frequency. ​ Review the chart where the red line represents the target set. ​ Use the report controls and filters in the target report to adjust what you are viewing (for example, entity type or date range). ​

chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: In the chart, click on any bar to view the detailed entity data behind that result. The bar is clickable and opens more detailed data. ​ Use the additional interactive controls in the report to explore more details or switch between entities and KPIs. ​ From the target reports area, you can also create a new target from scratch if needed. ​ In the target report view, use the export controls to export the graphic as a PNG , JPG , or .SVG file. ​ Click the Export to CSV button to export the report data as a CSV file. ​ 📩 Automated Emails When a Target is Achieved

chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can notify Assigned Teams/Roles/Individuals when a target is completed. Please notice that the Account Owner and Target Creator also receive notifications. To achieve this, turn on the 'Send Email Notifications to Assignees' toggle in Target Reports inside the Reports section . Turn on the Send Email Notifications to Assignees toggle to enable automated emails when a target is completed. ​ When enabled, assignees or assigned teams, roles, or individuals will be notified when a target is completed. ​The account owner and the target creator also receive notifications. ​ 🔗 Sharing, Embbeding, and Auto-Refreshing Target Reports

chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can also share your report externally through a unique link. In the target report view, click Share Report . ​ In the sharing settings, enable the target report direct link to generate a unique external link for the report. ​ Use the same controls to disable the direct link when you no longer want the report to be accessible externally. ​ Turn on Auto-refresh to refresh the report data at predefined intervals that you set. ​ Copy the target report URL to share it externally, and use the preview option to see how the shared report will appear. ​ Problem: KPIs you expect are not available when creating a target

chunks.t: Setting Up and Managing Target Reports in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: You are expecting KPIs that are not part of the team performance report. What to check: Review the KPIs available in the team performance report, as target report KPIs match this list. Resolution: Use one of the KPIs that exists in the team performance report, or adjust your reporting expectations to those available KPIs. Q1: What happens when a target reaches its end date? Targets automatically stop tracking after the end date. You can extend tracking by editing the target and updating the end date. Target reports in Recruit CRM give you a structured way to set KPIs, track performance visually, and share results with your team and stakeholders.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: What does this feature do and when to use it? The new Candidate List Page helps you manage and organize candidate records more efficiently. View and manage candidates using an improved list layout. Perform bulk actions on multiple candidates. Customize candidate columns and their order. Search and filter candidates more efficiently. Quickly access candidate summaries and candidate-level actions. Export more than 3,000 candidate records. To switch to the new version, click your Profile icon → Switch to New Version . You can switch back to the previous design at any time using the same option.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: The Quick View section displays the total number of candidate records, along with the number of Hotlists and Saved Searches and the records within them. You can also edit, pin, and delete Hotlists, as well as edit, pin, clone, and delete Saved Searches. The Candidate View, Hotlists, and Saved Searches sections can be minimized or expanded. The Candidate List Page uses infinite scrolling, allowing you to continuously view candidates without switching between pages. The first 100 records are loaded initially. As you scroll, additional records can be loaded and selected, up to a maximum of 3,000 records . You can use Scroll to Top to quickly return to the top of the list.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: Recruit CRM provides multiple ways to select candidates in bulk: Header checkbox: Selects the first 50 loaded records. As you scroll, another 50 records are automatically selected. Custom Record Selection: Click the arrow next to the header checkbox, enter a number between 1 and 3,000 , and click Select to select the exact number of records based on the current list order. Custom Record Selection replaces any existing manual or bulk selection. Automatic scroll-based selection is disabled after a custom selection until the selection is cleared. Only values between 1 and 3,000 are accepted. The Select All option is disabled once 3,000 records are selected.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: The five most commonly used bulk actions are displayed upfront by default, while the remaining actions are available under More . You can customize which actions appear upfront: Move the required actions above the dashed line. Set a default bulk action arrangement for your account Account Owners can configure a default bulk action arrangement for all users from Others View . To prevent users from changing the arrangement, select Do not allow users of your account to edit their view . Please note: Users with an Admin role or the required custom permissions can still rearrange the actions. For a custom role, enable Allow User to Choose their Own Field Order and Visibility .

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: You can export all candidate records in a section, including records beyond the 3,000-record limit , while still applying your selected filters. You can use the arrow next to a column to manage individual column settings. Pin Column – Keep a column fixed while scrolling. Add Column to Right/Left – Add a hidden column next to the selected column. Note : Only the hidden columns will be displayed in the list while adding a column to the left or right. Sort Ascending/Descending – You can sort the values in the column in ascending or descending order Multi Sorting – Sort by multiple columns using the column actions or by holding Shift while selecting columns.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: Hide Column – Remove a column from the current view. Click Show/Hide Columns next to the Resume Parser button to manage which columns are displayed. You can also see the number of Visible Columns and Hidden Columns . Pinned columns can be unpinned from this section. You can search for a field within the Show/Hide Columns section. Matching fields are highlighted, and a counter helps you move between multiple matches. You can also drag and drop columns to change their order while searching. The Updated By column is also available on the Candidate List Page. Set a Default Column Arrangement for Your Account

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: Account Owners can configure a default column arrangement for all users from Others View . To prevent users from changing the arrangement, select Do not allow users to edit their view . Please note: Users with an Admin role or the required custom permissions can still rearrange the columns. For a custom role, enable Allow User to Choose their Own Field Order and Visibility . You can view or edit a candidate’s summary directly from the Candidate List Page. Click the Summary icon for the candidate. Click Edit at the bottom-right. Update the required details and click Submit to save the changes. Click the three dots next to a candidate under the Name column to access candidate-level actions:

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: You can adjust the width of individual columns by hovering over the margin next to the column name and dragging it. You can also adjust the width of the Quick View section. For the Skills column, changing the width controls how many skills are displayed directly in the list. Switch to Classic View in Advanced Search The new Advanced Search allows you to switch to Classic View , which displays filters in the familiar grid format. Use the grid modal to apply your filters. Filters in Classic View are treated as independent AND conditions.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Candidate List Page
chunks.x: Important: Classic View does not support duplicate filters, group filters, or cross-entity filters. The dropdown-based Advanced Search remains available with its existing functionality. You can switch back anytime using the Switch to Compact View button to the New Advanced Search. The new Candidate List Page makes it easier to manage candidates, customize your workspace, perform bulk actions, and search through candidate records efficiently. With features such as infinite scroll, flexible column management, bulk selection, candidate-level actions, and Classic View in Advanced Search, you can tailor the Candidate List Page to your recruitment workflow.

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? With this feature, you can create unique job page URLs for specific teams and companies , ensuring only relevant job postings appear on your external websites. This targeted approach simplifies job listing management, offering greater flexibility and precision without additional integration efforts. • Jobs associated with a specific company. This allows you to create focused job pages for different audiences without additional development work. • You want to display only one team's open roles on a specific website or careers page. • You manage multiple teams and need separate job pages for each team.

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: • You want to create a dedicated public job page for a specific company. Before generating team-specific or company-specific public job page URLs, ensure the following requirements are met: • Available only on the Business and Enterprise plans, as Teams are supported on these plans only. • The relevant team must be added as a collaborator on the job. • You must have access to Admin Settings. • You must have access to Public Job Page Settings. 👥 Generate a Team-Specific Public Job Page URL Follow these steps to generate a team-specific public job page.

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: Navigate to Admin Settings → Public Job Page Settings → Job Page Integration and scroll to the bottom of the page, where you will find the Team URL and Company URL formats. Locate the Team URL format provided by Recruit CRM. Copy the URL as shown in the screenshot and paste it into a new browser tab. • Click the Click Here link available on the same page for quick access, or • Navigate to the ' Teams ' page and locate the Team ID for the required team Append the Team ID to the end of the Team URL. Once completed, the URL will display jobs associated with that specific team. Requirements for jobs to appear on a Team-Specific Job Page For a job to appear on a team-specific public job page:

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: • The relevant team must be added as a collaborator on the job. • The job status must not be set to Closed. • The Enable Job Application Form option must be enabled. Only jobs meeting all of these requirements will appear on the team-specific job page. 🏢 Generate a Company-Specific Public Job Page URL Follow these steps to generate a company-specific public job page. Navigate to Admin Settings → Public Job Page Settings → Job Page Integration and scroll to the bottom of the page, where you will find the Team URL and Company URL formats. Locate the Company URL format provided by Recruit CRM. Copy the URL as shown in the screenshot and paste it into a new browser tab.

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: Copy the alphanumeric value that appears after: https://app.recruitcrm.io/v1/company/ https://app.recruitcrm.io/v1/company/abc123xyz Step 4: Generate the Company-Specific URL Append the Company Slug to the end of the Company URL. The completed URL will display jobs associated with that specific company. • Create dedicated company-specific careers pages. Requirements for jobs to appear on a Company-Specific Job Page For a job to appear on a company-specific public job page: • The job must be associated with the selected company. • The job status must not be set to Closed. • The Enable Job Application Form option must be enabled.

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: Only jobs meeting all of these requirements will appear on the company-specific job page. Likely cause: The team has not been added as a collaborator on the jobs, or the jobs do not meet the visibility requirements. ​ ​ What to check: • The correct team is added as a collaborator • The job status is not Closed • Enable Job Application Form is enabled ​ ​ Resolution: Problem: Company-Specific URL shows no jobs Likely cause: The Company Slug is incorrect. ​ ​ What to check: • The Company Slug copied from the company URL • Any missing or extra characters ​ Problem: Some jobs are missing from the Company-Specific page

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: Likely cause: The jobs are not linked to the correct company or do not meet visibility requirements. ​ Problem: Cannot find the Team URL or Company URL Likely cause: Insufficient permissions or unsupported plan. ​ Upgrade to Business or Enterprise if Team functionality is required. How do I generate a team-specific or company-specific job page URL? Go to Admin Settings → Public Job Page Settings → Job Page Integration and append the relevant team or company identifier to the default job page URL. What happens if a job is linked to multiple teams? The job will appear in the job page URLs for all associated teams. Will the job page update automatically when job assignments change?

chunks.t: Create Company/Team Specific Public Job Pages
chunks.x: Yes, any changes in team or company assignments will be reflected in the respective job page URLs. What are the conditions for jobs to be displayed on the jobs page? 1. Job's status should NOT be " Closed ". 2. The "Enable Job Application Form" option should be checked. Team-specific and company-specific public job page URLs allow you to display focused, relevant job listings on external websites without requiring additional integrations. By using team and company filters, you can create tailored job experiences for candidates while keeping job management centralized within Recruit CRM. chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Call logs in Recruit CRM help you record and manage phone conversations directly against candidate, contact, or company records. They create a searchable and organized history of call activity, making it easier to track conversations, review outcomes, and collaborate with your team. • Notes summarizing the conversation • Call start time and duration • Collaborators who participated in the call • An associated record • A contact number • A customizable call type to match your workflow This feature is especially useful when you want to:

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: • Record important candidate or contact conversations • Build a searchable call history on records • Categorize calls and track outcomes over time • Add and manage call logs while working on mobile devices Open the Candidate, Contact, or Company record you want to log the call against. In the right-hand activity panel, click the call log icon to open the call log form. Fill in the Add Call Log form. The Related to field will be auto-filled based on the record you are on. You can also add: Call notes: Use this field to capture the key points and outcomes of the conversation. Collaborators: Add any teammates who were part of the call.

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Call duration and start time: Record how long the call lasted and when it began. Related to: If the call log is linked to a record, you can add that record in the Related to field. Contact number: This field is optional. Select a number from standard or custom phone fields stored on the record, or enter a new number manually. ​ 4. Click the green Submit button to save the call log. It will appear in the record's activity section immediately. Tip: Always fill in Call Notes to capture the highlights of the conversation. This makes the log useful for future follow-ups and keeps your team aligned. Method 2: Add a Call Log from the Global Add Menu

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Click the blue plus (+) button at the top right of any screen in Recruit CRM. Select Call Log from the activity options. A form will appear on the right side of the screen. In the Related to field, search for and select the Candidate, Contact, or Company the call log should be attached to. This field is not auto-filled when using this method, so selecting the correct record is essential. Fill in all remaining details such as call notes, collaborators, call duration, start time, and contact number. 📌 Please Note : If you forget to fill in the Related to field, the call log may not appear where you expect it. Always verify the correct record is selected before submitting.

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Open the Recruit CRM mobile app and navigate to the Candidate, Contact, or Company record you want to log the call against. Tap the floater button at the bottom right corner of the profile page. Fill in the call log details in the form that appears. Tap Save to add the call log to the record. Open the record and go to the Activities tab and select the Notes and Calls section to see all call logs. Each call log card displays the contact number associated with the call, making it easier to identify the caller at a glance without opening the log. Click View More of any call log to expand it for a detailed view.

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: The date and time when the call log is added appear at the bottom right of the call log card beside the clock icon. To expand the full activity view, click and move the bar to adjust the size of the section as needed. Use the search bar to find specific call logs by keyword. Use the filter options to narrow results by activity type, call type, date range, or collaborator, giving you a focused view of the call history you need. In addition to viewing call logs from individual records, you can access a centralized list of call logs from different areas of Recruit CRM. ​ Go to Admin Settings and open Phone Calling and SMS Settings .

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Scroll down to the Call Logs list to view the detailed list of call logs. Use the available options to choose which call logs you want to view: To Number – Filter calls made to a specific number. From Number – Filter calls made from a specific number. User – View call logs associated with a specific user. Call Type – Filter calls based on their call type. Call Outcome – Filter calls based on their outcome. Related To – Filter call logs associated with a specific Candidate, Contact, or Company . ​ Open the Mailbox from the left navigation menu. Scroll down and select Call Logs to open the detailed call logs list. Use the available options to choose which call logs you want to view:

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: To Number – Filter calls made to a specific number. From Number – Filter calls made from a specific number. User – View call logs associated with a specific user. Call Type – Filter calls based on their call type. Call Outcome – Filter calls based on their outcome. Related To – Filter call logs associated with a specific Candidate, Contact, or Company . ​ Please note: System-generated call logs associated with phone calling credits cannot be deleted by any user. This restriction helps maintain accurate Phone Calling credit usage and prevents discrepancies in credit reporting.

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Manually created call logs can still be deleted by users such as Account Owners, Admins, and users on custom roles with the appropriate permissions to delete call logs. To delete manually added call logs, click on the 3 dots icon on the call log and select the 'Delete' option. Click on 'Yes' in the delete call log pop-up. You can create custom call types to tag each call log with a specific category, such as Intro Call, Follow-up, or Client Update. This makes it easier to filter and report on call activity across your team. Go to Admin Settings and click Call Type Customization under CRM Process Customization. Click Customize and then Add New Status to create a new call type.

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Enter a name of up to 50 characters and click Save Status. The new call type will appear in the Call Type dropdown when adding call logs. Note: You can add up to 100 custom types for Call Logs, Notes, and Meetings. Problem: The Related to field is empty when creating a call log. Likely cause: You are using the global Add method to add the call log, which does not auto-fill this field. ​ ​ What to check: Verify that you opened the call log from the global Add icon instead of from within a record. ​ ​ Resolution path: Manually select the correct candidate, contact, or company in the Related to field before submitting. Problem: You cannot see certain call logs on a record.

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: Filters are applied in the activity panel. ​ ​ What to check: Review the activity filters to ensure Call or All activities are selected. ​ ​ Resolution path: Clear or update filters to reveal all visible call logs. Where do call logs appear after I create them? Call logs appear in the activity section of the related candidate, contact, or company record, under the Notes and Call section. ​ Can I log calls that were not made through Recruit CRM? Yes. You can manually create call logs for any phone conversation by entering notes, duration, and other details, even if the call took place outside Recruit CRM. ​

chunks.t: Adding and Managing Call logs (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. You can use call types to categorize your call logs and make them easier to filter and review. By using call logs in Recruit CRM, you can maintain a complete, structured history of all phone interactions with candidates, contacts, and companies. How to Add and Manage Call Logs in Recruit CRM Use the native dialer to call from the system (New UI) Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Task Type Customization in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Task type customization lets you create and manage custom task types in Recruit CRM. You can add new task types, name them, and set one as the default. This helps you tag and categorize tasks in a way that matches your recruitment process, making it easier for you and your team to identify and manage different types of tasks. When you want to create custom task types that match your internal workflow. When your team needs clearer tagging and categorization of tasks. Only users with access to the admin settings on the Business plan and above can customize task types.

chunks.t: Task Type Customization in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: On the Pro plan, only Account Owners and users with the admin role can perform task type customization. On the Business plan and above, you can also grant access to task type customization to team members with custom roles. 1. Go to Admin Settings > Click on Task Type Customization under CRM Process Customization. 3. Click on Add New Status and add a name (up to 50 characters) for your task type. 4. You can make it your default task type by checking the box next to it. 5. You can also customize the default Task types by editing the corresponding Task type name to suit the one relevant to you. ​

chunks.t: Task Type Customization in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Please Note: The number of available task types is a total of 100, including 2 task types available in the system by default, 'Follow Up' and 'Interview Scheduling'. chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The Data Enrichment feature helps users find missing email addresses and phone numbers for candidates or contacts using their LinkedIn profiles and other available information. Recruit CRM performs enrichment using a waterfall model i.e, when contact data is requested, Recruit CRM automatically requests data from RocketReach and FullEnrich. The waterfall model increases the chance of finding valid contact details without requiring additional steps from the user. For candidates, personal emails are fetched. For contacts, work emails are fetched. If more than one personal or work email is available, the secondary email is saved as a note.

chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts
chunks.x: You need to find missing email addresses or phone numbers for candidates/contacts. Data Enrichment is an Enterprise plan feature which can also be added at an additional cost to the Pro or Business plan subscriptions. Free Plan: Users on the Free plan will have 25 free Data Enrichment credits to try out this feature. The free credits are assigned on a per-user basis and cannot be shared across the account. The free credits do not have an expiration period and will remain available in the account until they are fully utilized. Pro Plan and Business Plan : Pro and Business Plan users can try the Data Enrichment feature using the free Recruit CRM Credits .

chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts
chunks.x: Enterprise Plan : Users will receive the Data Enrichment credits included with their Recruit CRM subscription. These credits can be used for AI Sourcing as well. AI Sourcing beyond free monthly searches consumes 1 enrichment credit per search/per page. A valid LinkedIn profile URL is required for enrichment to work, and at least one of the fields (email or phone) must be empty. If the LinkedIn URL is not available or is invalid, the system will attempt to find data using a combination of the Candidate/ Contact's Full Name, Job Title, and Current Organization, provided all three fields have valid data. 📧☏ How to enrich the email or phone number?

chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts
chunks.x: 1. If you don’t have an active data enrichment subscription, you will see manual 'Find Email' and 'Find Phone' buttons to enrich data. In such a case, data may or may not be found when the user hits these buttons. If data is not found, no credits are consumed.

chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts
chunks.x: 2. Auto Detection (Users having an active data enrichment subscription) Open a candidate or contact profile that does not have email, phone, or both fields filled. Wait while the system automatically checks for available email or phone data. If data is available, look for “email available” or “phone available” indicators on the profile. Click to fetch the available email or phone and populate it into the record. If data is available, it shows 'Email Available' or 'Phone Available' and you can fetch the email or phone instantly with a click. Note : For candidates, personal emails are fetched, and for contacts, work emails are fetched.

chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: The Candidate Portal is a powerful feature of Recruit Craft that enhances the candidate experience by streamlining job applications and profile management. It ensures a seamless and efficient process while keeping everything fully integrated with Recruit CRM , allowing candidates to manage their profiles, track applications, and engage with recruiters effortlessly. Note : The Candidate Portal feature is part of Recruit Craft. RecruitCraft is an Enterprise plan feature that can also be added at an additional cost to Pro or Business plan subscriptions.

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: If you are interested in knowing more about how to access the feature and the price details, you can reach out to us through the chatbot or via email at support@recruitcrm.io The Candidate Portal integrates with the Career Pages , allowing candidates to view all open jobs. However, they must sign up or log in to apply for positions. Browsing Jobs : Candidates can explore job listings without signing up. They confirm their email address via an OTP sent to their email address. Upon confirmation, they’re directed to the Onboarding Form . After signing up, candidates are presented with an  Onboarding Form , on which they provide essential details to complete their profiles.

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: The Onboarding Form fields are directly linked to the Profile Update Form in Recruit CRM. You can configure this form in the Admin Settings to collect the information required for your hiring process. Once the Onboarding Form is submitted, candidates are redirected to their Dashboard , which serves as their portal home. A quick overview of their total applications and the stages of each application (e.g., Applied, Assigned, Shortlisted, Placed, etc.). A summary of all the jobs they’ve applied to and the progress of each application. A real-time view of all open positions they can apply to and can bookmark jobs for the future.

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: By clicking the Apply Now button, candidates can quickly begin the job application process. The application form is designed to be simple and easy to complete, allowing candidates to review their details, fill in any missing information, and submit their application from a single page. ​ ​ When the application form opens, relevant information from the candidate’s profile such as name, contact details, and resume data , is automatically pre-filled where available. This helps reduce the amount of manual input required and allows candidates to focus only on completing any missing details required by the job’s application form.

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: All fields remain editable, so candidates can review and update their information directly before submitting the application. If any required fields are incomplete, they are clearly highlighted to guide the candidate toward the sections that need attention. The Save & Apply button becomes active only after all required information is completed, ensuring that applications are submitted with accurate and complete details. Once the application is submitted successfully, candidates will see a confirmation pop-up on the bottom right corner of the screen, indicating that their application has been received.

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: Candidates can bookmark jobs they are interested in for future reference. These saved jobs appear on a dedicated Saved Jobs Page . Candidates can update their details anytime from the Profile Section of the portal. The profile updates automatically sync with Recruit CRM, keeping candidate information accurate and up-to-date. The Profile section is also linked to the Profile Update form, just like the Onboarding form. It's also possible to change your password from the Profile Section . A detailed Application History Page provides candidates with a record of all jobs they’ve applied to, along with current statuses.

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: You can control how the Candidate Portal works through Recruit CRM. Key configurations include: Onboarding and Profile Update Forms : Customize fields in Admin Settings to gather needed. Job Listings : Ensure jobs are updated in Recruit CRM for visibility on the portal. Application Stages : Regularly update hiring stages to provide candidates with real-time status updates. ​ If you no longer want to keep the Candidate Portal active, you can disable it at any time by following these steps. Go to the project you are currently working on. From the dropdown at the top left of the screen, select Candidate Portal . ​

chunks.t: How the Candidate Portal Works
chunks.x: Now navigate to the Pages, and on the left side of the page, you will see a toggle to turn the Candidate Portal on or off. Switch the toggle off to disable the Candidate Portal. ​ A confirmation box will then appear, informing you that candidates will no longer be able to access the portal through this website. It will also clarify that their login credentials, including email and password, will be retained for access to other projects within your account. Select the Disable Portal button in the confirmation box to complete the process. ​ Once disabled, the Candidate Portal will no longer be accessible to candidates. ​ ​ Let us know in case you need any help! :)

Voicemail follows the inbound cost model. Because the call connects to play the greeting and record the message, recording cost is added to the inbound call and deducted after the call ends. If no matching record is found, the call log will be created with the Related To field left empty, and you can associate it with a record manually later. The KYC form is only required for UK-based customers.

chunks.t: Provision to Purchase Phone Numbers and Incoming Call Support
chunks.x: To protect consumers from fraud, spam, and bad actors, Twilio has implemented a Know Your Customer (KYC) policy. These mandatory regulations require businesses and organizations to submit their KYC information and become verified by the local authorities before they can begin texting or calling their customers. Learn more about Twilio's KYC policy here Every agency based in the UK that wishes to buy a UK number through Recruit CRM must comply with Twilios guidelines by filling in the KYC form. Users will not be able to use this feature until the KYC process is completed and approved by Twilio.

chunks.t: Provision to Purchase Phone Numbers and Incoming Call Support
chunks.x: To use texting, it's necessary to select "Mobile" as the number type during KYC, as only mobile numbers support texting in the UK. You can fill in the KYC form inside Recruit CRM under Phone Calling & SMS settings. The evaluation process can take 1-2 weeks. You will receive an email notification once Twilio approves your KYC registration. ​ You can also check the status of your form in the KYC tab. Problem: Cannot complete purchase of a phone number Likely cause: Insufficient credits or not on a paid plan. Confirm that your account is on a paid plan . Check that you have at least 2 dollars in credits. Upgrade to a paid plan if you are on a free plan.

chunks.t: Provision to Purchase Phone Numbers and Incoming Call Support
chunks.x: Recharge your account credits until you meet or exceed the 2-dollar minimum, then attempt the purchase again. Likely cause: Incoming calls are not enabled or outside working hours. In the phone number details, verify that incoming calls are enabled. Check the working hours configured for the number. Enable incoming calls if they are disabled. Adjust working hours so they cover the times when you expect to receive calls. Remember that incoming calls are supported on the web app only ; ensure the user is logged into the web app. Do I need to complete KYC to purchase a UK number?

chunks.t: Provision to Purchase Phone Numbers and Incoming Call Support
chunks.x: Yes. For a UK number, you must complete a KYC form. The number becomes available only after the KYC form is submitted and approved. Are purchased phone numbers available on all plans? No. Purchased numbers are available only on paid plans and require at least 2 dollars in credits. Users on a free plan will see an Upgrade screen when they access the Purchased tab. You can now purchase and configure phone numbers in Recruit CRM, manage incoming calls on the web app, and keep your call logs organized for accurate reporting. chunks.t: In-App Notifications
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Notifications feature keeps you informed about important activity across Recruit CRM, helping you stay updated on candidate activity, job updates, collaborator actions, emails, imports, exports, and more. View all your Recruit CRM notifications in one place. Filter notifications based on their status or type. Receive browser notifications for real-time updates. Stay informed about candidate, job, email, and collaboration activities. Please note: Notifications are stored for 30 days before being automatically deleted. Click the Notifications (bell) icon next to your profile picture to open the Notifications panel.

chunks.t: In-App Notifications
chunks.x: Use the available notification tabs to find the updates you're looking for: All Notifications : This tab displays all the notifications. Unread : This tab shows only unread notifications. Mentions : This tab highlights notifications where you are mentioned or tagged as collaborators. Click the blue dot beside a notification to mark it as Read. Click the grey dot to mark it as Unread. To mark every notification as read at once, click Mark All as Read. Navigate to Profile Settings and enable Browser Notifications . When prompted by your browser, click Allow to grant notification permissions.

chunks.t: In-App Notifications
chunks.x: If you accidentally denied permission, open your browser's Settings → Privacy & Security → Site Settings , then allow notifications for Recruit CRM. Once enabled, you'll receive browser notifications even when you're not actively using Recruit CRM. Please note: Recruit CRM also displays a notification badge on your browser tab whenever you have unread notifications. When a candidate updates/deletes their profile through the profile update request form When a hiring stage is updated by the client on the 'Online Candidate List' When clients give feedback on the Online Candidate List When an email is opened by the Candidate/Contact When candidates/contacts/companies are imported from CSV files

chunks.t: In-App Notifications
chunks.x: When duplicate candidates are merged automatically using the add/edit form OR when merged manually using the “Merge Candidates” option Added as Job Collaborator (even when added in bulk to various jobs) Added as Task Collaborator not related to any record Added as Task Collaborator related to any record Added as Meeting Collaborator not related to any record Added as Note Collaborator (even when added in bulk) Candidate/Contact/Company marked as off-limit (even if it is a bulk action) Note Mentions (even if it is a bulk action) Job Requisition Sent from Portal (Hiring Manager Portal) Recruiter (User receiving the job request) Job Requisition Updated (Hiring Manager Portal)

Can I mark notifications as unread again? Yes. Click the grey dot beside a notification to mark it as unread.

chunks.t: In-App Notifications
chunks.x: You can enable browser notifications in your profile settings by granting Recruit CRM permission to send real-time updates. Notifications will be stored for 30 days before being automatically deleted. Do browser notifications work when I’m logged out? No, browser notifications are only sent while logged in to the web app. The Notifications feature helps you stay informed about important activity across Recruit CRM by keeping all updates in one place. Whether you're tracking candidate activity, job updates, collaboration, emails, or client actions, notifications ensure you never miss important events and can respond quickly when needed.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Notes in Recruit CRM help you log conversations, updates, and activities directly on candidates, companies, jobs, or contacts. You can also use them to keep your team aligned, especially when working across multiple records or collaborating on the same candidates or clients.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: • Add notes to individual records or multiple records at once • Mention teammates to notify them via email with a link to the record • Pin important notes so they stay visible at the top • Edit or delete notes as information changes • Associate a single note with multiple records • Customize note types for better organization and reporting • Search and filter notes to quickly find relevant information This is especially useful when you want to standardize note tracking, maintain clear communication across your team, and easily review important updates whenever needed. Notes can be added to Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, and Deal records.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: Bulk note actions are available from the Candidates and Contacts list page. Customizing note types is restricted to users with access to the Admin Settings on the Business plan and above, or users with the Admin role on the Pro plan. The total of customised note types, call types, and meeting types which can be created is 30. Open the specific record you want to add a note to. You can navigate to Candidates , Companies , Contacts , Jobs , or Deals from the main navigation. On the record's profile/details page, click the Note icon on the right-hand side Activities panel. It is the first icon in the activity section.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: Type your note in the text area. Optionally, select a note type from the Select Note Type dropdown to categorize the note. Click Add to save. The note will be attached to that record immediately. If you need to log the same note for several candidates or contacts at once, use the bulk note action from the list page. Go to the Candidates or Contacts list page. Select the records you want to add the note to by checking the box next to each name. Click Add Note from the action bar that appears at the top of the list. Enter the note text and click Add Note . The same note will be added to all selected record profiles.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: 📌 Note: Bulk adding a note applies the same text and note type to every selected record. It is best suited for common updates, not personalized feedback. You can notify a teammate about a record directly from the Notes section. This is useful when you need someone to review a profile or take action on a specific record. While typing a note, enter the @ symbol followed by your teammate's name. Select the teammate from the suggestions dropdown that appears. When you save the note, the teammate receives an email notification containing a direct link to that record. ​

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: You can view the notes on a separate tab. You will be able to keep the most important notes visible and up to date using the options available on each saved note. To pin a note , click the three-dot menu, then select Pin. The note will move to the top of the Notes section so it is always visible first. To edit a note , click on the three-dot menu, then select Edit. Make your changes and save. To delete a note , open the three-dot menu, then select Delete. Deleting a note that is associated with multiple records will remove it from all of those records.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: ⚠️ Please note: Pinned notes are visible to all users who have access to that record. Avoid including sensitive or confidential information in pinned notes unless it is appropriate for all viewers. A single note can be linked to more than one record at the same time. This is useful when a conversation or update is relevant across a candidate or contact profile, a job, and a company simultaneously. While adding a note, click Create Associations below the note text area. Search for and select the additional records you want to link to this note. Save the note. It will now appear on every record you associated it with.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: All notes saved on a record are available in the Activities section, where you can search and filter them to quickly find specific entries. Open the record → go to the Activities section on the right to view all the entries. Use the search bar to find notes using keywords OR Apply filters from the Activities section to narrow results by: • Owner • Type • Created Date • Association This makes it easier to locate the most relevant notes without scrolling through all activities. Note types allow you to tag each note with a category such as Interview Feedback, Client Call, or Internal Review. This makes it easier to filter, report on, and organize notes across your team.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: 🔒 Access required: Only users with access to the CRM Process Customization in the Admin Settings on the Business plan and above, or users with the Admin role on the Pro plan, can create and edit custom note types, or set default note types. To add a custom note type, follow these steps: Go to Admin Settings and click Note Type Customization under CRM Process Customization. Click the Customize button at the top of the page. Click Add New Status and enter a name for the note type. Names can be up to 50 characters long. To make this the default note type that is pre-selected each time a new note is added, check the box next to the new type.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: You can click and drag the '=' icon beside the Note type to reorder them. Click Save Status to finalize the new note type. It will immediately appear in the Select Note Type dropdown when adding notes. 📌 Note: The number of available call types, meeting types, and note types is 100. Problem: You cannot create a new note type. Likely cause: You have reached the limit of 30 combined note types, call types, and meeting types. What to check: Review existing note, call, and meeting types in the customization settings. Resolution path: Remove or consolidate unused types to free up space, then try adding the new note type again. Can I add notes to all record types in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. You can add notes to Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, and Deal records. You can also associate a single note with multiple related records so it appears across all of them. Will my teammates be notified when I mention them in a note? Yes. When you type @ followed by a teammate's name and select them from the suggestions dropdown, they receive an email notification with a direct link to that record. Can I change or delete a note after it has been saved? Yes. Hover over the note and use the three-dot menu to edit its content or delete it. Keep in mind that deleting a note that is associated with multiple records will remove it from all of those records.

chunks.t: Adding notes and customizing note type (New UI)
chunks.x: What is the difference between adding a note and associating a note? Adding a note creates a new entry on a specific record. Associating a note links that same note to additional records so it appears on all of them. You do not need to create separate notes for each record when the information is the same. Using notes effectively in Recruit CRM helps you centralize information, keep your team aligned, and maintain a clear history of every interaction across records. By adding, associating, pinning, and customizing notes, and by taking advantage of filters and bulk actions, you can manage your workflows more efficiently and find key information whenever you need it.

chunks.t: How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM's Radius Search lets you look for candidates/contacts within the radius range you choose. The Radius Search feature in Recruit CRM is powered by Google Maps which works well if you have a candidate/contact's address available inside the "Full Address" field of candidate/contact. How is location data used in radius search? Radius search works using a process called Geocoding . Geocoding converts location information into geographic coordinates. Recruit CRM uses these coordinates to calculate distance and return records that fall within the selected radius. ✅ How to enable radius search on your account?

chunks.t: How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Only account owners, admins, and users with custom permissions will have the ability to enable the radius search options for each entity. You can choose which data you'd like to apply a radius search to by toggling the switch for each type of record in Recruit CRM (such as candidates, contacts, companies, and jobs). Follow these steps to enable a radius search for your records. 1. Navigate to your Account section in the Admin Settings . 2. Scroll down until you find the "Radius Search" settings, then switch on the toggle for each entity where you want to perform radius searches.

chunks.t: How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Adding a full address through a CSV import does not automatically enable radius search. Radius search works only when the toggle is turned on for the relevant record type, as this allows the system to process the address through geocoding and convert it into coordinates that can be used for searches. Do you need to find iOS Developers in New York who stay within a radius of 10 km of Central Park on your candidate database? Let me show you how you can find your candidate in just seconds! 1. Before you do the search, do make sure you have made the "Full Address" field visible on your list view, by clicking on the small pencil icon next to Advanced Search:

chunks.t: How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Now make sure that you have ticked the "Full Address" field from here: 2. Then go to candidates and click on the 'Add Filters' button: 3. Type the location you want & you can see suggestions as you type, select your preferred location. If it's Central Park, click & select that address from the drop-down: You can also choose to add other filters along with the Radius search. 4. Click on Apply filters and your results will be displayed instantly on the same screen. Also, you can Save this combination of filters if you happen to use this often, by clicking on "Apply Filters & Save Search".

chunks.t: How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: P.S. If you are importing a bunch of records in bulk and want to be able to run a radius search on them, please give us an intimation and we will help you with the process. You can filter jobs based on travel time instead of just distance! The Travel Time Search filter helps identify jobs that fall within a realistic commuting range from a candidate’s location—based on how long it would take to reach the job by driving, walking, cycling, or public transport. This improves job-candidate matching accuracy, reduces manual screening, and ensures recruiters focus only on viable opportunities.

chunks.t: How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: The Travel Time Search Filter is available on the Candidate's New List Page Version and Job’s list page - Advanced Search >>> Full Address. You can enter the candidate’s address or pin code as the starting point, specify commute time (5 to 60 minutes), select travel mode : and filters jobs based on reachability from the candidate’s location using real commute data.
