chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This article explains how to delete records in Recruit CRM, both individually and in bulk, along with the permissions required and how to manage bulk action options on list pages. The delete functionality allows Account Owners and Admins to permanently remove records that are no longer needed. You can delete a single record from its profile/details page or remove multiple records at once using bulk actions from the list page. You can also customize which bulk actions are available and how they appear, helping you manage records more efficiently.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: Deletion is permanent. Records that are deleted cannot be recovered. There is no undo option, so review your selection carefully before confirming. Only Account Owners and Admins can delete records by default. Users on the Team Member and Restricted Team Member role do not have permission to delete records. Deletion applies to Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, and Deal records. Navigate to the profile of the Candidate , Contact , Company , Job or Deal you want to delete. ​ Click the ellipses icon ( ... ) located at the top of the profile page. ​ Select Delete from the dropdown menu that appears.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: A confirmation pop-up will appear. Enter the number of records you are deleting and click Delete to confirm. Navigate to the list page for the record type you want to delete. You can go to the Candidates, Contacts, Companies, Jobs, or Deals list page. ​ Select the records you want to delete by checking the checkbox on the left side of each row. To select all records on the page, use the checkbox beside the column header. As you scroll down, more records will be selected automatically. Click More in the bulk action bar and then click Delete . A confirmation pop-up will appear. Enter the number of records to be deleted and click Delete to confirm.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: 📌 Note: The confirmation step requires you to enter the exact number of records being deleted. This is intentional and helps prevent accidental bulk deletions. You can control which bulk actions are visible directly on your list page, so the actions you use most often are always within reach. Select any random record on the list page and then click More on the list page action bar, then click Customize Bulk Actions . Select up to 5 actions to display directly on the screen without needing to open the More menu. You can arrange the order of the selected actions by dragging and dropping them into your preferred sequence. ​

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: Save your configuration. The list page will now reflect your customized layout. ​ Problem: The Delete option is not visible on a record Likely cause: Your user role does not have permission to delete records. ​ What to check: Confirm whether you are logged in as an Account Owner or Admin, or your custom role has the permissions to delete the record. Resolution path: Contact your Account Owner to request the necessary permissions or to perform the deletion on your behalf. Problem: The Delete option is missing from the bulk actions menu Likely cause: The Delete action may not be included in your customized bulk actions display on the List Page.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: Click More on the list page and check whether Delete is listed there. Also, check if your role has delete permissions. Resolution path: Click More and then Customize Bulk Actions to add Delete to your visible actions, or ask the Account Owner to adjust your permissions. Problem: The number I enter in the confirmation box is not accepted

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: The number you typed does not match the actual count of selected records. ​ ​ What to check: Recount the selected records in the list or confirm you are deleting only one record from a profile page. ​ ​ Resolution path: Enter the exact number of records shown as selected (for example, “1” for a single record, “4” for four selected records). By default, only Account Owners and Admins can delete records. Users on the Team Member and Restricted Team Member role do not have permission to delete records. No. Deletion is permanent and irreversible. Once a record is deleted, it cannot be restored through the application. Always confirm your selection carefully before proceeding.

chunks.t: Deleting records (Candidates, companies, contacts, jobs & deals) (New UI)
chunks.x: You can delete Candidate, Contact, Company, Job, and Deal records, both individually and in bulk. What does the confirmation step in the delete pop-up require? Both the individual and bulk delete flows require you to type the number of records being deleted before the deletion is processed. This step is a safeguard to prevent accidental removal of records. How many bulk actions can I display directly on the list page? You can display up to 5 bulk actions directly on the list page. Additional actions remain accessible through the More menu. You can also drag and drop the selected actions to arrange them in your preferred order.

chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Delete Hotlist feature allows users to permanently remove/delete a hotlist from the database. You can use this feature when: You want to remove outdated or irrelevant hotlists from your account. You need to clean up duplicate or mistakenly created hotlists. You want to keep your database organized and focused on active talent pools. 1. By default, only the Account Owner and the Hotlist owner can delete Hotlists. However, if you're on the Business Plan or above, you can create a custom role with permission to edit Hotlists owned by other teammates: ​ 2. When you delete a hotlist in Recruit CRM:

chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists (New UI)
chunks.x: The hotlist is permanently removed from your account. Deleting a hotlist does not delete the candidates inside it. 👩‍👩‍👧‍👧 Step-by-step instructions on how to delete a hotlist The process of deleting the Hotlists is the same for candidates, contacts, companies, and jobs. Here, we have taken the example of the Candidates entity. 1. Navigate to the 'Quick View' section by clicking on the 'Quick View' button located at the top left corner of your screen: 2. Click on the blue ' View All' button present beside the Hotlist section.

chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. You will see the list of hotlists of that particular entity and the option to edit and delete the hotlists you want. To delete a specific hotlist, just click on the Trash icon. You can search for a specific hotlist from the search bar located at the top-right of your screen. You can also filter the hotlists based on the 'Created On', 'Created By', or 'Updated On' fields: Problem: If you’re unable to delete the hotlist. Likely cause : You do not have the required permission or access. What to check: Check if you are the Account Owner or the person who created the hotlist, or if your custom role includes permissions to edit/delete hotlists owned by others.

chunks.t: Deleting Hotlists (New UI)
chunks.x: Resolution path: If you're unable to delete the hotlist, ensure that you have the required permission or access, or you can reach out to the respective user who has the required permissions to delete it and ask them to delete the hotlist. Problem: The hotlist is still visible after deletion. Likely cause: The page has not refreshed, or the view is cached. What to check: Confirm that you clicked the trash icon and that no error was shown. Resolution path: If the hotlist is still visible after deletion, try refreshing the page and check if that helps. Deleting a hotlist helps you keep your Recruit CRM database clean and focused while keeping all underlying records safe.

chunks.t: Pitch Candidate(s) to Contact(s)in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM lets you pitch or market candidates discreetly to multiple hiring managers/contacts without needing to assign them to a job role. You can use this feature when: You want to market a strong candidate profile to multiple clients without linking them to a specific job. You need to track which candidates were shared with which contacts for reporting or follow-up. You want to send candidate CVs and summaries as structured emails directly from Recruit CRM. The candidate won't receive an email when you send their application to a contact.

chunks.t: Pitch Candidate(s) to Contact(s)in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: This way, you can record if you shared Candidate CVs with your clients, even if the candidate isn't assigned to any specific job. Make sure your email is connected inside Recruit CRM, so you can send emails directly from Recruit CRM. Step-by-step instructions on Pitching a single candidate 1. Go to the relevant candidate’s profile. 2. Click the three-dot (ellipsis) button and select ' Pitch Candidates' . Alternatively, scroll to the middle of the candidate profile and click the Contacts Pitched widget to begin the pitch process.

chunks.t: Pitch Candidate(s) to Contact(s)in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. Now you will be redirected to a page to select the contacts you want to pitch this candidate with and click on the Select fields and email contacts option (or you can mark the candidate as pitched if you have already pitched outside of Recruit CRM): ​ 4. Select the candidate fields (including file/document fields) you wish to share with the contact, and then click on the " Generate Email" button: ​ In the File Columns section, you'll be able to select the option "Summary". The Candidate Summary will be converted into a .pdf file and attached to the pitch email. The file name generated will follow numeric order, to prevent sharing the name of the pitched record.

chunks.t: Pitch Candidate(s) to Contact(s)in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 5. You can now see an email is generated with the fields you selected, ready to be sent to the contacts you selected individually (Recruit CRM sends an individual email to each contact listed in the To field so that recipients are not aware the email is being sent to multiple contacts): ​ Pitching multiple candidates from the list view This can also be done with multiple candidates from the list view by just selecting candidates & clicking on the "Pitch Candidate(s)" button that appears. Note: You can pitch a maximum of 20 candidates at a time. Once you have pitched the candidate(s), you will be able to track this pitch on both the candidates' & contacts' profiles.

chunks.t: Pitch Candidate(s) to Contact(s)in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: On the candidate's profile, you will find the "Contact(s) pitched" widget which has a timestamp with the name of the user who made the pitch to keep you organized. ​ Similarly, from contact profiles: On the contact's profile, you will find the "Candidate(s) pitched" widget. ​ Click here to know more about Pitch Candidate Pipeline Track and Update Pitches from Contact Profiles Once you receive a status update from the contact about a candidate, click on the pitch stage value and select a new stage (for example, Pitched ) from the options you have customized in your system. You can add a Remark or Feedback for future reference. Don't forget to hit Submit :)

chunks.t: Pitch Candidate(s) to Contact(s)in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: How to view a list of all the candidates I have pitched in Recruit CRM? Recruit CRM enables you to view all the candidates pitched by any team members by generating a report. This report provides a clear list based on their specific activities as a user. Access the Reports Section > Team Performance Report . Choose the team members in the report filters, and the time period. Select the KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) as stages from your Pitch Candidate pipeline , such as "Candidate Pitched - Pitched". Click on the option to generate the report . Once the report is displayed, you will see a bar graph summarizing your pitching activity. ​

chunks.t: Pitch Candidate(s) to Contact(s)in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Click on the bar graph. This will lead you to a detailed list of all candidates the selected team members have pitched. Click here to learn more on generating a Team Performance Report Can I pitch candidates without assigning them to a job? Yes. Recruit CRM lets you pitch a candidate or market candidates discreetly to multiple hiring managers or contacts without needing to assign them to a job role. Can I record a pitch that was sent outside of Recruit CRM? Yes. chunks.t: Meeting Scheduler
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Meeting Scheduler helps streamline the process of scheduling meetings with candidates and contacts by allowing them to book a meeting directly based on your availability. Instead of coordinating schedules through multiple emails or messages, you can share a personalized booking link that lets recipients select a suitable time from your available slots directly from a personalized booking page. The feature automatically syncs booked meetings with your connected calendar and allows you to customize availability, event settings, booking forms, confirmation behavior, email notifications, and scheduling page branding.

chunks.t: Meeting Scheduler
chunks.x: • You want candidates or contacts to book meetings directly based on your availability from a personalized booking page. . • You need a reusable scheduling link that can be shared in emails, messages, or workflows. Click here to know how syncing your calendar to Recruit CRM works Note: This feature is available on all plans (Free plan, Pro, Business, and Enterprise) 🗓️ How to create a schedule page (meeting scheduler link) 1. Click on the Profile icon and select the 'Meeting Scheduler' option. If you haven't connected your email or calendar in Recruit CRM then you will be prompted to connect your email and calendar in order to create a schedule page.

chunks.t: Meeting Scheduler
chunks.x: Note : We recommend connecting the same/default email ID to your 'Calendar Settings' to ensure the visibility of scheduled meetings in Recruit CRM. Meetings booked through the scheduler's link will be added to the connected email ID's calendar. 3. You will now be prompted to choose the event type. Select the type of scheduling page you would like to create: • One-on-One Bookings – Ideal for interviews, screening calls, consultations, or any meeting involving one organizer and one participant. • Group or Class Bookings – Best suited for events where one organizer hosts multiple participants, such as webinars, training sessions, or group discussions.

chunks.t: Meeting Scheduler
chunks.x: Once selected, Recruit CRM will configure the scheduling page based on the chosen meeting type. ​ 4. Add the details regarding the meeting. Event Name : You can add the title of the event/meeting type. Event Duration : Select the duration of the meeting from the available options. Event Meeting or Location : In the event location, you can see options such as: Google Meet or Teams, based on the email that you have connected. To add Zoom as the event location, you can add the Zoom link by selecting the 'Custom Location' option, similarly, for other apps as well.

chunks.t: Meeting Scheduler
chunks.x: If you have an Outlook free account, then in the meeting location, when you select Teams and send the scheduled link, candidates/contacts can book the call, but it will not contain the automated meeting link of Microsoft Teams. This will work for Outlook Premium accounts only. 5. You can select the calendar where you want to add event bookings and click on 'Create'. 6. Under the 'Event Info' tab you can add the event description under the Event Description section. After creating the event, you can further customize your scheduling page by configuring availability, booking rules, form fields, notifications, confirmation settings, and page branding.

chunks.t: Meeting Scheduler
chunks.x: 1. Customizations under the 'Availability' Tab. Under the 'Availability' Tab, you will be able to: Select the calendar where you want to add event bookings. chunks.t: Meeting Scheduler

Note: Images used in the Meeting Scheduler must be publicly accessible, served over HTTPS, and not restricted by authentication, IP blocking, or anti-bot rules. Hosting images on S3, a CDN, or the company website is the recommended approach. And to save all your customizations, you need to click on the 'Save Changes' option and click on the 'Back' button. chunks.t: How to Run a Search in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM’s Advanced Search feature helps recruiters quickly find candidates and contacts using Boolean search, filters, and activity-based search options. You can search through candidate profiles, resumes, candidate attachments, notes, call logs, meetings, and tasks, then save your search criteria for future use to locate the exact records you need faster and more accurately. Click on the Boolean Search section to start building your keyword query. You can use Boolean Search to find specific keywords across candidate profiles, the resume uploaded in the default Resume field, and supported candidate attachments.

chunks.t: How to Run a Search in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: In the Boolean search, you can combine AND, OR, and NOT operators to narrow down your search results. Use the Contains search option to find records that include a specific keyword, even if the exact phrase does not match. For example, searching for ‘sales’ may return results such as ‘sales manager,’ ‘international sales,’ or ‘business sales. Select the sources you want to search, including: Candidates (candidate fields and the resume uploaded in the default Resume field) Files (candidate attachments in PDF, DOC, and DOCX formats, excluding the default resume)

chunks.t: How to Run a Search in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The Candidates and Files options work independently, allowing you to search either source individually or both together. When searching attachments, Recruit CRM searches the 10 most recent supported files for each candidate. Click Save Search to store your search criteria for future use. Once saved, the search will appear under the Quick View section in the Saved Searches tab. To clear your current Boolean search, click the Reset button. Click Add Filters to apply filters to default and custom fields. You can combine multiple filters to narrow down your results and improve search accuracy. To further narrow down candidates based on location, you can also use Radius Search in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: How to Run a Search in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Learn how to run a radius search inside the system Recruit CRM also lets you search across notes, call logs, tasks, meetings, and candidate attachments, making it easier to find previous interactions or information stored outside the default resume. Q: Can I search within candidate attachments other than the default resume? Yes. Select the Files option in Boolean Search to search supported candidate attachments in PDF , DOC , and DOCX formats. This searches up to the 10 most recent supported attachments for each candidate. The default resume is searched through the Candidates option. Q: What's the difference between the Candidates and Files options?

chunks.t: How to Run a Search in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Candidates searches candidate fields and the resume uploaded in the default Resume field. Files searches other supported candidate attachments. You can select either option individually or both together depending on where you want Boolean Search to look. Q: Can I combine Boolean search and filters in the same search? Yes. You can use both together to refine your results. Yes. You can search within notes, call logs, tasks, and meetings.

chunks.t: How to Run a Search in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Using Recruit CRM's Advanced Search feature helps you quickly locate candidates and contacts by searching across candidate profiles, resumes, supported attachments, activities, and filters, making it easier to find the right records and save frequently used searches for future use. ​ Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI) How to Run an Advanced Search-to-Shortlist Using Recruit CRM MCP

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM's advanced search feature lets you combine a powerful Boolean search with column-level filters. You can use this feature when: You want to narrow down large lists of candidates, contacts, companies, or jobs. You need to find records that match (or exclude) specific keywords, locations, or skills. You’re combining Boolean search with field-level filters for more precise results. You’re analysing activities (notes, calls, tasks, meetings) linked to your records. You want to quickly identify records with empty or filled-in fields. Open the Add Filters in Recruit CRM’s to access the full list of filter types you can apply to your search criteria.

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: Use the “ Is ” Filter for Exact Matches of a keyword. The Is filter looks for an exact match of a keyword. You can use it to find all the candidates who are located in a specific state or city, and it will exactly match the word you're searching for. Example, you can search for all the candidates located in Delhi using the Is filter. ​ Use the “ Is not ” Filter to Exclude Values . The Is not filter excludes records that do not fit a certain set of criteria. You might use the Is not filter to remove candidates who do not meet a particular requirement. For example, you could use the Is not filter to find any candidates who are not specified in a skill set. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: The Contains filter helps identify partial Keyword Matches. The Contains filter identifies records containing a specific keyword or criteria. For example, you could search for all candidates who have the word marketing in their resume using the Contains filter. ​ Use the “ Does not contain ” Filter to Omit Keywords. The Does not contain filter allows you to search for records that don't have a specific word or criteria. For example, you could search for contacts that don't have the title of manager. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: Use the “ Contains Exact Word ” Filter for Precise Word Matches. This filter looks for the exact word you enter, but allows it to appear anywhere within the field as a standalone word. Unlike the regular Contains filter, it will not return results where the keyword is part of a larger word. For example, if you search for “Shravya” using the Contains Exact Word filter, it will return results like “Shravya Verma” or “Shravya M”, but will exclude variations where the word is embedded within another term or formatted differently. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: Use the “ Contains at least one ” Filter for Multiple Keywords. Use this filter to find records that match at least one keyword from a list. For example, you could search for all candidates who have either marketing or accounting skills using the Contains at least one filter. ​ Use the “ Begins with ” Filter for Starting Text Begins with the specific keyword. The Begins with filter finds records starting with a keyword or a phrase. For example, you can search for all jobs that begin with the word product using the Begin with filter. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: Use the “ Ends with ” Filter for Ending Text Ends with a specific keyword. Use this filter to find records ending with a specific keyword. For example, you could search for all jobs that ends with the word manager using the Ends with filter. ​ Use the “ Has any value ” Filter for Non-Empty Fields that have any value. Use this filter to find records where the selected field is not empty. ​

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: Use the “ Is empty ” Filter and Apply Your Filters. You can use the Is empty filter to search for records that have the specific field selected as empty, and then click on Apply to save these changes and save the filter and use it. Now that you know everything about filter types, you should try to run a search. ​ Understand Record Fields vs Activity Fields Across all entities, filters are broadly divided into two main categories. One is record fields. These are core details of records like candidate, company, contact, or job.

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: And the second is activity fields such as notes, calls, tasks, and meetings. Each activity type can be further filtered using added on, updated on, added by, or updated by the type associated with, collaborated with, and if it exists or not. How is “Is” different from “Contains” in Advanced Search? The Is filter looks for an exact match of a keyword in the selected field, while Contains finds records where the keyword appears anywhere in that field, even as part of a longer phrase. Can I combine Boolean search with these filter types?

chunks.t: Filter types for Advanced Search (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. Recruit CRM's advanced search feature lets you combine a powerful Boolean search with column-level filters. You can run a Boolean query and then refine the results using filters like Is , Contains , Is empty , and more. Using the right filter types in Recruit CRM’s Advanced Search helps you quickly narrow down large datasets, find exactly the records you need, and spot gaps or patterns in your data. chunks.x: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM lets you compose an email now and schedule it to be sent automatically at a specific future date and time. Recruit CRM will deliver the email exactly as scheduled, even if you are offline. This feature allows you to plan and automate your communication, ensuring your emails are delivered exactly when you want them to be. Send emails to candidates or clients at a specific time. 1. Open the email composer from either the candidate/contact list view or the detailed profile view in Recruit CRM. You cannot bulk-select candidates/contacts and schedule emails. To send a scheduled email to multiple recipients, manually enter each email address in the To field.

chunks.t: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Please note that you can add up to 10 recipients per email at a time, and this feature is available on all plans. 2. Write your email as usual, then click the clock icon next to the Send button. This option is labelled Send Later and opens the scheduling window. 3. Select the date and time you want the email to be sent based on your time zone and hit the schedule button. When scheduling an email, you can select from which connected email you wish to send the email: Save your settings to schedule the email. Recruit CRM will automatically send the email at the selected time, even if you are offline. Note: 2 email connections are only available for users in the Business Plan.

chunks.t: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: It's worth noting that you need to select a date and time at least 15 minutes ahead of the current time. For example, if the current time is 1:43 PM, selecting 1:45 PM will not allow you to schedule the email. Make sure to set the time for 1:58 PM or later to ensure your email is properly scheduled. All emails you have scheduled will appear in your mailbox under the Scheduled Emails tab. Please note that you will only be able to see your own scheduled emails, not those of your team members. If a scheduled email fails to send, you can easily reschedule it from the "Scheduled Emails" section in your mailbox, ensuring your important messages still reach their intended recipients.

chunks.t: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Here are some important limits to keep in mind when scheduling emails: 1. Per Slot Limit: Each user can schedule up to 20 emails within any 5-minute slot. Note that if there are 3 recipients in an email, it will be counted as 3 separate emails, since our bulk email functionality sends individual emails to each recipient. 2. Daily Limit: Users can schedule up to 100 emails per day, based on the GMT zone over 24 hours. 3. Recipient Limit: You can add a maximum of 10 recipients per email. Problem: I can’t select the time I want; the system won’t let me schedule. Likely cause: The selected time is too close to the current time.

chunks.t: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: Confirm the time you’re choosing is at least 15 minutes ahead of the current time. Resolution path: Adjust the scheduled time to be 15 minutes or more in the future (for example, from 1:45 PM to 1:58 PM or later) and try scheduling again. Problem: My scheduled email did not send at the planned time. Likely cause: The send may have failed due to email provider issues or temporary connectivity problems. What to check: Go to your mailbox and open the Scheduled Emails tab to see the status of the email. Resolution path: If the email shows as failed, open it from the Scheduled Emails section and reschedule it for a new time.

chunks.t: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Can I schedule emails to multiple candidates at once using bulk select? No. You cannot bulk-select candidates or contacts to schedule a single email to all of them. You must manually enter each recipient’s email address in the To field, and you can add up to 10 recipients per scheduled email. What happens if I add multiple recipients to one scheduled email? Each recipient is counted as a separate email , because Recruit CRM’s bulk email functionality sends individual emails to each recipient. For example, one email with 3 recipients counts as 3 emails towards your per-slot and daily limits.

chunks.t: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Email Scheduling in Recruit CRM allows you to send candidate and client emails automatically at the time you choose. It helps you stay organized and maintain timely communication with less manual effort. By following the steps in this guide, you can easily schedule and manage your emails with confidence. Understanding bulk email limits in Recruit CRM Scheduling Meetings in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Exporting Data To Excel/CSV (New UI)
chunks.x: This feature allows you to export data from Recruit CRM into CSV or Excel files directly from list pages or reports, preserving your selected fields and filters for easy use outside the platform. Only the Account Owner, Admins, and users on the Custom Roles with access to export can export data. Users on the Team Member role and Restricted Team Member roles cannot use export. You can use the same export process for candidates, contacts, jobs, companies, and deals. Navigate to the list page of your desired entity. For example, go to the Candidates entity page. Select the number of records that you want to export. Click on the Export button from the top header bar under the More tab.

chunks.t: Exporting Data To Excel/CSV (New UI)
chunks.x: In the export pop-up, choose the fields that you want to have in the exported sheet. Hit the Export button to download the file (CSV or Excel, as available). The GIF illustrates how to export the selected records to CSV/Excel. When exporting Jobs, the "Updated By" column shows the user's full name (e.g., Ryan Cooper), just like other user-reference columns in the export. 2. Export all candidates from the list page (beyond 3,000 records): This will allow you to export all the candidate records in a section when exporting more than 3,000 candidates while still respecting any filters you have applied.

chunks.t: Exporting Data To Excel/CSV (New UI)
chunks.x: The 'Export All' option will be visible only when more than 3000 candidates are selected. For fewer than three thousand candidates, the normal export above will work. You can bulk select the candidates or only those from a filtered search. Click on the Export All button from the top header bar under the More tab. Choose the fields you want to have in the exported sheet and hit the Export button to download the file. The GIF below shows exactly how it works. Select the parameters, i.e., timeframe, teammates, etc, and generate the report. Once the report is generated, click on the Export Report to CSV button to download the tabular data of the report.

chunks.t: Exporting Data To Excel/CSV (New UI)
chunks.x: Additionally, each bar on the chart is also clickable and will direct you to the detailed list of data. You can also export this data by clicking the Export to CSV button located on the header bar. Problem: You can’t see the Export or Export All options. Likely cause: You do not have the required permission to export. What to check: Confirm whether you are the Account Owner or an Admin. Resolution path: Ask the Account Owner/Admin to either export the data for you or update your role/permissions. Problem: You can’t find the “Export All” option for candidates. Likely cause: You have fewer than 3,000 candidates selected.

chunks.t: Exporting Data To Excel/CSV (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: Check the total number of selected candidates on the candidate list page. Resolution path: If under 3,000, use the standard export from the list page. “Export All” appears only when more than 3,000 candidates are selected. Problem: Report export works, but the chart-level detail export does not show the expected records. Likely cause : You clicked a specific bar that only represents a subset of the data. What to check: Confirm which bar on the chart you have clicked and what filters are applied to that view. Resolution path: Adjust filters or select a different bar if you want a different subset of data, then export again.

chunks.t: Exporting Data To Excel/CSV (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Who can export data to CSV or Excel from Recruit CRM? Only the Account Owner, Admins, and users on custom roles can export data from list pages and reports. 2. Which entities can I export from the list page? You can export records from Candidates, Contacts, Jobs, Companies, and Deals. The method of exporting data for all entities is the same. Yes. The export option from the list page is available on all plans, including the free plan. 4. Does export respect filters and selections? Yes. Both standard exports and “Export All” for candidates respect any filters you have applied and the fields you select.

chunks.t: Exporting Data To Excel/CSV (New UI)
chunks.x: Exporting data to CSV or Excel from Recruit CRM helps you analyse, share, and back up your records across candidates, contacts, jobs, companies, deals, and reports. Exporting Data to Excel/CSV in Recruit CRM Bulk export files for candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: This is a Business Plan feature and for the Pro/Free plan, users will have access to create only 1 sequence. Only the account owners, admins, and users on custom roles with access to sequences can create a sequence. You can send a series of precisely timed email templates to candidates and contacts over a specified period. A sequence can contain up to 40 steps in total. You can use a single step type or mix email, SMS, task, and LinkedIn steps within the same sequence, as long as you do not exceed 10 steps per step type. The sequence will continue until the recipient responds to any of the emails sent. 1. Go to Admin Settings > CRM Process Customization > Sequences .

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. Select either "Candidates" or "Contacts" as the recipient of the sequence. 4. The next step is to name your sequence and select the task or email step that needs to be executed. You can choose to either select an existing email template or create a new one dedicated to the sequence. 5. Then, specify the number of days and the time when the sequence step should be executed. It is important to know exactly when an email will be sent in relation to the starting date of the sequence. To calculate this, you can use the following formula: Send Date = Start Date + Specified No. Of Days (Send Email In) Here, "Start Date" represents the date when the email sequence was initiated.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: "Specified Date" or "Send Email In" is the number of days you have indicated for the email to be sent after the start of the sequence. The resulting "Send date" is the calculated date on which the email will be sent. For example - If you start the email sequence on January 1st and specify that the email should be sent in 2 days, the Send Date would be calculated as follows: Send date= January 1st + 2 days =January 3rd. You can also set the " Send Email In " date as 0, establishing the beginning of your sequence in Day 0 . This way, the first email will be sent on the same day you enroll prospects into a sequence.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: In addition, we provide the option to execute email or task steps exclusively on business days. All you need to do is turn on this toggle : 6. When creating an email step, you'll have the option to include an unsubscribe/ opt-out link within each email. 7. Add steps to the sequence as required, up to a maximum of 40 steps , which includes a maximum of 10 email steps, 10 task steps , 10 LinkedIn steps and 10 SMS steps . You can easily rearrange the sequence steps by using the drag-and-drop functionality. 8. Set a specific number of days for each step to execute, with a range of 1 to 250 calendar days or business days.

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Tasks can be created on the same day as the sequence initiation by setting the day as "0". ​ When implementing a task on the 0th day, it's crucial to align the step timing with the previous steps or set it for a later time than the preceding step to ensure a seamless workflow. 9. Refer to this article to know more about how you can enrol and unenroll records from a sequence: The email signature used for sequences will match the one set in your system settings for regular emails. If you’ve created a signature on this page: Email Signature Settings , it will also appear in your sequence emails. Enrolling contacts into a sequence while Pitching the Candidates to the Contacts

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. You need to click on the 'Enroll Selected Contacts to Sequence' option while pitching the candidates to the contacts After successful completion of sending the email/marking the candidates as pitched, you will be automatically redirected to the page where you can enroll them into the sequence. What are the time slots/execution times of the sequences? Emails in a sequence are fired in 30-minute slots (e.g. 9:00 AM, 9:30 AM, etc.). Also, the email's timestamp is based on the timezone set in the user profile who initiated the enrolment . ​ Here's how a user can check their timezone: How many prospects can be enrolled in a sequence at a time?

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The limit on the number of prospects that can be enrolled in a sequence depends on the number of users in the account. Each user can enrol up to 500 prospects in a sequence at a time. Is there any limit on the number of candidates/contacts that a user can enroll in a sequence? A user can enrol up to 500 candidates/contacts in either 1 or across multiple sequences at any given point in time. Once a user reaches the maximum active + paused enrollments i.e. 500, they will not be able to enrol any further records until the active sequence(s) are completed or they manually unenroll some records. How many steps can you have in a particular sequence?

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Add steps to the sequence as required, up to a maximum of 40 steps , which includes a maximum of 10 email steps, 10 task steps , 10 LinkedIn steps and 10 SMS steps . You can easily rearrange the sequence steps by using the drag-and-drop functionality. What happens when a user edits a running sequence? If someone edits the sequence that is already running, then the changes will apply to only future enrollments. How many sequences can be created on an account? In total, you can add up to 1000 sequences to a business plan account. However, on the pro plan, you can test the feature with 1 sequence. When does a prospect get unenrolled from the sequence?

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Whenever someone replies to the email sequence , the sequence gets paused for that specific prospect and it gets unenrolled from the sequence. 2. If the candidate/contact chooses to opt out of the email they will get automatically unenrolled. 3. If you manually unenroll them from the sequence. Can we add a candidate/contact to multiple sequences? No, each candidate/contact can only be a part of a single sequence at a time. Is there a time gap between each email sent in a sequence? Yes, consecutive emails will experience a delay ranging from 3 to 5 seconds. This measure has been implemented to prevent email throttling. How to add an image and resize it on the signature?

chunks.t: Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: You can click on the 'Insert image' option under the 'Email Signature' section and add the image: You can even re-size it by clicking it and dragging it at the bottom right of the image:

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Adding candidates one at a time is painful. The Resume Parser in Recruit CRM automatically creates candidate profiles from uploaded resumes, making the process both efficient and accurate. The Resume Parser is designed with a user-friendly interface, making it seamless to add and manage candidate profiles. You need to upload and parse multiple resumes at once. You want to quickly create accurate candidate profiles from resumes. If you upload the resume in the Files section, then it will not be parsed. Go to the Candidates section in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Click on the Add Candidate button, then select the Resume Parser option from the dropdown to open the Resume Parsing window. ​ In the Resume Parser window, either drag and drop resumes into the upload box or click to select files from your computer. You will receive a notification once all resumes have been parsed. This may take a few minutes if you uploaded a large number of files. When duplicate candidates are detected during Global Resume Parsing, they are clearly marked with a “Duplicate” tag so you can easily identify them before proceeding.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Each duplicate candidate also includes an “Update Values” option, allowing you to review the existing candidate profile alongside the newly parsed resume information before applying any changes. In the comparison screen, fields where changes are detected are automatically selected by default. You can review these selections and choose which fields should or should not be updated before saving the changes. Empty fields, Work History, and Education History are not shown as separate highlighted changes during duplicate review, as they are updated automatically before the comparison screen opens.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If multiple duplicate candidates are found, you can navigate through them one by one using the duplicate counter. You can choose to skip a duplicate or update selected field values and move to the next duplicate. For the final duplicate candidate, the option changes to Override Selected Field Values . Perform Bulk Actions on Parsed Candidates: Once parsing is complete, review the list of newly added candidates. From this page, you can perform bulk actions such as: Compose an email, add a note, assign to owner, update the field assign to a job, and add the candidates to a hot list and more. You can also edit the candidate profile and assign them to a job directly from the page.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Use the Default Resume Field to Trigger Parsing : When creating or editing a candidate profile, you can upload a resume directly into the Default Resume field to trigger parsing for that specific candidate. You can also upload the resume in the default resume field to parse the resume. Re-parse Resumes & Choose Which Fields to Update You can replace a candidate's resume from the Candidate Details page using the default Resume field. When uploading a new resume, you can choose between: 1. Replace Resume: Replaces only the resume file without parsing it or updating the candidate's existing profile information.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 2. Replace and Re-parse Resume: Replaces the existing resume, parses the newly uploaded file, and displays a comparison screen with the Field Name , New Value , and Current Value side-by-side, allowing you to compare the extracted information with the candidate's existing profile and choose which fields to update. Note: Recruit CRM remembers your last selected option and automatically pre-selects it the next time you replace a resume for any candidate. Users can choose to re-parse a candidate's resume from either of the following locations: From the default Resume field on the candidate profile

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Once selected, the resume is parsed again, and the newly extracted information is compared with the candidate’s current profile details before any updates are applied. You can choose how the candidate information should be updated by selecting either the ' Update Empty Field Values' option or the ' Override Selected Field Values' option: When the ' Update Empty Field Values' option is selected, the system will only fill fields that are currently empty in the candidate profile, while keeping the existing information unchanged.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: When the ' Override Selected Field Values' option is selected, the system will replace the existing candidate information with the newly parsed values for the fields you select. This gives you more control over which existing details should be updated from the latest resume. Note: If a re-parsed resume contains no new information to update, the comparison screen displays a Save option along with the message: "No changes detected. Click Save to update the resume." so you can complete the process without updating any fields. Clicking Save replaces only the resume file; no candidate fields are updated. Bulk resume re-parsing and bulk candidate updates are currently not supported.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The comparison view currently supports only the default candidate fields available in the resume parser. Problem: Resumes are not being parsed after upload. Likely cause: The resumes were uploaded to the Files section instead of the Resume Parser or Default Resume field. What to check: Confirm whether the files were added through the Resume Parser button in the Add Candidate button in Candidates, or through the Default Resume field.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Resolution path: To upload and parse resumes into Recruit CRM, click on the Resume Parser button inside the Add Candidate button in Candidates. You can also upload the resume in the default resume field to parse the resume. If you upload the resume in the Files section, then it will not be parsed. Problem: Parsing is taking longer than expected. Likely cause: A large number of files were uploaded at once. What to check: Check how many resumes you uploaded in a single batch. Resolution path: This might take a few minutes if you have uploaded a large number of files. Wait for the notification once your resume has been parsed. You will receive a notification once your resume has been parsed.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: How many resumes can I parse at once with the Resume Parser? You can upload and parse up to 100 files at a time, making it ideal for high-volume recruitment needs. Can I parse a single resume while creating or editing a candidate? You can also upload the resume in the default Resume field to parse the resume. When creating or editing a candidate profile, you can upload a resume directly into the Default Resume field to trigger parsing for that specific candidate.

chunks.t: Resume parsing on Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The resume parser in Recruit CRM lets you build your candidate database in seconds by automatically creating candidate profiles from uploaded resumes. By using the Resume Parser button in Candidates or the Default Resume field, you can parse up to a hundred files at a time and then perform powerful bulk actions, so you can move from raw resumes to ready-to-use candidate profiles with just a few clicks.

chunks.t: Assigning Owners To Records (New UI)
chunks.x: Assigning owners to candidate records in Recruit CRM lets you specify which recruiter is responsible for each candidate. With the bulk update option, you can quickly assign or reassign multiple candidates at once, making it easier for recruiters to manage their records. This is especially useful when you want to: Organise candidate ownership across your team Open the Candidates page in Recruit CRM to view the full list of candidates. Select the checkboxes for all candidates you want to assign to an owner. Click on the More option to access additional bulk actions. From the More menu, select Update field to modify a field for all the selected candidates.

chunks.t: Assigning Owners To Records (New UI)
chunks.x: From the dropdown menu, select the Owner field to update the owner for all selected candidate records. Select or enter the name of the new owner you want to assign to the selected candidates, then click Submit to update the Owner field for all selected records. Change Record Owner from the Details Page Open the specific record (candidate, company, contact, or job) for which you want to change the owner. ​ On the record details page, hover over the owner’s name and click on the pencil icon beside it. From the dropdown, select the new owner to whom you want to transfer the record. Problem: You cannot see the option to update the Owner field.

chunks.t: Assigning Owners To Records (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: You may not have permission to bulk update records. What to check: Check your user role and permissions in Recruit CRM with your Account Owner. Resolution path: Ask the Account Owner to grant you access or perform the bulk update on your behalf. Problem: Not all the candidates you expected are updated. Likely cause: Some candidates were not selected before running the bulk update. What to check: Review the candidate selection and applied filters on the Candidates page. Resolution path: Re-select the missing candidates and run the bulk owner update again. What changes after I assign a new owner to candidates?

chunks.t: Assigning Owners To Records (New UI)
chunks.x: The selected candidates will appear under the new owner’s name, making it easier for that recruiter to manage and track their records. Assigning owners to candidate records in Recruit CRM helps keep responsibilities clear and ensures recruiters can focus on the right candidates. If you have any questions, you can message us anytime through the chat icon on the bottom right. Bulk emailing candidates/contacts (New UI)

chunks.t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on List page (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to customize and arrange the fields (for Candidates / Companies / Contacts / Jobs) in the List View in any way you want! Field visibility and column reordering let you control which fields appear as columns on list pages and in what order they appear from left to right. ​ You want to quickly see the most important information on your list pages. Use it when you want to organize your list view for better efficiency, focus on important fields, or reduce clutter by hiding unnecessary columns. 📋 Step-by-step instructions on how to customize the field arrangement

chunks.t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on List page (New UI)
chunks.x: Please note that only users with the appropriate permissions will be able to edit the column/field arrangement. Click here to learn more. 1. Go to the Candidates / Companies / Contacts / Jobs list page, depending on which records you want to customize. ​ 2. On the top-right of the list page, click on the Show/Hide Columns icon to open the column settings panel and view all fields that are available in your database. 3. Now tick the fields you want to make visible on the List page. The fields will be divided in 'Visible Columns' and 'Hidden Columns'. You can also quickly find the fields using the search bar. Click here to learn more about field visibility

chunks.t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on List page (New UI)
chunks.x: 4. You can rearrange the order of the fields by dragging the field up or down and by clicking on Apply. That's it. Your column order will reflect immediately! How to set up a default field arrangement for the entire account? If you are the Account Owner you can set up a default column arrangement on the Candidate/Contact/Company/Job's List Page for all users in the account. ​ While editing the visibility of the columns, you'll have the option to switch to "Others View". All changes you make in this view will apply to all the users in your account.

chunks.t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on List page (New UI)
chunks.x: If you wish to enforce the column arrangement and prevent the users from having a different setup, you can simply tick the checkbox. This will ensure that the account owner's column arrangement remains the same for all users in the account. Users with an Admin role or custom permissions will still be able to rearrange the column even if the toggle is on. ​ If you're creating/editing a custom role, you just need to make sure to enable the "Allow User to Choose their Own Field Order and Visibility" ​ You can also create custom fields from the Admin Settings for all entities (Candidate / Company / Contact / Jobs) and add them to the List View.

chunks.t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on List page (New UI)
chunks.x: Problem: I can’t change the column order or visibility. Likely cause: Your role doesn’t allow custom field order and visibility, or an enforced layout is applied. ​ What to check: Confirm your role and whether “Allow user to choose their own field order and visibility” is enabled. Check if the Account Owner has enforced a default layout. ​ Resolution path: Ask the Account Owner to adjust your role permissions or to make changes to the enforced layout if appropriate. Does changing my column visibility affect other users? No. Changes you make typically apply only to your own view unless you are the Account Owner editing the 'Others view' and enforcing a layout.

chunks.t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on List page (New UI)
chunks.x: By adjusting field visibility and column order on your list pages, you can create focused, efficient views that match your daily workflows. Use role-based permissions and enforced layouts where needed to balance flexibility with consistency across your team. Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on list page

chunks.t: How Radius-Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Radius search in Recruit CRM allows you to find candidates, contacts, companies, or jobs within the radius range you choose. The Radius Search feature in Recruit CRM is powered by Google Maps which works well if you have a candidate/contact's address available inside the "Full Address" field of candidate/contact. The Radius Search relies on accurate geocoding based on the "Full Address" field, which maps records to precise geographical locations. Shortlist local talent for specific roles Target companies or jobs within a travel radius How is location data used in radius search?

chunks.t: How Radius-Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Radius search works using a process called Geocoding . Geocoding converts location information into geographic coordinates. Recruit CRM uses these coordinates to calculate distance and return records that fall within the selected radius. ✅ How to enable radius search on your account? 1. Open Radius Search Settings in Admin Settings Only Account Owners , Admins , and users with custom permissions can enable radius search. Navigate to the Admin Settings in Recruit CRM and go to the Account section. Scroll down until you see the Radius Search settings. Enable the toggle for each record type where you want to perform radius searches.

chunks.t: How Radius-Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Simply adding a full address via CSV import does not automatically enable radius search. Radius search works only when the toggle is turned on for that specific record type, allowing the system to process the address via geocoding and convert it into usable coordinates that can be used for searches. 2. Ensure the Full Address Field Is Visible in the List View Open the relevant list (e.g., Candidates). Click the Show/Hide Column icon to manage visible columns. In the column selection panel, tick the Full Address field so it appears in your list.

chunks.t: How Radius-Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: In the Full Address field > Radius Search, start typing the location you want (e.g., “Central Park”). You will see suggestions as you type. Choose the desired radius (e.g., 10 km). You can also choose to add other filters along with the radius search. Click on Apply filters, and your results will be displayed on the same screen. Also, you can save this combination of filters if you happen to use this often, by clicking on "Apply Filters & Save Search". P.S. If you are importing a bunch of records in bulk and want to be able to run a radius search on them, please give us a heads-up, and we will help you with the process.

chunks.t: How Radius-Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: Problem: Radius search returns no results even though records have addresses. Likely cause: Radius search is not enabled for that record type. What to check: In Admin Settings > Account > Radius Search, confirm the toggle is switched on for the relevant entity (Candidates, Contacts, Companies, Jobs). Resolution path: Turn on the toggle for the required record type and allow the system to process the addresses via geocoding before re-running the search. Problem: Some records are missing from the radius search results. Likely cause: The Full Address field is empty or incomplete for those records.

chunks.t: How Radius-Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: Verify the Full Address field is filled and correctly formatted for the missing records. Resolution path: Update or correct the Full Address values, save the records, and run the radius search again. Radius search in Recruit CRM helps you quickly find records within a set distance using Full Address data. Once enabled and configured, you can run precise location-based searches and save them for reuse. How to Run a Search in Recruit CRM (New UI) How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI)

chunks.t: Emailing Candidates & Contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM lets you send and track emails to candidates and contacts directly from the platform. You can send individual or bulk emails, use email templates and AI-generated drafts, attach files, and it automatically links each email to the relevant candidate, contact, company, and job records available in the database. chunks.t: Obtaining consent for texting prospects (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature ensures that you obtain and manage a prospect’s consent before sending them SMS from within Recruit CRM. It helps you stay compliant with messaging regulations. You can obtain consent from your candidates/contacts for texting and allow them to opt out whenever they request it. Use this feature whenever you want to send SMS/text messages to prospects. You can send SMS to candidates/contacts without requiring them to opt-in and can directly ask for opt-in through messages. You can also check on the details page if they have not given consent, under the 'SMS' tab:

chunks.t: Obtaining consent for texting prospects (New UI)
chunks.x: It is necessary for you to include additional information on how to opt out of receiving SMS messages. The initial message that you send to take consent needs to include the following OPT IN and OPT OUT keywords: OPT-IN keywords: 'START' or 'YES' or 'SUBSCRIBE', or 'JOIN'. OPT-OUT keywords: 'STOP' or 'STOPALL' or 'UNSUBSCRIBE' or 'CANCEL' or 'END' or 'QUIT'. Once the text receiver replies with STOP or similar opt-out messages, Twilio blocks them from their end: You can also see a message on the details page indicating whether they’ve opted out of messages or emails:

chunks.t: Obtaining consent for texting prospects (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM also lets you obtain texting consent from prospects from different sections, including the Job application form, Talent pool page, and Profile update request form. There is an optional checkbox where candidates can subscribe to receive SMS updates about specific job opportunities. If the candidates have already given their consent, it simply updates on the candidate details page. This is how the consent checkbox appears at the bottom of external pages: If SMS consent has already been obtained outside Recruit CRM, you can record the existing consent directly in Recruit CRM instead of requesting consent again.

chunks.t: Obtaining consent for texting prospects (New UI)
chunks.x: Open the SMS consent popup for the relevant candidate or contact by clicking on their contact number and selecting the Send Text Message button. Review the warning popup confirming that valid consent must have already been obtained from the prospect. ​ Confirm the consent to proceed with sending SMS. Recruit CRM does not verify consent recorded manually. You are responsible for ensuring that the consent is valid, properly documented, and compliant with applicable TCPA and carrier requirements . The Record SMS Consent Manually option is not available for records that are already opted in or have explicitly opted out. This option is available only when the account's texting region is the US .

chunks.t: Obtaining consent for texting prospects (New UI)
chunks.x: 🧐 Enabling consent through external pages ​1. Go to Admin Settings > Job Application Form Settings / Talent Pool Page Settings / Profile Update Form Settings 2. Scroll down to locate: " Customize Button & Link Labels" , and look for the label "I'd like to receive SMS notifications about jobs at the provided phone number," which you can edit and choose to activate or hide. On the Job Application Form Settings , you can also edit the SMS Terms that your applicants can read before offering their consent. How do I know if a candidate has opted out of SMS? Open the candidate/contact record and you will be able to see a message if they have opted out of SMS.

chunks.t: Obtaining consent for texting prospects (New UI)
chunks.x: What happens if a candidate replies STOP to my message? When a candidate replies with STOP or similar keywords (STOPALL, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END, QUIT), Twilio automatically blocks further SMS messages to that number from their end. The candidate’s record in Recruit CRM will show that they have opted out. Obtaining and tracking SMS consent in Recruit CRM helps you communicate with candidates and contacts in a compliant, transparent way. While Recruit CRM allows you to send an email shot to 500 candidates/contacts at a time, it is important to understand that most email service providers (like Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, etc.) impose certain restrictions on the number or volume of emails that can be sent in a single batch AND/OR within a day .

chunks.t: Bulk emailing candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: It's advisable to keep your email batches relatively small, typically no more than 30 to 50 emails at a time, based on the restrictions set by your email service providers. After sending each batch, we recommend waiting for a 20 to 30-minute interval before dispatching the next set of emails. This strategy can lower the risk of your email account being flagged by your service provider, thus reducing the chances of these emails landing in the spam folder of your candidates or contacts. Bulk emailing in Recruit CRM helps you communicate quickly with multiple candidates and contacts while keeping each message personalized.

Click here to learn more about how to enable field visibility and rearrangement on the lists Last Call Log Added: Displays the timestamp of the last call log added for a candidate or contact. chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts (New UI)

Last Meeting Added (only for candidates, contacts, and companies) : Captures the time stamp when the meeting was added. Last LinkedIn Message Sent On : Tracks the LinkedIn Messages sent using the LinkedIn Integration feature. ​ Last Note Added On: Tracks the timestamp of the most recently added note for the specific entity. If no note exists, the field will display Not Available .

chunks.t: How to track the latest communications with candidates and contacts (New UI)

chunks.t: Managing Your Sequence (New UI)
chunks.x: This is a Business Plan feature and in the Pro/Free plan, users will have access to create only 1 sequence. Only the account owners, admins, and users on custom roles with access to sequencing can create a sequence. Enrolling Candidates/Contacts in a Sequence To enroll candidates and contacts in a sequence, follow the steps mentioned below: 1. Open the candidates / contacts list page and select the candidates/contacts to enroll in a sequence. You can also enroll records in a sequence from the jobs page . This will enroll all the primary contacts for that job in the selected sequence.

chunks.t: Managing Your Sequence (New UI)
chunks.x: 2. After selecting the candidates/contacts, a pop-up box will appear displaying a list of the enrolled candidates/contacts, except those records which: Are already enrolled in another sequence; 3. After clicking 'Continue', you will be taken to a page where your email templates will be displayed by default. Additionally, you will have the option to select templates belonging to other users as well. 4. While selecting a sequence, you can now see the number of Active Enrollments for each sequence. This helps you understand the current enrollment count across sequences.

chunks.t: Managing Your Sequence (New UI)
chunks.x: 5. After selecting a sequence, you'll have access to all its constituent steps. You can edit the sequence by clicking on the pencil icon to your right. ​ 6. By clicking on each step, you can modify the number of days or preferred execution time to suit your needs. While enrolling records in the sequence, you'll be able to see a preview of the placeholders used in each step. The placeholders will be highlighted in yellow in the preview, but not in the email sent in the sequence. If you're enrolling multiple records in the sequence, the placeholders will reflect the information of the first person enrolled.

chunks.t: Managing Your Sequence (New UI)
chunks.x: 7. If you have two email IDs connected, you can choose from which email the sequence will be sent: ​ Click to learn how to connect 2 emails at the same time 8. If you want to execute the first stage of the sequence today, then click on the " Send Today " button and the rest of the steps will be rolled out accordingly. 9. You can also make changes to the step's body, and subject line, add attachments, and customize the sequence according to each enrollment. The customization is limited to steps that haven't been executed yet.

chunks.t: Managing Your Sequence (New UI)
chunks.x: 10. You can choose the starting point of your sequence. For example, if you want to start from step 2, simply select it from the ' Start At ' dropdown and your sequence will skip step 1 and start from step 2. 11. You can check the enrollment status of the enrolled candidates/contacts on their detailed pages, which will display an info bar indicating if they are enrolled in a particular sequence. 12. If someone edits a sequence that is already running, then the changes will be applicable only to future enrollments. 13. Whenever someone replies to the email sequence the sequence gets paused and the candidate/contact gets unenrolled from the sequence.

chunks.t: Managing Your Sequence (New UI)
chunks.x: 14. Moreover, you also have the flexibility to enrol the candidates/contacts directly from the sequence section. chunks.t: Bulk export files for candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: You can export files for up to 1,000 candidates at a time. If you attempt to export files for more than a thousand records, only the first thousand candidates' files will be processed. Problem: The export email has not arrived. Likely cause: Processing is still ongoing, or the email is filtered. What to check: Check the in-app notification center to see if the export is completed. Check your spam/junk folder for emails from support@recruitcrm.io . Resolution path: Wait a few more minutes for large exports. Whitelist support@recruitcrm.io in your email system if needed and retry the export. Problem: Not all selected candidates’ files are included in the export.

chunks.t: Bulk export files for candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: More than 1,000 candidates were selected. What to check: check how many candidate records were selected on the Candidate List. Resolution path: Re-run the export with a maximum of 1,000 candidates at a time. If needed, split your selection into multiple exports. Problem: The download link in the email no longer works. What to check: Confirm whether it has been more than three days since you received the email. Resolution path: Repeat the bulk export from the Candidate List to generate a new file and a fresh link. Q1. Can I export files for more than 1,000 candidates at once?

chunks.t: Bulk export files for candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: No. You can export up to 1,000 candidate files at a time. If you select more than 1,000 records, only the first 1,000 candidates’ files will be processed. Run multiple exports if you need more. The process may take a few minutes, depending on the file size and number of candidates. You will receive both an in-app notification and an email from support@recruitcrm.io when the export is ready. Bulk exporting candidate files lets you quickly download resumes, job-associated documents, custom field files, or all files for up to 1,000 candidates at once.

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Assigning candidates to jobs lets you assign people to specific open roles directly from the candidate list page, candidate profile page, job profile page, or while creating a new candidate. You can use this when: You want to assign one or more candidates to open jobs. You need to email primary job contacts at the same time as assigning candidates. You’re viewing a job profile and need to assign existing or new candidates. You’re parsing resumes or using the Chrome extension and want to assign candidates immediately. Ensure job records have primary contacts with valid email addresses if you plan to email them. Have your candidate resumes and attachments ready if you plan to share files.

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Assign a candidate from the candidate list page: From the candidate list page, select the candidate(s) you want to assign by clicking the checkbox beside each candidate’s name. At the top of the list, you will see new action options appear, including the option to assign the selected candidates to a job. Use the assignment options to either create a new job or select one of the existing jobs in your database. During this process, you can also choose to immediately update the hiring stage of the candidate for the selected job. If the candidate is already assigned to that specific job, the system will alert you with a pop‑up so you do not create duplicate assignments.

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Emailing the contacts of the selected jobs While assigning candidates to jobs from the candidate list, you can choose to directly email the primary contacts of the selected jobs. This allows you to assign candidates and share their details with job contacts in a single workflow. In the job assignment window, click the Email Contacts button at the bottom. Then complete the assignment by clicking Assign or Assign and Update Stage , as required. If you have selected candidates who are already assigned to the job, the system will skip reassigning them, but they will still be included in the email that is sent to job contacts.

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: A pop‑up will appear where you can select which candidate fields and files to share (for example, resume, summary, or other attachments). Once you have made your selections, click Generate Email . If any of the selected job contacts are missing an email address, a validation box will appear listing those records. You can review the highlighted records in the validation box and then click Continue to proceed with the valid contacts only. After continuing, you will be redirected to the Compose Email screen. Here, the email will be pre‑filled with: Recipients (only primary contacts linked to the selected jobs) The candidate details and files you selected

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Review the email content and simply click Send to share the candidates with the selected job contacts. Only the first 20 candidates (based on the last updated date) will be included in the email. Only primary contacts linked to the selected jobs will receive the email. 2. Assign a candidate from the candidate profile To assign a candidate from the candidate profile/details page, scroll down to the candidate’s job section and click the Assigned Jobs tab. There, you will be able to see all the jobs the candidate is currently assigned to and assign them to a new job by clicking on Assign to Jobs .

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Jobs that the candidate is already assigned to will be pre-selected and will not be selectable again, and you will have the option to view unassigned jobs for easier selection. From inside a job profile, use the Assign Candidates option to add existing candidates to that job. If a candidate does not yet exist in your database, you can parse their resume and assign them to the job as part of the same flow. You can also assign candidates directly from the Job Kanban view. On the job card, click the three-dot menu and select Assign Candidates to add candidates to that specific job. The assignment can also be performed via the Chrome extension.

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: After saving a new candidate, click on the 'Assign to Job' option on the Chrome Extension, and you will have the option to assign the candidate to the job: If a candidate exists in your database, click on the 'Assign to Job' option as shown below, and you will have the option to assign the candidate to the required job: Click here to learn more about Chrome Extension You can also assign the candidate to a job using our Resume Parser Feature. Click on the 'Assign to Job' option as shown below: Click here to learn more about the Resume Parser How many candidates can be included in the email to the job contacts?

chunks.t: How to Assign Candidates to Jobs in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Only the first twenty candidates, sorted by last updated date, will be included in the email sent to job contacts, even if you assign more than twenty in the same action. Which contacts receive the email when I use Email Contacts? Only primary contacts linked to the selected jobs will receive the email. Other contacts on the job who are not marked as primary will not be included. Assigning candidates to jobs helps you keep pipelines accurate, share profiles with job contacts, and streamline your recruiting workflow from multiple entry points. chunks.t: Integrating Wedge HR with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: WedgeHR is a one-way video assessment tool that streamlines your hiring process. With WedgeHR, you can effortlessly send video assessment invites to candidates, allowing them to record their responses one by one to your pre-set questions. Once submitted, you can seamlessly review their responses via email, Recruit CRM, or directly within WedgeHR. You need to have an active Wedge HR subscription for this. This integration is available on all the plans of Recruit CRM (Pro, Business and Enterprise). You can install the Wedge extension from the Chrome Webstore and pin it to your browser. Once done, you need to connect your WegdeHR account to the extension.

chunks.t: Integrating Wedge HR with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 2. Set interview questions for different job roles: Please note : You need to select/add the questions on the WedgeHR platform. Click here to know more about creating an interview/job role Click here to know more about creating custom questions 📧 How to send the invites to the candidates from Recruit CRM? 1. Click on the 'Send Invite' button on the candidate profile. 2. Select the interview (job role) that you have created on Wedge HR and click on the 'Send Invite' button. You can even send reminder emails about the assessment by clicking on the 'Send Reminder' button. 👀 How to check the responses of the candidates?

You can also view the responses on your email that you'll receive once the candidate submits their responses and you can check them on the WegdeHR as well.
