chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Currently, this feature is in beta and can be enabled upon request. Please feel free to reach out to your Account Manager to have it enabled for your account. What this feature does and when to use it? The Timesheets feature in Recruit CRM helps you track and manage work hours for candidates working in contract or temporary roles. It enables you to record hours worked, submit timesheets for approval, and automatically calculate payable and billable amounts based on the pay rates, bill rates, and rule templates configured for the job. This provides a structured workflow for agencies, clients, approvers, and candidates while keeping all timesheet-related activities in one place.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Once timesheets are enabled for a job, you can create and manage timesheets, monitor their progress through the approval workflow, and calculate payments based on approved hours. • You need to track candidate work hours for contract or temporary placements. • You want to automatically calculate payable and billable amounts using predefined rates and rule templates. • You require a structured approval workflow for timesheets (Open → Submitted → Approved/Rejected). • You want candidates, approvers, and agency users to collaborate on timesheets through their respective portals.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: • You need flexible time logging with support for unpaid breaks , multiple work segments, shifts, and configurable timesheet periods. Timesheets are automatically created based on the job duration, the configured timesheet frequency (such as weekly), and the selected week start day. Throughout the process, Recruit CRM keeps candidates, approvers, and agency users informed with email and in-app notifications, ensuring everyone stays updated on the status of each timesheet. Enable and access timesheets for a candidate After enabling timesheets, you can add new timesheets, track them, and manage approvals for the specific job they’re working on.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Once you enable Timesheets for a candidate, you’ll see a green button under the Candidate Pipeline of the Job where the candidate is assigned. When you click this button, you’ll be able to view the timesheet details for that candidate in one place. This makes it easy to track and manage the timesheet-related details for each candidate. How Timesheet Periods Work in Recruit CRM When you enable timesheets for a candidate, the system automatically splits the job duration into timesheet periods based on the Timesheet Frequency and the Start of the Week you’ve configured (e.g., Weekly starting on Monday). Example 1: Job Starts on the Week Start Day In this case, the timesheet periods will be:

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Jan 8 – Jan 12 (Partial week, starting from job start date) Jan 13 – Jan 19 (Full week, aligned with week start) Note: Only 12 timesheet periods will be visible at a time. New periods will appear automatically as you continue adding timesheets. Each timesheet goes through the following statuses: Open : The timesheet is created but no hours have been added yet. Submitted : The candidate has filled in their working hours and submitted the timesheet for approval. Approved :The approver has verified and approved the timesheet. Rejected : The timesheet was not approved and needs correction.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Click "Add Timesheet", then select the date ranges you want to add. Then click "Add". This will create timesheet rows for the selected dates, and their status will be set to Open. Timesheets are created based on the hour logging method defined in the Rule Template selected when enabling timesheets for the candidate. Click here to know more about how to enable timesheets You can enter working hours for each day. You can also add multiple start and end time entries within a single day, allowing hours to be logged across separate time segments. This is supported in both single and bulk time entry workflows, and the system automatically calculates the total hours for all entries combined.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: You can enter break time directly by typing the break duration in hours or minutes (for example, 1 hour or 30 mins ). ​ You can also add multiple breaks within each time entry. Any break added is automatically deducted from the logged working hours , and the existing calculation and validation logic is applied automatically. ​ Breaks must be added as separate time slots within your shift. ​ For example, if your working hours are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM and you took a break from 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM , add a break slot: The system automatically treats this as a break and deducts the break duration from the total working hours . You can add multiple break slots if needed. ​

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: 📌 Note: Any break added to a timesheet is always deducted from the logged working hours and is not included in pay or bill calculations. You can copy the work hours and break hours for all days. After submission, the system automatically calculates billable and payable amounts based on the rule template and the set bill/pay rate. ​ When the Round time entries option is enabled, the time entry is automatically updated according to the selected rounding interval and rounding method as soon as the time is entered. If the contractor's Rate Type is set to Per Day, you'll log attendance instead of hours. For each working day defined in the Work Schedule, select one of:

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Full Day — applies 1x the daily Pay and Bill Rate Half Day — applies 0.5x the daily Pay and Bill Rate No Show — applies 0x the daily Pay and Bill Rate The total number of days for the timesheet is calculated from these entries. For example, 4 Full Days and 1 Half Day totals 4.5 days. You can also add Remarks for each row if there’s anything specific you want to note. Remarks can be marked as mandatory while enabling timesheets for a contractor. If enabled, remarks will be required for every time entry across the agency, contractor, and client portals, and this setting will apply to both existing and newly created timesheets. Once you’ve entered all the details, click Submit .

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: The timesheet status will change to Submitted , and it will be sent to the assigned Approver for review. If you are the timesheet Approver, you can submit and approve simultaneously. A timesheet with zero logged hours can be submitted . Entries with no logged time will display “ No hours logged .” Zero-hour timesheets will also show an indicator next to their status. Hover over the indicator to see the tooltip “ No hours logged in this timesheet. ” ​

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Zero-hour timesheets will not appear on the Approvers’ Review Timesheets page and will not trigger automatic submission notifications to approvers. They will continue to be available in All Timesheets, Contractor Portal, Agency Portal, Client Portal, Contractor Details, and Deals, and in Reports when approved. Agency and client users can still manually approve zero-hour timesheets when required. If a Custom Reminder is manually sent, approvers will receive the reminder and can review the timesheet. ​ If a timesheet that previously had logged hours is resubmitted with zero hours, it will be removed from the approvers’ review queue.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Click here to know more about how to bulk add time to the timesheets If you are the Approver , click on the timesheet period to open it and review the hours. If the details are correct, click Approve . If corrections are needed, you can either Edit the hours and then approve. You can also Reject it with a remark, if it needs further correction. Once a timesheet is Approved , it cannot be edited. Timesheets in Open , Submitted , or Rejected status can still be edited and submitted. For approved/rejected timesheets, the system automatically calculates billable and payable amounts based on the rule template and the set bill/pay rate.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: You can click the Remarks button next to the timesheet status to view the history of changes. To delete a single timesheet, you can click on the trash icon to the right of it: To delete them in bulk , select multiple timesheets and click the Delete button above. Once a timesheet is marked as Approved, it cannot be deleted. Which roles and permissions are required to access timesheets? Timesheet permissions are determined by the permissions of both the candidate and the job. Account Owners, Admins and users on the custom roles with the following permissions have access to timesheets: - No → Cannot edit timesheet settings, add time, submit, approve, or bulk update

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: - No → Cannot view contractor details page or timesheets - Yes → Can view contractor details page and timesheets - Yes → Can edit timesheet settings and pay/bill rates - No → Cannot view contractor details page If you would like to learn more about this feature, you can book a quick call with our team through this link . Recruit CRM automatically keeps contractors, approvers, and agency users informed throughout the timesheet process using email and in-app notifications. Click here to learn about Timesheet Notifications and Reminders Problem: Timesheet option or green button not visible for a candidate

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Likely cause: Timesheets are not enabled for your account or not enabled for that specific candidate and job; or you lack view permissions. Confirm with your main account manager that the beta timesheets feature is enabled for your account. Check that timesheets have been enabled for the candidate on the specific job. Verify that your role has Can view permissions for both candidates and jobs. Ask your main account manager or admin to enable timesheets and adjust your role permissions if required. Once enabled, refresh the job’s candidate pipeline to see the green timesheet button. Likely cause: The timesheet is empty or required fields (such as mandatory remarks) are missing.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Make sure you have added working hours for at least one day in the period. If remarks are configured as mandatory, verify that each time entry has a remark. Enter hours and any required breaks, add all mandatory remarks, then try submitting again. If the submit button remains disabled, check the hour logging method rules in the associated rule template with an admin. Problem: Cannot edit or delete a timesheet Likely cause: The timesheet is in Approved status or your role lacks edit/delete permissions. Confirm the timesheet status (Open, Submitted, Approved, Rejected). Check if your role has Can edit and Can delete permissions for candidates and jobs.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: If the timesheet is Approved, it cannot be edited or deleted by design. If permissions are missing, contact an Account Owner or Admin to update your role or perform the required action. What happens if you change timesheet settings after timesheets are created? If you change the Pay Rate, Bill Rate, or Rule Template after timesheets have already been generated, the updates will only apply to timesheets created going forward . Existing timesheets will not be affected.For any timesheets already in Open , Submitted , or Rejected status, the system will continue to use the rules and rates that were in place at the time those timesheets were created.

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: If you want these timesheets to use the updated rules or rates, you must: Save the updated rules or rates in the template. Why didn't a contractor receive an automated email? Contractor Portal does not exist (they haven’t been Invited/ No sign Up) Contractor has been unassigned from the job Why can't I send a reminder for an approved timesheet? Approved timesheets are not eligible for reminder emails, since Timesheet Lifecycle is considered Complete upon Approval. What happens when I click a notification or email link?

chunks.t: How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta)
chunks.x: Depending on your Portal, you will be redirected to the relevant timesheet, approval page, or portal page associated with the notification, where you can perform the necessary Action. Timesheets in Recruit CRM give you a structured, configurable way to track contractor hours, manage approvals, and calculate billing and pay in one place. Once enabled and correctly permissioned, you can confidently use timesheets to streamline your contract and temp workflows while maintaining clear audit trails and accurate financial calculations. How to Enable Timesheets for Contract Staffing Jobs in Recruit CRM (Beta) Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)

chunks.t: Adding a Tracking Pixel to Recruit Craft Using Google Tag Manager (GTM)
chunks.x: A tracking pixel is a tiny image or code snippet that is placed on a webpage or email to collect information about user behavior. It can help you track actions such as page visits, clicks, form submissions, and conversions. This data is useful for improving your campaigns and understanding your audience better. Google Tag Manager (GTM) is a tool from Google that allows you to manage and deploy marketing and analytics tags on your website without needing to edit the site’s code each time. With GTM, you can add tracking pixels, analytics codes, and other scripts all in one place, making it easier to keep track of them and update them when needed. ⛓️Embedding the GTM code with Recruit Craft

chunks.t: Adding a Tracking Pixel to Recruit Craft Using Google Tag Manager (GTM)

After filling in the required details like website name and identifiers, you’ll find the GTM code displayed on your dashboard. Copy this code. 2. Now go to Recruit Craft , click on your profile picture at the top right corner and go to Settings . 3. From the settings menu on the left, select Google Tag Manager . 4. Paste the GTM code you copied earlier into the given field.

chunks.t: Getting started with Recruit Craft

Let’s walk you through how to sign up and get started! 1. When you land on the homepage of Recruit Craft , click on the “Get Started Free” button if you’re signing up for the first time and want to try it out on our Free Trial account. If you already have an account, just hit Sign In. You can also sign up from the login page, just find the “Sign Up” option right there at the bottom.

chunks.t: Getting started with Recruit Craft

Open it and click on the verification button inside. That’s it! Your email gets verified, and you’ll be automatically logged into your new account. 🔗 Connecting Recruit Craft to your Recruit CRM account

chunks.t: How to View Placeholder Values While Sending Emails
chunks.x: The email placeholder preview feature helps you preview emails with real placeholder values filled in before you send them. In preview mode, placeholders are highlighted in yellow and show actual values from the selected record so you can check formatting, spot missing data, and confirm the final content for both individual and bulk emails. This works seamlessly for both plain text and HTML emails, so what you see in the preview is exactly what your recipients will receive. You are sending personalized one-to-one emails/bulk emails to candidates or contacts and want to confirm how placeholders (like first name) will appear.

chunks.t: How to View Placeholder Values While Sending Emails
chunks.x: This feature will be available for new rich text editor (powered by Syncfusion ), which is currently in the testing phase and will be available to all users soon. Previewing emails inside a candidate or contact profile 1. Open a candidate or contact profile and click on the Email . 2. Draft your email and add placeholders where needed (e.g., {{First Name}} ​ Click the Preview button in the email editor toolbar to open your email in preview mode. ​ 3. Placeholders will appear in yellow with actual values from the profile, any missing values in the record will show up as blank, and once you’re satisfied with how everything looks, simply close the preview and click Send . ​

chunks.t: How to View Placeholder Values While Sending Emails
chunks.x: Previewing placeholders when sending bulk emails 1. Navigate to the candidate list page or contact list page, depending on who you want to email. 2. Choose the candidate or contact records you want to include in the bulk email. 3. Click the Email button to open the bulk email editor. 4. Compose your email and insert placeholders as you normally would. 5. Click Preview in the editor toolbar to open the email preview. 6. The preview shows how the email will appear for the first recipient in your selected list, with placeholders filled with that recipient’s actual data.

chunks.t: How to View Placeholder Values While Sending Emails
chunks.x: 7. Confirm that all placeholders are displaying correctly. Once you are satisfied with the preview, close it and click Send in the bulk email editor to send the email to all selected recipients. Problem: Placeholders appear blank in preview Likely cause: The corresponding fields are empty in the candidate or contact records. What to check: Open the candidate or contact profile and verify that the fields used in your placeholders (for example, first name) contain data. Resolution: Update the missing data in the record or remove/replace the placeholder in your email content before sending. Is the placeholder preview available in all editors in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: How to View Placeholder Values While Sending Emails
chunks.x: The preview feature is available in the new Rich Text Editor powered by Syncfusion, which is currently in testing and will be rolled out to all users. It may not appear in older editors. By previewing placeholder values before sending an email, you can verify that personalization fields are pulling the correct information and avoid sending emails with missing or incorrect data. This all-inclusive subscription bundles all current and future integrations, enhanced quotas into a single plan, streamlining billing, procurement, and feature access. Whether you're looking to boost automation, scale outreach, or unlock advanced analytics, the Enterprise plan gives you everything, without the extra complexity.

chunks.t: Enterprise Plan

Note: If you would like to start using Advanced Analytics, please feel free to reach out to your Account Manager, who will be happy to assist you. Enterprise plan feature quotas (per user/month): Calling Credits: Region-specific credits are allotted per user. RecruitCraft Jobs: Unlimited (if connected) 30,000 records per entity per user (candidates, contacts, companies) Unlimited Advanced Analytics & LinkedIn Messaging

chunks.t: Enterprise Plan
chunks.x: What does 'Unlimited' mean on the Enterprise plan for AI Sourcing? The Enterprise plan includes unlimited candidate searches, meaning there is no fixed monthly quota. You can run searches freely based on your hiring needs. To ensure consistent platform performance for all users, we apply a soft Fair Usage limit of 2,500 searches per user per month. This limit is designed to prevent misuse (such as automated scripts or bulk extraction) and does not impact normal recruiting activities. Note: Even though credits are provided per user, they are pooled at the account level meaning all users will be able to use all credits form the combined pool.

chunks.t: Enterprise Plan
chunks.x: Seamless Upgrade Experience: You can upgrade to Enterprise plan from Pro plan or Business plan with prorated billing and optional migration of existing add-ons. The Enterprise plan credits refresh monthly. You can also purchase additional credits if you have a higher usage (except Workflow Automation). Additional Calling Credits will not refresh monthly. Scalable with Your Team: You can add users anytime and quotas auto-scale. You can deactivate users and quotas adjust at the next renewal cycle. 1. Click on Admin Settings > Plans & Billing > Plans 2. Select 'Enterprise Plan' and review your order & proceed to checkout to make the payment. Can I still purchase additional credits separately?

It is not directly possible to purchase additional tasks for Workflow Automation on the Enterprise plan. This is a limitation from workato but if you need additional tasks you can reach out to us through the chat bot at the bottom right corner of your screen and we can add additional credit to an account from the backend. chunks.t: Enterprise Plan

The Enterprise plan gives your team access to Recruit CRM’s full feature set, enhanced quotas, and flexible credit management in one subscription.

chunks.t: How to change the default calling app on Windows and Android?
chunks.x: Setting the default calling app helps users who want to call candidates/contacts from within Recruit CRM using the native caller option to automatically call in a preferred calling application. The default calling app allows you to choose which application handles calls by default, such as Skype, Zoom, Microsoft Teams. Once configured in your device settings, clicking on the Open Native Caller beside the phone number to automatically start the call. • Want phone numbers in Recruit CRM to open in a specific calling app automatically. • Frequently use tools like Skype, Zoom, or Teams for calling.

chunks.t: How to change the default calling app on Windows and Android?
chunks.x: You must have your preferred calling app (e.g., Skype, Zoom, Teams, or another dialer) installed on your device. You need access to your device’s system settings (Windows or Android). Changes are device-specific, so you’ll need to repeat the setup on each computer or phone you use. Make sure your browser is allowed to open external applications when prompted. Change the default calling app on Windows: 1. On your Windows computer, open the Start menu and type “Default apps” into the search bar. 2. From the search results, click  Default apps by link type at the bottom. 3. In the Choose default apps by link type window, scroll down until you find the TEL link type.

chunks.t: How to change the default calling app on Windows and Android?
chunks.x: 4. Click on TEL , then select your preferred calling app from the list of installed apps. Compatible options include Skype, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and any other app installed on your computer that supports phone links. ​ Your selection takes effect immediately. The next time you click Open Native Caller in Recruit CRM it will open directly in the app you selected. Change the Default Calling App on Android: 1.Open the Settings app on your Android device. 2.Tap Apps and notifications (this may also appear as Apps depending on your device and Android version), then tap Default apps . 3. Under Default apps , locate and tap Phone app .

chunks.t: How to change the default calling app on Windows and Android?
chunks.x: 4. From the list of available apps, select the calling app you want to use by default for all phone calls on this device. Can I use different calling apps on different devices? Yes. Defaults are device-specific. You can use one app as default on your Windows computer and another on your Android phone. Will changing the default calling app affect existing data in Recruit CRM? No. Changing the default calling app does not change or delete any candidate, client, or activity data. Can I switch back to the previous calling app later? Yes. You can repeat the same steps on Windows or Android and select a different app (including the original dialer) at any time.

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Bulk Add Time feature makes it easy to add, edit, submit, and approve time entries across multiple timesheets at once, eliminating the need to update each timesheet individually. It helps streamline timesheet management by allowing you to update work hours, break hours, and remarks in bulk, then submit or approve multiple timesheets in a single action. This feature is available from both the Contractor Details page, where you can manage timesheets for an individual contractor, and the Timesheets tab under a Deal , where you can manage timesheets for multiple contractors simultaneously.

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: You need to add or edit work hours, break hours, or remarks across multiple timesheets. You want to copy the same time entries or remarks across multiple working days using Copy to All or Copy to This Period . You need to submit several completed timesheets in a single action. You are the designated approver and want to approve multiple submitted timesheets at once. You want to manage timesheets for a single contractor or multiple contractors more efficiently without opening each timesheet individually. Currently, this feature is in beta and can be enabled upon request. Please feel free to reach out to your Account Manager to have it enabled for your account.

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Adding Bulk Time from the Contractor Details Page 1. Open the Job, then select the contractor from the pipeline whose timesheet you want to update. Please note: If the timesheet is not enabled for that contractor, you will first need to enable the timesheet. ​ How to Enable Timesheets for Contract Staffing Jobs in Recruit CRM 2. Bulk select the timesheets to update, then click " Bulk Update Time Entries" . ​ 3. In the Bulk Update Time Entries tab, enter work hours, break hours, and remarks. Use Copy to All or Copy to This Period if you want to replicate values, then click the relevant button to apply the changes across all selected timesheets. ​

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: ​4. If you are the designated approver, you can also directly submit and approve all the timesheets at once. The Copy to All and Copy to Period actions will only apply hours to working days, not to days off. If needed, time for days off can be added manually. When you bulk update, the system checks the first valid timesheet (a non-approved timesheet is considered valid) to find errors. Some timesheets may not proceed. For example: “Method for logging work hours is different” → means the selected timesheets use different logging methods. “Timesheet is approved” → means approved timesheets cannot be updated. You can still continue with the valid timesheets by clicking Proceed. ​

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: 1. Open the Deal details page. Go to the Timesheets tab . ​ 2. Bulk select the timesheets to update, then click " Bulk Update Time Entries" ​ 3. Enter the hours, breaks, and any remarks as required, then click Submit to save your changes and update the selected timesheets. ​ The first valid timesheet is always taken as the reference. After that, any errors are added based on the following conditions: Timesheets with different periods are excluded. Timesheets with different settings (workdays or method of logging hours) are excluded. Timesheets from different jobs are excluded. Timesheets where the user does not have edit access are excluded.

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Roles and Permissions: Based on edit access for the candidate, you can edit their timesheets. This includes bulk adding time, approving, and rejecting entries. ​ If you would like to learn more about this feature, you can book a quick call with our team through this link . Can I add different time entries for different contractors at once? Yes. Each contractor is listed with their respective timesheet period in the bulk entry modal. You can update individually or use Copy to All for consistency. Is overtime shown when adding time? Can I also add a remark

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Yes. Overtime is automatically displayed based on the rule template that was applied when the timesheet was created. You can also add remarks while entering or updating time. ​ What happens if a submitted or rejected timesheet is selected, and it already has values? The values from those timesheets will be pre-populated, and you can edit or update them as needed before resubmitting. If any remarks are added, those also will be populated. Can I submit timesheets in bulk if no time has been filled for any period? No. For all the selected periods, at least one day must have a time entry. If no entries exist, the timesheets cannot be submitted.

chunks.t: Bulk Add Time in Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Bulk add time in timesheets helps you update, submit, and approve multiple timesheets quickly while respecting timesheet settings and permissions. chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn
chunks.x: Note: A Premium Recruiter account is required in order to connect to LinkedIn via the ATS. A Recruiter Lite account will not succeed. You can read more about the differences between the two types of accounts on LinkedIn's page here . Connecting your LinkedIn contract requires a multi-step process that includes logging in to the LinkedIn account that is authorized to use the contract’s job slot inventory. The steps below must be followed exactly in order to properly connect your LinkedIn contract. 1. You must have a LinkedIn Recruiter Account. Go to LinkedIn and log out of that account.

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn
chunks.x: 2. Begin typing in the search field for MyContracts within the ATS platform to find the job board you wish to set up. In this case, search for “LinkedIn” (not Limited Listings) and select it from the drop down. Once you select the desired job board, the page will automatically render the instructions and fields that are specific to that job board. 3. To begin the setup/initialization process for LinkedIn, click the GREEN “Initialize Authentication” button. Clicking this button will take you to a LinkedIn login page. 4. Click Sign In and enter your login credentials to log in to LinkedIn. ​ 5. Once logged in to LinkedIn, you must select the contract that you intend to connect to MyContracts.

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn
chunks.x: If you have multiple accounts tied to your login, they will be presented here. Be sure that you choose the correct account. 6. After selecting the correct account, you must edit the Job Poster information. Click the Edit button to the right of “Job Poster” and under the name. It may already show the name correctly - you MUST complete this step. 7. After clicking the Edit button, you will need to retype your name and then press Save. This will initialize the connection between your LinkedIn posting account and the MyContracts delivery system. 8. Now return to the MyContracts setup screen. Your LinkedIn Company ID will now appear in the COMPANY ID field. Verify that the Company ID is correct.

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn
chunks.x: 8. There are various optional fields that you can now use for managing your contract in MyContracts. Contract Alias allows you to give your contract a name. chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: A user with this permission will be able to access the Calling Integration & Credits page to buy calling credits and manage the call recording settings. If enabled, if a user has this permission, the recording toggle inside a record will always be enabled by default. 🎯Allow user to choose which calls to record : If enabled, the user can turn the recording toggle on or off for each call in the phone calls section. ​ If enabled, the user can download call recordings from the system. If a user has Start recording calls by default but does not have Allow user to choose which calls to record , the recording toggle will be on by default, and the user will not be able to turn it off.

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Change Default Call Recording from Call Settings (User Level) A user can also manage their default call recording behaviour from their own Call Settings page: 1. Go to Phone Calling and SMS Settings . 3. Enable or disable the default call recording toggle as needed. Only Account Owners , Admins , and users with appropriate custom roles can access this settings page. This setting is at the user level and does not affect recording settings for the entire account. The toggle in Call Settings will override the role-based Start recording calls by default permission.

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Example: If a user’s role has “Start recording calls by default” enabled, but the user has access to Call Settings, they can turn the default recording toggle off there and override that permission. Click here to learn more about call recording laws that may apply to your calls. 1. When you initiate a call from a record, you will hear a calling tone, and the phone will start ringing. During the call, you can take call notes on the screen . These notes will be automatically added to the Notes and Calls section in the record once saved. ​ 2. Once the call ends, a post-call screen will appear where you can: Add more details about the call (e.g., call type).

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Review and add to the call notes (the notes from the live call screen will already be visible here). ​ Open the relevant Candidate or Contact profile. ​ Click on the Notes and Calls tab to view call recordings (subject to your download/view permissions). All notes associated with those calls. ​ Within this area, use the Notes and Calls tab to see the full history of call activity and access the recordings. 📋 How to transcribe calls in Recruit CRM? Click here to learn how to transcribe the calls 📲 How to use the native dialer to call from the system? Click here to learn to use your native dialler for calling! Problem: I can’t see the Call Settings page

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Likely cause: Your role does not have permission to access Phone Calling and SMS Settings. What to check: Confirm if you are an Account Owner, Admin, or have a custom role that allows access to calling settings. Resolution path: Ask an Account Owner or Admin to review your role under Users and ensure you have the correct calling permissions. Problem: Calls are recording by default, and I can’t turn them off Likely cause: Your role has Start recording calls by default enabled but does not have allow user to choose which calls to record. What to check: Ask an admin to confirm your role’s settings for: Allow user to choose which calls to record

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Resolution path: If appropriate, the admin can update your custom role to grant Allow user to choose which calls to record, or grant you access to Call Settings so you can override the default. Problem: I can’t download call recordings Likely cause: The Allow user to download recordings permission is not enabled for your role. What to check: In your role configuration, verify if Allow user to download recordings is turned on. Resolution path: Ask an Account Owner or Admin to edit your custom role and enable Allow user to download recordings if it aligns with your organization’s policy.

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Call recording permissions in Recruit CRM’s new UI give you fine-grained control over who can record, manage, and download calls, as well as how default recording behaves for each user. By configuring custom roles correctly and understanding user-level Call Settings, your team can capture the right call data while staying aligned with your organization’s policies. Custom Roles - Access Control & Permissions In Recruit CRM Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM (New UI) Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Contractor Portal provides contractors with a secure space to access jobs where timesheets are enabled, create and submit timesheets, track approvals, and manage their timesheet activity independently. All actions performed in the portal are synchronized with Recruit CRM in real time, giving agencies complete visibility into contractor timesheet activity. Give contractors secure access to manage their own timesheets. Allow contractors to create, save, edit, and submit timesheets. Enable contractors to track timesheet approvals and rejections. Reduce manual follow-ups between agencies and contractors.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Keep timesheet activity synchronized with Recruit CRM in real time. Please note: This feature is currently available in Beta and can be enabled upon request. Please contact your Account Manager to have it enabled for your account. A candidate is considered a contractor when timesheets are enabled for at least one job assigned to them. Once timesheets are enabled, the candidate is automatically identified as a contractor in Recruit CRM. A contractor can have one of the following statuses: Contractor Assigned: The contractor is currently working on a job with an active job duration.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Contractor Available: Timesheets are enabled for the contractor, but they are not currently working on an active job. You can enable portal access directly from a contractor's candidate profile, allowing them to manage their timesheets independently. Open the candidate's profile and ensure timesheets are enabled for at least one assigned job. You can confirm this by checking for the Contractor: Available or Contractor: Assigned status at the top of the profile. Click the three-dot menu on the candidate's profile and select Enable Portal Access .

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: A Compose Email box will open with the Contractor Portal Invitation template pre-selected. Review or customize the subject and email body as needed. The template includes the {Invitee_Name} placeholder and a built-in help video, which can be removed if not required. Click Send to deliver the invitation. Once the invitation is sent, the Portal Invitation Sent tag will appear on the candidate's profile, and the contractor will receive an email with a signup link. While the Portal Invitation Sent tag is displayed, hover over it to see the following options: Resend Invite: Sends a new invitation email and generates a new active invitation link.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Copy Invitation Link: Copies the current active invitation link to your clipboard, allowing you to share it directly without sending another email. Copying the link does not send a new invitation or change the portal status. You can copy and share the same active link as many times as needed while it remains valid. If the invitation link has expired, the Copy Invitation Link option will no longer be available. Only Resend Invite will be shown, which generates a new active link that can then be copied and shared.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: 📌 Please note: The invitation link and reset link is valid for 24 hours from the time it is sent. If the link expires before the contractor signs up, resend the invitation to generate a new active link. Once the contractor completes the signup process using the invitation link, the status automatically changes from Invitation Sent to Portal Enabled . The contractor can then log in and start managing their timesheets directly from the portal. Portal access cannot be enabled if the candidate does not have an email address on their profile.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Each email address can be associated with only one portal account, so if an email is already linked to an existing portal account, it cannot be used to enable portal access for another candidate. The email template that opens when enabling portal access can be customized. Click here to learn how to edit and customize email templates. How to manage timesheets in the Contractor Portal? Once contractors have completed sign-up and logged in, they can manage their timesheet activities directly from the portal. Contractors can choose whether timesheets are displayed in a 12-hour or 24-hour format.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: To update the time format, navigate to Settings → Profile , select the preferred option under Time Format , and click Save Profile . All timesheets will then be displayed using the selected format. Contractors can view only the jobs they are assigned to where timesheets have been enabled. All timesheets related to eligible jobs are available in one place, and contractors can filter them by time periods, such as This Week or This Month , to quickly find the required entries. While a timesheet is in the Open status, contractors can enter their timesheet details and click Save without submitting it. The timesheet remains open and can be accessed later for further updates or submission.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Contractors can create timesheets for jobs where timesheets are enabled. Click + Add Timesheet , select the relevant job and time period, and create the timesheet. To add time, click the Pencil icon in the Actions column of the relevant timesheet. Depending on the Rate Type configured for the contractor, enter either the hours worked (plus any breaks) or the day's attendance (Full Day, Half Day, No Show), then submit the completed timesheet for approval. If a submitted timesheet is rejected, the contractor can view the rejection status, edit the timesheet to make the required changes, and resubmit it for review.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Contractors can track the status of each timesheet directly from the portal. Timesheets clearly indicate whether they are Submitted , Approved , or Rejected , along with updates made during the approval process. All timesheets created, saved, updated, submitted, or resubmitted through the Contractor Portal are synchronized with Recruit CRM in real time. Each timesheet also displays who submitted and approved it and when each action occurred, providing contractors and agency users with a clear activity history. Agency users can disable portal access at any time if a contractor no longer requires access or if access needs to be temporarily paused. Open the contractor's profile in Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Click the three-dot menu and select Disable Portal Access. A confirmation window will appear. Click Disable to confirm. Once portal access is disabled, the candidate's status tag changes to Portal Disabled . The contractor is immediately logged out of the portal, sees a message indicating that access has been disabled, and receives an email notification about the change. Portal access can be enabled again later if required. Once re-enabled, the contractor receives a new notification and can log in using their existing credentials. If a candidate record is deleted from Recruit CRM, the associated Contractor Portal account is automatically deleted.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: If candidate records are merged and the secondary candidate has an associated Contractor Portal account, that portal account is also deleted as part of the merge process. This ensures Contractor Portal access remains aligned with active candidate records in Recruit CRM. Problem: I can't enable Contractor Portal access for a candidate. Likely Cause: The candidate doesn't have an email address, timesheets haven't been enabled for an assigned job, or the email address is already linked to another portal account.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: What to Check: Confirm that timesheets are enabled for at least one assigned job, the candidate has a valid email address, and the email isn't already associated with another portal account. Resolution: Enable timesheets for an assigned job and add a unique email address to the candidate's profile before enabling portal access. 1. Can I resend a Contractor Portal invitation? Yes. If the invitation link is still active, hover over the Portal Invitation Sent tag and click Copy Invitation Link to share it directly without resending the invitation.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: If the link has expired, Copy Invitation Link will no longer be available. In that case, click Resend Invite to generate a new active link, which will remain valid for another 24 hours . You can then copy and share the new link in the same way. 2. A re the bill rate and bill amount f ields visible to contractors? No. Bill rate and bill amount fields are client-specific and are not visible to contractors in the portal. 3. How can an agency user change the email address of a contractor who already has portal access?

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: An agency user can update the email address directly from the candidate record. Once the new email is saved, the change takes effect immediately. A notification is sent to both the old and the new email addresses, and the contractor can log in using the updated email. Note: If the email being updated already exists in the portal (whether added manually, through a profile update, etc.), the system will display an error, and the email change will not be allowed. 4. What happens if a contractor is unassigned from all jobs where timesheets are enabled?

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: The candidate will no longer be considered a contractor. If portal access already exists, related options will still be available, and the contractor will no longer be able to view timesheets for jobs they have been unassigned from. 5. Is it possible to save a timesheet having status other than “Open”? No, it is currently not possible to save a timesheet having any other status except “Open” 6. What happens if a Contractor wants to edit a Timesheet with status- Submitted or Rejected? In such a case, the Save option is not available. They must resubmit timesheets after editing them.

chunks.t: Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: The Contractor Portal gives contractors a secure and convenient way to manage their timesheets while keeping agencies informed through real-time synchronization with Recruit CRM. Contractors can create, save, submit, and track timesheets independently, while agency users retain control over portal access and contractor records. All Contractors Page / Timesheets in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: Your careers page is often the first impression candidates have of your company. With Recruit Craft’s Website Editor , you can easily design and customize a page that reflects your brand and helps attract the right talent. ​ The editor allows you to mix and match templates, preview your design on different devices, and control how job listings appear, all without needing any technical skills. Let’s explore how you can make the most of it. 1. Choose a Template That Fits Your Brand 🎨 Start by selecting a pre-designed template that best represents your company’s look and feel. Each template provides a strong foundation, making it easy to create a polished, well-structured careers page.

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: After choosing a template, you can start personalizing every section of your careers page. The modular structure of the editor gives you complete control over each element, allowing you to create a page that looks and feels exactly the way you want it to. When you open the editor, you’ll notice that the workspace is divided into two main parts. The left panel is where you navigate between different components on your page, while the right panel is where you make all your edits and adjustments. This layout keeps everything organized, so you can easily move through your page and make changes without switching screens.

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: The Elements panel on the left displays all the components that make up your selected page. This is where you’ll find sections like the navigation bar, hero banner, job cards, and more. When you click on a specific element, the panel will automatically show you the available settings and configuration options for that section. Each element has its own unique configuration settings, so it’s normal if one section offers certain options that others do not. For instance, one component might allow you to add a background image, while another might let you upload an SVG or adjust layout properties.

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: To start making changes, simply hover over the element and click Edit. This opens a detailed view where you can modify that specific component. Within the right panel, you’ll find two main tabs that help you organize your work - The Configure tab lets you control how the element functions, such as field mappings, visibility, or content settings. The Design tab focuses on how the element looks, allowing you to adjust the layout, font styles, colors, and backgrounds. This clean, intuitive setup ensures that you can easily locate every tool and option you need, making it simple to fine-tune each part of your careers page until it perfectly represents your brand.

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: Add your company logo to the navigation bar and customize the sign-up button to align with your brand’s style. You can adjust the colors, fonts, and layout to ensure it blends seamlessly with the rest of your website. ​ You can also change the height of the navigation bar using a simple slider. The height can be adjusted from 72 px up to 82 px; this helps achieve a more balanced and visually appealing header layout. As you adjust the navigation bar height, the logo automatically resizes as well, ensuring it looks more prominent while keeping the layout clean and well balanced.

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: You can also make the company logo in the navigation bar clickable by adding a custom link to it. This allows you to direct candidates to a specific destination, such as your company website or a social page, when they click on the logo. The link can be updated at any time, giving you flexibility to change where the logo redirects without altering the design of the navigation bar. While uploading the logo, you can zoom in or out, rotate, and crop it as needed. This makes it easier to fit the logo correctly and match your branding requirements without having to edit the image elsewhere. ​

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: Choose the perfect top section for your careers page from multiple layout options. You can mix and match designs from different templates to create your dream page. Adjust the font and color scheme to reflect your brand identity and make a strong first impression. ​ Decide how you want your job filters to appear on the page. You can set their color, font, and position to make the filtering process smooth and visually appealing for visitors. ​

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: You can also enable additional filtering options to help candidates find relevant roles faster. For example, a Salary Range filter allows candidates to set a minimum and/or maximum salary range while browsing jobs on the career page. This filter appears only if the Salary field is mapped in the filter configuration . When a salary filter is applied, jobs that do not have salary information will be excluded from the results. Click here to know more about how you can add this. Select Job Listing Page from the dropdown at the top and navigate to Filters . ​ Select the Golden Groove filter and click Edit . ​ Choose the Dropdown option and open the Configure tab. ​

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: Select the Salary field from the list and click Save to apply the filter. Note: The Salary Range filter is currently available through the Golden Groove filter template . However, it is not restricted to the Golden Groove career page template. You can apply the Golden Groove filter configuration to any career page template if you want to enable the Salary Range filter. Control how your open job listings are displayed. You can modify the layout, font, and color of job cards to make them stand out while maintaining a clean and professional look. ​

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: You can also choose to display salary information on job cards to give candidates clearer visibility into compensation details. The salary values are automatically formatted for better readability and follow the appropriate numbering format based on the currency used. If the minimum and maximum salary are equal → a single value is displayed (e.g., $5,000/month). If a salary range exists → it appears as a range (e.g., $5,000 – $8,000/month). If only the maximum salary is available → it is displayed as Up to $8,000/month . If no salary information is available → the salary will not appear on the job card.

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: Salary values automatically include separators for better readability (for example, 700000 → 700,000 ). Indian currency values follow the Indian numbering format (for example, 700000 → 7,00,000 ). The salary frequency shown on the job card reflects the actual pay frequency configured in Recruit CRM , such as: You can enable or disable salary visibility using the Salary Range toggle in the editor. ​ Select Job Listing Page from the dropdown at the top and navigate to Job Cards . ​ Select the desired job card template and click Edit . ​ Choose the Additional Information option from the list. ​ Click on Salary Range , then open the Configure tab. ​

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: You can choose to display the Job ID on your job description pages by enabling the Show Job ID toggle in the Job Description page settings. Once enabled, the Job ID appears on the job description page, making it easier to reference specific job openings. You can display the total number of available jobs on your Job Listing page. When enabled, candidates will see a count such as “Showing 25 jobs.” The count updates automatically when candidates apply a search or filters, so they can immediately see how many roles match their criteria. ​ 📌 Please note: The Job Count setting is off by default for both new and existing templates. ​

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: Open the Project where you want to enable the job count display. Select Job Listing Page from the dropdown at the top. From the left panel, go to Sections and select Job Cards . In the right panel, enable the Job Count toggle. You may need to scroll down to find this setting. You can also customize the text color and the text that appears before and after the job count. Customize the top section of your job description page just like the hero section. You can select from different layouts, mix and match styles, and personalize fonts and colors to keep your careers page consistent across every section. ​

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: This modular approach gives you full creative freedom to design a page that perfectly matches your brand and helps candidates navigate easily. The editor lets you see your changes instantly through a real-time preview feature. You can also toggle to Mobile Preview to check how your careers page looks on mobile devices, ensuring a great experience for all visitors. Job links will display the customized preview image and text configured under Social Media Sharing Settings in the Recruit CRM Public Job Page settings .

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: This means that whenever a job link is shared on social platforms, the preview automatically reflects your configured branding and messaging. The image and title shown in the preview will match the settings you have defined, ensuring a more consistent and professional appearance when sharing job opportunities externally. ​ ​ Note : Any changes made in Recruit CRM may take up to 24 hours to reflect. This is because the preview information is cached to ensure better performance and faster loading. Candidate Terms & EEO Policy on the Apply Page The job application (Apply) page also supports the following additions:

chunks.t: Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor
chunks.x: • A Candidate Terms checkbox , allowing applicants to confirm acceptance of the terms before submitting their application. • An EEO Policy section , where the Equal Employment Opportunity policy can be displayed to candidates during the application process. The Recruit Craft Website Editor  gives you everything you need to design a careers page that feels authentic to your company. With its flexible templates, live previews, and easy-to-use components, creating a modern, mobile-friendly page has never been simpler. ​ Recruit Craft: No-Code Career Page & Candidate Portal Builder How Google for Jobs Works With Your Recruit Craft Career Page

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Client Portal for Timesheets gives clients secure access to contractor timesheets associated with their jobs. Depending on the permissions granted, clients can view, create, edit, delete, and approve timesheets, with every action syncing automatically to Recruit CRM. This feature improves collaboration between agencies and clients by providing real-time visibility into contractor timesheets while maintaining complete control over client permissions. Share contractor timesheets with clients. Allow clients to create, edit, or delete timesheets. Enable designated client contacts to approve timesheets.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Keep all timesheet updates synchronized with Recruit CRM. Maintain a complete audit trail of timesheet activity. Please note: This feature is currently available in Beta . If you'd like to enable it for your account, please contact your Account Manager . Clients can access the Client Portal in two ways: through the Hiring Manager Portal (HMP), or by receiving a direct portal invitation from their Contact profile. To learn how Hiring Managers are invited, sign up, and access the portal, refer to t his article. For the direct invitation flow, see "How to invite a client to the Client Portal" below. Enable Client Portal access for timesheets

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Before enabling timesheet access, ensure the client contact has been added to the relevant company and is associated with the appropriate Contract or Contract-to-Permanent job in Recruit CRM. Open the required job and click Submit to Client . Select the permissions you want to grant to the client, then click Online Candidate List to activate the portal link. Once enabled, your client will be able to view shared timesheets in real time through the Hiring Manager Portal. To access the shared job, the client can open the email containing the Online Candidate List link, then click View in Portal. They will be taken to the Timesheets tab by default.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: You can invite a client to the Client Portal directly from their Contact profile. Open the contact's profile in Recruit CRM. ​ Click the three-dot menu and select Enable Portal Access . The Compose Email window will open with the Client Portal Invitation template pre-selected. Review or customize the subject and email body as needed, including the {Invitee_Name} placeholder. The built-in help video can also be removed if it is not required. Click Send to deliver the invitation. Once the invitation is sent, the Portal Invitation Sent tag will appear on the contact's profile, and the client will receive an email containing a signup link.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: 📌 Please note: The invitation link and the reset link is valid for 24 hours from the time it is sent. While the Portal Invitation Sent tag is displayed, hover over it to access the following options: Resend Invite: Sends a new invitation email and generates a new active invitation link. Copy Invitation Link: Copies the current active invitation link to your clipboard, allowing you to share it directly without resending the invitation. This doesn't send a new invitation or change the portal status, and you can copy the same active link as many times as needed while it's valid.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: If the invitation link has expired, Copy Invitation Link will no longer be available. Click Resend Invite to generate a new active link, which can then be copied and shared in the same way. If the Online Link is disabled at any time, the client's access to timesheets is removed immediately. For the best experience, ensure the client already exists as a Contact in Recruit CRM for that specific job before enabling portal access. The email template that opens when enabling portal access can be customized. Click here to learn how to edit and customize email templates. Client access is fully controlled by your agency and is available only for Contract and Contract-to-Permanent jobs.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: When enabling the Online Candidate List , you can choose whether clients are allowed to: Please note: All permissions are enabled by default when Portal Access is first activated. Any changes you make are saved and applied going forward. You can update these permissions at any time if your client's responsibilities change. After signing in to the Client Portal, clients can access the Timesheets tab to review and manage all shared contractor timesheets in one place. Filter timesheets by This Week , Last Week , This Month , or Last Month . Edit existing timesheets by clicking the Pencil icon. Approve timesheets (if assigned as the approver).

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Each timesheet clearly displays who created, submitted, and approved it, along with the corresponding timestamps, providing a complete audit trail. Timesheets for candidates who have been deleted from the Recruit CRM remain visible in the Client Portal and are clearly marked as Deleted . While clients cannot create new timesheets for deleted candidates, they can continue viewing existing timesheets and perform permitted actions where applicable. Agency users can assign specific client contacts as timesheet approvers while enabling Portal Access for a job.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Only assigned approvers can approve timesheets. Other client contacts may still be able to view, create, edit, or delete timesheets based on the permissions granted to them, but they cannot approve submissions. All approval actions performed in the Client Portal are synchronized instantly with Recruit CRM. All actions performed in the Client Portal, including creating, editing, submitting, and approving timesheets, are synchronized with Recruit CRM in real time. Each activity is automatically logged, ensuring complete visibility for agencies, clients, and contractors. Likely Cause: You're not assigned as the timesheet approver.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: What to Check: Confirm with your agency that you've been assigned as the approver for the job. Resolution: Only designated approvers can approve timesheets. Other users can only perform the actions permitted by their assigned permissions. 1. Can I control what clients can do with timesheets? Yes. You can independently allow clients to create, edit, delete, and approve timesheets through the Portal Access permissions. 2. What happens if I disable the Online Link? The client's access to shared timesheets is removed immediately, and the timesheets will no longer be visible in the Client Portal. 3. Can clients view timesheets for deleted candidates?

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: Yes. Existing timesheets remain visible and are clearly marked as Deleted , although new timesheets cannot be created for deleted candidates 4. Can I copy the invitation link without resending the email? Yes. If the invitation is still active, you can hover over the Portal Invitation Sent tag and click Copy Invitation Link. 5. What happens when the invitation link expires? Copy Invitation Link is no longer available for the expired link. Use Resend Invite to generate a new active link.

chunks.t: Client Portal for Timesheets (Beta)
chunks.x: The Client Portal for Timesheets simplifies collaboration between agencies and clients by providing secure, real-time access to contractor timesheets. With configurable permissions, instant synchronization, and a complete audit trail, agencies can confidently manage timesheet workflows while giving clients the flexibility they need. How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta) Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta) Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)

chunks.t: Creating and Managing Invoices in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Invoices feature in Recruit CRM lets you create, customize, and manage invoices directly within the platform. You can generate invoices from supported records such as candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, deals, and placements, use customizable invoice templates and fields, track invoice statuses from a centralized dashboard, work with multiple currencies using automatic exchange rate updates for reporting, and perform bulk actions such as exporting, downloading, archiving, deleting, and updating internal fields. You need to generate invoices directly from candidate, contact, company, job, deal, or placement records.

chunks.t: Creating and Managing Invoices in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You want to monitor invoice statuses such as Paid , Due , and Overdue from a single dashboard. You work with multiple currencies and need consistent reporting in your account's base currency. You want to create customized invoice templates and add client-facing or internal custom fields. You need to bulk manage, export, archive, or report on invoice data from the Invoice List page. The Invoice List page serves as the central dashboard for managing all invoices created in Recruit CRM. From here, invoices can be tracked, organized, and managed from a single location. From the left-hand sidebar, click Placements & Invoices .

chunks.t: Creating and Managing Invoices in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: On the Placements & Invoices page, select the Invoices tab to view all invoices created. This section gives you a centralized view of all invoices, making it easier to monitor billing activity and manage invoice records efficiently. ​ The Invoice List Page acts as the central dashboard for managing invoices. From here, you can track invoice statuses, organize records, and perform actions such as editing, downloading, archiving, or exporting invoices. ​ At the top of the invoice list page, you will see a quick overview of key invoice statistics, including:

chunks.t: Creating and Managing Invoices in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: These metrics give you a quick snapshot of your billing performance. You can also click on any of these metrics to instantly filter the list and view invoices belonging to that category. ​ For example: Selecting Paid Invoices will show all invoices marked as paid. Selecting Overdue Invoices will display invoices whose due date has passed. Recruit CRM supports invoices in multiple currencies to accommodate different billing requirements. Exchange rates are automatically fetched once per day , and invoice values are converted into the account's base currency for reporting. This ensures that reports display consistent values in the configured account currency.

chunks.t: Creating and Managing Invoices in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: While creating or editing an invoice, open the invoice form. On the left side of the invoice form, select the required Currency from the currency dropdown. On the Invoice List page, review the following information: Converted amount based on the account's base currency ​ Note: Daily exchange rate updates may cause small fluctuations in report totals. To make invoice tracking easier, you can organize invoices using the 'Group By' feature. ​ Click on the "Group By" button on the top right of the invoice list page. Select the entity you want to group invoices by (Jobs, Deals, Companies, or Contacts).

chunks.t: Creating and Managing Invoices in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The system will automatically organize invoices into groups based on the selected entity, allowing you to quickly review invoices associated with the specific records. ​ The invoice list page also supports Filter search and Boolean search. ​ Filter invoices by status, company, currency, or other attributes. Sort invoices based on fields such as creation date or invoice amount. Use the search bar to locate specific invoice records. Click here to learn how to run a search in Recruit CRM (New UI) You can select multiple invoices and perform actions such as: You can select the invoice you want to download as a PDF, then click on the 'Download PDF' button.

chunks.t: Creating and Managing Invoices in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can select the invoice you want to export, then click on the 'Export' button. Select the invoice you want to archive. Then click on the 'Archive' button: ​ To view Archived Invoices, click on the Quick View button and click on 'Archived': ​ After selecting the invoice you want to delete, click on the 'Delete' button. ​ 1. Choose the entity for which you want to create the invoice. ( Candidate, Contact, Company, Jobs & Deals). Here we have selected a company record as an example. ​
