chunks.t: Linking Candidates & Contacts That Are The Same Person (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? In recruitment, it’s quite common to come across situations where a candidate you’re working with later becomes a client, or a client you’ve been in touch with decides to look for new opportunities as a candidate. This feature in Recruit CRM lets you connect a candidate record and a contact record that represent the same person. ​ To make handling such scenarios simple, Recruit CRM gives you three easy options: Link an existing candidate and contact – If both records belong to the same person, you can link them together. Create a candidate from a contact – Turn an existing client or contact into a new candidate profile.

chunks.t: Linking Candidates & Contacts That Are The Same Person (New UI)
chunks.x: Create a contact from a candidate – Convert an existing candidate into a new client or contact record. Once you’ve linked the records, you can then access and view the associated “Linked Record” from both candidate and contact profiles. 1. Go to a Candidate or Contact Record. Click on the "Link To Contact/Candidate" button in the header section. ​ If the Candidate or Contact record you wish to link is already in the system you can search for it or you can just hit the blue "Add Contact" or "Add Candidate" button to create a new record and automatically link it. Once you hit the green "Link Contact" or "Link Candidate" button in the pop-up, the 2 records will be linked.

chunks.t: Linking Candidates & Contacts That Are The Same Person (New UI)
chunks.x: After linking, the candidate and contact profiles are connected you can navigate between the linked records directly. ​ Note: If you wish to unlink them, just click on the button "Contact Linked" or "Candidate Linked" button and then click on the 'Unlink' option: Now, if you wish to delete them as a contact but still leave them as a candidate and vice versa, you can simply delete them as a normal record. Although both are linked, contacts and candidates are different entities, so if you delete one, it won't delete the other. 🔍 Identifying Candidates Who Are Also Contacts From the Candidates List Page , click on the name of the candidate to open their profile.

chunks.t: Linking Candidates & Contacts That Are The Same Person (New UI)
chunks.x: On the candidate’s profile page, look for the red “Contact-Linked” label at the top. Hover over the “Contact-Linked” label a dropdown will appear showing the linked Contact details of the same person. You can click the contact name in the dropdown to open their Contact profile directly. ​ 🔍 Identifying Contacts Who Are Also Candidates Individually from Contact's Profile: ​ From the Contacts List Page , click on the name of the Contact to open their profile. On the contact's profile page, look for the green “Candidate-Linked” label at the top. Hover over the “Candidate-Linked” label, and a dropdown will appear showing the linked Candidate details of the same person.

chunks.x: You can click the candidate name in the dropdown to open their profile directly. ​ Go to the Contact List Page and click the " Add Filter" button located near the top of the page. Select “Yes” to see only contacts who are also saved as candidates, or select “No” to view contacts not linked to any candidate profile. Then, click Apply to set the filter. ​ Can I have more than one candidate linked to the same contact (or vice versa)?

chunks.t: Track the Source of Applicants from Multiple Platforms Using the Job Application URL/Talent Pool Page (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature allows you to track where candidates are applying from when they use a Recruit CRM Job Application form or Talent Pool Page . By adding a simple source parameter to the URL before sharing it on external platforms, Recruit CRM automatically captures that source and stores it in the candidate's Source field when they apply. This makes it easy to identify which platforms and channels are driving applications, helping you measure the effectiveness of your recruitment efforts and make better sourcing decisions. • You share Recruit CRM job application links on platforms such as LinkedIn, job boards, social media, or other external websites.

chunks.t: Track the Source of Applicants from Multiple Platforms Using the Job Application URL/Talent Pool Page (New UI)
chunks.x: • You want to track which platforms generate the most candidate applications. • You need to filter and report on candidates based on where they applied from. • You manage a talent pool page and want to measure the performance of different traffic sources and sharing channels. Track Candidate Sources Using a Job Application URL You can track where candidates are applying from by adding a source parameter to your job application URL before sharing it on external platforms. For example, if you want to track candidates applying through LinkedIn, you can modify the job application URL to capture LinkedIn as the source.

chunks.t: Track the Source of Applicants from Multiple Platforms Using the Job Application URL/Talent Pool Page (New UI)
chunks.x: Open the job you want to share in Recruit CRM and copy the Job Application URL . Add ?source=LinkedIn to the end of the URL. ​ Original URL: https://jobs.yourcompany.com/job/software-engineer Modified URL: https://jobs.yourcompany.com/job/software-engineer?source=LinkedIn ​ 3. Share the modified URL on LinkedIn along with your job post. 4. When a candidate applies through this link, Recruit CRM automatically records LinkedIn in the candidate's Source field. You can use the same approach for any platform by replacing the value after source= with the desired source name.

chunks.t: Track the Source of Applicants from Multiple Platforms Using the Job Application URL/Talent Pool Page (New UI)
chunks.x: Once applications start coming in, you can use Advanced Search in Recruit CRM to filter candidates by the Source field and analyze which platforms are generating the most applications. The parameter must use the word source in lowercase. For example, use ?source=LinkedIn and not ?Source=LinkedIn . Track Candidate Sources Using a Talent Pool Page URL If you want to track the source of candidates who join your database through a Talent Pool Page, you can use the same source-tracking method described above. Follow the steps below to add a source parameter to your Talent Pool Page URL before sharing it.

chunks.t: Track the Source of Applicants from Multiple Platforms Using the Job Application URL/Talent Pool Page (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Navigate to Admin Settings and open the Talent Pool Page Settings , next click on the 'Integrate Talent Pool' tab and copy the Talent Pool Page Link. 2. Append the appropriate source parameter to the URL before sharing it. https://jobs.yourcompany.com/talent-pool?source=LinkedIn 3. Share the modified URL on the desired platform. Candidates who submit their profiles through the modified Talent Pool Page URL will have the specified source captured automatically in Recruit CRM. Problem: The Source field is not showing the expected platform name for new candidates. Likely cause: The URL parameter was not added correctly or source is not in lowercase.

chunks.t: Track the Source of Applicants from Multiple Platforms Using the Job Application URL/Talent Pool Page (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: Confirm the URL contains ?source= followed by the platform name and verify that source is written exactly in lowercase (not Source or SOURCE ). Correct the URL to use ?source=PlatformName with source in lowercase, then reshare the updated link. Do I need separate URLs for each platform? Yes. To distinguish between platforms, create a unique URL for each one by changing the value after ?source= and then share that specific link on that platform. Will this update the Source field for candidates who already applied? No. The Source parameter only applies to candidates who apply after you start using the modified URL. It does not retroactively update existing candidates.

chunks.t: Track the Source of Applicants from Multiple Platforms Using the Job Application URL/Talent Pool Page (New UI)
chunks.x: Where can I see and use the Source information? You can view the Source field on candidate records and use the Source field in Advanced Search to filter and track applications from a specific platform. Source tracking helps you understand where your candidates are coming from by capturing the platform or channel used to access your job application or Talent Pool links. By simply adding a source parameter to the URL before sharing it, you can accurately track candidate origins, measure the effectiveness of different sourcing channels, and use Recruit CRM's filtering and reporting capabilities to make more informed recruitment decisions. chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts(New UI)
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The Data Enrichment feature helps users find missing email addresses and phone numbers for candidates or contacts using their LinkedIn profiles and other available information. Recruit CRM performs enrichment using a waterfall model i.e, when contact data is requested, Recruit CRM automatically requests data from RocketReach and FullEnrich. The waterfall model increases the chance of finding valid contact details without requiring additional steps from the user. For candidates, personal emails are fetched. For contacts, work emails are fetched. If more than one personal or work email is available, the secondary email is saved as a note.

chunks.t: Data Enrichment: Find Email & Phone Number of Candidates/Contacts(New UI)
chunks.x: You need to find missing email addresses or phone numbers for candidates/contacts. Data Enrichment is an Enterprise plan feature which can also be added at an additional cost to the Pro or Business plan subscriptions. Free Plan: Users on the Free plan will have 25 free Data Enrichment credits to try out this feature. The free credits are assigned on a per-user basis and cannot be shared across the account. The free credits do not have an expiration period and will remain available in the account until they are fully utilized. Pro Plan and Business Plan : Pro and Business Plan users can try the Data Enrichment feature using the free Recruit CRM Credits .

chunks.t: US A2P 10DLC Registration & SMS Consent Configuration
chunks.x: US carriers require clear, intentional consent before you can send text messages. If you’re sending SMS to US numbers through Recruit CRM (powered by Twilio ), you must complete A2P 10DLC registration and comply with carrier consent rules; otherwise, your campaigns may be rejected, delayed, or suspended to prevent spam and protect consumers. US carriers regulate application-to-person (A2P) messaging under the 10DLC framework. Any business sending SMS messages for recruitment communication must: Clearly describe how consent is collected Ensure users actively opt in before receiving messages

chunks.t: US A2P 10DLC Registration & SMS Consent Configuration
chunks.x: Recruit CRM supports compliant consent collection, but it must be properly configured before submitting your registration form. Consent means a clear, affirmative action by the recipient indicating they agree to receive SMS messages from your company for a stated purpose. To prevent rejection, Recruit CRM requires clients to configure compliant consent before submitting A2P registration details. Purpose of messaging (recruitment / hiring communication) cross mark Don’t include your own name/ any brand’s name) Purpose of messaging (recruitment / hiring communication) Message frequency (or “Message frequency may vary”) Links to: ​ Recruit CRM SMS Terms of Service

chunks.t: US A2P 10DLC Registration & SMS Consent Configuration

The candidate receives an email requesting confirmation. The user must actively click to accept SMS communication. Consent is recorded before any SMS is sent. This method provides strong audit documentation and is recommended where possible. Navigate to Admin Settings and Open SMS Opt-in Settings Click on pencil icon to Edit and enter your approved SMS consent text and click save.

chunks.t: US A2P 10DLC Registration & SMS Consent Configuration
chunks.x: Campaigns are frequently rejected due to: Submitting the form before configuring consent Review your configuration carefully before submission to avoid delays. ⚠️ Legal Risk & Penalties for Non-Compliance It’s important to understand that failure to follow SMS consent requirements is not just a product issue; it carries real legal and financial risk. 📌 US Legal Risk — Consumer Protection Act (TCPA) Under US federal law (the TCPA), text messages sent without proper consent are treated as unsolicited communications and can lead to substantial fines : ​ ✔ Federal penalties can range from $500 to $1,500 per violation (per message) when consent is missing or invalid. ​

chunks.t: US A2P 10DLC Registration & SMS Consent Configuration

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? Call recording permissions in Recruit CRM control which users can: Access phone calling and recording settings. You are an Account Owner setting up call recording permissions for your team. You are creating or editing a custom role and need to control who can record or download calls. You want to understand how default call recording works at the role and user level. You need to know where to find call recordings and call notes for candidates or contacts. 1. Calling and call recording must be enabled in your Recruit CRM account.

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 2. Only Account Owners, Admins, and users with relevant custom role permissions can configure calling and call recording settings. 1. Open Users and Roles to Create or Edit a Custom Role Go to the Users section in your Recruit CRM account to manage user roles. While creating a new custom role or editing an existing one, you will be able to configure specific calling and call recording permissions for that role. Configure Calling and Call Recording Permissions in the Custom Role Within the custom role permissions, locate the Calling Settings. Configure the following permissions for users with this role:

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: A user with this permission will be able to access the Calling Integration & Credits page to buy calling credits and manage the call recording settings. If enabled, if a user has this permission, the recording toggle inside a record will always be enabled by default. 🎯Allow user to choose which calls to record : If enabled, the user can turn the recording toggle on or off for each call in the phone calls section. ​ If enabled, the user can download call recordings from the system.

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Understand the important behaviour: If a user has Start recording calls by default but does not have Allow user to choose which calls to record , the recording toggle will be on by default, and the user will not be able to turn it off. Change Default Call Recording from Call Settings (User Level) A user can also manage their default call recording behaviour from their own Call Settings page: 1. Go to Phone Calling and SMS Settings . 3. Enable or disable the default call recording toggle as needed. Only Account Owners , Admins , and users with appropriate custom roles can access this settings page.

chunks.t: Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: This setting is at the user level and does not affect recording settings for the entire account. The toggle in Call Settings will override the role-based Start recording calls by default permission. Example: If a user’s role has “Start recording calls by default” enabled, but the user has access to Call Settings, they can turn the default recording toggle off there and override that permission. chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to control which fields are visible across different record types such as Candidates, Companies, Contacts, and Jobs. By managing field visibility and layout, you can: • Control which fields appear on list pages. • Decide which fields are shown in Add/Edit forms. • Manage which fields are visible on record detail pages. This helps you reduce clutter, simplify your interface, and ensure your team focuses only on the most relevant information. Use this feature when you want to: • Hide unused or irrelevant fields. • Ensure important fields are always visible. ​ 📋 Step-by-step instructions to manage field visibility

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) (New UI)
chunks.x: Please note that only users with the appropriate permissions will be able to edit the column/field arrangement. Click here to learn more. Step 1: Navigate to the "Admin Settings" icon and click on the Record fields that you want to edit. Step 2: Locate the field you want to manage and use the toggle to control its visibility. Click Save once done to apply the changes. • Toggle ON → Field will be visible • Toggle OFF → Field will be hidden • List pages • Add/Edit forms • Record detail pages Note: Column customization is user-specific, while field visibility is global. The selected field will now be shown or hidden across all relevant views.

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) (New UI)
chunks.x: Field visibility controls whether a field exists in the system view. To control how it appears on the list page: Go to the relevant list page → click Show/Hide Columns • Select the fields you want to display • Rearrange columns based on your preference • Click Apply to save changes In the Hide/Show Columns page, searching for a field scrolls to and highlights the matching field(s), with a counter (e.g., 1/2) to jump between matches. You can still drag and drop to reorder columns while a search is active. Only fields marked as visible will appear in the Add/Edit form, and they will follow the same order as configured in Admin Settings .

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) (New UI)
chunks.x: Please note that any required fields must be filled before saving the record. Fields with visibility turned on will appear on the record's details (profile) page, while hidden fields will not be shown. From the profile page, you can further arrange and choose which of these visible fields to display using the Customize Information Overview option. ​ You can rearrange all fields visible on each page (Candidates/Companies/Contacts/Jobs) in an order of your choice. Problem: A field no longer appears on the list page. Likely cause: The field's visibility is turned off in Admin Settings or not selected in the Show/Hide Columns option. ​ What to check:

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) (New UI)
chunks.x: Check the field’s visibility toggle in Admin Settings > Data Customization for the record type. Check the Show/Hide Columns settings on the list page. Turn the field’s visibility toggle on in Admin Settings. Reopen Show/Hide Columns , select the field, and click Apply . Does changing field visibility affect all users? Yes. Field visibility is global and applies across the account. ​ No. Hiding a field only removes it from view. The data remains stored. Only users with access to the Admin Settings and permission to access the Data Customization section can manage the field visibility. Is column customization the same as field visibility?

chunks.t: Showing & Hiding data fields Across forms (Candidate/Company/Contact/Job) (New UI)
chunks.x: No. • Field visibility → controlled in Admin Settings (global) • Column layout → controlled on list page or details page (user-specific) Managing field visibility helps you create a cleaner, more focused workspace in Recruit CRM. By showing only what matters, you can improve data quality, streamline workflows, and make it easier for your team to navigate and use the system effectively. chunks.t: Texting Candidates/Contacts in RecruitCRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM's Texting feature, powered by Twilio , allows you to send and receive SMS messages with candidates and contacts directly from within Recruit CRM. You can manage one-to-one or bulk SMS outreach, use reusable SMS templates with placeholders, view conversation history from the record, and monitor SMS usage and costs, all without leaving the platform. You will need to purchase credits to send and receive messages. You can do this from Admin Settings >>> Phone Calling & SMS Settings : Now click on the green "Buy Calling Credits" button to add calling & texting credits. Choose your country: https://www.twilio.com/sms/pricing/us

chunks.t: Texting Candidates/Contacts in RecruitCRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Locate your phone number type. (Long code, mobile number, etc.) Multiply the assigned cost by 1.25 (data storage cost). Outbound SMS Cost = $0.00XX (Texting Cost) + $0.00XX(Carrier Cost) *1.25 Inbound SMS Cost = $0.00YY (Texting Cost) + $0.00YY(Carrier Cost) * 1.25 SMS cost is calculated after the message is delivered , based on the number of segments used. This includes messages with emojis , non-GSM characters , and regular English text .

chunks.t: Texting Candidates/Contacts in RecruitCRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Because the cost depends on segments, the final amount charged may differ slightly from the "expected" SMS cost you see before sending the message. ​ You can learn more about how segments are calculated from this Twilio Article on Segments. To estimate the number of segments in your message, you can also use the Twilio Segment Calculator . Carrier charges are also calculated per segment . Incoming SMS will only be charged for one segment , even if the received message has more than one. Also, incoming SMS carrier charges apply only for the US , not for other countries. For failed messages , we charge a flat $0.001 processing fee , which includes our margin.

chunks.t: Texting Candidates/Contacts in RecruitCRM (New UI)
chunks.x: For other delivery statuses - sent, delivered, undelivered, or delivery unknown - we charge the normal full cost: ​ Total cost = 25% of [message cost + carrier cost] A charge of $0.05 per unique recipient will be deducted immediately when a message is sent to a unique recipient for the first time in a calendar month. Each recipient is charged only once per month, regardless of how many messages you send them. Here is the pop - up which states that you will be charged $0.05 for each unique recipient per month and that this will be deducted from your phone calling and SMS credits according to Twilio’s volume pricing. If you send an SMS to a recipient, the charges applied are as follows:

chunks.t: Texting Candidates/Contacts in RecruitCRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Example values: SMS charge = $0.0079 , Carrier charge = $0.005 . Formula: (SMS Charge + Carrier Charge) * 1.25 Calculation: (0.0079 + 0.005) * 1.25 = $0.0166 ≈ $0.016 per SMS 2. Monthly Active Users (MAU) Charge Calculation: This charge is applied only once per recipient per month, regardless of the number of SMS sent. MAU Charge: $0.05 (applied only once per recipient per month) 2. Set up a Texting number and Messaging Candidates/Contacts

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The sequence is a powerful strategy that enables you to streamline your communication efforts and optimize task management. In this article, we will talk about the various sequence capabilities Recruit CRM offers. When a candidate or contact is enrolled, Recruit CRM begins executing the sequence from the first configured step. Each step executes in sequence according to its configured timing and channel. The next step is triggered based on the delays and schedule defined within the sequence. This allows you to automate outreach, follow-ups, and internal actions without manually managing each interaction.

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If a step fails due to issues such as a disconnected email account, insufficient SMS credits, or invalid contact information, the enrollment may pause until the issue is resolved. A candidate or contact can only be actively enrolled in one sequence at a time. What this feature does and when to use it? Sequences in Recruit CRM help you automate communication and follow-ups across multiple channels such as email, SMS, LinkedIn, and internal tasks. Instead of manually reaching out at every step, you can set up a structured workflow that runs automatically over time. This ensures consistent outreach, better engagement, and fewer missed follow-ups while managing candidates or contacts at scale.

Common reasons include: • Email account disconnected or token expired • Missing or invalid candidate/contact email or phone number • LinkedIn chat not initiated or LinkedIn not connected • Low SMS credits or Twilio pricing errors ​ If the user selects Yes , the “failed” step of all paused enrollments will be scheduled to execute in the nearest 30-minute slot.

Q1. Can a candidate or contact be enrolled in multiple sequences at the same time?

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: No. Records that are already enrolled in another sequence are excluded during bulk enrollment, so a candidate or contact can only be actively enrolled in one sequence at a time. Q2. Do changes to a sequence affect enrollments that are already in progress? No. Edits to a sequence only apply to future enrollments. Existing enrollments continue using the version of the sequence that was active when they were enrolled. Q3. What happens if my email account disconnects during a sequence?

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If your email account disconnects or the token expires, affected email steps will fail and enrollments will be paused. Once you reconnect your email, you can choose to reschedule failed steps in the next 30 minutes or allow them to run on their original schedule. Q4. Can I choose which email address a sequence sends from? Yes. If you have two email IDs configured, you can choose which email ID to use when enrolling records into a sequence. Q5. Do I need to un-enroll prospects to fix paused steps?

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: No. In most cases you can simply correct the underlying issue (for example, invalid email/phone, low SMS credits, disconnected LinkedIn) and then resume the paused enrollments. Un-enroll and re-enroll only if you want to restart from a specific step. Q6. Can I combine email, SMS, LinkedIn, and task steps in one sequence? Yes. Recruit CRM allows you to create multi-channel recruitment workflows that combine communication and internal task management within a single sequence.

chunks.t: Sequences within Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Sequences help you automate candidate outreach, candidate nurturing, recruiter follow-ups, and recruitment communication campaigns at scale. By combining email sequences, SMS automation, LinkedIn outreach, and task management into a single workflow, recruiters can build consistent communication cadences while reducing manual effort. chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: 🎉 The new version of our Contact List page is designed to help you manage and navigate your contact records more efficiently with an improved layout and enhanced functionality. It offers a sleek, more user-friendly design, ensuring seamless contact records management, better data visibility, and a more streamlined recruitment workflow. 🚀 To switch to the new version, click on the 'Profile icon' and select the 'Switch to New Version' option. You can switch back to the previous design at any time by using the same option. Here is the list of all the key features:

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: You can view the total count of records in the Contact Quick View section. The Quick View also shows the total count of Hotlists and Saved Searches, along with the count of records present in those hotlists. You can edit, pin, and delete hotlists by clicking on the three dots next to each Hotlist. Similarly, you can edit, pin, clone and delete the Saved Searches as well. You can minimize and maximize the Contact View, Contact Hotlists and Saved Searches sections by using the arrow icon next to each section. With the infinite scroll feature, you can view the contacts continuously as you scroll, without switching between pages.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: When a user lands on the contact list page, the first 100 records are loaded initially. If the user bulk-selects the records, all the 100 records are selected. You can scroll manually to select more records and the records will be automatically selected up to 3000. You can click on the 'Scroll to Top' button to scroll to the top of the list. When selecting contacts in bulk, Recruit CRM offers multiple ways to choose records: Header checkbox: Selects the first 50 loaded records. As you continue scrolling, 50 additional records are automatically selected at a time.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: Custom Record Selection: Click the arrow next to the header checkbox , enter any number between 1 and 3,000 , and click Select to choose the exact number of records based on the current list order. Custom Record Selection replaces any existing manual or bulk selection. Once a custom selection has been applied, automatic scroll-based selection is disabled until the selection is cleared. Only numeric values between 1 and 3,000 are accepted. If a value greater than 3,000 is entered, Recruit CRM displays an error message. When 3,000 records are already selected, the Select All option is disabled. Display of important bulk actions upfront

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: The 5 most commonly used bulk actions are listed upfront by default, and the other options are listed under the 'More' tab. The options to be shown upfront by default can be customized as well. Customization of Bulk Actions to be shown upfront: 1. Click on the 'Customize Bulk Actions' option under the 'More' tab. 2. Move the Options above the dashed line to show them outside the 'More' Dropdown and click on the 'Save' button. How to set up a default bulk action arrangement for the entire account If you are the Account Owner you can set up a default bulk action arrangement on the Contact List Page for all users in the account.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: While customizing the bulk actions, you'll have the option to switch to "Others View". All changes you make in this view will apply to all the users in your account. If you wish to enforce the bulk action arrangement and prevent the users from having a different setup, you can simply tick the checkbox 'Do not allow users of your account to edit their view'. This will ensure that the account owner's bulk actions arrangement remains the same for all users in the account.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: Users with an Admin role or custom permissions will still be able to rearrange the actions even if the toggle is on. ​ If you're creating/editing a custom role, you just need to make sure to enable the "Allow User to Choose their Own Field Order and Visibility" ​ You can click on the arrow button to perform column-level actions: You have the option to pin a column in order to freeze its position at the left/right of the screen, allowing other columns to remain scrollable for improved readability. You can add columns to the right/left of the selected column by clicking the respective 'Add Column to Right/Left' options >>> Select the column >>> Click on 'Apply'.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: Note : Only the hidden columns will be displayed in the list while adding a column to the left or right. Sort the values in the columns in ascending/descending order You can sort the values in the column in ascending or descending order by clicking on the 'Sort Ascending/ Sort Descending' options. You can apply multi-column sorting by clicking the arrow and selecting "Sort Ascending" or "Sort Descending" for different columns. Alternatively, you can hold the Shift key and click on multiple columns to enable multi-column sorting. You can hide a specific column by clicking on the 'Hide Column' option.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: To show/ hide columns, click on the 'Show/Hide Columns' option next to the 'Add Contact' button. You can even view the count of the 'Visible Columns' and 'Hidden Columns' as well. Note: If you pin a column, you will be able to unpin it from the Show/Hide Columns section as well. How to set up a default column arrangement for the entire account If you are the Account Owner, you can set up a default column arrangement on the Contact List Page for all users in the account. While customizing the visibility of columns, you'll have the option to switch to "Others View". All changes you make in this view will apply to all the users in your account.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: If you wish to enforce the column arrangement and prevent the users from having a different setup, you can simply tick the checkbox 'Do not allow users to edit their view': This will ensure that the account owner's column arrangement remains the same for all users in the account. Users with an Admin role or custom permissions will still be able to rearrange the column even if the toggle is on. ​ If you're creating/editing a custom role, you just need to make sure to enable the "Allow User to Choose their Own Field Order and Visibility" ​

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: In the Hide/Show Columns page, searching for a field scrolls to and highlights the matching field(s), with a counter (e.g., 1/2) to jump between matches. You can still drag and drop to reorder columns while a search is active. You can click on the three dots next to each contact under the 'Name' Column to perform the following actions: Increase/Decrease the Width of each column You can hover over the margin next to the column name and drag it to increase/decrease the column width. You can even increase the width of the Quick View section as well. Switch to Classic View in New Advanced Search

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: The “Switch to Classic View” feature allows users to quickly apply filters using the familiar grid modal, making searches faster and more intuitive for everyday workflows. Once switched to Classic View, users continue to see the grid modal by default when clicking Add Filters . Confirmation message appears when switching back to dropdown/compact view, warning that applied filters will be reset. Filters are treated as independent AND conditions. The classic grid view does not support duplicate filters, group filters, or cross-entity filters. The dropdown-based advanced search interface remains fully functional and unchanged.

chunks.t: New Version Of The Contact List Page
chunks.x: You can switch back anytime using the Switch to Compact View button to the New Advanced Search.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM's Mention Feature Helps Your Team Collaborate Faster (New UI)
chunks.x: Need to quickly loop in a teammate on a record? Use mentions to notify them instantly and avoid back-and-forth. The Mention feature in Recruit CRM lets you tag teammates or teams directly in notes on the records. When you mention someone, they receive an in-app notification and an email notification with a direct link to the record where you added the note. If the note is added to a candidate from within a job , the notification also includes the Job Name and Company Name to provide additional context. Email notifications also include the job's primary contact. This helps recipients quickly understand which opportunity the note relates to before opening the record.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM's Mention Feature Helps Your Team Collaborate Faster (New UI)
chunks.x: You want to quickly alert a teammate about an update on a candidate, company, contact, or job record. You need a direct link to a specific record included in an email notification. How to mention your teammate on a record? You can mention your teammates on any record (candidate/company/contact/job) by adding the "@" symbol in the Notes section. Your teammate will get an email notification with a link to the record you mentioned them on. You can see all "mentions" in the Notes section: Important Note: They might need to mark this email as "Not Spam" the first time so that all future "Mentions" show up right in the inbox.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM's Mention Feature Helps Your Team Collaborate Faster (New UI)
chunks.x: You can reply to this email directly to start an email thread with your teammate or click View Mention to open the related record. When the mention is added to a candidate from within a job, the opening line of the email body includes the candidate name, job name, company name, and the job's primary contact, making it easier to identify the context before opening the record. The email subject stays the same either way. If you are on the Business plan and above, you can also mention "Teams" even if you don't belong to that team. ​ However, please note that the tagged user will only be able to see the note if their role has 'View Everything' access:

chunks.t: Recruit CRM's Mention Feature Helps Your Team Collaborate Faster (New UI)
chunks.x: When you edit a note that already has a mention on it, everyone already mentioned continues to be notified by email only - there's no in-app notification for an edit. The email lets them know the mention was updated. If the note is a candidate note added from within a job, this email also includes the job name, company name, and primary contact for that job. If your edit mentions someone for the first time, they instead get the standard mention notification described earlier in this article, both in-app and by email, since it's a new mention for them. Problem: The tagged user cannot see the note on the record. Likely cause The user role does not have “View Everything” access.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM's Mention Feature Helps Your Team Collaborate Faster (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check Confirm the user’s role and permissions, especially access to 'View Everything' on that record type. The Account Owner should update the user’s role permissions or assign a role with “View everything” access so they can see the note. Can I mention teammates on any type of record? Yes. You can mention your teammates on any record, including candidates, companies, contacts, and jobs. Do mention notifications include job details? Yes. If a mention is added to a candidate note from within a job , both in-app and email notifications include the Job Name and Company Name so recipients can quickly understand which opportunity the note relates to.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM's Mention Feature Helps Your Team Collaborate Faster (New UI)
chunks.x: Which job is shown if a candidate is associated with multiple jobs? Notifications display the Job Name and Company Name of the job pipeline where the note was originally added. Other manually associated jobs are not included. Do email notifications include additional information? Yes. In addition to the candidate , job , and company names, email notifications also include the job's primary contact in the subject line. What happens when multiple candidates are mentioned from the same job?

chunks.t: Recruit CRM's Mention Feature Helps Your Team Collaborate Faster (New UI)
chunks.x: When mentions are created for multiple candidates within the same job, the notification groups them together under the same Job Name and Company Name , followed by the list or count of the affected candidates. Does this apply to notes created from the candidate profile? No. The additional job and company context is only included for notes added to a candidate from within a job . Notes created directly from the candidate profile continue to display the standard notification. Follow the steps above to mention individual users or teams, ensure emails reach their inboxes, and keep everyone aligned on key updates. Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: ✨ What this feature does and when to use it? The Candidate Custom Field Parsing Agent uses AI to analyze resumes and automatically fill candidate custom fields based on the Field Description configured for each field. This works across supported sources such as resume uploads, job board applications, Chrome Extension imports, and other external candidate sources. This feature is especially useful when you: • Want to automatically extract information from resumes and populate selected candidate custom fields during parsing. • Want to reduce manual updates after resume parsing. • Need more consistent candidate data across records.

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: The Field Description acts as an instruction for the AI and helps define what information should be extracted from the resume and populated into that field. More specific descriptions generally produce more accurate results. To maintain reliable performance, parsing can be enabled for up to 10 candidate custom fields per account. Fields with parsing enabled display a purple parsing icon in the custom field list for quick identification. 1. Go to Admin Settings in Recruit CRM and navigate to the Candidate Fields under Data Customization. ​ ​2. Enable AI Parsing for Candidate Custom Field: Enabling it while creating New Custom Candidate Fields:

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: 1. On the Candidate Data Customization page, click the + New Custom Field button to create a new candidate custom field. ​ 2. Enter the Field Name and choose the appropriate Field Type. 1. Certain field types are not supported for parsing, such as: For these field types, the ‘Enable Parsing Agent’ option will not be shown while creating or editing the field. 2. Additionally, Dropdown and Multi-Select fields support parsing only when they contain 100 values or fewer. If these fields contain more than 100 values, the parsing option will remain disabled, and you will not be able to enable parsing for that field.

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: 3. In the Field Description area, write a clear description as the field description helps the AI understand what type of information should be extracted and what kind of value is expected in the field. Make sure that the description is between 30 and 500 characters . The Enable Parsing Agent checkbox remains inactive until a valid description is entered. ​ 💡 Example Field Description: For a certifications field: "Identify and list all professional certifications and industry-specific qualifications mentioned in the candidate's resume." For a notice period field: "Extract the candidate's stated notice period or availability to start, expressed in weeks or months."

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: 4. Once a valid description is added, the Enable Parsing Agent checkbox becomes active. Select the checkbox and save the field to enable AI parsing for that custom field. After the field is saved with parsing enabled, the live parsing counter updates automatically to reflect the total number of parsing-enabled fields in the account. 5. Once the custom field is saved with parsing enabled, the AI will automatically attempt to extract and populate values for that field during resume parsing. Enabling AI Parsing for an Existing Candidate Custom Field: 1. On the Candidate Custom Fields page, locate the existing field you want to update. Open the field for editing by clicking on the pencil icon.

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: 2. Add or update the Field Description to clearly explain what information should be extracted and what kind of value is expected. Ensure it meets the 30 to 500-character requirement. ​ Once a valid description is present, the Enable Parsing Agent checkbox becomes active. Select it to enable parsing, or clear it to disable parsing for this field. ​ 3. Review the live parsing counter to ensure the total does not exceed 10 enabled fields , and save your changes. 📌 Note: You cannot change the field type of an existing candidate custom field. Recruit CRM allows AI parsing to be enabled for up to 10 candidate custom fields per account. Follow these steps to manage the parsing limit:

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: Go to Admin Settings → Data Customization → Candidate Custom Fields . Review the live parsing counter displayed on the page (for example: 07/10 ) to see how many fields currently have parsing enabled. Open any parsing-enabled custom field that is no longer required. Disable the Enable Parsing Agent option for that field. Save the changes to make that parsing slot available again. You can then enable parsing for another custom field as needed. 📌 Please note: Once the limit of 10 parsing-enabled fields is reached, the Enable Parsing Agent option becomes unavailable for additional fields until an existing parsing-enabled field is disabled.

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: If a candidate custom field is configured as a child field, the parent field must first be configured correctly before parsing can be enabled for the child field. Before enabling parsing for a child field, ensure that the parent field: Has a valid Field Description between 30 and 500 characters. If these conditions are not met, the following message will appear: “Add description and enable parsing for parent field to parse child field”. Complete the parent field configuration first, then return to the child field and enable parsing. Problem: “Enable Parsing Agent” checkbox is disabled and cannot be selected

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: Likely cause: No valid Field Description has been entered, or the description does not meet character limits. ​ Confirm that the Field Description field is filled and check that the description meets the minimum and maximum character limits: Edit the Field Description to be within the allowed character range. Once valid, confirm that the Enable Parsing Agent checkbox becomes active and then select it. Problem: Cannot enable parsing for another custom field Likely cause: The account has already reached the maximum of ten candidate custom fields with parsing enabled. ​ Review the live parsing counter on the Candidate Custom Fields page. ​

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: Identify fields that currently have parsing enabled but are less critical. Edit one or more of those fields and clear the Enable Parsing Agent checkbox to reduce the count. Then enable parsing on the new field you want to prioritize. Problem: AI parsing is enabled, but the custom field remains empty after resume parsing The resume does not contain information matching the field description. The Field Description is too vague or unclear for the AI to interpret. Review the Field Description and confirm it clearly states what information should be extracted and in what form. Check the resume to verify that the expected data actually appears.

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: Improve the Field Description to be more specific about the information and value format. Test with another resume that clearly includes the target information. Problem: Unable to change the field type of an existing candidate custom field Likely cause: Existing system behavior does not allow editing the field type of already created candidate custom fields. If a different field type is required, create a new candidate custom field with the desired field type and, if needed, enable the parse agent for that new field. Why is the “Enable Parsing Agent” option disabled? The “Enable Parsing Agent” option can remain disabled for multiple reasons: A valid Field Description has not been added.

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: The Field Description contains fewer than 30 characters. The field type is File, Entity or Date-Time, which are not supported for parsing. The Dropdown or Multi-Select field contains more than 100 values. The account has already reached the maximum limit of 10 parsing-enabled custom fields. The Field Description helps the AI understand what type of information should be extracted from resumes and what kind of value is expected in the field. This additional context helps improve parsing accuracy and ensures the extracted information is mapped correctly. Can existing custom fields also be configured for parsing?

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: Yes. Users can edit existing custom fields, add a valid field description, and enable parsing for those fields. How can users identify which fields have parsing enabled? Fields that have parsing enabled will display a purple parsing icon in the custom fields list. How many candidate custom fields can I enable for AI parsing? You can enable AI parsing for a maximum of 10 candidate custom fields per account. The live parsing counter on the Candidate Custom Fields page shows how many fields currently have parsing enabled, for example 04/10. When the limit is reached, you must disable parsing on an existing field before you can enable it on a new one. ​

chunks.t: Custom Field Parsing Agent
chunks.x: Which field types support the parsing agent? Text and Number fields are fully supported. Dropdown and Multi-Select fields are supported only when they contain 100 values or fewer. File, Entity, and Date-Time fields do not support the parse agent and the Enable Parsing Agent option will not appear for those field types. AI parsing for candidate custom fields helps you reduce manual data entry and improve data consistency by extending resume parsing to the custom fields that matter most to your workflows.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Indeed XML Feed integration allows you to automatically publish sponsored jobs from Recruit CRM to Indeed using an XML feed. Once configured, eligible jobs are sent directly to your Indeed paid feed, while applications submitted through Indeed are redirected to Recruit CRM and automatically added to your database. This helps streamline job advertising and applicant management without requiring manual posting. 📌 Please note: Indeed only supports sponsored job postings through this integration. Free job postings are not supported. • You want to post and sponsor jobs on Indeed directly from Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: • You need to automatically publish eligible jobs to an Indeed XML feed. • You want applications from Indeed to flow directly into Recruit CRM and track candidates by their application source. ​ The integration lets you selectively include or exclude jobs from the XML feed, automatically assign XML feeds to new jobs, and ensure all Indeed applicants are captured within Recruit CRM, making it easier to manage job advertising and candidate sourcing from a single platform. How to get a job posted on the Indeed XML Feed Note: All new and existing accounts are required to verify the account starting January 1, 2025.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The first step is to make sure your account is verified with Recruit CRM from the account management settings. Here, fill in all the account information and click on "Verify Account". In case the auto-verification fails, you have the option to send a manual request to our team. Once the account is verified, you will receive an in-app notification and email notification that your account is enabled for job postings on Indeed. In case you update any account information, you will have to verify the account again. 2. Making sure your jobs meet Indeed's publishing criteria Please note that users on Recruit CRM's free plan can not integrate with Indeed. Criteria to push the jobs to the XML feed

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. The job application form should be enabled. This can be enabled while creating or editing the job. 2. The Updated On date should be within the last 30 days; 3. All the fields where you see the message "Required To Post On Partner Job Boards" (City, State, Country, Maximum Salary, Job Description, Currency, Salary Type) need to have a value. Adding city, state, country, and postal code fields is mandatory only if the job type is hybrid or onsite. If it's remote, it's not mandatory. 4. 'Note for candidates' should be filled in (only if the Job Description is uploaded as a file) 5. The "Post On Job Boards" option should be selected inside Admin Settings >> Job Custom Fields .

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 6. The job status should not be 'closed', 'on hold' or 'canceled'. 7. Jobs posted on Indeed should be EEO compliant. Discrimination on the basis of age, sex, marital status, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, or disability is not tolerated. Discrimination based on language is not permitted either. If point 7 is not complied with, it could result in a ban of your with Indeed. 8. The job description should be well-formed with at least 300 characters. Emojis are not allowed in the description and the title. 9. You need to sponsor your jobs on Indeed. Free posting is not allowed as per the Indeed guidelines.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM can take action against accounts if any spam or fraudulent job is posted to Indeed. Only the job types full-time and part-time are mapped to the Indeed field. Experience is considered as minimum experience. For instance, if you add 5 years on Recruit CRM, on Indeed it will reflect as 5+ years. Salary description on Indeed is based on how salary fields are added: If Max salary = Min Salary, the salary field will have a single value (e.g., "Pay: $15 per hour"). If Max salary > Min salary, the salary field will have a range between two amounts (e.g., "Pay: $10-15 per hour"). If only Min salary is present, the salary field will have “from” (e.g., "Pay: From $10 per hour").

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: if only Max salary is present, the salary field will have “up to” (e.g., "Pay: up to $10 per hour"). If you don't want to share salary information this field can be left blank and salary will not appear on the XML feed. 3. Select "Indeed" under the XML Feeds section: You have the ability to selectively push job postings to specific XML feeds. While adding/editing a job, you'll get an option to select the XML feeds from both the default and custom XML feeds that you have built, provided the 'Post on Job Board' option is enabled from the Job Fields settings .

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: While creating a new job or editing an existing one, make sure you select "Indeed" in the XML Feeds section to get your jobs posted on the correct XML Feed. ​ By selecting the appropriate XML feeds, you can ensure that your jobs reach the intended audience through the most relevant job boards. You also have the option to preselect the XML feeds in the Build Job Feed XML page. This means the XML Feed will automatically be selected for all the new jobs created. ​ If you don't want a job to be automatically posted on the Indeed XML Feed, you can simply disable the preselection on the Build Job Feed XML or uncheck the XML Feed while creating/editing the job:

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The jobs will be indexed to Indeed and other external boards only if the requirements given above are met. After fulfilling the necessary criteria, the jobs will be visible on the Indeed XML Feed. The next step is to copy and integrate the XML Feed URL with Indeed. 1. To access the XML feed, go to Admin Settings >>>> Build Job Feed XML . 2. Click on the XML Feed URL for Indeed. ​ 3. You'll be redirected to a new page with the XML Feed page source. Copy the URL and submit it to your Indeed account manager.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: First, an Indeed account must be created for the integration to work. If you have a paid Indeed account, you'll have a dedicated account manager and can share the XML feed with them directly. How to verify which jobs are being pushed to the Indeed XML Feed You can check the list of jobs being pushed to Indeed's XML Feed by going to Admin Settings >>>>>> Build Job Feed XML . Here you can click on "View Listed Jobs" to get a list of all the jobs in your account that currently meet the required criteria: You can also run an Advanced Search inside the Jobs List Page to see all the jobs that have been posted on Indeed (including old jobs that are no longer being pushed to the XML feed). ​

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If one of your jobs is not on the list, one of the necessary criteria is not being met. Applicants will be auto-directed to your Recruit CRM Job Application forms and they will be directly added to your Recruit CRM database. How will you get applications for the jobs? When a candidate fills out the application form, you'll be notified in Recruit CRM. You can see all the website applicants on the candidate list page . You can also specifically look for Indeed applicant candidates in your database by enabling the Source field in Candidate Fields : ​

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: With the Source field, you'll be able to track the origin of how the candidate was added to the system. If the candidate applies externally, the name of the job board will be mentioned in the field: ​ You can even run an Advanced Search on the Source field: Problem: A job is not appearing in the Indeed XML feed (or on Indeed) Likely cause : One or more required criteria for Indeed publishing are not met. Confirm the job application form is enabled. Check that the job’s “updated on” date is within the last 30 days. Verify all fields marked as “required to post on partner job boards” (city, state, country, maximum salary, job description, currency, salary type, etc.) are filled.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: For onsite or hybrid jobs, confirm city, state, country, and postal code are filled. Ensure the job status is not closed, on hold, or canceled. Make sure the job description is at least 300 characters and does not contain emojis in the title or description. Confirm Post on Job Boards is enabled for the relevant fields and the Indeed XML feed is selected for that job. Resolution : Fix any missing or invalid fields, update the job, and re-check the View Listed Jobs list on the Build Job XML Feed page to confirm the job appears. ​ Problem: The account cannot post jobs to Indeed from Recruit CRM Likely cause : The Recruit CRM account is not verified or is on the free plan.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Verify that the account has completed the Verify Account process under Account Information . Check whether the account is on the free plan (free plan users cannot integrate with Indeed). Complete the account verification process or request manual verification if auto-verification fails. Use a plan that supports Indeed integration instead of the free plan. ​ Problem: Jobs are on the XML feed but not accepted by Indeed Likely cause : Jobs may not comply with Indeed’s policies or sponsorship requirements. Ensure jobs are sponsored on Indeed (free posting is not allowed).

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Confirm that job content is EEO compliant and does not include discriminatory language (age, sex, marital status, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, disability, or language). Verify that job descriptions are clear, at least 300 characters, and do not use emojis. Update job content to remove any non-compliant language and meet Indeed’s guidelines. Confirm with your Indeed account manager that the sponsored posting and XML feed have been correctly configured. ​ Problem: You cannot identify which candidates applied via Indeed Likely cause : The source field is not visible or not used in candidate views and filters. Ensure the source field is enabled in candidate fields.

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Confirm that you are viewing or filtering by the source field on the candidate list page. Enable and display the source field in your candidate view. Use advanced search or filters on the source field to find candidates whose source is Indeed. ​ Problem: You cannot see the XML feeds option to select the specific XML feed while Editing or Adding a job. Likely Cause: The Post on Job Boards option is disabled. What to Check: Head over to the Admin Settings and navigate to the Job Fields settings. From here, ensure that the Post on Job Boards is toggled on. Resolution : Toggle the Post on Job Boards option and then check again. Q1: Do I need to sponsor jobs on Indeed to use this integration?

chunks.t: Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. You must sponsor your jobs on Indeed. Free posting is not allowed as per Indeed’s guidelines. Q2: Can I use this integration on the Recruit CRM free plan? No. Users on the free plan cannot integrate Recruit CRM with Indeed. By verifying your Recruit CRM account, meeting Indeed’s publishing criteria, configuring the XML feed, and monitoring listed jobs, you can reliably post and sponsor jobs on Indeed while keeping all applications and candidate data centralized in Recruit CRM. If you need further assistance, review the troubleshooting steps above or contact your Recruit CRM and Indeed support contacts for help with specific integration issues.

chunks.t: Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Placements help you keep track of candidates placed in specific jobs under specific companies. Recruit CRM makes this easier by giving you simple ways to filter, update, and avoid duplicate placements. You can see all your placements on the Placements list page: You can customize the Placement list view by selecting which fields are displayed and arranging them in your preferred order. This helps you focus on the information that matters most to you. ​ Click on the 'Show/Hide Columns' button at the top right corner of the page. ​ Select the fields you want to display and deselect the ones you don’t need. Arrange the fields in your preferred order by dragging and arranging the list.

chunks.t: Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Whenever you update a candidate’s hiring stage, you’ll get the option to create a Placement. Option 1: From within the candidate's profile: Go to the candidate's profile and click on the Assigned Jobs tab. This will have a list of jobs that the candidate has been assigned to: Click on the hiring stage of the candidate and you will get a drop-down menu of the stages you created like Shortlisted, Assigned, Rejected, and many more. After selecting the appropriate stage, ensure to select the 'Create Placement' checkbox for creating a placement: ​Go to the Job details page and open the Candidate Pipeline tab. This will have a list of candidates assigned to the job:

chunks.t: Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Click on the Hiring stage for the candidate - you will get a drop-down menu of the different stages like Shortlisted, Assigned, Rejected, and many more. You can select the appropriate stage, make sure to tick the 'Create Placement' checkbox for creating a placement: When marking a candidate as Placed, you will have an option to update the candidate's current organization and Job Title using the "Update Candidate's Current Organization and Job Title" checkbox. Checking it lets you edit the pre-filled job title (in case it needs to differ from the job's own title) before submitting, so both the candidate's organization and title update together in one step.

chunks.t: Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: You can also change the hiring stages on the “List view” and “Kanban view” of candidates within a job. To do that click on the blue "View All" button: Now on the List View, you can click on individual hiring stages and update it, and make sure to select the 'Create Placement' checkbox for creating a placement: On the Kanban board view, you can simply drag and drop the candidate across the hiring stages and select the 'Create Placement' checkbox for creating a placement. Note: The 'Create Placement' checkbox will remain disabled when you are updating the hiring stage of candidates in bulk.

chunks.t: Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: When you create a new placement from a job or candidate profile, the system will automatically pre-fill the Candidate, Company Contact, and Job fields. 🛠️ How to create custom fields for placements? If you have specific requirements, you can include custom 'Placement' fields to store additional details as needed. This can be done from the Placement Fields page . chunks.t: Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)

Then choose the field you want to filter by (for example, Candidate or Job): You can use Boolean search to quickly find specific placements by applying keywords and conditions to narrow down your results. ​ To make placement tracking more organized, you can use the Group By option to view placements based on related records. Click on Group By at the top right of the Placement list page. Select how you want to group placements (Jobs, Deals, Companies, or Contacts).

chunks.t: Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)

If the Archive option is not immediately visible, click on More to find and select it.
