chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: The Resume Formatting Agent helps you automatically generate well-structured resumes using AI, without needing to manually format them. Once you define your preferred layout and style, every resume follows the same consistent format, making your submissions more polished and efficient. Resume generation works for one candidate at a time (bulk generation is not supported). The Resume Formatting Agent is available across supported plans with plan-specific generation limits. It runs on the gpt-oss-120b (Cerebras) model.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Free and Pro users can generate up to 5 resumes per user. The 5-resume limit applies only to new resume generations. Editing an already generated resume does not count toward this limit. AI edits consume 0.5 Recruit CRM credits per edit. Manual edits and restoring previous versions do not consume credits. The Resume Formatting Agent helps you quickly create formatted resumes with AI. You can set your preferred style and structure using presets or custom instructions, and the system will automatically apply this format every time a resume is generated using the Agent. Open " Admin Settings " and access the " Resume Formatting Settings ". ​

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Access the "Resume Formatting Agent" from the panel on the right. ​ Select one of the available presets , which provide a predefined structure and style for the resume. Alternatively, you can create your own format by adding custom instructions in the Instruction box. You can also choose a preset and modify its instructions to better match your requirements. • Forest Minimal – Clean, minimal, and modern; suitable for general recruitment across most industries • Executive Prestige – Dramatic and prestigious; ideal for executive search and board-level roles • Bold Editorial – Bold and typographic; best suited for senior, creative, or editorial roles ​

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Configure additional options to control how the resume is generated and what information it includes. Choose Custom Field to Save Resume You can decide where the generated resume will be saved by selecting a File type custom field . You can either choose an existing file field or create a new one directly from here. A File type custom field must be selected to save generated resumes. If no field is selected, you will be prompted to choose or create one before proceeding. ​ If a resume already exists in the selected field, you will have the option to replace it. When a resume is replaced, the older version is automatically moved to the Files section to help prevent data loss. ​

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Custom Fields to include in Formatted Resume You can include additional candidate information in the resume by selecting up to 10 default or custom candidate fields you want to display. You can also include Candidate Owner Name, Email, and Phone number. Note: All candidate custom field types are supported except File and Entity fields. Long Text fields support content up to 1000 characters. ​ Information used to generate the formatted resume: The information provided to the AI depends on whether the candidate has an existing resume:

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: If the candidate has a resume: The AI uses the resume text along with the 10 fields selected in Resume Formatting Settings . These can include default fields, custom fields, and Candidate Owner Name, Email, and Phone number. If the candidate does not have a resume,  the AI uses the candidate's basic details and work history , along with the 10 fields selected in Resume Formatting Settings, which may include: Basic details: First Name, Last Name, Email, Contact Number, Position, Last Organisation Professional information: Summary, Qualification, Specialization, Work Experience, Current Salary, Salary Expectation, Notice Period, Willingness to Relocate

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Location and address: Locality, City, State, Country, and Address Skills and languages: Skills and Language Skills Personal details: Gender, Age, and Date of Birth Social profiles: LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, GitHub, and Xing Profile information: Profile Picture and Resume Filename Only the information provided to the AI during generation is available for use when making AI edits to the generated resume. Include your company logo You can choose to include your company logo in the resume. The logo is fetched from your Public Job Page settings : If a logo is not available or the option is disabled, the resume will automatically adjust and be generated without branding. ​

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Text Redaction on Resume You can choose to hide sensitive candidate details such as Phone, Email and LinkedIn. These selected fields will be automatically excluded from the resume. Tip: If you want to hide additional details (such as name or location), you can mention this in your instructions. ​ Click Preview to see how the resume will look. It is recommended to review the preview at least once before saving to ensure the formatting and layout appear as expected. ​ Click "Save Instructions" to apply your configuration. Once saved, the same format is used whenever you generate a resume for any candidate. ​

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: The AI may not always follow instructions perfectly and can sometimes produce slightly inconsistent results. We recommend previewing the generated resume and refining instructions if needed. ​ If EEO settings are enabled, sensitive information such as Age, Gender, and Ethnicity will automatically be excluded from the formatted resume. You can generate AI Formatted Resumes from multiple places such as: Navigate to the Generate Resume with Agent option at the top of the candidate’s details page. If the option is not visible among the default actions, click on the three dots (⋯) and select Generate Resume with Agent from the list ​

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: On the Candidate List page, click on the candidate’s resume that you want to generate using the agent. Once the resume preview panel opens, click Generate Resume with Agent from the bottom of the preview window. ​ Once a resume is generated, you can edit it directly from the preview using AI instructions, voice commands, or manual edits. Enter a natural-language instruction to make changes to the resume, such as rewriting the summary, making content more concise, or improving a section. Use the built-in rich text editor to make direct changes to the resume. Please note: Manual edits do not consume credits or count toward the AI edit limit and can be combined with AI edits.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Use voice input to give instructions to the AI Editor. Your voice instruction is converted to text and processed as an AI edit. Please note: AI edit instructions must contain between 15 and 500 characters . Each successful AI edit is added to Edit History during the current editing session. You can view previous AI instructions, restore a previous version, and continue editing from the restored version. You can make up to 15 AI edits per session . Restoring a previous version does not consume credits. Please note: Edit History is available only during the current editing session.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: The updated resume replaces the existing version in the configured custom field, while the previous version is moved to the Files section. You can also download the current version during the editing session without saving it. Each AI edit consumes 0.5 Recruit CRM credits . If the required candidate information wasn't provided during generation, you can include it directly in your edit instruction. If a valid instruction is processed but the required information is unavailable, the credit is still consumed.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: If you don't have enough credits, the AI edit won't be processed, and no credits will be deducted. You'll see an Insufficient Credits message with an option to purchase additional credits. Please note: AI editing is available only during the active editing session after generating a resume. Once you save or discard the changes and close the preview, you must generate a new resume to edit it again. The agent provides ready-made resume styles to help you get started: • Executive Prestige : Premium and high-impact ​

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Selecting a preset automatically fills in the instruction field, which you can further edit if needed. You can also reset your setup back to the default preset and instructions at any time (with confirmation). 💡 Best practices for writing instructions To ensure your resumes look consistent and professional, it’s important to define each part of the layout clearly. The clearer your instructions, the more consistent and professional your resumes will be. Here’s what you should cover:

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: • Define the overall style and colours clearly Describe the look and feel (for example, clean, minimal, or executive) and specify exactly where each colour should be used. Avoid vague terms and use precise values where possible. • Specify font styles and usage Mention which fonts should be used for headings and body text. If using multiple fonts, clearly define where each should apply. • Structure the header clearly Define what should appear in the header (name, contact details, profile picture) and how it should be aligned and displayed. • Define section order and layout List sections in the exact order you want them to appear and specify how each section should be structured.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: • Define content formatting rules Specify how experience and other sections should be displayed (bullet points, summaries, tone, etc.). • Define footer content and layout Specify what should appear in the footer (such as confidentiality notes or company details) along with its styling and alignment. • Define logo placement and branding Clearly mention if and where your company logo should appear and how it should be displayed. • Handle missing data carefully Only show sections or fields when data exists. Avoid displaying empty sections.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: • Define custom field usage Clearly mention which custom fields to include, where they should appear, and how they should be displayed. Custom fields are display instructions only. The actual field values are entered separately each time a resume is generated - not stored in your instruction. Click here to view a template that might help with custom fields CUSTOM FIELDS - Include the following custom fields in the resume: [Field name]: show in [location - e.g. header / below contact details / end of resume] Display as: [e.g. plain text / label and value / italic note] - If a custom field has no value, do not show it - skip entirely

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Make sure your instructions are detailed enough and clearly describe the expected format, tone, and structure. You can use the template below as a starting point, simply fill in each section based on your preferences and paste it into the agent. Feel free to remove any sections that aren’t relevant to your requirements.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: OVERALL STYLE Describe the mood in a few words - e.g. clean and minimal / bold and editorial / prestigious and executive. COLOURS - Header background: [colour name or hex code] - Body/page background: [colour] - Accent colour (section titles, highlights): [colour] - Body text colour: [colour] FONTS - Heading font (name, section titles): [e.g. Lora / Cormorant Garamond] - Body font (labels, content, descriptions): [e.g. Nunito / Outfit] HEADER - Height: [e.g. 150px / full bleed] - Alignment: [left-aligned / centre-aligned] - What to show: [name, title, email, phone, LinkedIn, address] - Field labels: never show field names - values only (no "Email:", "Phone:" - just the value itself) - Profile picture: if provided, show circular top-left / show circular left of name / if absent, do not reserve space BODY SECTIONS List the sections in the order you want them to appear: 1. [e.g. Summary] 2. [e.g. Work Experience] 3. [e.g. Education] 4. [e.g. Skills] 5. [e.g. Certifications] 6. [e.g. Languages] 7. [e.g. Any additional details] - Section title style: [e.g. bold, accent colour, uppercase] - Spacing between section titles: [e.g. 10px] - Spacing between section title and content: [e.g. 5px] WORK EXPERIENCE - Format: [e.g. job title and company bold, dates right-aligned] - Descriptions: convert to bullet points only if descriptive content exists - otherwise show role, company, and dates only - Location: show after company name - e.g. Recruit CRM, New York - Bullet count: reflect only available data - do not force a specific number - Bullets must end with a period EDUCATION - Format: [e.g. degree and university bold / two-column table with dates on the right] SKILLS - Format: [e.g. inline dot-separated / round pills / square pills / grouped] SUMMARY - Use exact verbatim content from source / rewrite as third-person executive summary CONTENT TONE - [e.g. neutral and factual / elevated third-person / outcome-driven with strong verbs] - Avoid generic adjectives: excellent, dynamic, results-driven - Remove all personal pronouns: [yes / no] PAGE MARGINS - [e.g. no margin on any side / standard margins] FOOTER - [e.g. full-width header colour background, centre "CONFIDENTIAL" in red uppercase 9px / none]

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: • Always preview before saving, as the saved version is used every time. • Your latest saved instructions are applied to all newly generated resumes. Please note: Once you save or discard the changes and close the preview, the editing session ends. To edit the resume again, you must generate a new AI-formatted resume. • The system generates resumes based only on your current instructions and does not remember previous outputs. • Make sure your instructions are clear and specific; any missing detail will be interpreted by the system, which may lead to inconsistent results. • Do not include candidate-specific data in your instructions.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: • You must either select a preset or add your own instructions, empty inputs are not allowed. • If you're unsure where to begin, start with a preset and refine it with small updates instead of building from scratch. • If something looks incorrect, adjust only that specific section and preview again rather than rewriting everything. • All resumes are generated as structured PDFs. • All saved configurations (preset, instructions, branding, data settings, storage) are applied globally across the platform for consistency. Refer to the Dos and Don’ts below to ensure your instructions are clear, consistent, and effective -

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Provide an exact hex code for every colour - e.g. #1e4d3b not just "forest green". Define Heading, subheading, body, etc. fonts clearly. Define the section order explicitly - list every section in the sequence you want. State that field labels must never appear in the header - values only. Cover profile picture scenarios - provided and absent. Instruct the agent to skip any section or field that has no data. State that candidate name is always the largest, most prominent element for a professional look. Specify bullet point rules - when to use them, how many, and that they end with a period. Preview before saving every time you make a change.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Define Brand Name in the main instructions if needed. Avoid vague instructions like “make it look professional”. Don't leave section order unspecified - the agent will decide its own order and will bring inconsistent outputs. Don't show empty sections - if there is no data for certifications, languages, or any other section, it must not appear at all. Don't reserve space for a profile picture when none is provided. Don't forget to save instructions after making changes and previewing it - unsaved edits are not saved automatically ​ If something looks wrong, click here and try these steps before rewriting your instructions

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Rephrase the specific rule that is not working - use direct, explicit language. Instead of "the header should feel clean and minimal", write "the header background is #1e4d3b, height 150px, no borders or dividers anywhere." Check for contradictions - if two parts of your instruction say different things (e.g. "left-align the header" in one place and "centre-align all text" in another), the agent will guess which to follow. Find and remove the conflict. Add more detail, not just different wording - if a section is rendering incorrectly, be more specific about that section rather than rewriting the whole instruction.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Preview before saving changes - after adding/updating the instructions, always preview before saving the changes. If an issue keeps recurring - repeat the rule in a second place. For critical layout rules like name prominence or section order, stating them twice reinforces the behaviour. The agent fills in anything you do not specify. Every gap in the instruction is a design decision the agent makes on its own. The more complete your instruction, the more consistent your output will be across different candidates. Do I need to configure the Resume Formatting Agent feature before using it to create an AI resume?

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: No. A default configuration (Forest Minimal preset) is already available, so you can start using the Resume Formatting Agent without any initial setup. Although you do need to select a custom field to save the generated resume. No. Resume generation is limited to one candidate at a time. Where will the generated resume be saved? The resume will be saved in the configured custom field. If no field is selected, you will be prompted to choose or create one before proceeding. What happens if a resume already exists in the selected custom fields? You will get an option to replace the existing resume. The older resume will be saved in the Files section.

chunks.t: Resume Formatting Agent
chunks.x: Are these settings applied per candidate or globally? All saved configurations (preset, instructions, branding, redaction, storage) are applied globally across the platform. Editing a preset will remove its selection and the system will treat it as a custom instruction setup. What happens if I leave the instruction field empty? The system will mark it as invalid and prompt you to either enter instructions or select a preset before proceeding. The Resume Formatting Agent helps you standardise resume formatting across your team, ensuring every candidate profile is presented in a clean, consistent, and professional manner with minimal manual effort. 🤖

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM's Calling feature, powered by Twilio , lets you call candidates and contacts directly from within the platform, eliminating the need to switch to an external calling application. • You want to call candidates or contacts directly from Recruit CRM. • You need to use the built-in native dialer available on the Pro Plan and above. The Calling feature helps streamline your communication workflow by allowing you to place calls, optionally record conversations, and store call logs and notes within the candidate or contact record, ensuring all communication history remains centralized and easily accessible.

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The calling/auto-dialer feature is available on the Pro plan and above. Due to local guidelines, Twilio will no longer allow domestic outbound calls between +91 (Indian) numbers. International calls placed from Indian numbers will still be supported. Based on Twilio guidelines, the phone number verification method has been updated. To continue using calling services, please verify your phone number using the new verification process added here . 📞 How to set up calling integration in Recruit CRM? There are two ways to add the calling number to the system: Navigate to your Profile section and add the phone number under the 'Phone' field:

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Once the phone number is added in Recruit CRM, open the candidate/contact profile. Click on the phone number of the candidate/contact, and the system will ask you to verify your number. Click on the 'Verify your number to make calls' option, then click on 'Proceed'. The system will show a pop-up containing the 6-digit verification code as shown below. You will receive an incoming call from Twilio to the number you added to verify the number. After answering the call, open the dialer section on your phone and enter the 6-digit code shown on the pop-up in Recruit CRM. Once added, the number will be verified.

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Click on the candidate's/contact's phone number and, in the pop-up window, add the phone number (if not added from the Profile Settings ). Once added, click on 'Proceed', the system will show a pop-up containing the 6-digit verification code. You will receive an incoming call from Twilio to the number you have added. After answering the call, open the dialer section on your phone and enter the 6-digit code shown on the pop-up in Recruit CRM. Once added, the number will be verified. If you haven't used our calling service before, you can try it with free calling credits available on the Free plan - no upfront cost required!

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Pro Plan and Business Plan : Pro and Business Plan users can try the Calling feature using the free Recruit CRM Credits . Enterprise Plan : Users will receive the Calling credits included with their Recruit CRM subscription. To check if you have free calling credits: Go to Admin Settings -> Phone Calling & SMS settings . Look for the "Limited Free Credits Available" message, which indicates available credits for local calls (not international). Note: Free credits apply only to calling and do not include texting functionality.

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If you haven't used the entire free credit in previous calls, you can continue making calls until it’s fully used, provided the remaining balance is enough for at least one more minute of calling. Each free credit call will automatically disconnect once it reaches a 5-minute duration limit. Now, to start making calls through Recruit CRM, you'll have to buy calling credits. ⬅️ Here's how you can buy calling credits 💰 Navigate to the Admin settings -> Phone Calling and SMS settings Click on the green 'Buy Calling Credits' button: Add the credit amount by clicking on the " +" button, you can check the amount on the right side:

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Confirm the default payment method or add another card to make the payment. You can check the prices on Twilio by clicking on the link below: https://www.twilio.com/voice/pricing/us The actual cost paid by you is (Local Call Pricing + Browser/App Call Pricing + Recording Pricing (if applicable)) x 1.25 and this includes us storing the call for you as long as you use Recruit CRM Once the number is verified and credits are added, click on the phone number of a candidate/contact and the system will open a pop-up to make a phone call: You'll see the "To" and "From" numbers along with an option to record the call.

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If you wish to record a call, switch to YES, tick the consent box to confirm, and click on the green 'Call' button to start the call. You'll hear a calling tone and the phone will start ringing. You can take call notes on the screen, those will be added to the 'Notes & Calls' section on the record. Once the call is over, you'll get another screen to add more details about the call, including the Call Type. Click here to know how to customize the call type! 🎧 Call recording permissions in Recruit CRM Click here to learn about Call recording permissions 📋 How to transcribe calls in Recruit CRM? Click here to learn how to transcribe the calls

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 📲 How to use the native dialer to call from the system? Click here to learn to use your native dialler for calling! Problem: Unable to place domestic outbound calls between +91 Indian numbers Likely cause : Twilio no longer allows domestic outbound calls between +91 Indian numbers. What to check : Confirm that both the caller and recipient numbers are +91 Indian numbers and that the call is domestic. Resolution: Use international calling where supported, or use an alternative method for domestic calls between +91 Indian numbers, as this restriction is enforced by Twilio and cannot be overridden in Recruit CRM. Problem: Call cannot be placed despite having credits

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: Phone number might not be verified, credits might not be sufficient for at least one more minute, or Twilio restrictions may apply. Confirm your phone number is verified via the six-digit code process. Check the remaining balance and ensure it is enough for at least one minute of calling. Review Twilio limitations relevant to your country, especially for +91 Indian numbers. Top up calling credits if the balance is low. Adjust your calling strategy to comply with Twilio’s guidelines Q1: Which plans support calling in Recruit CRM? The calling feature is available on the Pro plan and above. Q2: Do I need to verify my phone number to use calling?

chunks.t: Setting up calling in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. Based on Twilio’s updated guidelines, you must verify your phone number using the new verification process, which involves receiving a Twilio call and entering a six-digit code shown in Recruit CRM. Q3: Are domestic calls between +91 Indian numbers supported? No. Due to local Twilio guidelines, Twilio will no longer allow domestic outbound calls between +91 Indian numbers. International calls placed from Indian numbers are still supported. Q4: Do free credits cover international calls or texting? No. Free credits are for local calls only and do not apply to international calls. Free credits also apply only to calling and do not include texting functionality.

chunks.x: You can now set up Twilio-powered calling in Recruit CRM, verify your number, manage free and paid credits, and place calls to candidates and contacts directly from the platform. Texting Candidates/Contacts in RecruitCRM (New UI) Call Recording Permissions in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: The Candidate Submission Agent is designed to simplify and standardize how you can send candidate submission emails to clients. It enables you to generate AI-powered, structured, and professionally formatted submission emails directly from the candidate submission flow, while allowing control over instructions, layout, and branding through Admin Settings. Reduce manual effort in drafting submission emails Ensure consistency in client communication Improve the overall presentation of candidates Note: The Candidate Submission Agent runs on the gpt-oss-120b (Cerebras) model. ✨ How to use the Candidate Submission Agent

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: The feature is designed to be simple and flexible, allowing you to either use a ready-made format or create your own. Open " Admin Settings " and navigate to " Fields Shared with Clients ". ​ Access the Candidate Submission Agent from the panel on the right. ​ Select from one of the available presets , which provide a predefined structure and styling for your submission email. These presets help you get started quickly with a ready-made format that you can use as-is or customise further. Alternatively, you can create your own format by adding custom instructions in the Instruction box. You can also select a preset and tweak its instructions to better match your requirements.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Navy & White (Professional) – Clean and corporate layout with a deep navy header, white candidate cards, and blue accent labels. Best suited for formal hiring briefs in industries like finance, legal, or technology. • Dark Gold (Editorial) – Premium and editorial style with a near-black header, warm beige background, and gold accents. Ideal for executive search or boutique recruitment. • Talent Grid (Spreadsheet-Style) – Compact and data-focused layout where all candidates are displayed in a single table format. Best for internal hiring teams or quick comparison use cases. ​ Click Preview to see how the email will look. ​

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: If satisfied, click Save Instructions . If the generated layout does not fully match your expectations, click Regenerate to create another version using the same instructions and overall structure. ​ Saving instructions is allowed only after previewing. The AI may not always follow instructions perfectly and can sometimes produce slightly inconsistent results. We recommend previewing the generated template and refining instructions if needed. The email layout may vary slightly depending on the recipient's inbox (e.g., Gmail or Outlook). Once saved, the system keeps the structure fixed and simply fills in candidate and job data each time you send an email. ​

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: To use the configured template, go to the job you are working on and click on Submit Candidates . Then select Email with Attachments and Candidate Grid . Make sure the Candidate Submission Agent toggle is turned ON to generate the AI-powered submission email. The Candidate Submission Agent toggle state will persist based on the user’s last action. This behaviour is user-specific and applies across all jobs. Example: If a user turns OFF the toggle while submitting candidates for a job, the toggle will remain OFF the next time they initiate candidate submission (via Email with Attachments and Candidate Grid method) for any job, until it is manually turned ON again.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: You can continue with your submission process, and if needed, edit the generated email (subject, recipients, and content) before sending. ​ The candidate details shown in the email are based on the " Fields Shared with Clients " settings: Any updates made at the global level (via Admin Settings) will apply to all existing and future jobs. If fields are updated for a specific job, then the candidate submission email for that job will follow the job-specific field configuration. This ensures consistency while still allowing flexibility. ​ The agent provides built-in templates to help you get started quickly: • Navy White (Professional): A clean and professional layout

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Dark Gold (Editorial): A more premium/editorial style ​ • Talent Grid (Spreadsheet-Style): A compact grid-style format for quick comparison Selecting a preset automatically fills in the instruction field, which you can further edit if needed. You can also reset your setup back to the default preset and instructions at any time (with confirmation). Clicking on the 'Reset' option restores the default preset along with the default instruction prompt. 💡 Best practices for writing instructions To ensure your submission emails look consistent and professional, it’s important to define each part of the layout clearly. Here’s what you should cover:

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Define the overall theme and colours clearly Describe the look and feel of your email (for example, corporate, minimal, or premium). Specify exactly where each colour should be used, such as the header background colour, accent elements colours (labels, borders), page background colour, and card or content background colour. Avoid vague terms like “use blue” and instead use precise values (like HEX codes) to ensure consistent results. "The header should have a dark navy background. Use a bright blue as the accent colour for labels and borders. The page background should be a very light blue-grey. Candidate cards should have a white background with a 4px blue left border."

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Specify font styles and usage across sections Mention which fonts should be used for headings, candidate names, and body text. If you want a single font throughout, state that clearly. If you prefer a mix (for example, serif for headings and sans-serif for body), define it for each section to avoid mismatched or inconsistent text styling. "Use Arial throughout - for headings, labels, and all body text. No serif fonts anywhere." Or "Use Georgia for the candidate name and headings. Use Arial for all labels, body text, and tags."

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Structure the header layout in detail The header appears at the top of every email and contains the job role name, your company name, and optionally your logo and the client's logo. Clearly define what the header should include and how it should appear. This can include a small top label, the main job title, company name, and logo placement. Also describe styling such as font size, alignment, and positioning of each element. A well-defined header ensures every email looks structured and branded.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: "The header should have a small eyebrow label at the top that always reads: CANDIDATE SHORTLIST · CONFIDENTIAL. Below that, a large heading that says 'Top Talent for' followed by the job role name on the next line in the accent colour and italic. Below the heading, a smaller line showing 'Presented by [my company name]' in grey italic. If a logo URL is provided, show it as a circular image in the top right corner of the header."

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Define how candidate information should be displayed Specify whether candidates should appear as individual cards or in a table format. Also describe how each field should be shown (for example, label-value pairs, inline text, or tags), how the candidate name should be highlighted, and how each candidate section should be separated. This helps avoid issues like misaligned fields or inconsistent layouts.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: "Each candidate should appear as a separate card with a white background and a 4px blue left border. The candidate name should be the largest and most prominent element in the card. Below the name, show other details as label-value pairs - the label on the left in small uppercase blue text, and the value on the right in normal black text. Labels and values must always be on the same line, never stacked. Separate each card with a thin horizontal line." "All candidates should appear as rows in a single data table. Each column corresponds to a candidate field. The candidate name column should use a slightly larger bold font. Alternate row backgrounds between white and very light grey."

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Define the overall layout style Clearly specify whether the email should follow a card-based layout, table/grid format, or any other structure to ensure consistency across all submissions. • Provide complete instructions for logo handling Clearly explain how logos should appear, including their position, shape (for example, circular), and alignment. Most importantly, define all scenarios: when both logos are present, when only one is available, and when no logos are provided. This prevents broken layouts or empty placeholders in your emails.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: "Logos should always appear as circular images in the top right corner of the header, aligned to the top of the header text. If both a client logo and my company logo are provided, show the client logo on top and my company logo below it with a small gap between them. If only one logo is provided, show just that one logo. If no logos are provided, remove the logo column entirely - do not show an empty space or placeholder."

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Define the footer content and styling Specify what should appear in the footer, such as a confidentiality note, company name, or contact details. Also define its background colour, text style, alignment, and any borders or separators. A consistent footer ensures your emails look complete and professional. "The footer should have a white background with a 2px blue top border. Show a confidentiality note in small grey text centred or left-aligned." "The footer should match the header - dark background, small light-coloured text centred. The format should be: Prepared by [My Company Name] · [Email Address] · Strictly confidential."

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: Make sure your instructions are detailed enough (minimum 30 characters required), not too short and clearly describe the expected format, tone, and structure. You can use the template below as a starting point, simply fill in each section based on your preferences and paste it into the agent. Feel free to remove any sections that aren’t relevant to your requirements.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: OVERALL THEME The email should have a [describe mood: e.g. corporate / editorial / minimal] feel. COLOURS - Header background: [colour name or hex code, e.g. dark navy / #0f2d4a] - Accent colour (labels, borders, highlights): [colour] - Page/email background: [colour] - Card/content background: [colour] FONTS - Heading and candidate name font: [e.g. Arial / Georgia] - Body text and labels font: [e.g. Arial] - Serif or sans-serif preference: [serif / sans-serif / mixed] HEADER - Eyebrow label (small top line): [e.g. CANDIDATE SHORTLIST · CONFIDENTIAL / none] - Main heading wording: [e.g. Top Talent for [job role]] - Job role styling: [e.g. on second line, accent colour, italic] - Meta line: [e.g. Presented by [my company name], grey italic] - Logo position: [e.g. top right, circular / none] CANDIDATE LAYOUT - Layout style: [individual cards / table rows] - Candidate name: [e.g. largest element, bold, top of card] - Other fields: [e.g. label-value pairs on same line / inline dot-separated / table cells] - Card separator: [e.g. thin horizontal line / alternating row colour / top border] LOGOS - When both logos provided: [e.g. client logo on top, my logo below, 6px gap] - When one logo provided: [e.g. show that logo only] - When no logos provided: [e.g. hide the logo column entirely] - Logo style: [always circular] FOOTER - Background: [colour] - Top border: [e.g. 2px accent colour / none] - Text: [e.g. confidentiality note in small grey text] - Format: [e.g. Prepared by [Company] · [Email] · Strictly confidential]

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Always preview before saving, as the saved version is used for all future submissions (you cannot save without previewing). • Your latest saved instructions are applied every time, and the structure remains fixed, only the candidate and job data change. • The system generates results based on your instructions each time and does not remember previous outputs. • Make sure your instructions are clear and specific; avoid vague inputs to prevent inconsistent results. • Do not leave the instruction field empty; you must either select a preset or add your own instructions. • Do not include candidate or job-specific details in your instructions.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • If you're unsure where to begin, start with a preset and refine it with small changes instead of rewriting everything. • If something looks off, adjust only that specific section and preview again. • Place important instructions earlier in your input for better results. • Only the first 20 visible candidates are included in the email. • All saved configurations (preset, instructions, branding) are applied across all jobs for consistency. Refer to the Dos and Don’ts below to ensure your instructions are clear, consistent, and effective - ​

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Be specific about where each colour is used (for example, header background, labels, borders) • Clearly define all logo scenarios (both logos, one logo, or no logo) • Ensure label and value appear on the same line if using a card layout • Use one of the built-in presets as a starting point if unsure • Always preview your instruction before saving

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: • Avoid vague instructions like “make it look professional” • Do not include candidate or job-specific details in your saved instruction • Do not rely on the system to remember previous outputs • Avoid using technical terms unless you are confident; simple language works best • Do not skip logo instructions, as this can lead to broken or misaligned layouts Do I need to configure this feature before using it? No. A default configuration (Talend Grid preset) is already available, so you can start using the Candidate Submission Agent without any initial setup. Why am I unable to save my instructions after editing them?

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: If you modify the default or preset instructions, the system treats it as a custom configuration. In such cases, you must preview the output first, after which the Save option will be enabled. Can I switch back to the default email while editing? Yes. While editing the AI-generated draft, you can switch back to the default email format if required. Can I still send emails without using AI? Yes. You can turn OFF the Candidate Submission Agent toggle and proceed with the default email flow. Are these settings applied per job or globally? All saved configurations (preset, instructions, branding) are applied globally across all jobs.

chunks.t: Candidate Submission Agent
chunks.x: Editing a preset will remove its selection and the system will treat it as a custom instruction setup. Can I edit the AI-generated email before sending? Yes. You have full control to modify the subject, recipients, and content before sending the email. What happens if I leave the instruction field empty? The system will mark it as invalid and prompt you to either enter instructions or select a preset before proceeding. The Candidate Submission Agent helps you present candidates in a consistent, polished, and client-ready format while reducing manual effort. Once set up, it becomes a reliable way to standardise how you share talent across all your submissions. 🧠

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)
chunks.x: What does this feature do & when to use it? The Work and Education History feature lets you store candidates' work or education details as separate categories in their profiles. You can easily add work and education history while adding a candidate by scrolling down the Add Candidate form. You can use this when: You are adding a new candidate and want to capture their work and education history immediately. You want to view all saved work and education details in a single place in the candidate profile. You need to add additional work experience or education entries to an existing candidate. You want to clean up a profile by deleting outdated or incorrect work or education records.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)
chunks.x: You should have access to add and edit candidate records in your account. Have the candidate’s work experience and education details ready (job titles, companies, dates, institutions, degrees, etc.). Remember that work and education details are stored as separate categories under the Work and Education History feature. How to Add Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles 📗 1. Click on the Global Add plus icon in the top-right corner of the screen. This opens the main menu to create a new record. 2. From the dropdown menu, select Candidate to open the Add Candidate form.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. In the Work History and Education History sections, enter all the required details for the candidate’s work experience and education. These two sections here store candidates' work or education details as separate categories with the Work and Education History feature. 4. When finished, click the Submit button to save the candidate record. How to View Saved Work and Education History in the Candidate Profile? 👀 Once the details are added and the record is saved, open the candidate’s profile. Within the Details area, locate the Work History and Education History categories.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)
chunks.x: You can easily expand the collapsible section from the categories to move across the fields and view more information by clicking on this. Use the expanded view to review or scroll through all stored fields for each entry. Identifying Missing Work or Education History On the Candidate List page, “Not Available” is displayed when a candidate does not have any work history or education history. This makes it easier to identify missing information at a glance. ​ How to Add Additional Work Experience or Education Entries? 📚 1. In the same Details section, click Add Experience to add more work history entries, or Add Education to add additional education records.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)
chunks.x: How to Delete Work or Education History Entries? ❌ 1. Deleting work or education history from a candidate profile is easy. 2. To delete an existing work or education entry, click on the trash icon against the field that you no longer require. 3. A confirmation pop-up menu will appear. 4. When the confirmation pop-up appears, click Sure to confirm deletion and remove the entry from the candidate’s profile. Problem: Work or education details are not visible in the candidate profile Likely cause: The sections were not filled out or the record was not saved.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: Confirm you scrolled down the Add Candidate form, entered the details in Work History and Education History, and clicked Submit. Resolution path: Edit the candidate, add the missing details in the Work History and Education History sections, and save again. Problem: Cannot find the Work History or Education History sections Likely cause: You are not looking under the All Details section or the categories are collapsed. What to check: Open the candidate profile and go to All Details. Check under Details for Work History and Education History and see if they are collapsed.

chunks.t: Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)
chunks.x: Resolution path: Expand the collapsible section from the categories by clicking on it and then drag or scroll to move across the fields. Managing work and education history in candidate profiles is straightforward: add details while creating the candidate, review and expand them under All Details, and use Add Experience, Add Education, and the trash icon to keep records accurate. I Hope this helps. chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Free job posting automatically sends eligible jobs to partner job boards through XML feeds, helping you advertise roles across multiple platforms without manually posting on each one. Applications received through these job boards are automatically captured in Recruit CRM as candidate records. This feature is especially useful when you want to: • Advertise jobs on multiple free job boards automatically. • Receive applications directly into Recruit CRM. Recruit CRM posts eligible jobs to the following ten free partner job boards:

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Adzuna, Post Job Free, My Job Helper, Jooble, and Twine: You must explicitly select them in the XML feeds field when adding or editing each job. Jooble Direct Apply: On Jooble, applicants see a Direct Apply option rather than being redirected to your application page. Recruit CRM will not receive data for any custom fields or mandatory fields you have added to your application form when candidates apply through this method. Admin access required for global settings: Only users with access to Admin Settings can configure Job Fields, Job Custom Fields, and Build Job Feed XML. Recruiters and team members handle job-level settings only.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: This is a free integration: Recruit CRM includes your job in the XML feed when it meets all criteria, but each partner job board makes its own decision about whether to publish the job. Meeting all requirements in Recruit CRM does not guarantee the job will appear on every board. The first step is to make sure all the necessary criteria are met for the jobs to be visible on the XML Feed and posted on the free job boards. 1. Enable global settings for Job Application form visibility Before jobs can be posted to free job boards, the required account-level settings must be enabled. Go to Admin Settings in Recruit CRM and open Job Fields under the Data Customisation section.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Ensure the Default Job Application Form Visibility checkbox is enabled.Once the Default Job Application Form Visibility is enabled, make sure to select the Post on Job Boards option. If this setting is disabled, jobs will not be posted on your website or partner job boards. ​ 2. Enable the Job Application Form for the job. In the Add/Edit Job form, scroll to the Job Application Form section and make sure the checkbox for Enable Job Application Form is selected. 3. Keep the “Updated On” date within the last 30 days. The job must have been updated within the last 30 days. Jobs that have not been updated during this period are excluded from the XML feed. ​

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 4. Fill in all fields marked “Required to post on partner job boards” Open the job form and fill in all fields labeled Required to post on partner job boards . This currently includes fields such as City, State, Country, Maximum Salary, Job Description, Currency and Salary Type. ​ Please note: • Both full names and initials are accepted in required fields. • Required fields may change over time based on partner job board requirements. 5. Fill the “Note for candidate” field when using a file-based job description If the Job Description is uploaded as a file instead of entered as text, the Note for Candidate field must also be completed for the job to qualify for posting.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 6. The job status should not be 'closed', 'on hold' or 'cancelled'. A job must have the status set to Open in order to be eligible for posting on job boards in Recruit CRM. Jobs with statuses like Closed, On Hold, or Cancelled cannot be posted. ​ 7. Select “Free Job Boards” in the XML Feeds section. Recruit CRM allows you to selectively push jobs to specific XML feeds, helping you control which job boards receive each posting. While creating or editing a job, locate the XML Feeds field and select Free Job Boards from the available feed list. Save the job after making your selection.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If you want the job to appear on specific partner job boards such as Adzuna, Post Job Free, My Job Helper, Jooble, Twine, make sure those boards are also selected in the XML feed options for that job. • Default XML feeds provided by Recruit CRM • Custom XML feeds created by your team Please note that XML feed selection will only work if the Post on Job Board option is enabled under the Job Fields settings, as mentioned in Step 1. You can also preselect XML feeds from the Build Job Feed XML page. When preselected, those XML feeds will automatically be selected for all newly created jobs. ​ If you do not want a job to be posted to the Free Job Boards XML feed automatically, you can:

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: • Disable the XML feed preselection from the Build Job Feed XML page, or • Manually uncheck the XML feed while creating or editing the job. ​ • Jobs will only be indexed and pushed to external job boards if all the eligibility requirements mentioned above are met. • Once all required details are added, the job goes through a review process. If everything is fine, Recruit CRM pushes the job to partner job boards automatically. • Since this is a free integration, the final decision to publish the job remains with the respective job board. Each partner board follows its own review criteria, and some jobs may not qualify based on their internal requirements.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Use the following three methods to confirm that a job is live on partner job boards. ​ Method 1: Check the Build Job Feed XML Listing Go to Admin Settings → Build Job Feed XML . Click View Listed Jobs for the Free Job Boards feed or for the other Job Boards that you have selected. Review the list. All jobs that currently meet all eligibility criteria will appear here. If a job is missing from the list, at least one eligibility criterion is not being met." ​ 💡 Tip: You can also run an Advanced Search on the Jobs List page to view all jobs where XML feeds have been selected. ​ Method 2: Search the Partner Job Board Website Directly

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Go to the relevant partner job board website, for example, ZipRecruiter or Talent.com. Search for the job by title, location, or other identifying details to check if the job was posted. Once the candidate clicks on the " Apply on Website " button, they will be redirected to your website where the job is posted. There they can read the job description and apply for that job. Method 3: Track Applications via the Source Field Enable the Source field in Candidate Fields if it is not already visible on candidate records. When a candidate applies externally from a job board, the Source field on their candidate record will display the name of the job board they applied from.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: You can run an Advanced Search on the Source field from the Candidate List page to filter and see all candidates who came from specific job boards. Get applications for jobs posted on free job boards When a candidate fills out the application form (either via your website or through an Apply on Website button on a job board), Recruit CRM will: • Add the application as a candidate record. 1. Go to the Candidate List page and use Quick View to see all website applications. 2. Review the Source field for each candidate to confirm which job board the application came from. If you want to post jobs on other portals that are not part of the free partner job boards:

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Go to the Jobs page in Recruit CRM and open the specific job you want to post. 2. Copy the job application URL inside the job. • On social media platforms. You can know more about sharing jobs on Social Media here . • In adverts or listings on job boards you already partner with. 5. Optionally, you can create your own custom XML feed: • You can build a custom XML feed to integrate directly with other job boards. • Configure this in the Build Job Feed XML area, then select this custom feed in the job’s XML feeds section when adding or editing the job. Click here to learn more about building your own XML Feed Problem: The job is not visible on free job boards

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause : One or more eligibility criteria are not met, or the job is not included in the Free Job Boards XML feed. ​ • All fields labeled Required to post on partner job boards (e.g., City, State, Country, Maximum Salary, Job Description, Currency, Salary Type) have values. • Note for candidate is filled if the job description is uploaded as a file. • Job status is not Closed , On Hold , or Canceled . • Free Job Boards (and any specific job boards like Adzuna, Post Job Free, My Job Helper, Jooble, Twine) are selected in the XML feeds section. ​ In Admin Settings : • Default Job Application Form Visibility box is ticked in Job Fields .

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: • Post on job boards option is enabled under the Default Job Application Form Visibility in the Job Custom Fields section. ​ ​ Resolution path : 1. Correct any missing or invalid fields in the job. 3. Ensure the Free Job Boards XML feed is selected for the job. 4. Re-save the job to refresh its Updated On date if needed. 5. Allow some time for the XML feed to update and the partner job boards to pick up the change. Problem: Job removed from free job boards Likely cause: One or more required posting settings were disabled, or required fields were cleared, causing the job to be removed from the XML feed.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: • Whether the Job Application Form was disabled • Whether the Post on job boards option was unchecked • Whether any required posting fields were left blank • Whether the job status was changed to Closed , On Hold , or Canceled Change the job status back to an active status if required Save the job again to re-add it to the XML feed Problem: Job not visible despite meeting all requirements Likely cause: The correct XML feed or intended partner job boards were not selected for the job.

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: • Whether Free Job Boards is selected in the XML Feeds section • Whether the intended partner boards (such as Adzuna, Jooble, Post Job Free, etc.) are selected • Whether the XML feed configuration is enabled correctly Edit the job and review the XML feed selections Select the correct XML feeds and partner boards Allow some time for the XML feed and external job boards to refresh and publish the job. Who controls whether my job actually appears on a job board?

chunks.t: How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM includes your job in the Free Job Boards XML feed when all eligibility criteria are met, but each partner job board makes its own decision about whether to publish the job based on its own criteria. Because this is a free integration, Recruit CRM cannot guarantee that every eligible job will be published on every board. Can I stop specific jobs from being posted on free job boards? Yes. You can uncheck the Free Job Boards XML feed for an individual job in the XML Feeds section when creating or editing it. If you want to stop all jobs from being posted automatically, you can disable the pre-selection setting in Build Job Feed XML.

chunks.x: Free job posting in Recruit CRM lets you publish eligible jobs to multiple partner job boards automatically. Please feel free to reach out using our chatbot if you have any further questions. How Free Job Board Posting Works in Recruit CRM Integrating Indeed With Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: The New Company Details Page
chunks.x: The new Company Details page in Recruit CRM brings a cleaner layout, smarter organization, and greater customization across every section. From managing company details to tracking activity and assignments, the updated UI helps streamline everyday recruiting tasks. ✨ Here is the list of all the key features: The new UI allows you to perform a wide range of company-related actions directly from the top corner of the company profile. You can perform several actions for a company directly from the details page, including: Linking the company to parent and child companies

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature allows you to add, view, edit, and manage a candidate’s Work experience and Educational details directly within the candidate's profile. Candidate Work and Education History can be edited in multiple ways: 1. Open the relevant candidate profile in Recruit CRM and click on the Edit Candidate button (pencil icon). 2. Scroll down to the Work History or Education History section you want to update. Click on the pencil icon within that section, make the required changes, and then click Save to apply them.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Note: In the Description box, you can also format text using Bold, Italics, Underline, Bullet points, Numbered lists, and even add Hyperlinks. Once you're done, hit the "Submit" button. You can also edit Candidate Work and Education History from the "Details" tab under candidate profiles by clicking on the "pencil" icon. Customizing the Candidate Work and Education History section You just need to follow these simple steps: 1. Go to Admin Settings and click on Candidate Fields under data customization.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 2. Click on the "pencil" icon against the work or education history section to change the section name. You can also show/hide the education or work history sections using the toggle beside the section name. 3. You can turn the visibility toggle on/off to show/hide a field on the "Add Candidate" and "Edit Candidate" forms. You can also make a field "Required" by hitting the checkbox against it. By making a field mandatory, you and your team will not be able to add/edit a candidate without filling in some data in these "required" fields.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Note: The "Educational Qualification" under the Education History section and the "Title" under the Work History section are default fields and can not be edited. P.S. You can see multiple cascading-type sections divided into different categories in the admin settings. How are Work and Education History entries handled within Recruit CRM? When a candidate's resume is updated, the system identifies any manually added or edited work and education history entries. We understand the importance of the effort put into customizing the profiles, so we retain these specific entries.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Simultaneously, we automatically replace the remaining entries with the most recent data from the uploaded resumes. This ensures that you have access to the most up-to-date work and education history. In cases where you use our Chrome extension to source and parse resumes, the override data option plays a crucial role. When the override data option is turned on, the system will replace all the work and education history entries with the data extracted from the resume, regardless of whether they were manually added or edited.

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: However, when the override data option is turned off, no changes will be made to work and education histories. This gives you more control over the data allowing you to retain manually added or edited information. If a candidate manually enters their work and education history using the talent pool, or job application form, or when a candidate updates their resume from the profile update form, we preserve their entries in the original form. ​ However, when the work and education history details are sourced from a resume then the information provided by the external forms is replaceable. Do visibility and required settings apply to all users?

chunks.t: Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. Changes made in Candidate Fields apply account-wide to all users working with candidate profiles. Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles Managing Candidate Work & Education History in Recruit CRM Adding Work & Education History in Candidate Profiles (New UI)

chunks.t: Integrating Xobin to Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Integrating Recruit CRM with Xobin brings AI-powered skill assessments directly into your hiring workflow , allowing you to evaluate candidates more efficiently and track results within the same platform. Integrating Xobin with Recruit CRM helps streamline your hiring process by bringing skill assessments directly into your recruitment workflow . It enables you to automate candidate evaluation while maintaining full visibility into their performance, all without leaving Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Integrating Xobin to Recruit CRM
chunks.x: • Automatically send assessments when candidates move to a specific stage • Track assessment progress without switching platforms • View scores and detailed reports directly within candidate profiles • Reduce manual follow-ups and administrative effort • Make more objective, skill-based hiring decisions This setup is especially useful for recruiters, HR teams, and hiring managers looking to improve screening efficiency and accuracy. It works particularly well for teams hiring at scale, where automated assessments and structured evaluation help speed up decision-making while maintaining consistency across roles. Follow these steps to connect Recruit CRM with Xobin:

chunks.t: Integrating Xobin to Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Navigate to the Admin Settings in your Recruit CRM account and then go to the API & Integrations section. Make sure to turn the toggle on to enable the API token and then copy the API key. Only the Account Owner or a user on custom role with the necessary permissions to access the API token can manage the API key. Log in to your Xobin dashboard and navigate to Settings → Integrations → Recruit CRM . Paste the API key and click Connect Recruit CRM . Link your Recruit CRM jobs with relevant Xobin assessments. • Define the candidate stage that will trigger the assessment • Set the final status to be applied once results are received Save the mapping once the relevent options are selected.

chunks.t: Integrating Xobin to Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Once the setup is complete, assessments are triggered automatically when a candidate’s stage is updated to the selected trigger stage configured during mapping. Simply open a job in Recruit CRM and update the candidate’s status to the mapped stage. The system will automatically send the assessment invite to the candidate. You can review assessment results directly within Recruit CRM. Open the job, go to the candidate, and click View Remarks to see the assessment summary. You can also click View Report to access a detailed report with performance insights, score breakdown, and evaluation details.

chunks.t: Integrating Xobin to Recruit CRM
chunks.x: This integration helps you streamline candidate evaluation, reduce manual effort, and make faster, more informed hiring decisions, all within your existing workflow. ​ Hope this helps! 😄 Connecting Recruit CRM & other apps with Workflow Automation Integrating Recruit CRM with your Broadbean account How to Review Assigned Candidates with AI Using Recruit CRM MCP

chunks.t: Contact Stage (Sales Pipeline) (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Contact Stage indicates where a contact (client) is in your sales or marketing funnel. Track a contact's progress through your sales pipeline. Update the stage of one or multiple contacts. View the complete history of stage updates for a contact. chunks.t: Contact Stage (Sales Pipeline) (New UI)

Select the required stage from the dropdown, enter a reason for the change, and save your update. chunks.t: AI Email Reply Suggestions
chunks.x: AI Email Reply Suggestions help you respond to emails faster by automatically drafting replies based on the latest message and conversation context. This reduces repetitive writing while keeping you fully in control, allowing you to review, edit, regenerate, or refine the response before sending. When you click Reply or Reply All , the system analyzes the most recent email along with the conversation thread (up to the last five messages) to generate a relevant and professional reply. The suggestion loads in the background, so you can continue typing without any interruption. Click on Reply or Reply All from the Mailbox or Related Emails section. ​

chunks.t: AI Email Reply Suggestions
chunks.x: An AI Suggestion Card appears at the bottom of the compose window with a short preview (first two lines) of the reply. The suggestion loads asynchronously, allowing you to continue typing while it is being generated. You can click View More to expand and read the full response, and scroll within the card if the content is longer. ​ Click Insert to add the reply to the email editor. If you have already typed content, the AI reply will be inserted above it. Once inserted, the suggestion card will automatically close, and the inserted content remains fully editable. ​

chunks.t: AI Email Reply Suggestions
chunks.x: If the suggestion does not match your requirement, you can click Regenerate to create a new version, which replaces the previous suggestion without affecting any text already written in the editor. For more specific changes, you can click Customize to open AI Assist and refine the response with additional instructions. ​ Use the toggle in the compose window to control how AI suggestions appear. The toggle is ON by default, and you can turn it OFF to hide suggestions if needed. Your preference is remembered during your session and resets to the default state (ON) when you log in again. ​

chunks.t: AI Email Reply Suggestions
chunks.x: Optionally, provide feedback on the suggestion using 👍 or 👎 to help improve future responses. Feedback can be submitted once per suggestion. ​ Once ready, review your email and click Send . The suggestion card will automatically disappear when the email is sent, the compose window is closed, or after the suggestion has been inserted. ​ This feature works seamlessly across both the Mailbox and Related Emails sections and supports multiple languages, automatically generating replies in the same language as the incoming email for a consistent communication experience. Will the AI suggestion interrupt my typing?

chunks.t: AI Email Reply Suggestions
chunks.x: No. The email editor remains fully editable while the suggestion is being generated. Yes. Once inserted, the reply is completely editable. What happens if the suggestion isn’t useful? You can regenerate the reply or open AI Assist to customize it further. Does the feature work with non-English emails? Yes. Replies are generated in the same language as the incoming email. How many previous emails are considered when generating a reply?

chunks.t: AI Email Reply Suggestions
chunks.x: The system considers up to the last five messages in the email thread when generating the AI suggestion. If fewer than five messages exist, all available messages are used. The most recent inbound email is given the highest priority to ensure the reply aligns with the latest context. Is there a limit to the use of this feature? Yes, the AI-Assist feature has monthly token limits that vary based on your plan. Token usage includes both input and output, and may vary depending on the language and content. • Free Plan – 50K tokens • Pro Plan – 5 million tokens • Business Plan – 10 million tokens • Enterprise Plan – 20 million tokens These limits apply to the following AI features:

chunks.t: AI Email Reply Suggestions
chunks.x: • Generate Note Summary • Generate Call Log Summary • Generate Email Template • Generate Email • Generate Email Sequence • Email Reply Suggestion • Generate Candidate Summary • Generate Job Description Note: These token limits currently do not apply to AI Sourcing and AI Boolean Search .

chunks.t: Adding Files & Creating Folders (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM provides a dedicated Files section for every Candidate, Contact, Company, and Job record, allowing you to upload, organize, and manage documents directly within the platform. You can create folders, rename files, reuse saved files by attaching them to file-type fields or emails, and access everything without needing to re-upload them from your device. File size limit: Each individual file must be 8 MB or smaller. • You need to store candidate, contact, company, or job-related documents in one place. • You want to organize files into folders within a record.

chunks.t: Adding Files & Creating Folders (New UI)
chunks.x: • You frequently reuse the same documents in fields or emails and don’t want to re-upload them. How to access the Files tab on the Record Profile Every record in Recruit CRM has a Files tab where files can be stored and accessed. Open any Candidate, Contact, Company, or Job record. Click the Files tab in the horizontal navigation bar, located below the record's information overview. ​ From here, you can view, download, upload, and organize all files linked to that record. You can add files to a record in two ways: Click the upload area or the Upload button, then select a file from your computer. Drag a file from your desktop and drop it directly into the Files section.

chunks.t: Adding Files & Creating Folders (New UI)
chunks.x: You can also rename files stored in the Files section to keep them organized and make them easier to identify. Locate the file you want to rename in the Files Tab. Click the three-dot menu (⋯) next to the file. Enter the new file name and click Save . ​ Folders help you keep documents organized within a record's Files section, for example, separating resumes from offer letters. Click the Create Folder button on the right side of the Files section. Enter a name for the folder in the pop-up dialog. Once the folder is created, you can click into it to upload files directly, or drag and drop files into the folder.

chunks.t: Adding Files & Creating Folders (New UI)
chunks.x: Click the three-dot menu (⋯) next to any folder to access the Rename or Delete options. If a record has file-type fields (for example, a Resume field on a Candidate), you can populate those fields directly from the record's Files section, no need to re-upload a file from your computer. This works for Candidates, Contacts, Companies, and Jobs. Click the pencil (edit) icon next to the file-type field you want to fill. Click the dropdown arrow next to the upload button and select Select From Saved Files . A list of files already uploaded to that record will appear. Select the file you want. Clicking a file name opens a preview before you confirm the selection.

chunks.t: Adding Files & Creating Folders (New UI)
chunks.x: Only files uploaded to the record you are currently editing appear in the list, keeping the selection clean and secure. You can still choose Upload File from the same dropdown to upload a new file directly from your computer. This feature works in both the Edit form and directly on the file fields visible on the record page. When composing an email inside Recruit CRM, you can attach files that are already saved on any record, no need to download them to your computer first. In the email composer, click the dropdown arrow next to the Upload From Device button.
