chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Contact Stages help you track where each contact is in your sales pipeline. You can customize these stages to match your business process, set a default stage for new contacts, and use them to organize and filter contacts more efficiently. Create custom contact stages for your sales process. Set a default contact stage for new contacts. Update a contact's stage as they progress through your pipeline. Filter contacts based on their current stage. Please note: Only Account Owners, Admins, and users with permission to the Contact Stages section in Admin Settings can create or customize Contact Stages.

chunks.t: Customizing And Using Your Contact Stages (New UI)
chunks.x: Navigate to Admin Settings , under CRM Process Customization, click Contact Stages . Click the Pencil icon to edit your contact stages. To create a new stage, scroll down and click Add Stage . Enter the stage name. If you'd like it to be the default stage for newly created contacts, select the Default checkbox. You can also drag and reorder existing stages to match your preferred workflow. To delete a contact stage , click the – (minus) icon next to the stage you want to remove. ​ 📌 Please note: Once a contact stage is deleted, any contacts currently assigned to that stage will have their Contact Stage set to Empty . This action cannot be undone.

chunks.t: Customizing And Using Your Contact Stages (New UI)
chunks.x: Once your Contact Stages are configured, you can update a contact's stage directly from the Contact List by selecting the appropriate stage from the Stage dropdown. You can also use Advanced Search to filter contacts based on their current Contact Stage. Problem: I can't edit or create Contact Stages. Likely Cause: You don't have the right set of permissions. What to Check: Verify that you're logged in as an Account Owner, Admin, or on a custom role with permission to access Contact Stages section in Admin Settings. Resolution: Only Account Owner and Admin users can create, edit, reorder, or delete Contact Stages. Contact your Account Owner or Admin if you need assistance.

chunks.t: Customizing And Using Your Contact Stages (New UI)
chunks.x: Customizing Contact Stages helps you tailor Recruit CRM to your sales process and keep your client pipeline organized. By creating meaningful stages, setting a default stage, and filtering contacts based on their progress, you can easily monitor and manage your client relationships. Customizing And Using Your Contact Stages Customize Your Hiring Pipeline And Create Multiple Hiring Pipelines

chunks.t: How to use the Global Search Bar in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The Global Search Bar is accessible from every page in the platform, making it the fastest way to locate candidates, contacts, jobs, companies, or deals when you already know a key detail. The Global Search Bar is located at the top of your screen and is available across all the entities. What can you search for with the Global Search? Using the Global Search, you can search for any of the following entities: This grouped view makes it easy to identify the correct record type and navigate directly to it. You can use the Global Search Bar to look up records using key identifiers such as: Name / ID (Candidate, Contact, Company, etc.)

chunks.t: How to use the Global Search Bar in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Simply type any of the above details into the search bar, and Recruit CRM will fetch all matching records across entities. Global Search looks for records using a specific set of fields for each entity to return the most relevant matches. Candidate ID, Name, Phone Number, Email Address, LinkedIn Profile Company ID, Company Name, Website, LinkedIn Profile Contact ID, Name, Phone Number, Email Address, LinkedIn Profile Global Search also interprets your search input. Alphanumeric searches (such as names, email addresses, job titles, or LinkedIn URLs) are matched against relevant text-based fields.

chunks.t: How to use the Global Search Bar in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Numeric searches (such as phone numbers or record IDs) are matched against supported numeric fields. This helps return more relevant results based on the type of information you're searching for. How does the View More Records option work in the Global Search If your search returns more results than can be displayed in the preview of the Global Search results, click View More Records to open the complete search result list for that entity. The expanded results use the same search logic as the initial Global Search, helping ensure the records shown remain relevant and consistent. The selected Global Search filter is automatically applied to the list page.

chunks.t: How to use the Global Search Bar in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can apply additional filters or perform a Boolean Search to further narrow down the results. The Global Search filter remains applied as you navigate between list pages until you remove it using the × icon. While the Global Search filter is active, Saved Search is unavailable. You will have to remove the Global Search filter to enable the Saved Search again in this view. ​ Q. Which fields does Global Search search? Global Search searches a predefined set of fields for each entity, such as names, IDs, email addresses, phone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, company names, and job titles. Q. Can I apply additional filters after clicking View More Records in the Global Search results?

chunks.t: How to use the Global Search Bar in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Yes. After opening the full Global Search results, you can apply additional filters or use Boolean Search to further refine the results. Q. Why is the Saved Search option unavailable after clicking View More Records? When you open the expanded search results, a Global Search filter is automatically applied. While the Global Search filter is active, Saved Search is unavailable. You will have to remove the Global Search filter to enable the Saved Search again in this view. Boolean Search and Filters in Recruit CRM How Radius-Search and Travel Time Search Works in Recruit CRM? (New UI) Tracking Placed Candidates in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Connecting Your Existing Domain to the Recruit Craft Careers Page
chunks.x: Recruit Craft allows you to connect a custom subdomain to your career page so candidates can access your jobs using your own domain. This helps maintain your company’s branding and makes your career page feel like a natural extension of your main website. Once connected, your Recruit Craft career page will be accessible through your chosen subdomain (for example, careers.youragency.com ), while still being fully managed inside Recruit Craft. Follow these steps to connect your domain to Recruit Craft: ​ Open your Recruit Craft account and click the Custom Domain option from the left-hand navigation panel to begin the setup process. ​ 2. Enter your custom domain in Recruit Craft

chunks.t: Connecting Your Existing Domain to the Recruit Craft Careers Page
chunks.x: Provide the subdomain you want to use for your career page and re-enter it again to verify and avoid errors. ​ Once done, click on Connect. Recruit Craft then begins processing the request and prepares the configuration needed for the connection. Please note The custom domain entered should match your default Jobs Page URL. Recruit Craft will automatically generate two CNAME records required for the domain connection. You will receive an email notification once the CNAME records are ready. At this stage, the connection status will appear as In Progress , indicating that the domain configuration is still being set up. ​ 4. Add the CNAME records in your DNS provider

chunks.t: Connecting Your Existing Domain to the Recruit Craft Careers Page
chunks.x: Log in to your domain provider (for example, GoDaddy, Cloudflare, Namecheap, or others) and add the CNAME records provided by Recruit Craft. These records connect your chosen subdomain with your Recruit Craft career page. ​ Once the DNS records are added, Recruit Craft will automatically verify the configuration. During this time, the connection status will continue to show In Progress until the records are detected and validated. After verification is successful, the status will change to Completed , and your career page will start working through your custom domain. ​ DNS propagation may take a few minutes to several hours , depending on your domain provider.

chunks.t: Connecting Your Existing Domain to the Recruit Craft Careers Page
chunks.x: No. Your existing website hosting does not need to change. Only a subdomain needs to be connected to Recruit Craft. No. This feature works only with subdomains , such as careers.domain.com or jobs.domain.com. DNS propagation can take a few minutes to several hours , depending on your domain provider. What happens if the CNAME records are added incorrectly? If the records are incorrect, the connection status will remain In Progress until the correct DNS settings are added. chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: The Candidate Pitching Agent is designed to simplify and standardize how you pitch candidates to clients. It enables you to generate AI-powered, structured, and professionally formatted candidate pitch emails directly from the pitching workflow, while allowing control over instructions, layout, branding, and candidate information through Admin Settings. • Reduce manual effort when pitching candidates • Ensure consistency in client communication • Create professional, branded candidate pitches in just a few clicks

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: 📌 Note: The Candidate Pitching Agent is powered by the gpt-oss-120b (Cerebras) model and generates candidate pitches using AI. As with any AI-generated content, we recommend reviewing the generated pitch for accuracy, relevance, and tone before sending it to clients. ✨ How to use the Candidate Pitching Agent The feature is designed to be simple and flexible, allowing you to either select a predefined preset layout or build a completely custom configuration based on your preferred instructions, branding, and email style. ​1. Configure the Candidate Pitching Agent Open " Admin Settings " and navigate to " Fields Shared with Clients ". ​

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: Click on the Candidate Pitching Agent tab from the panel on the right. From here, you can configure how candidate pitch emails are generated. 2. Select a Preset or create Custom Instructions The Candidate Pitching Agent includes built-in presets that provide predefined email layouts, styling, and AI instructions to help you get started quickly. • Talent Grid (Default) – A compact, data-focused layout designed for quick candidate comparisons. • Navy White (Professional) – A clean and professional layout suitable for most recruitment workflows. • Light Gold (Editorial) – A premium, editorial-style design ideal for executive search and retained recruitment. ​

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: When you select a preset, its corresponding AI instruction is automatically added to the instruction box. You can use the preset as-is or customize the instructions to better match your preferred tone, layout, branding, and candidate presentation style. The instruction box controls how the AI generates your pitch emails, including: If you edit a preset's instructions, the preset is automatically deselected and the configuration becomes a custom setup. You can also select Custom to clear the instruction box entirely and create your own instructions from scratch. The most recently saved instructions are used for all future candidate pitch emails until they are updated again.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: Once you have configured your preset and instructions, you can choose which branding elements should be included in your candidate pitch emails. These settings help ensure that generated emails align with your company's branding and provide a more professional experience for clients. You can configure the following branding options: • Include Your Company Logo Displays the logo configured under Admin Settings → Public Job Page Settings . If no logo has been configured there, the email will be generated without a company logo even if this option is enabled. ​

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: • Include Contact Company Logo Displays the logo associated with the company linked to the selected contact. If a contact is associated with multiple companies, the logo from the first linked company will be used. If no company logo is available, the email layout automatically adjusts to maintain a clean appearance. ​ • Include Email Signature Automatically adds the email signature associated with the email account used to send the pitch email. For users on the Business and Enterprise plans who have multiple email accounts connected, the signature corresponding to the selected sending account will be used. ​

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: These branding preferences are applied to the generated candidate pitch email and are included in all future pitches once the configuration is saved. Once your configuration is ready, click Preview to generate a sample email and review how the pitch will appear based on the selected preset, instructions, and branding settings. If you're satisfied with the output, click Save Instructions to save your configuration. This saves the selected preset, the latest instruction prompt, and branding preferences, which then become the default settings used across future candidate pitches.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: If the generated layout or content does not fully meet your expectations, click Regenerate to create another version using the same instructions and configuration. You can also click Reset to restore the default preset and its original instructions. ​ Once you have configured the Candidate Pitching Agent, you can begin pitching candidates to your client contacts. You can start the pitching workflow from either side of the relationship: • From Candidates – Select one or more candidates from the Candidate List or Candidate Profile, then choose the contacts you want to pitch them to.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: From Contacts – Select one or more contacts from the Contact List or Contact Profile, then choose the candidates you want to pitch. 📌 You can pitch up to 20 candidates at a time . After selecting your candidates and contacts, click Select Fields & Email Contacts . From here, choose which candidate information should be included in the pitch email, including the Profile Picture field if you would like candidate photos to be visible to the recipient. Once you have reviewed and finalized the fields you want to share, proceed to the email generation step. On the field selection screen, you'll find the Candidate Pitch Agent toggle.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: • When the toggle is ON (default), clicking Generate Email creates an AI-generated pitch email based on your configured instructions, selected candidate fields, branding preferences, and chosen layout. • When the toggle is OFF , Recruit CRM uses the standard candidate pitching workflow instead. ​ 📌 The toggle remembers your most recent preference. If you turn it off, it will remain off for future pitches until you enable it again. This preference is specific to each user. ​

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: The Profile Picture field is available under Shared Candidate Fields and allows you to control whether candidate photos are shared with clients. Like other shared fields, it supports custom labels, visibility controls, drag-and-drop reordering, and can be selected when pitching candidates. When enabled, profile pictures are included in Candidate Pitch Emails, Candidate Submission Emails, Online Candidate Lists, and the Hiring Manager Portal. When disabled, they are hidden from all client-facing experiences. ​ 📌 Note: Profile Pictures and Full Names are controlled independently, and profile pictures are only shared when the Profile Picture field is explicitly selected.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: The generated email remains fully editable before sending. ​ • Layout styling based on your saved configuration • Make any final changes to candidate summaries If you prefer not to use the AI-generated version, click Switch to Default to return to the standard candidate pitch email template at any time before sending. You can also provide feedback on the generated email using the 👍 Thumbs Up or 👎 Thumbs Down options. Selecting Thumbs Down opens a short feedback form where you can share suggestions for improvement. ​

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: Whether you are sending to a single contact or multiple contacts, Recruit CRM generates a separate personalized email for each recipient. Contacts are not added as CC or BCC recipients. When you first open the Compose Email screen, placeholder values are shown instead of the contact's actual details. Clicking Preview replaces those placeholders with the details of the first selected contact and highlights the resolved values so you can clearly identify previewed content. ​ 📌 During actual sending, each recipient receives their own personalized email with their corresponding contact details automatically populated. 💡 Best Practices while writing Instructions

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: • Be clear and specific in your instructions. • Define your preferred tone, structure, and formatting expectations. • Use a preset as a starting point if you're unsure how to structure your instructions. • Keep instructions generic so they can be reused across multiple candidate pitches. • Always preview the generated email before saving your configuration. • Save only the version of the instructions that you want applied to future pitches. ​ ​ Avoid : • Vague requests such as "make it look professional." • Candidate-specific or job-specific information. • Expecting the AI to remember previous outputs or conversations. • You can pitch up to 20 candidates at a time.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: • The latest saved instructions and branding preferences are automatically applied to future candidate pitches. • Candidate profile pictures are only included when the Profile Picture field is enabled and selected for sharing. • If you leave, refresh, or close the page with unsaved changes, Recruit CRM will display a confirmation message to prevent accidental data loss. • Email layouts may appear slightly different depending on the recipient's email client, such as Gmail or Outlook. • The AI generates content based on the currently saved instructions each time and does not retain memory of previous outputs.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: • AI-generated content may occasionally vary in quality or formatting. Always review the generated email and refine your instructions if needed before sending. Do I need to configure the Candidate Pitching Agent before using it? No. A default configuration is already available, allowing you to start pitching candidates immediately. Instructions can only be saved after previewing the generated email. If you modify the instructions, you'll need to preview again before saving. Can I switch back to the default pitch email? Yes. You can click Switch to Default at any time before sending. Yes. You can pitch up to 20 candidates in a single workflow.

chunks.t: Candidate Pitching Agent
chunks.x: Yes. Turn OFF the Pitch Candidate Agent toggle and Recruit CRM will use the standard pitch email flow. Are these settings job-specific or global? All saved presets, instructions, and branding preferences are applied globally across the platform. Can I edit the AI-generated email before sending? Yes. You have full control to modify the subject, recipients, and email content before sending. The Candidate Pitching Agent helps you present candidates in a consistent, polished, and client-ready format while reducing manual effort. Once configured, it becomes a reliable way to standardize candidate pitches and deliver a more professional client experience.

chunks.t: Compliance Support in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Recruit Craft supports compliance-related elements within the job application form. This ensures that candidates see the correct policies and consent options based on your existing settings, without any additional configuration required. The experience stays aligned across platforms, helping you maintain accuracy, trust, and compliance throughout the application process. Compliance elements in the job application form are controlled entirely through your existing settings in Recruit CRM. Based on what is enabled or disabled, the form dynamically updates to display only the relevant sections. • Candidate Terms • EEO Policy (Equal Employment Opportunity policy) • SMS Terms

chunks.t: Compliance Support in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: If any of these are disabled in your settings within Recruit CRM, they will not appear on the application form. This ensures that candidates only see what is applicable, keeping the form clean and relevant. All labels, checkbox text, and content are pulled directly from your configured job application form settings in Recruit CRM. This means the wording remains consistent across Recruit Craft and Recruit CRM. Click here to know more about handling EEO policy in Recruit CRM Click here to know more about how to manage the Candidate Terms in Recruit CRM Click here to know more about handling SMS terms in Recruit CRM

chunks.t: Compliance Support in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: When candidates apply for a job, they will see compliance-related sections based on your setup. • Each policy (Candidate Terms, EEO, SMS Terms) appears as a checkbox with clearly defined text • Clicking on any of these opens a detailed view with full policy information • The content shown always matches what is configured in your system ​ This creates a transparent experience where candidates can review and understand the terms before submitting their application. If SMS Terms are enabled and a candidate opts in: • Their consent is captured at the time of application submission • This allows recruiters to send SMS communications only to candidates who have explicitly agreed ​

chunks.t: Compliance Support in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: This ensures that all SMS outreach remains compliant and respects candidate preferences. Please note: This is currently available only for users based in the US. • Compliance elements are shown only if they are enabled in your settings • No additional setup is required in Recruit Craft • All content and labels are automatically synced from your existing configuration • This applies to accounts where the Candidate Portal is not enabled This improves both compliance and candidate experience:

chunks.t: Compliance Support in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: • Ensures accurate and consistent policy display across platforms • Eliminates the need for manual updates or duplicate configurations • Builds trust by clearly communicating terms to candidates • Helps you stay compliant with communication consent (especially for SMS) Do I need to configure anything separately in Recruit Craft? No. All compliance elements are controlled through your existing job application form settings. It will not be shown on the job application form. Yes. Clicking on any policy opens a detailed view with the complete content. Consent is recorded when candidates opt into SMS Terms during application submission.

chunks.t: Compliance Support in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Compliance is seamlessly built into your job application flow, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and transparency without adding extra steps to your workflow. chunks.t: Integrating Vente.ai with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM integrates with Vente.ai, an AI-powered outbound lead generation platform that helps automate prospecting, outreach, and lead qualification. This integration allows you to streamline your B2B sales process by connecting Vente.ai’s automation capabilities with your Recruit CRM data. By integrating Vente.ai with Recruit CRM, you can automate repetitive sales tasks and focus more on closing deals. Autopush leads with deal values and close dates Autoassign contact stages to contacts created Autocreate tasks and notes for consultant followup Autopush custom deal name and deal notes, using Vente data

chunks.t: Integrating Vente.ai with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Custom field mapping on deals, companies and contacts Sign up or log in to your Vente.ai account and navigate to the "Integrations" section within Vente.ai 2. Scroll to find Recruit CRM and click on "Manage Accounts" 3. Once you do that, click on the "Add Account" option to add your RecruitCRM account. 4. Fill in the name (you can chose the name that you wish to) and fill in the API token and click on "Create". To find the API Token in RecruitCRM, please follow the following steps: 1. Navigate to " Admin Settings " and click on " API " 2. Click on "Copy" to copy the API Token and paste it in Vente.ai's website.

chunks.t: Integrating Vente.ai with Recruit CRM
chunks.x: 5. Once that is done, you will be prompted to map the fields. Please map them accordingly based on your requirement. 6. You also have the options to set "Custom fields default" and "Updating existing records". Then, proceed to click on "Update" to finish setting up the integration. 7. The integration has been successfully set up! Accessing, Editing, Deactivating, or Deleting your Integrated Account on Vente.ai 1. Navigate to the "Integrations" section and click on "Manage Accounts". 2. Here you will be able to see the 'Status' of your integration and Edit, Deactivate or Delete your integration accordingly.

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The AI Candidate Summary Generator uses information in a candidate’s profile such as name, title, skills, work experience, and education history to automatically create a concise and structured summary. You need a quick, professional summary of a candidate for internal review or client submissions. You want consistent candidate summaries across your team and processes. You need to save time preparing candidate overviews from detailed profiles. Before generating a summary, ensure the following required fields are completed on the candidate record: For a more detailed and accurate summary, also fill in:

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: 💡 Tip: The more complete the candidate profile, the more comprehensive and useful the generated summary will be. A profile with only the three required fields will produce a brief output. Adding work history and education significantly improves the depth of the result. Scroll a bit down to locate the Candidate Summary section. Click the AI Assist button to trigger generation. The system will use all available candidate data to produce a concise summary. Review the generated summary. If the output is too brief or not specific enough, add more details to the candidate record, then click the Regenerate button again to regenerate. ​ After the summary is generated, you will see three options:

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Copy: Copy the generated text to your clipboard for use in external documents or emails. Insert: Insert the summary directly into the candidate's Summary field in Recruit CRM. Regenerate: Generate a new version of the summary to explore alternative outputs or fine-tune the result. ​ After the summary is generated, you can enter a custom prompt to guide the AI toward a more specific or tailored output. ​ To enter a custom prompt, type your instruction in the prompt input area below the generated summary and apply it. The AI will refine the output based on your instructions. Prompts that work well can be saved for future reuse, so you do not have to retype them each time.

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Click the Save icon next to the prompt input area. Enter a clear and descriptive name for the prompt so you and your teammates can identify it easily. Choose whether to share the prompt with your team by toggling the Share with Teammates option on or off. Click Save . The prompt will appear in the Saved Prompts section for future use. ​ Open the Saved Prompts section to view all stored prompts. Click any saved prompt to apply it directly to the current summary generation. Click the pin icon next to any prompt to pin it to the top of the list for faster access. Click it again to unpin. ​ Problem: The AI button is visible, but the generated summary seems incomplete or not very accurate.

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: Key candidate fields (name, title, skills, work experience, education) are missing or incomplete. ​ What to check: Review the candidate record and confirm that the Name, Title, Relevant Skills, and major experience/education fields are filled in. ​ Resolution path: Update the missing fields, then click AI again to regenerate the candidate summary. Problem: The AI Candidate Summary Generator does not reflect recent changes to the candidate profile. Likely cause: The summary was generated before updating the candidate record. What to check: Confirm that you regenerated the summary after updating the record.

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Resolution path: Update the candidate record, then scroll to the Candidate Summary section and regenerate the summary. Problem: A teammate cannot see a prompt I created. Likely cause: The prompt was saved as private instead of shared. What to check: Check whether the prompt was set to be shared with teammates during the save step. Resolution path: Edit the prompt by clicking on the Pencil icon in the Saved Prompt section and toggling on the Share with Teammates option. Is there a limit to the use of this feature? Yes, the AI-Assist feature has monthly token limits that vary based on your plan. Token usage includes both input and output, and may vary depending on the language and content.

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: • Free Plan – 50K tokens • Pro Plan – 5 million tokens • Business Plan – 10 million tokens • Enterprise Plan – 20 million tokens These limits apply to the following AI features: • Generate Note Summary • Generate Call Log Summary • Generate Email Template • Generate Email • Generate Email Sequence • Email Reply Suggestion • Generate Candidate Summary • Generate Job Description Note: These token limits currently do not apply to AI Sourcing and AI Boolean Search .

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: If you reach the token limit, the AI-assist features will stop generating new content until the next monthly cycle begins and you will get this error: ​ ​​ "Oops! It seems you have exhausted your 2 million token limit for this month. It will be restored on {date in this format 20 May 2023}" What languages does the AI-Assist feature support? Currently, the AI-Assist feature officially supports English. However, OpenAI is capable of understanding and generating text in several other languages, including French, Spanish, German, Italian, Dutch, and others. Please note that the quality of AI output may vary across languages. Is there any limit to the number of prompts I can save?

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: The limit of prompts that can be saved is 50. Who can use the AI Candidate Summary Generator? Any user with permission to view and edit candidate records in your Recruit CRM plan can use the AI Candidate Summary Generator. Does the AI summary update automatically when I change candidate details? No. If you update candidate information, you need to scroll to the Candidate Summary section and click Regenerate (or the AI button again) to refresh the summary. Can I customize how the AI writes summaries for different roles or clients?

chunks.t: AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. You can create custom prompts to guide the AI toward specific formats, tones, or focus areas, and then save and reuse those prompts for similar roles or clients. Will my saved prompts be visible to my entire team? Only if you choose to share them. When saving a prompt, you can decide whether to share it with teammates or keep it private. The AI Candidate Summary Generator in Recruit CRM helps you quickly turn detailed candidate records into clear, structured summaries that support faster reviews, stronger client submissions, and more consistent documentation across your team.

chunks.t: Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM gives you the option to include an unsubscribe link within your email that allows candidates/contacts to opt out of further emails from you, helping you build the right contact list and protect your email marketing strategy. You can add an unsubscribe link to your emails, manually opt records out, and later opt them back in if needed. You send bulk or individual marketing or outreach emails from Recruit CRM, and you need to comply with email marketing regulations and respect unsubscribe requests. You want to improve email engagement by maintaining a clean, consent-based contact list. Email opt-out behavior is based on the email address, not just the individual record.

chunks.t: Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: Opting out/unsubscribing means that all the records linked to that specific email ID will no longer receive your email communication. Bulk opt-out is not supported; you can only opt out records individually. Account Owners can customize or translate the opt-out button text under Admin Settings → Email Opt Out Settings. ​ How to include the unsubscribe link in the emails sent to candidates and contacts? You can include an unsubscribe link in both individual and bulk (mass) emails sent via Recruit CRM. 1. Open the candidate or contact details page and click their email address to open the email composer. 2. Enter the email body and subject line.

chunks.t: Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. In the top-right corner of the email composer, locate the Include opt-out/unsubscribe link checkbox and check this box to add an unsubscribe link to the email. ​ When this checkbox is selected, an unsubscribe/opt-out link is automatically added to the email. The candidate/contact can simply click and unsubscribe from your emails: Recognize Unsubscribed/Opted-Out Profiles Once a candidate or contact clicks the unsubscribe link and opts out, their Recruit CRM profile is updated with a specific label indicating they have opted out or unsubscribed. All candidates or contacts marked as opted out or unsubscribed are automatically skipped when sending bulk or mass emails.

chunks.t: Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: You do not need to manually exclude them while selecting records for bulk emails. Manually Opt a Candidate or Contact Out of Emails Apart from the self-service unsubscribe link, you can manually remove a candidate or contact from your email list. 1. Open the candidate or contact’s profile. 2. Click the Opt Out of Email icon or option. 4. In the confirmation pop-up, click the Yes, Opt Them Out (green) button. The profile will now be marked as opted out, and they will no longer receive emails from you. Re-Enable Email for an Unsubscribed or Opted-Out Record If you need to start sending emails again to a candidate or contact who previously unsubscribed or was opted out:

chunks.t: Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Open the candidate or contact’s profile. 2. Locate the Opted out of all emails tag/button. 3. Click this tag/button, then click Opt In to Emails . ​ 4. When the confirmation pop-up appears, click Yes, Opt Them In . After this, the unsubscribe/opt-out status is removed, and you can send emails to this candidate or contact them again. Show and Use the Opt-Out Column on the Contact List To easily see which contacts have opted out: 3. Ensure the Opt-Out column is turned on (visible). 4. Reorder the columns if needed so that Opt-Out is clearly visible. 5. Click Apply to save your column settings. You will now see a Yes/No value in the Opt-Out column:

chunks.t: Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes = candidate/contact has opted out of email communication Filter Contacts/Candidates by Email Opt-Out Status You can filter candidate/contacts based on whether they have opted out of emails: On the Candidate/Contact List page, open the Advanced Search or filtering options. Add a filter condition on the Opt-Out field: Opt-Out = Yes to view only candidates/contacts who have opted out Opt-Out = No to view only candidates/contacts who have not opted out Apply the filter to see the resulting list. At this time, bulk opt-out is not supported ; opting out must be done on an individual basis. Can I bulk opt out multiple contacts at once?

chunks.t: Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: No. Bulk opt-out is not supported currently. You can only opt out candidates or contacts individually, or let them opt out themselves via the unsubscribe link in your emails. Use the unsubscribe link, manual opt-out, and opt-in controls together with list filtering to keep your communication targeted and respectful of recipient preferences. Enable the 'unsubscribe/opt-out from email' link for emails sent to candidates/contacts Bulk emailing candidates/contacts (New UI)

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The AI Job Description Generator creates job descriptions based on a job title and any additional details or prompts you provide. You can refine the generated content using manual prompts, regenerate results as needed, and directly copy or insert the description into the job record. Frequently used prompts can also be saved and shared with your team, helping standardize and speed up job description creation across roles. Use the AI Job Description Generator when you want to create high-quality job descriptions quickly while maintaining consistency across your hiring process.

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: • Need to generate a complete job description from just a job title. • Want to standardize job descriptions across your team or clients. • Need to customize descriptions for different seniority levels, industries, or hiring requirements. 1. Navigate to the Add/Edit Job form and enter a title in the Job Title field. Once a job title is added, the AI Assist button will automatically become active. 2.Fill in any additional job fields that are relevant to the role. The more detail you provide, the more specific and comprehensive the generated description will be. ​ 3. Click the AI Assist button to generate the job description. Once generation is complete, you will see three options:

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Copy: Copy the generated text to your clipboard. Insert: Insert the generated description directly into the Job Description field on the record. Regenerate: Generate a new version of the description to explore alternative outputs or fine-tune the result. ​ Refining a Description with Manual Prompts You can add a manual prompt either before generating the job description or after it has been generated to further refine the output. These prompts help you customize the tone, add or remove specific details, or restructure the description to better match your requirements. ​ " Remove desired experience from above " to strip out experience requirements.

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: " Make this description more concise " to shorten verbose sections. " Add a section on company culture " to append a new block of content. After entering your prompt, click the send button to see the updated output. ​ After entering a prompt, click the Save icon next to the prompt input area. Enter a clear and descriptive name for the prompt so you and your teammates can recognize it later. Choose whether to share the prompt with your team by enabling the Share with Teammates toggle. Click Save to store the prompt. It will appear in the Saved Prompts section for future use. Click Saved Prompts to view all stored prompts.

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Click the pin icon next to any prompt to pin it to the top of the list for quicker access. Click the pin icon again to unpin it. Select any saved prompt to apply it directly to a new job description, saving time on repetitive manual input. ​ Problem: The generated job description is too generic. Likely cause: Additional job details were not filled in. ​ ​ What to check: Ensure you have added desired qualifications, key responsibilities, and other job-specific information. ​ ​ Resolution path: Update the job details and click to regenerate the description using AI Assist. Problem: Teammates cannot see a shared prompt.

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: The Share with Teammates toggle was not enabled. ​ ​ What to check: Open the prompt settings and verify whether sharing is turned on. ​ ​ Resolution path: Enable Share with Teammates , save the prompt again, and ask teammates to refresh their view. Is there a limit to the use of this feature? Yes, the AI-Assist feature has monthly token limits that vary based on your plan. Token usage includes both input and output, and may vary depending on the language and content. ​ ​ Monthly token limits per user: • Free Plan – 50K tokens • Pro Plan – 5 million tokens • Business Plan – 10 million tokens • Enterprise Plan – 20 million tokens These limits apply to the following AI features:

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: • Generate Note Summary • Generate Call Log Summary • Generate Email Template • Generate Email • Generate Email Sequence • Email Reply Suggestion • Generate Candidate Summary • Generate Job Description Note: These token limits currently do not apply to AI Sourcing and AI Boolean Search . Is there any limit to the number of prompts I can save? The limit of prompts that can be saved is 50. If you reach the token limit, the AI-assist features will stop generating new content until the next monthly cycle begins. Users also get this error: ​ "Oops! It seems you have exhausted your 2 million token limit for this month. It will be restored on {date in this format 20 May 2026}"

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: What languages does the AI-Assist feature support? Currently, the AI-Assist feature officially supports English. However, OpenAI is capable of understanding and generating text in several other languages, including French, Spanish, German, Italian, Dutch, and others. Please note that the quality of AI output may vary across languages. How does AI Assist generate a job description? AI Assist generates a job description based on the job title you enter and any additional job details you provide, such as qualifications and responsibilities. Can I edit the AI-generated description manually?

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. You can copy the generated description or insert it into the Job Description section and then edit it like any other text. Can I reuse my favorite prompts for different jobs? Yes. You can save any manual prompt and access it from the Saved Prompt section to reuse it on future roles. Can my team members use my saved prompts? Yes, if you enable the Share with Teammates toggle when saving the prompt, your teammates will be able to access and use it. What if I don’t like the generated description? You can regenerate the description, adjust the job details, or use manual prompts to change the tone, level of detail, or specific requirements.

chunks.t: AI Job Description Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Using AI Assist for job description creation in Recruit CRM helps you move from a job title to a polished, tailored description in just a few steps. By combining generated content, manual prompts, and saved templates, you and your team can maintain consistency, save time, and adapt job descriptions to every hiring scenario.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The AI Assist feature generates email templates based on the prompt you provide. Simply describe the type of email you need, and the system will create both the subject line and email body for you. Once generated, you can further refine the content using additional prompts, regenerate the output, copy it, or insert it directly into the email template editor. You can also save frequently used prompts and share them with teammates. You want to quickly generate candidate or client email templates without writing from scratch. You need consistent, on-brand emails across your team. You frequently send similar emails and want to save and reuse templates.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. You can access the AI Assist email generator from three places in Recruit CRM: From the mailbox: Open your mailbox and create a new email template or open an existing one to edit it. From Email Templates in Admin Settings: Go to Admin Settings and open the Email Templates section to create or edit a template. From Email Triggers in Admin Settings: Go to Admin Settings and open Email Triggers to create a trigger-based template. 2. In the email template creation section, click the blue AI Assist button. A prompt input area will appear at the top of the editor.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. Type a clear and detailed prompt describing the email you want to generate. For the most accurate and useful output, include the following in your prompt: Purpose of the email: What is the email trying to achieve? Recipient's role or audience: Who will receive the email, such as a candidate, client, or hiring manager? Desired tone and formality: Should the email be formal, conversational, direct, or warm? Intended outcome: What action should the recipient take, such as booking a meeting or confirming a detail? Specific requirements: Any key points, information, or constraints the email must include.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: After entering a prompt, you can save it for future reuse so you do not have to retype it each time. Click the Save icon next to the prompt input area. Enter a clear and descriptive name for the prompt so you and your teammates can identify it easily later. Choose whether to share the prompt with your team by toggling the Share with Teammates switch on or off. Click Save to store the prompt. It will appear in the Saved Prompts section immediately. Open the Saved Prompts section to view all stored prompts. Click any saved prompt to load it into the input area and apply it to your current template.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Click the pin icon next to any prompt to pin it to the top of the list for faster access. Click the pin icon again to unpin it. Once your prompt is ready, click on the arrow to generate the template. The system will take a few seconds to process your prompt and produce the output. ​ 4. After the template is generated, you will see the following options: Regenerate: Generate a new version of the template if the first output does not meet your needs. Copy: Copy the generated subject line and body text to your clipboard. Insert: Insert the generated content directly into the email template editor. The subject line will be automatically populated along with the body of the email. ​

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: 5. You can include placeholders in the prompts, however, we recommend replacing the AI-generated placeholders with the placeholder from the dropdown to avoid potential errors. ​ Review the entire email body and subject line for any placeholder-style text that was not inserted from the official dropdown. Replace all AI-generated placeholders with the correct official placeholders using the placeholder dropdown in the editor. Do not send or save a template that contains AI-generated placeholders, as they will not resolve correctly in live emails. ​ Problem:  The AI-generated email includes incorrect or broken placeholders.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause The AI created generic placeholders that do not match Recruit CRM’s official placeholder format. ​ ​ What to check Review the email body and subject for any placeholder-like text that was not inserted from the placeholder dropdown/box. ​ ​ Resolution path Manually replace all AI-generated placeholders with official placeholders from the placeholder dropdown/box before saving or sending the template. Problem: You cannot see your saved prompts in the Saved Prompts section.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause The prompt was not saved. ​ ​ What to check Confirm you clicked Save after naming the prompt and setting sharing options. Verify you are in the same area where you originally created the prompt. ​ ​ Resolution path If the prompt is missing, re-enter your prompt and save it again, ensuring the save confirmation appears. Problem: The AI response is too generic or not relevant to your use case.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause The original prompt is too short or lacks detail about purpose, audience, tone, and outcome. ​ ​ What to check Review your prompt and see if it clearly describes the scenario, desired tone, and key points. ​ ​ Resolution path Edit the prompt to add more context and detail, then click Send again or use Regenerate to get a more tailored email. Problem: The Send button is visible, but nothing happens after clicking it.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause There may be a temporary processing delay or connectivity issue. ​ ​ What to check Check your internet connection and wait a few moments to see if the response appears. ​ ​ Resolution path If the issue persists, refresh the page and try again. If still unresolved, contact support with details of the behavior. What languages does this feature support? The AI-Assisted Email Template Creation feature currently supports the following languages: Is there any limit to the number of prompts I can save? The limit of prompts that can be saved is 50. Why do placeholders need to be updated by the user?

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Recruit CRM placeholders have a specific format, like {candidate_name}, {candidate_city}, etc. However, AI may generate different results in terms of placeholders, such as [candidate_fullname], or , etc. Therefore, users are advised to update the placeholders using the placeholder dropdown to avoid issues. If placeholders are incorrectly added, they will not work. Is there a limit to the use of this feature? Yes, the AI-Assist feature has monthly token limits that vary based on your plan. Token usage includes both input and output, and may vary depending on the language and content.

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: • Free Plan – 50K tokens • Pro Plan – 5 million tokens • Business Plan – 10 million tokens • Enterprise Plan – 20 million tokens ​ These limits apply collectively to the following AI features: • Generate Note Summary • Generate Call Log Summary • Generate Email Template • Generate Email • Generate Email Sequence • Email Reply Suggestion • Generate Candidate Summary • Generate Job Description ​ Note: These token limits currently do not apply to AI Sourcing and AI Boolean Search . If users reach the token limit, the AI-assist features will stop generating new content until the next monthly cycle begins. Users will also get this error:

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: ​ "Oops! It seems you have exhausted your 2 million token limit for this month. It will be restored on {date in this format 20 May 2023}" How detailed should my AI email prompt be? For best results, include the email purpose, audience, tone, desired outcome, and any specific points or requirements. The more detail you provide, the more accurate and usable the generated template will be. Can I share my saved prompts with my team? Yes. When saving a prompt, you can choose whether to share the prompt with your teammates by toggling the sharing switch on or off before clicking Save . Does the AI Assist feature automatically add subject lines?

chunks.t: AI Email Template Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. When you insert the AI-generated response into the email editor, the email subject line is automatically populated along with the body of the email. Yes. Your saved prompts appear in the Saved Prompts section, where you can access them, select them, and pin or unpin prompts based on how frequently you use them. Using AI Assist for email template creation helps you draft professional, consistent emails faster while keeping control over content and placeholders. By saving and managing prompts, you can build a reusable library of high-quality email templates that support your daily recruiting workflows.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: The new Jobs Details page in Recruit CRM brings a cleaner layout, smarter organization, and greater customization across every section. From managing job information to tracking activity and assignments, the updated interface helps streamline your day-to-day recruiting tasks. ✨ Here is the list of all the key features: The new UI allows you to perform a wide range of job-related actions directly from the top corner of the job profile. You can perform several actions for a job directly from the details page, including:

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: This layout makes it easier to scan and quickly find the action you need. You can also customize and rearrange these actions based on how frequently you use them, making your workflow more efficient. You can click on the three dots menu to view more actions. Click on the three dots on the Jobs details page and select Customize Options at the bottom of the list. ​ Drag and drop your top five most frequently used actions to the top of the list and click Save to apply the changes. ​ Once saved, these selected actions will be directly accessible at the top of the contact's details page, making them quicker and easier to use.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Account Owners can set the default Job actions visible for the team from the Others View section. They can also choose to lock this view by selecting the option that prevents other users from editing or changing it. ​ Please note: Users may still be able to modify field order and visibility even when the view is locked at the account level, if the permission “Allow users to override locked view layouts” is enabled in their role. By default, this permission is enabled for the Admin role and disabled for Team Member and Restricted Team Member roles. You can manage this setting for the Custom Roles from Rules and Permissions under the User section in Admin Settings . ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Click here to know more about the Roles and Permissions in Recruit CRM. The Job ribbon gives you quick access to the most important information at a glance. You can choose up to four key fields to display here, helping you focus on what matters most. Hover next to the field you want to remove from the ribbon and click on the pencil icon that appears. In the box that opens, click Replace Field at the bottom. Now select the new field you want to display from the list and click on replace and then verify the field details, and click on Save to apply the changes.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: You can also manage the job status directly from this section. Simply click on the current status shown at the top to open the Update Job Status prompt. From here, you can select a new status, add a reason for the change if needed, and choose whether to close the job on external job boards or enable/disable the job application form. ​ To view the Job Status history , click on the comment icon next to the job status to see all past updates. ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: The Information Overview section contains all essential job fields in one place. You can fully customize which fields appear here and control how many fields are visible, allowing you to tailor the layout to match your hiring process and reduce visual clutter. This section is also collapsible and can be minimized by clicking on the arrow at the top next to Information Overview whenever you want a more compact view. Click here to explore how you can customize it: Click on the Customize Information Overview button from the top right corner of the section.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Set the number of fields you want to display in the Information Overview section. This allows you to control how many job fields are visible at a glance. Simply choose the number of fields you want to appear in the overview, and the selected fields will be displayed accordingly in the Information Overview section. Select the specific fields you want to appear in the Information Overview. You can even adjust the order of these fields by dragging and arranging them as per your need. ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Account Owners can set a default view and define which fields are visible for their team from the Others View section. They can also choose to lock this view by selecting the option that prevents other users from editing or changing it. ​ ​ Please note: Users may still be able to modify field order and visibility even when the view is locked at the account level, if the permission “Allow users to override locked view layouts” is enabled in their role. By default, this permission is enabled for the Admin role and disabled for Team Member and Restricted Team Member roles. You can manage this setting for the Custom Roles from Rules and Permissions under the User section in Admin Settings . ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: The panel on the right side of the page helps you track and manage all activities related to the job from one place. From this panel, you can work with the following : This panel is adjustable, allowing you to control how much space it occupies on the screen. You can resize it by dragging the panel edge to adjust its width based on your working preference. You can choose which activities appear in this panel to keep the view focused and clutter-free. Here is how you can customize it: Click on the three dots in the top right corner of the activity panel screen and select Customize Activities.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Choose the activity types you want to be visible in the panel, and arrange them in the order you need by dragging them. Click on Save to apply the changes. Account Owners can also set a default Activities Panel view for their team from the Others View section. They can lock this view to prevent other users from editing or changing the selected activities by checking the box. ​ Please note: Users may still be able to modify field order and visibility even when the view is locked at the account level, if the permission “Allow users to override locked view layouts” is enabled in their role.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: By default, this permission is enabled for the Admin role and disabled for Team Member and Restricted Team Member roles. You can manage this setting for the Custom Roles from Rules and Permissions under the User section in Admin Settings . ​ The Widgets tab can be customised to show only the information that matters most to you. This allows you to tailor the view and keep the job profile clean and relevant. Follow along to customise the widgets view: Click on the three dots located on the right corner of the Widgets tab and select Customize Widgets. ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Choose the widgets you want to display and arrange them by dragging them into your preferred order. Then click on Apply to save your changes. ​ You can also customize the columns displayed within supported widgets by showing or hiding columns, reordering them, resizing column widths, and using available column-level actions. These layout preferences, along with show/hide selections, are persisted, so your customized layout is retained across sessions. Show/hide columns options are available on the following widgets on the jobs details page: Candidate Pipeline and Related Deals.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Column-level sorting is currently available in some widgets only, such as Candidate Pipeline, Hotlists, Related Deals, and Invoices. Account Owners can also set a default Widgets view for their team from the Others View section. They can choose to lock this view to prevent other users from editing or changing the selected widgets. When you add a record from a widget on a Jobs Details page, you will remain on the same details page after saving the record. A success toast message confirms that the record was added, and the widget updates automatically with the new record entry, with no manual refresh required and no redirect to the new record's details page.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: For example, when adding a Deal from the Related Deals widget on a Candidate Details page, you’ll stay on the same page while the newly added Deal appears in the widget. This also applies to actions such as Add to Hotlist, Add Note, and Assign Candidates. This section provides a comprehensive view of all candidates associated with a job. The Candidates Pipeline on the Job Details/Profile page helps you track and manage all candidates linked to the specific job in one place. Candidates are organized by their hiring stages (such as Shortlisted, Assigned, or Rejected), allowing you to quickly understand where each candidate stands in the process.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: When you make a call to a candidate directly from the Candidate Pipeline under Jobs , the call log is now automatically associated with the job. This means the call log will be visible on both the candidate and job , and can also be accessed through the call widget . Manage candidate and field visibility shared with the client You can also perform candidate-specific actions by clicking on the three dots next to a candidate’s name. This will give you options such as: Additionally, you can drag and drop pipeline sections to rearrange them as per your workflow. The sections can also be resized to better suit your view. ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: For Contract and Contract to Permanent jobs, a Timesheets tab is available on the Job Details page. It shows every timesheet associated with contractors working on that job, so you don't need to leave the job to check on them. ​ Search and filter timesheets, using quick filters for Contractor, Status, and Timesheet Period, or column-level filters Select multiple timesheets and perform bulk actions: export, create invoices, bulk update time, send reminders, or delete Select View All Timesheets to open the main Timesheets page with this job's filter already applied. ​ Please note: The Timesheets tab only appears on Contract and Contract to Perm jobs. It does not appear on other job types. ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Timesheets tied to a contractor who has since been unassigned, or a job that has been deleted, remain visible in this tab with a status tag showing their current state. ​ This tab displays all comments, remarks, and feedback shared by the client for candidates submitted to them. ​ From here, you can manage candidate visibility, schedule interviews, and unassign candidates directly, making it easier to act on client feedback without switching between sections. ​ This tab shows all the active job campaigns associated with the job, along with any saved drafts. You can also directly advertise the job from this section, making it easy to manage and launch campaigns without leaving the job page.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Here you can see all hotlists that the Jobs is part of, making it easy to track the groups they belong to. The columns in this section are adjustable, allowing you to resize them by dragging the column edges to suit your view. You can also sort the values in each column in ascending or descending order by clicking on the Sort Ascending or Sort Descending options available in the column header. ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: In addition, you can manage hotlists directly from this section. Next to a hotlist name, relevant action icons appear, allowing you to edit the hotlist or remove the job from the hotlist quickly without leaving the page. You can also add the job to a hotlist from the button on the top right corner of the tab. This section displays all email conversations associated with the Job. It includes emails exchanged between your team and any email addresses saved on the profile, including custom email fields. Only emails where the association is linked to the concerned job will appear here, helping you view all job-related communication in one place without switching screens. ​

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: This section gives you a complete view of all deals connected to the contact, helping you track placements, negotiations, and the overall progress in one place. To make reviewing deal information easier, the columns in this section are fully adjustable. You can resize them by dragging the column edges and sort deal values in ascending or descending order using the sorting options available in each column header. You can also take action on deals directly from this view without leaving the contact profile. By hovering next to a deal name, a three dots menu appears that lets you quickly archive, unlink, or delete the deal.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Additionally, if you need to associate the contact with more opportunities, you can add a new deal or link the contact to an existing deal using the options available at the top of the section, ensuring all deal related information stays current and organized. This area tracks which candidates has been pitched, giving you clear visibility into outreach efforts. It provides a complete view of all the candidates the contact has been pitched to, helping you track progress in one place.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: To make reviewing this information easier, the columns in this section are fully adjustable. You can resize them by dragging the column edges and sort values in ascending or descending order using the sorting options available in each column header. From this section, you can take action on pitch records either individually or in bulk. Available actions include: • Updating the pitch stage • Composing emails • Adding notes • Adding the contact to a hotlist

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: All files linked to the contact, such as resumes or supporting documents, are accessible here for quick reference and downloads. From this section, you can also upload new files and create folders to keep documents organized, making it easier to manage and find candidate related files when needed. ​ To add a file, click on the box above to attach the new files. Click here to know more about the supported file types that you can upload The Invoices section lets you view and manage invoices linked to the contact directly from their profile.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: To make reviewing invoice information easier, the columns in this section are fully adjustable. You can resize columns by dragging their edges and sort values in ascending or descending order using the sorting options available in each column header. From this section, you can take action on invoices either individually or in bulk. Available bulk actions include- For individual invoice related actions, hover next to an invoice and click on the three dots menu. From here, you can: You can also edit an invoice directly from this view. To do this, hover next to the invoice name and click on the pencil icon that appears.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: You can further customize which invoice related columns appear in this section and control their order. To do this: Click on the Show or Hide Columns button. Now, select the fields you want to display and arrange them by dragging them into your preferred order and click on Apply to save the changes. Known Differences between the Old Version and the New Version Enhanced 3-Column Field Layout: The Information Overview now features a 3-column layout , allowing you to view significantly more data upfront without scrolling. The older version was limited to a 2-column design, which often required more vertical scrolling to locate specific information.

chunks.t: New Version of Jobs Details Page
chunks.x: Rearrangeable Widgets: The Widgets area at the bottom of the page can now be fully rearranged and customized, allowing you to prioritize the tabs you need most. In the old UI, the layout of these sections was static and could not be moved or reordered. Tailored Field Visibility: You can now fully customize the Information Overview section by selecting exactly how many fields you want to display. This provides a much cleaner, personalized interface compared to the old UI, which was restricted to a fixed display of 16 fields.

chunks.x: Updated Position for Files & LinkedIn Messaging: The Files tab and the LinkedIn Messaging section have been moved to the widgets at the bottom of the page.
