chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: Our LinkedIn messages integration, powered by Unipile , helps you manage your LinkedIn conversations seamlessly within Recruit CRM. It provides a complete view of all interactions with candidates and contacts, enabling you to communicate with them directly through LinkedIn without leaving Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: LinkedIn Messages Integration is included with the Enterprise plan and can also be added to Pro or Business plan subscriptions as a per-seat, credit-based add-on. The option to add the LinkedIn Messages Integration feature as a per-seat, credit-based add-on is currently in Beta and will be gradually rolled out to all users in the upcoming weeks. For the remaining paid plan accounts that are not in the Beta release , the LinkedIn Messages Integration can be added at an additional cost as an account-wide add-on to the Pro or Business plan subscriptions. The LinkedIn Messages Integration is powered by Uniplie and it is GDPR compliant .

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: The LinkedIn Messages Integration supports the following plans, i.e, LinkedIn Recruiter, Recruiter Lite, Sales Navigator core, business, and career plan. 💲 How to purchase the LinkedIn Messages integration? The LinkedIn Messages Integration can be purchased using Recruit CRM Credits on a per-seat basis. Instead of a flat account-wide subscription, you can purchase the number of LinkedIn seats your team needs. (This option to add the LinkedIn Messages Integration feature as a per-seat, credit-based add-on is currently in Beta and will be gradually rolled out to all users in the upcoming weeks.) ​ Where to purchase the LinkedIn Messages integration using Recruit CRM Credits (beta):

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: Click your Profile icon and select the LinkedIn Integration tab. Enter the number of seats you want to purchase. Review the credit cost shown in the confirmation pop-up and confirm your purchase by clicking on the Buy Linkedin Integration button. Only users with the Plans & Billing permission can purchase or reduce the number of seats. ​ 150 credits per seat/month or 1,500 credits per seat/year . The annual option includes 2 months free. Annual LinkedIn seats are available only when the core Recruit CRM subscription is also on annual billing . The number of LinkedIn seats cannot exceed the total number of purchased Recruit CRM licenses on the account.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: Credits are charged for every purchased seat, regardless of whether the seat is currently connected to a LinkedIn account. LinkedIn seats are assigned on a first-come, first-served basis . Seats cannot be pre-assigned to specific users. The first users to connect their LinkedIn accounts automatically claim the available seats. Once all purchased seats are in use, additional users who try to connect will see: “All LinkedIn seats for this account are in use — reach out to your account owner.” When a connected user disconnects their LinkedIn account, their seat becomes available for the next user who connects, at no additional cost. Each user can connect only one LinkedIn account at a time.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: Increasing seats: Additional seats are available immediately, and you’re charged the prorated credit amount for the remaining days in the current billing cycle. The full seat count applies from the next renewal. Decreasing seats: There is no refund for the current billing cycle. The reduced seat count takes effect at the next renewal. If the reduced seat count is lower than the number of currently connected users, the earliest-connected users keep their seats . Any additional users will be disconnected when the reduced seat count takes effect at renewal. LinkedIn seats renew on the same billing cycle as your core Recruit CRM subscription . How to purchase the LinkedIn Messages integration:

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Navigate to the Admin Settings --> Plans & Billing : 2. Click on the "Edit Current Plan" button on the first page: ​ 3. Scroll down to the bottom of the page to find the LinkedIn integration section and add it to your subscription. 🔗 Connecting your LinkedIn account to Recruit CRM 1. Click on the 'Profile' icon and select the ' LinkedIn Integration ' tab. 3. Enter your LinkedIn account credentials and verify the details. If you haven’t connected your LinkedIn account through the profile settings, you’ll see a button to connect it under the LinkedIn Messages tab inside any candidate or contact profile.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: How to use the Cookie login method to avoid multiple LinkedIn login sessions being detected in the app? Click here to know more about the multiple LinkedIn login sessions You can follow the following steps to overcome the LinkedIn multiple sessions login error detected in the app: 1. Under the LinkedIn Integration tab, click on 'Connect' 3. Now you need to enter your li_at/li_a value under the Cookies section. To know these values you need to open your 'Linked Account' on the new tab and right click anywhere on the screen and select 'Inspect'. Then click on the 'Application Tab ' and expand the 'Cookies' section. Now, click on the LinkedIn URL ( www.linkedin.com ).

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: You can use the search bar and find the li_a/li_at value and make sure to copy the 'value'. If your account has a Recruiter or Sales Navigator subscription, you need to copy the li_a value too. Now you need to paste the value under the Cookie section while you are connecting your account and click on 'Login'. Here is a tutorial on how to log in via the Cookie Method: 💬 Starting LinkedIn conversations within Recruit CRM 1. To start messaging on LinkedIn through Recruit CRM, ensure the candidate/contact’s profile includes their LinkedIn URL.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: 2. If the candidate/contact is not yet connected on LinkedIn, then you can send Inmail (if you have a Premium LinkedIn account) or you must first send a connection request and have it accepted. 1. Navigate to the candidate/contact’s profile >> Click on the LinkedIn tab to start a conversation. Note: If you have less than 50 API requests, the messages will be fetched directly (if available). If your API requests are between 51–70, you’ll need to click the "Start Conversation" button to send/view messages.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: If you’ve made more than 70 API requests, the "Start Conversation" button will appear along with a warning message: “You’re reaching the daily limit set by LinkedIn for retrieving conversations. Exceeding this limit could risk blocking your LinkedIn account.” 2. Type your message or insert Message template and optionally insert placeholders for personalization >> Click Send to deliver the message. 3. When a new message is received, a Load New Message button will appear within a minute or two. Click this button to view real-time updates. 4. You can also download the files sent by the candidate/contacts. 📩 InMail Capabilities for Recruiter Lite users

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: If you have a LinkedIn connection , you can send a normal LinkedIn message and can start InMail as well. If you don't have a LinkedIn connection with the desired candidate/contact, then: You need to make a manual connection with the candidate/contact. You can either create InMail Threads or chat in an existing thread. 📩 InMail Capabilities for Sales Navigator Core users If you have a LinkedIn connection , you can send a normal LinkedIn message. If you don't have a LinkedIn connection with the desired candidate/contact, then: You need to make a manual connection with the candidate/contact For Sales Navigator, new InMail threads can not be created currently.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: 📩 InMail Capabilities for Career/Business users If you have a LinkedIn connection , you can send a normal LinkedIn message. If you don't have a LinkedIn connection with the desired candidate/contact, then: You need to make a manual connection with the candidate/contact. InMail isn't available for connected prospects on Premium Career/Business plans. New InMail threads can not be created on Business/Career plans. The messages will continue in the existing thread. You will be able to see the syncing of messages from the paid version of LinkedIn. You will not be able to message a second-degree non-connection, and in this case, only InMail messaging is possible.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: You will be able to see the credits count when sending InMail messages. If you are blocked by the prospect, then you will not be able to send any messages. 👀 View teammates' LinkedIn message history You can view the message histories of other teammates but cannot send messages on their behalf. Note: If you are using the Classic/Free LinkedIn account, to view the message histories of other teammates with a specific candidate/contact, you need to be connected with the specific candidate/contact on LinkedIn. If you are on a LinkedIn Premium plan, you will be able to view the message histories of other teammates regardless of whether you are connected with the candidate/contact.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: 1. Go to the LinkedIn Messages tab in a candidate/contact’s profile. 2. Use the search bar to select a teammate and view their conversation history. 🔒 Manage who can see your LinkedIn conversations To help you manage the privacy of your LinkedIn conversations, the “Hide My Messages” option in the LinkedIn Integration settings gives you more control over who can view your LinkedIn conversations. This feature allows you to keep your messages with prospects private from other users in your account, ensuring sensitive communications remain confidential. Click on the Profile icon and select the LinkedIn Integration tab.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: In the LinkedIn card , turn the Hide Your Messages toggle on or off based on your preference. Toggle ON 🔐 – You can see both your own LinkedIn messages and those sent by other users to the same prospect. However, your messages will not be visible to other users. Toggle OFF 🔓 – All users can see the complete message history with the prospect, regardless of who sent the messages. The toggle is only visible when the LinkedIn Integration is purchased and your LinkedIn account is connected. The toggle works on a per-user basis, so each user can individually choose to hide or show their own messages at any time from the LinkedIn Integration settings.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: Why can’t I automatically start conversations? You can directly communicate with the candidate/contact by clicking on the LinkedIn tab on the candidate/contact record, and you will be able to see the messages (if you have any) directly. However, if the API Requests are between: 51-70: Then you will need to click on the “Start Conversation” button to view the messages. 70+: You will be able to see the “Start Conversation” button with a warning message as: " You’re reaching the daily limit set by LinkedIn for retrieving conversations. Exceeding this limit could risk blocking your LinkedIn account." Can teammates reply to messages on my behalf?

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: No, your teammates can only view your messages and cannot message on your behalf. If my LinkedIn account is created via direct Google sign-up, can I connect it to Unipile LinkedIn integration in Recruit CRM? No, accounts created via direct Google sign-up CANNOT be connected to Unipile at this time. To enable the connection, you’ll need to manually set a password in your LinkedIn account settings. If I link LinkedIn, would my Recruit CRM search engine search in the messages of LinkedIn? No, because we do not store the messages on our end, we just use Unipile’s API to stream it real-time. Is it possible to buy the LinkedIn Messages Integration for specific users only?

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. LinkedIn Integration can be purchased on a per-seat basis rather than as an account-wide subscription. You can choose the number of seats you need, up to your account’s total purchased Recruit CRM licenses , and pay only for those seats. See “How to purchase the LinkedIn messages integration” above for more information on seat assignment and billing. The option to add the LinkedIn Messages Integration feature as a per-seat, credit-based add-on is currently in Beta and will be gradually rolled out to all users in the upcoming weeks.

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: For the remaining paid plan accounts that are not in the Beta release , the LinkedIn Messages Integration can be added at an additional cost as an account-wide add-on to the Pro or Business plan subscriptions. Can I upload only from a date onwards my LinkedIn Messages? No, currently this is not possible because we do not store the messages on our end, we just use Unipile’s API to stream it real-time. If I send a LinkedIn message to the candidate out of RecruitCRM, maybe something personal, will this get into RecruitCRM? Is there a way to bypass RecruitCRM for this case, such as personal or confidential messages?

chunks.t: LinkedIn Messages Integration (New UI)
chunks.x: No, Unipile will retrieve all messages sent to and from the LinkedIn account synced in the system, there’s no way to bypass anything. chunks.t: Re-parsing Resume in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: You can now use the Re-parse Resume option directly from the Candidate Details page to update candidate information using the newly parsed resume. The Re-parse Resume option is available in two places: From the default Resume field on the candidate profile ​ You can either upload a new resume from their system or select an existing resume from the candidate’s Files section. Once selected, the resume is parsed again, and the newly extracted information is compared with the candidate’s current profile details before any updates are applied. 🔍 Reviewing Parsed Information Before Updating

chunks.t: Re-parsing Resume in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Before applying updates, a comparison screen shows the Field Name , New Value , and Current Value side-by-side, allowing you to review and choose which fields should be updated. You can choose how the candidate information should be updated by selecting either the ' Update Empty Field Values' option or the ' Override Selected Field Values' option: When the ' Update Empty Field Values' option is selected, the system will only fill fields that are currently empty in the candidate profile, while keeping the existing information unchanged.

chunks.t: Re-parsing Resume in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When the ' Override Selected Field Values' option is selected, the system will replace the existing candidate information with the newly parsed values for the fields you select. This gives you more control over which existing details should be updated from the latest resume. Note: Bulk resume re-parsing and bulk candidate updates are currently not supported. The comparison view currently supports only the default candidate fields available in the resume parser. 🔁 Managing Duplicate Candidates During Bulk Resume Parsing When parsing resumes in bulk, if duplicate candidates are detected, they are clearly marked with a “Duplicate” tag so you can easily identify them before proceeding.

chunks.t: Re-parsing Resume in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Each duplicate candidate also includes an “Update Values” option, allowing you to review the existing candidate profile alongside the newly parsed resume information before applying any changes. If multiple duplicate candidates are found, you can navigate through them one by one using the duplicate counter. You can choose to skip a duplicate or update selected field values and move to the next duplicate. For the final duplicate candidate, the option changes to Override Selected Field Values .

chunks.t: Re-parsing Resume in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: In the comparison screen, fields where changes are detected are automatically selected by default. You can review these selections and choose which fields should or should not be updated before saving the changes. Empty fields, Work History, and Education History are not shown as separate highlighted changes during duplicate review, as they are updated automatically before the comparison screen opens. Why are some fields already updated before I review the changes? In the Global Resume Parser flow, empty fields, Work History, and Education History may be updated automatically before the review step. These changes are saved before reviewing the remaining fields.

chunks.t: Re-parsing Resume in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Make sure you are viewing the candidate’s profile page. The option is available from the default Resume field or the three-dot action menu . What happens to fields that already have information? Existing field values are only updated if you select them during the review process or choose the override option. What happens if the parsed resume contains information that is already available in the candidate profile? Fields with identical values remain unselected, as there is no new information to update. Are custom fields included in the comparison view? No. The comparison view currently supports only the default candidate fields available through the resume parser.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The AI Call Transcript Generator automatically creates written transcripts for calls recorded in Recruit CRM. You can search in transcripts using keywords or Boolean Search, jump to specific parts of a conversation using timecodes, and copy or export transcripts as text files when needed.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: The feature also allows you to generate transcripts for previously recorded calls, regenerate transcripts if the output is inaccurate, and optionally update associated call notes at the same time. Using AI Assist, you can summarize conversations, extract key points, refine wording, or run custom prompts directly from the transcript content to quickly turn conversations into actionable insights. You want a written record of candidate or client calls for future reference. You want to summarize long calls or extract key points without re-listening. Enable Recording and Generate a Transcript for a New Call:

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Before placing the call, locate the Record Call toggle in the calling interface and turn it ON . Select the Generate Call Transcript checkbox to instruct the system to create a transcript once the call ends. After the call ends, open the Notes and Calls tab on the relevant candidate, contact, or company record and locate the call log entry for the completed call and click View Transcript to open the transcript pop-up. ​ Note: If the Record Call toggle or the Generate Call Transcript checkbox was not enabled before the call, no transcript will be created for that call. Both settings must be active before dialing.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: If you have an older or previously recorded call that does not yet have a transcript, you can generate one at any time. Navigate to the Notes and Calls tab on the relevant record. Find the call recording entry and click the Call Transcript button associated with it. In the pop-up that appears, click Generate Transcript . The system will process the audio and create the transcript. View, Search, Copy, and Export a Transcript Clicking View Transcript opens the full transcript in a pop-up where you can interact with the content in the following ways: Search: Use the search bar within the pop-up to find specific words, phrases, or timecodes within the transcript.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Copy: Click the copy option to copy the entire transcript to your clipboard for use in external documents or emails. Export: Download the transcript as a text file for archiving, sharing with stakeholders, or storing in external systems. ​ Regenerate an Inaccurate or Hallucinated Transcript At times, call transcripts may appear in the wrong language due to AI hallucination. When this happens, use the Regenerate option to create a corrected version. Open the transcript and click the Regenerate button. A confirmation message will appear. If you want the associated call notes to be updated automatically once the new transcript is generated, select the Update Call Notes checkbox.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Confirm the regeneration. The system will reprocess the audio and produce a corrected transcript. ​ Your last choice for the Update Call Notes checkbox is remembered by the system. You do not need to select or deselect it every time. If you regularly want call notes to update on regeneration, leave the checkbox enabled. If you prefer to manage call notes manually, keep it deselected. Regeneration cannot recover content from calls with incomplete or poor-quality audio recordings. Search Across Transcripts Using Boolean Search

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Boolean Search in Recruit CRM lets you search through all transcribed call logs to find records containing specific keywords or phrases. This makes it easy to locate important conversations without reviewing calls individually. Navigate to the Candidates or Contacts list page, depending on where you want to search and click the Boolean Search option to open the search interface. Enter the phrase or keywords you want to search for in the search field. Select the Call Logs checkbox to restrict the search to call transcript content.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Click Search . The results will show all records whose call transcripts contain the searched phrase, allowing you to trace and review the relevant conversations directly. ​ Enhance a Call Transcript Using AI Assist Once a call transcript is open, AI Assist lets you process and act on the content without manually reviewing every line. Open the call transcript using the View Transcript option on the call log. Click the AI Assist button at the bottom of the transcript area. Choose what you want the AI to do, or enter a custom prompt to tailor the output. ​ Extract key points: Pull out the most important topics, decisions, or action items from the transcript.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Summarize: Generate a concise summary of the full conversation. Improve it: Refine the transcript language for clarity and readability. Saved Prompts: Use your own saved instructions to tailor the generated output to a specific requirement, such as drafting a follow-up email based on the call. 4. Once the AI generation is complete, you will see three output options: Copy: Copy the generated result to your clipboard. Replace: Replace the current call notes or summary in the system with the AI-generated content. Regenerate: Run the prompt again to refine or adjust the output if the first result is not satisfactory. ​ Problem - The call transcript is missing or not generated.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Call recording or the Generate Call Transcript checkbox was not enabled before the call. ​ ​ What to check Verify that the Record Call toggle and Generate Call Transcript checkbox were turned on in the Record section of the calling interface before placing the call. ​ ​ Resolution path For future calls, always enable both settings before dialing. Existing calls with recording can be transcribed by clicking on the Generate Transcribe button when opening the Call Transcript. ​ Problem - Boolean search is not returning the expected call transcript results.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause The Call Logs checkbox is not selected, or search terms are too broad/narrow. ​ ​ What to check On the Candidates or Contacts List page, confirm that Boolean Search is used and Call Logs is checked. ​ ​ Resolution path Refine the search query and ensure Call Logs is selected to limit results to transcripts. Try alternative keywords or Boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT) as needed. Is there a duration limit for the call transcription? The feature accommodates calls of varying lengths, with the only constraint being the size of the audio file, which should not exceed 25 MB (which equals 1 to 1.5 hours of call duration). This ensures a smooth and efficient transcription process.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: The transcription feature supports a wide array of languages, including but not limited to English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, and many more. Here is the complete list: ​ Afrikaans, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, Galician, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Malay, Marathi, Maori, Nepali, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Tamil, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese, and Welsh.

chunks.t: AI Call Transcript Generator (New UI)
chunks.x: Can I transcribe the calls recorded in the past? Absolutely! You can generate transcripts for past calls from the call logs, making sure you always have access to the information you need, whenever you need it. The Whisper ASR system is trained on a substantial amount of data, ensuring a high level of accuracy in transcription. However, the accuracy might vary based on the clarity of the audio and the language spoken. Is there a limit to the use of this feature? The AI-Assist feature has a monthly token limit of 3000 minutes of call transcription. ​ The AI Call Transcript Generator in Recruit CRM helps you capture, search, and act on every important conversation with candidates and clients.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Connect your Recruit CRM account to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, or Perplexity and interact with your recruitment data using natural language. 🔑 [IMPORTANT] Previously connected using an API key? Recruit CRM MCP previously authenticated with a single account-wide API key — one key per account, giving full access to your entire database regardless of user role. This has been replaced by OAuth-based authentication, scoped to each individual user's role and permissions. If you were connected using the old API key method, that connection no longer works. To reconnect:

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Delete the existing Recruit CRM connection in Claude, ChatGPT, or whichever app you used it with — the old API key–based connection won't upgrade itself and needs to be removed first. Confirm MCP Access is enabled for your role: Go to Admin Settings → User → Roles & Permissions and enable MCP Access for the user role. Please contact your admin if you don't have access to the Roles & Permissions settings. ​

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: The old API key had full read and write access by default. The new OAuth connection depends on your role's MCP Access setting: Read Only gives search and view access, Read & Write gives the same full access the old API key had. Please contact your admin if you're not sure which one your role has. ​ Reconnect using the OAuth steps below for your AI app. ⚠️ If the old API key is no longer used anywhere else, rotate or revoke it — it still grants full account access to anyone holding it. This is intended for Recruit CRM Users who want to connect their Recruit CRM data to an AI assistant like Claude or ChatGPT via MCP (Model Context Protocol).

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: The Recruit CRM MCP feature is available only on the Business and Enterprise plans. MCP Access needs to be enabled for the User's Role, and set to either Read Only or Read & Write: Go to Admin Settings → User → Roles & Permissions and enable MCP Access for the user role, then choose the access level. Read Only — search, list, and view Recruit CRM data through MCP. Write actions aren't available. Read & Write — full access to all available MCP tools, same as before. Note: By Default, Account Owner and Admins have MCP access and their roles always have Read & Write MCP access, and this can't be changed for those roles.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: For the Claude Team plan , the Admin needs to add the connector for the team. Click here to view a quick help guide on it. For Pro and Max plans (individual users): You can click on this link: https://claude.ai/directory/recruit-crm and click on the 'Connect to Claude' button. On the authentication page that opens, click on ' Authorize' to connect. Enter the MCP server URL: https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp and click "Add" Click "Connect" on the Recruit CRM connector that appears On the authentication page that opens, click on ' Authorize' to connect.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: You can enable connectors for individual conversations via the “+” button on the lower left of your chat interface, then "Connectors." You'll see your configured connectors with toggles allowing you to enable/disable them per conversation. For more details, see Claude’s guide on custom connectors using remote MCP: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp Remote MCP connectors require Developer Mode on ChatGPT Open ChatGPT Settings, navigate to Security and login, then scroll down to enable Developer mode. ​ Enter name: Recruit CRM and paste the MCP server URL: https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Select Authentication: OAuth (if not selected by default) Follow the on-screen instructions to connect For more details, see ChatGPT’s guide on MCP and Developer Mode: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-developer-mode-and-mcp-apps-in-chatgpt For your account: Account settings → Connectors For the organization (admins only): Enterprise settings → Permissions → Connectors permissions Click + Custom connector in the top-right corner. MCP Server URL : https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp Optionally, fill in these additional fields: Description : A short explanation of what the connector does. Check the acknowledgment box to confirm you understand the risks of custom connectors.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Click Add . The connector will appear in the Connectors screen in your Account settings . Click the connector card to start the authentication flow and enable it. To modify or remove the connector later, click the ellipsis (⋮) and choose the appropriate option. For more details, see Perplexity’s guide on adding custom connectors: https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/13915507-adding-custom-remote-connectors

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Gemini does not currently support custom remote MCP connectors in the standard consumer Gemini web app (gemini.google.com) or Gemini mobile apps. Custom MCP servers are only available in Gemini Enterprise (Google Cloud), which is a separate enterprise product. If your organization uses Gemini Enterprise, your administrator can add custom MCP data stores — contact your Google Cloud admin for setup. Grok supports custom MCP connectors, allowing you to connect Recruit CRM and access supported Recruit CRM tools through Grok. Open Grok and sign in to your account. Click Plugins. Enter the connector name, paste https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp into the MCP Server URL field, and click Add Connector.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: On the authentication page, connect your Recruit CRM account by logging in with your Recruit CRM credentials. Review the requested permissions and click Authorize to approve the connection. Once the connection is successful, open Plugins and navigate to Connected Plugins to view your connected Recruit CRM plugin. For more details, see Grok’s guide on custom connectors using remote MCP: Once connected, you can ask your AI assistant questions like: "Show me Frank's progression across all jobs" "How many candidates are in interview hiring stage for Sales Consultant?" "Which candidates on the Senior Engineer role have been idle for more than 7 days?"

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: "Review candidates added today and create notes on what to discuss during the initial phone call based on their profiles." "Give me a bottleneck report for this job and suggest what to do next" "For the 'Director of Product Management' (Job ID-842), review all candidates in the Shortlist stage and prepare a professional, modern-themed executive search report, including an executive summary and other notable details." Currently supported: The write actions listed below (create, update, assign, etc.) are only available if your role has Read & Write MCP access. With Read Only access, you can search, view, and review records, but not create or modify them.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Find candidates, review profiles and job history, create or update records, assign them to jobs, move them through hiring stages, and manage off-limit status. Find roles by title, company, owner, or status; review assigned candidates by stage; create or update jobs; and diagnose pipeline bottlenecks. Find companies, review account details, create or update company records, and manage off-limit status. Find contacts, review relationship history, create or update records, pitch candidates, track pitch progress, and manage off-limit status.

chunks.x: Find upcoming or overdue work, including tasks associated with the record as well as tasks where it's the primary relation; review related context; create tasks; and update existing tasks. Find scheduled meetings, including meetings associated with the record as well as meetings where it's the primary relation; review attendees and related records; create meetings; and update meeting details. Search notes across candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, and deals, including notes associated with the record as well as notes where it's the primary relation; create notes; and update existing notes.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Review call activity across candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, and deals, including call logs associated with the record; log new calls on candidates, contacts, and companies; and update existing call records. Find hotlists, create new lists, and add records to existing lists. Custom fields are supported for searching, creating, and updating records, including parent-child dependencies. Prepare account briefs with open jobs, contacts, candidate pipeline status, recent activity, risks, and recommended follow-ups.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Diagnose a job's hiring pipeline. Returns stage distribution, days-in-current-stage per candidate, idle candidate detection, bottleneck verdict, recent activity (notes, meetings, tasks), etc. All entity search tools now work like search inside the Recruit CRM app. Boolean search support for more precise candidate and entity discovery Advanced Filter search support for narrowing results using structured criteria App-like search behavior across entities for a more familiar and more powerful MCP experience.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: This version does not support delete actions in Recruit CRM. Write operations are supported and occur only when explicitly requested. Delete actions remain unavailable to everyone regardless of access level, this is enforced at the server level. Write operations also require your role to have Read & Write MCP access, as described above.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Notes, call logs, tasks, and meetings created or updated through MCP are always attributed to the account you're connected as. Assigning a different owner to a task or meeting still works, but you can't set the author of an activity to another user. Attempting this returns an error explaining that MCP-created or MCP-updated records are always logged under the connected account. If your use case isn't supported yet, let us know through Recruit CRM Support - we'd love to hear what you need. When you use this MCP server, your Recruit CRM data is sent to the AI assistant you're using (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT). This means:

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Candidate profiles , names, email, phone, job history, hiring stage, etc. will be exposed to the AI provider so that it can assist with the data. Company and contact data , job details, notes, and call logs may also be exposed depending on what you ask. The AI provider processes this data on their servers according to their own privacy and data retention policies. Most AI providers (including Claude) have a data retention period - typically around 30 days for conversation data, though this varies by plan and provider. Always check the latest policies directly on their official websites: Claude: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: If your team or organization has data residency, GDPR, or other compliance requirements, confirm that using an AI assistant with live recruitment data is permitted. Use good judgment about what you query - only ask for data that's necessary for the task at hand. By using this tool, you accept responsibility for ensuring its use complies with your organization's data policies and applicable regulations. Problem: ChatGPT can perform simple Recruit CRM searches but says it does not have a callable Recruit CRM search function when handling complex prompts that require multiple searches.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Likely Cause: The Recruit CRM MCP connection may need to be refreshed for ChatGPT to properly invoke the available tools. What to check: Confirm the Recruit CRM connection is active and connected through OAuth. Test whether simple Recruit CRM searches are working. Resolution: Disconnect the Recruit CRM connection in ChatGPT without deleting it , then reconnect it through OAuth and grant the required permissions again. After reconnecting, retry the complex prompt. Do I need to be technical to set this up? No local configuration or terminal commands are required. Setup takes a few clicks in your AI assistant's settings. Will this change anything in my Recruit CRM account?

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: If your role has Read & Write MCP access, yes, it can create and update data in Recruit CRM based on your prompt. Write operations are supported, such as creating/updating records, activities (notes/tasks/meeting/call logs), etc., and occur only when explicitly requested. If your role has Read Only MCP access, it can only search and view your data, no write actions are available. Any activity you create or update this way (a note, call log, task, or meeting) is always logged under your own account; you can't attribute it to a teammate.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Yes, but user roles must allow MCP access, set to either Read Only or Read & Write. MCP access does not override existing permissions, users connecting via MCP can only read and write data that their role allows elsewhere in Recruit CRM. A role with Read Only MCP access can search and view data through MCP but can't create or update anything, regardless of its other permissions. Can users log in during the consent flow? Yes. The consent screen includes a Login button, and users are then asked to authorize access. Can I connect MCP clients other than Claude and ChatGPT?

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Yes. Any MCP client that supports remote MCP servers over OAuth (Streamable HTTP) can connect using the same URL: https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp . Step-by-step instructions exist for Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity because those are the most common, but the pattern is identical elsewhere: add a custom/remote MCP connector in that client's settings, point it at the URL, complete OAuth. What happens if a user doesn't have MCP Access when they try to connect?

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: The consent screen still loads and confirms they're logged in, but shows a permission denied message: "You do not have permission to connect... Contact your Recruit CRM admin to enable access." The connection stops there — they'll need an admin to enable MCP Access for their role in Roles & Permissions before retrying. What happens if MCP Access is revoked after a user already connected?

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: User's existing connection stops working. The next time user tries to use MCP through Claude, ChatGPT, or any connected app, they'll be prompted to reconnect. When users attempt to reconnect, they'll see the same "You do not have permission to connect... Contact your Recruit CRM admin to enable access" screen. To use MCP again, your admin needs to re-enable MCP Access for your role. What happens if a user's MCP access is changed from Read & Write to Read Only, rather than fully revoked?

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Unlike full revocation, their connection isn't broken; they don't need to reconnect to keep using MCP. Write actions stop working from their next MCP action, but their AI assistant's connector configuration may continue to display write tools until they manually reconnect. Reconnecting refreshes the tool list shown in their client to match the Read Only access they now have. What's the difference between Read Only and Read & Write MCP access? Read Only allows searching and viewing data through MCP without write tools. Read & Write provides the full existing set of MCP tools, including creating and updating records, as described in "Will this change anything in my Recruit CRM account?" above.

chunks.t: Recruit CRM - MCP (Model Context Protocol)
chunks.x: Does Recruit CRM show an audit log for actions taken via MCP? Not currently — write actions performed through MCP (creating or updating records, notes, tasks, etc.) aren't yet logged in the audit log. Audit log visibility for MCP-originated actions is on the roadmap. chunks.t: How to choose which jobs are visible on your website? (New UI)
chunks.x: What This Feature Does and When to Use It? Recruit CRM lets you control exactly which jobs appear on your website and external jobs page. Each job has a single setting called Enable Job Application Form that acts as the on and off switch for public visibility. When this checkbox is checked, the job is visible on your website and candidates can submit applications through the job application form. This gives you precise control over your careers page without needing to delete or close a role internally. You want to publish a job on your website and allow candidates to apply online. You need to hide a specific job from your website while keeping it active in your internal pipeline.

chunks.t: How to choose which jobs are visible on your website? (New UI)
chunks.x: You want to temporarily pause new applications for a role that already has enough candidates. You are cleaning up your careers page to show only current, relevant openings. You want to keep confidential or internal-only roles out of the public view. ​ ⚠️ Important: Jobs with a Closed status will never appear on your website, regardless of whether the Enable Job Application Form checkbox is checked. To make a job visible again, the job status must first be changed back to an active or open status. Confirm that you have access to the Jobs section in your Recruit CRM account.

chunks.t: How to choose which jobs are visible on your website? (New UI)
chunks.x: Confirm that your user role includes permission to edit jobs. If you cannot see the Edit Job option on a job record, contact your Account Owner to request access. Changes to job visibility may take a short time to appear on your website, depending on your browser cache or website integration settings. ​ Navigate to the Jobs section in Recruit CRM and open the specific job you want to show or hide on your website. ​ Click the pencil icon or the Edit Job button at the top of the job profile to open the Edit Job form. If you cannot see the Edit button directly, click the three dots icon and select Edit Job . Scroll down the Edit Job form until you find the Enable Job Application Form checkbox.

chunks.t: How to choose which jobs are visible on your website? (New UI)
chunks.x: Set the checkbox according to what you want: Check the box to make the job visible on your website and external jobs page. Candidates will be able to see the job and submit an application through the form. Uncheck the box to hide the job from your website and external jobs page. Candidates will not be able to find or apply for the job through public channels. ​ 5. Click Save to apply the change. The update will take effect shortly, depending on your website cache or integration settings. To learn more about the Public Jobs Page, please check out the articles below: How to Integrate Jobs Page to my Website ​ Problem: The job is not appearing on my website.

chunks.t: How to choose which jobs are visible on your website? (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause: The Enable Job Application Form checkbox is unchecked, or the job status is Closed . ​ ​ What to check: Open the job, go to Edit Job , and verify the Enable Job Application Form checkbox and the job status. ​ ​ Resolution path: If you want the job visible, set the job status to an open/active status and check ​ Enable Job Application Form . Save the job and refresh your website or external job page. ​ Does disabling the application form delete existing candidates or applications?

chunks.t: How to choose which jobs are visible on your website? (New UI)
chunks.x: No. Unchecking Enable Job Application Form only hides the job from your website and external job pages and stops new applications. Existing candidate records and previous applications remain in Recruit CRM. Managing job visibility on your website in Recruit CRM is controlled primarily through the Enable Job Application Form checkbox and the job status. By following the steps above, you can decide exactly which jobs appear publicly and when candidates can apply, while keeping full internal control over all roles. chunks.t: Merging Jobs (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature lets you combine two duplicate job records into a single primary job in Recruit CRM. The secondary job is merged into the primary job, and the secondary job record is then deleted. When you find two or more job records that are duplicates of the same role. Identify which job will be the primary job (the one you want to keep) and which will be the secondary job (the one that will be merged and then deleted). Ensure the secondary job does not have any draft or live job campaigns; these must be deleted before you can merge. If the secondary job has an active external job posting, you must take it offline before merging.

chunks.t: Merging Jobs (New UI)
chunks.x: You won't be allowed to do the merging process if the secondary job has approved Timesheets. Candidates are retained in the merged job. If a candidate is in both jobs and has any common stages for both jobs, then their oldest assignment entry (for that stage) will be preserved. The Online Candidate Link for the secondary job will be disabled post-merge. If the secondary job has any Executive Search Reports , you will be notified. 1. Open the primary job record that you want to keep in Recruit CRM. 2. On the primary job, click the three-dot menu and select Merge Job .

chunks.t: Merging Jobs (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. In the merge dialog, search for and select the secondary job that you want to merge into the primary job. Click the Merge button to start the merging process. 4. Once you click on the Merge button, the system will give you an intimation that the process has been initiated. 5. You will receive a notification once the merge is complete. What happens to the secondary job after merging? The selected secondary job is deleted after its data is merged into the primary job. Will any data on the primary job be overwritten? No. Only empty fields in the primary job are updated with new data from the secondary job. Existing data on the primary job is not overridden during merging.

chunks.t: Merging Jobs (New UI)
chunks.x: How will I know when the merge is complete? After you click the Merge button, the system shows a notification that the process has been initiated, and you receive a notification once the merge is completed under the Notification section. Merging jobs in Recruit CRM helps you safely clean up duplicate job records. chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM’s Reimbursements feature enables contractors to submit and manage expense claims directly within timesheets while giving agencies and clients full visibility into the approval process. Once enabled, contractors can raise reimbursement requests for expenses such as travel, accommodation, meals, and fuel. Agencies can review, approve, and manage these reimbursements, while also choosing which expense claims are shared with client approvers. This helps streamline expense tracking, simplify approvals, improve invoice accuracy, and provide greater control over client visibility.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: This feature is currently in beta release and will be gradually rolled out to all users over the next few weeks. This is an individual feature that can be enabled on a Contractor basis, while enabling Timesheets for a Contractor, in a Contract/contract-to-permanent type job. While enabling Timesheets from any place on the app, you can turn ON the Toggle of “Enable Expense claim.”

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: When Enable Expense Claim is turned on, a Share expenses with client checkbox appears below it. This setting is enabled by default and determines whether newly created expense claims are automatically shared with client approvers. You can change this setting at any time, and it will only affect expense claims created after the change. An Expense Claim tab appears in newly generated timesheets. Contractors can submit reimbursement requests. Agencies can review and manage all reimbursement requests. Expense claims are shared with client approvers based on the Share expenses with client setting, which can be overridden for individual claims. Managing reimbursements through the Contractor Portal

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: Contractors can raise reimbursement requests directly from the Expense Claim tab within their timesheet. Add multiple reimbursement requests in a single timesheet Edit and resubmit rejected reimbursements NOTE: Reimbursements can only be edited while they are still under review or rejected. Managing Reimbursements from the Agency Portal Agency users can review and manage reimbursement requests from Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: Each reimbursement includes a Share with Client toggle that allows agency users to control whether an individual expense claim is visible on the Client Portal. The toggle can be updated at any time, regardless of whether the reimbursement is Pending , Approved , or Rejected , and whether or not an invoice has already been created. Reimbursements move through the following statuses: Pending, Approved & Rejected Only designated timesheet approvers can approve or reject reimbursements. Other users can still view reimbursement details.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: Once approved, reimbursements are automatically marked as Payable and Billable. Approvers can choose not to mark them as Payable or Billable. The Share with Client setting does not affect the Payable or Billable status of a reimbursement. Timesheet Approvers at Recruit CRM can reopen approved reimbursements. The reimbursement status changes back to Pending Payable and Billable options are automatically disabled The reimbursement goes back through the approval process Remarks and status history remain visible for tracking purposes. Please note that reimbursements cannot be reopened, updated or deleted once a client invoice is linked to the timesheet.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: Managing Reimbursements from the Client Portal Clients can review reimbursement details only for expense claims that have been shared with them by the agency. Only approvers can approve or reject reimbursement requests, but they cannot edit or delete them. If an expense claim is not shared, it will not appear on the Client Portal, even if the timesheet itself has been shared. Note: If an expense claim was previously shared and later hidden by turning off the Share with Client toggle, clients will no longer be able to view that reimbursement, even if they had already received an in-app notification for it. Approved reimbursements can be exported along with timesheets in Excel or CSV format.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: During export, approved reimbursements appear in a separate sub-sheet, with each reimbursement listed as an individual row for easier tracking and reporting. Reimbursement Attachments for Reimbursements When you click Save & Send to Client while sending an invoice, any reimbursement attachments associated with that invoice are automatically included in the email. You can remove attachments before sending the email if required. Removing an attachment from the email does not delete it from the reimbursement or the timesheet.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: When exporting reimbursements, any available attachments are sent to your email as a downloadable ZIP file. The reimbursement data itself continues to download separately as a CSV or Excel file. Reimbursement attachments included in invoice emails follow the existing 25 MB attachment size limit. Reimbursement attachments are downloaded separately as a ZIP file and are not bundled with the CSV or Excel export. 1. Why isn't an expense claim visible on the Client Portal? The expense claim may not be shared with the client. Check the Share with Client toggle for that reimbursement. If it is turned off, the claim will remain visible only to agency users.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: 2. Why can’t a reimbursement be edited or deleted? Reimbursements cannot be updated once they are approved or linked to an invoice. 3. Why are Payable and Billable options disabled? These settings only become available after the reimbursement is approved. 4. Can rejected reimbursements be submitted again? Yes. Rejected reimbursements can be edited and resubmitted for approval. 5. Is currency conversion supported automatically in invoices? No. Currently, if the pay currency and bill currency are different, reimbursement amounts are not automatically converted as of yet. The reimbursement amount will be added directly using the bill currency without any currency conversion.

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: 6. If I change the Share expenses with client setting, will it affect existing expense claims? No. The setting only applies to expense claims created after the change, including new claims added to existing timesheets. Existing claims keep their current sharing status. 7. Can I override the sharing setting for an individual expense claim? Yes. Each reimbursement has its own Share with Client toggle, allowing agency users to show or hide individual expense claims regardless of the default setting. 8. Can I change the sharing setting after a reimbursement has been approved or rejected?

chunks.t: How to Manage Contractor Reimbursements in Recruit CRM (Beta)
chunks.x: Yes. The Share with Client toggle can be updated at any time, regardless of the reimbursement status or whether an invoice already exists. Recruit CRM’s Reimbursements feature simplifies contractor expense management by allowing reimbursement claims to be submitted and tracked directly within timesheets. chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: This article explains how to use the Recruit Craft Website Builder to create, customize, and publish a branded website directly from Recruit Craft. ✨ What this feature does and when to use it The Recruit Craft Website Builder is a drag-and-drop website builder that allows you to create and manage branded websites directly inside Recruit Craft. With the Website Builder, you can create: • A Full Website with multiple pages, such as Home, About Us, FAQs, Testimonials, and custom pages •Career pages for publishing jobs and job application/candidate portal in a unified website experience.

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: The builder includes a visual editor with drag-and-drop sections and elements, responsive previews, SEO settings, and publishing tools. This feature is especially useful when you: • Want to create a fully branded recruitment website without coding • Want your Jobs page and Candidate Portal under one website experience • Need drag-and-drop editing for website pages • Want to manage pages, layouts, and branding from one place • Need responsive previews before publishing • Want to customize SEO settings for website pages

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: The Projects Dashboard is the first page you land on after logging in to Recruit Craft. From here, you can view and manage all your Recruit Craft projects, including both live published websites and unpublished projects currently being worked on. • View projects • Create projects • Edit projects • Preview projects • Rename projects • Publish projects • Delete projects • Open live projects ​ Follow these steps to create a new project in Recruit Craft: Click + Create Project at the top-right corner of the dashboard. Choose one of the following project types based on the kind of website experience you want to create:

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: Use this option if you only want to create a dedicated jobs page experience for candidates. The Career Page builder includes the refreshed Career Page design while continuing to support the existing functionality and settings already available in Recruit Craft. This option is best suited for teams that primarily want to: • Publish open jobs • Share a branded jobs page • Allow candidates to browse and apply for roles

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: The Full Website builder allows you to create a fully branded recruitment website experience that goes beyond just jobs and candidate applications. You can build informational and branding-focused pages to showcase your company, services, culture, testimonials, FAQs, and more, while also allowing visitors to browse jobs, apply for roles, and access the Candidate Portal from one centralized platform. A Full Website can include multiple pages such as: • Home page • Jobs page • Job Application page • Candidate Portal • About Us page • Testimonials page • FAQ page • Custom pages ​

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: After selecting the project type, the next step is to choose the template that will act as the starting point for your website or career page. Recruit Craft provides ready-made templates to help you quickly build and customize your project without starting completely from scratch. If you selected Build Full Website , you can: • Choose from the available website templates, or • Start with a completely blank project Website templates come with prebuilt layouts and sections that can help speed up the website creation process. These templates can then be fully customized using the drag-and-drop Website Builder editor.

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: Starting with a blank project allows you to build the website structure and design entirely from scratch. If you selected Build Career Page , you can choose from the available Career Page templates. These templates are specifically designed for job listing and candidate application experiences while continuing to support the existing Career Page functionality and settings. ​ Once you select a template, the project will automatically open in the Website Builder editor, where you can begin customizing pages, sections, elements, layouts, branding, and content. 🖥️ Understand the Website Builder Editor The Website Builder includes a visual editing interface with 4 main areas.

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: The left sidebar is used to add new content to your website, such as elements, sections, and pages. Simply drag and drop the required items from the sidebar onto the canvas to start building your website. ​ The central canvas is the main workspace where you can view, build, and edit your website. Any elements, sections, or pages added from the left sidebar can be placed and arranged here. ​ The right sidebar provides customization and editing options for the item currently selected on the canvas. From here, you can modify design settings, content, styling, spacing, and other properties related to the selected element or section. ​

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: The top toolbar contains controls that help you manage and navigate your website design. From here, you can switch between pages, adjust the zoom level of the canvas, and access other page-level controls while editing. The top toolbar includes: • Zoom controls • Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile preview controls • Preview • Save • Publish The Pages section allows you to manage all the pages within your website project. Open the Pages section from the left sidebar. The new page will automatically be created and added to the pages list, where you can begin customizing it using sections and elements. You can switch between website pages at any time while editing.

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: • Click on any page directly from the list inside the Pages section • Use the Page Selector from the top toolbar to quickly navigate between pages The selected page will automatically open in the Website Builder editor. From the Pages section, you can also access the Jobs List Page, Job Description, and Job Application Form . The Jobs-related pages are managed slightly differently from standard website pages. ​

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: 📌 Please note: The Jobs List Page , Job Description Page , and Job Application Form continue to use the dedicated Career Page editor experience. You can customize and manage these pages using the available Career Page settings, while the rest of your website pages can be built and customized using the drag-and-drop Website Builder. The Candidate Portal can also be enabled directly from the Pages section. Once enabled, candidates will be able to access the Candidate Portal experience from your website. Each element can be customized using the settings available in the right sidebar, including layout, styling, spacing, sizing, and other element-specific options. ​

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: The Sections panel includes predefined website sections. These sections can be dragged directly into the page. ​ • Flexbox • Grid • Space • Header • Footer • Hero • Testimonials • FAQs • About Us • Banner • Block quote Follow these steps to build and customize your website using Recruit Craft: Start by deciding whether you want to add new content to your website or edit existing content. To add new content, use the left sidebar and select the type of item you want to add: • Section – Add a new website section, such as a hero banner, testimonials section, or contact form. • Element – Add individual components such as text, buttons, images, social icons, lines, forms, videos, and more.

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: • Page – Create additional pages for your website. Once you have selected the section or element you want to use, drag and drop it from the left sidebar onto the central canvas. Place the item in the desired location on your website layout. The canvas provides a real-time view of your website, allowing you to see exactly where the content will appear. ​ If you do not want to add new content, you can simply select an existing section or element directly from the canvas. Clicking on an existing item will automatically make it active for editing and display the available customization options in the right sidebar. ​

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: After selecting or adding an item, use the right sidebar to customize its settings. The available options will vary depending on the item selected but may include: Any changes made in the right sidebar are reflected on the canvas, allowing you to preview your edits as you work. As you build your website, review the layout and content on the central canvas to ensure everything appears as intended. You can continue adding, removing, repositioning, or editing sections and elements until you achieve the desired design. ​ Once you have completed your edits, click Save to preserve your changes.

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: You can then use the Preview option to review how the website will appear to visitors before publishing or sharing it. The Website Builder is included as part of your Recruit Craft subscription and is available at no additional cost for users on the Enterprise Plan . There is no separate fee for creating, managing, or customizing a website using the Website Builder, as it is already included in the plan. Your existing Recruit Craft pricing plan and job opening limits continue to apply. Click here to know more about the Pricing and Billing in Recruit Craft Can I create a complete recruitment website in Recruit Craft?

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: Yes. Full Website projects support complete recruitment websites with multiple pages. Yes. Career Page projects continue to be supported. Does the Website Builder support drag-and-drop editing? Yes. Website pages support drag-and-drop editing using sections and elements. Can I preview the website before publishing? Yes. Desktop, tablet, and mobile previews are available before publishing. Yes. Recruit Craft supports custom domains. Can multiple projects be published at the same time? No. Only one project can be published at a time. Can website forms create records in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: Yes. Forms can be configured to automatically create a Contact record in Recruit CRM for every submission. The submitted First Name , Email , and Phone values are mapped to the corresponding Contact fields, and the submitted message is saved as a note on the Contact record. If a Contact with the same email address already exists, the submission is added to the existing record instead of creating a duplicate. Forms support Text , Email , and Phone fields. Every form must include at least one field and a Submit button. First Name and Email are required for a visitor to successfully submit the form. Will I be notified when someone submits a form?

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: Yes. Whenever a visitor submits a form, Recruit Craft sends an email notification to the email address associated with your Recruit Craft account. Embed videos using YouTube , Vimeo , or Loom links. Uploaded videos are stored in Recruit Craft and can be reused across your website. Yes. You can configure playback settings such as: When Autoplay is enabled, Mute is automatically enabled because most browsers require autoplay videos to be muted. Why can't I enable Loop or Show Controls for a Loom video? Loom videos do not support the Loop and Show Controls settings due to limitations of the Loom video player.

chunks.t: Recruit Craft Website Builder
chunks.x: • Only one project can be published at a time • Only one custom domain can be connected at a time • The Jobs page and Home page cannot be deleted or renamed • Header and Footer are global across website pages • Header and Footer can only be edited from the Home page • Jobs pages currently use the existing Career Page editor experience • Full drag-and-drop customization is currently available only for website pages Using Recruit Craft Website Builder, you can create and publish a fully branded recruitment website experience connected directly to your Recruit CRM jobs and candidate workflows. chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Indeed (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Through this feature, when you post jobs to Indeed through Recruit CRM, you can choose the application method, whether candidates apply directly through Direct Apply , or they get redirected to another page to complete the application. This helps streamline the application process and reduce friction. 1. Go to the job you want to post, and click on Advertise Job . 2. You can edit the pre-filled name of your campaign or simply click Continue to keep it as it is. 3. On the Added Contracts page, you’ll see all your connected job board accounts. How to add your Indeed contract to your job advertising subscription

chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Indeed (New UI)
chunks.x: This is a one-time setup to configure your Indeed contract. ​ To enable posting to Indeed by using your own account and budget with Indeed, please follow these steps: Fill in the linked form . Do not create the contract yourself. VONQ will validate the company information with Indeed. After validation is complete, you will receive your sourceName over email. You can now create the contract and input the obtained sourceName After you create the contract, your connection will be activated, and you can start posting jobs.

chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Indeed (New UI)
chunks.x: Please note: In order for your jobs to be visible to potential candidates, once sent from your ATS, must be sponsored from your Indeed company admin portal. You can manage sponsorship directly on your Indeed account, either manually or by setting up rules in your Indeed dashboard. This contract setup is not meant for organic/free advertising on Indeed. 4. Click Add to Campaign under your Indeed contract.

chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Indeed (New UI)
chunks.x: 5. You’ll be asked to select or create a " Groups" . These are inbuilt (via VONQ ) and act as folders for job board contracts, allowing only one contract per job board type per group. ​ You’ll see existing options like a Default group and a Test group , or you can create a new group and rename it as needed. Once added, you can save the changes , as well as rename or remove the group . ​ ​ 5. Once you’ve filled in all the details for your posting, scroll down to Application Type . Here, choose Indeed Apply . Finally hit the "Confirm & Post Job" button. That's it.

chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Indeed (New UI)
chunks.x: Please note: If a job is posted to Indeed through Recruit CRM without the “Direct Apply” option selected, candidates will not complete the application directly on Indeed. Instead, they will be redirected to the job application form page, where they can submit their application through your Recruit CRM career page or application form. Any questions you want candidates to answer when applying via Direct Apply must be added to the Job Application Form : When candidates apply, their answers to these questions will be available under the Questions tab in their profile: How does using Direct Apply for Indeed change the candidate experience?

chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Indeed (New UI)
chunks.x: When you select Indeed Apply as the application type, candidates complete their application directly on Indeed instead of being redirected to the Recruit CRM Job Application form. Using Direct Apply for Indeed in Recruit CRM lets you post jobs to Indeed while giving candidates a fast, seamless application experience directly on Indeed. If you have further questions, please feel free to reach out to our support team via the chatbot. Any requests for listings exceeding 30 days will automatically default to the standard 30-day period. Ads are also sent to candidates through notifications.

chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Seek (New UI)

If your ATS does not appear in the list, contact your ATS representative and request that SEEK be added. Once listed, sign into your account and submit an access request.

chunks.t: How to use Direct Apply for Seek (New UI)

Depending on the location of your vacancy, your job will become visible in one of the countries SEEK operates in, which includes the sites JobStreet and JobsDB. Please note : Your Organization ID is also referred to as your Hirer ID and follows this format:seekAnz:organization:seek:XXXXXX
