chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: ✨ What this feature does and when to use it SEO (Search Engine Optimization) helps search engines like Google understand your website content and display it to people searching for relevant information. Recruit Craft allows you to configure SEO settings for individual website pages as well as Career Pages. These settings control how your pages appear in search engine results and when they are shared on social platforms. Using the SEO settings panel, you can configure: • Route (URL path) • Page Title • Page Description • Metadata • Thumbnail Image

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: These settings help improve discoverability, create a better user experience, and increase the chances of attracting relevant candidates and clients to your website. • You want your website or Career Page to rank better on search engines • You are creating a new website and want to optimize it from the beginning • You want pages shared on social platforms to display professional titles, descriptions, and images • You need different SEO settings for different pages on your website • You want candidates and clients to easily understand what a page is about before clicking it SEO stands for Search Engine Optimization.

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: It is the process of helping search engines understand your website content so that your pages can appear in relevant search results. • Improve click-through rates from search engines • Create more professional page previews when links are shared For example, if someone searches for "Recruitment jobs in London," well-configured SEO settings can help your Careers Page or Job Page appear higher in search results. 📋 Configure SEO Settings for a Website Page Follow these steps to configure SEO settings for a website page: Open your website project in Recruit Craft and navigate to the Pages section in the left sidebar.

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Click the three dots (⋮) next to the page that you want to configure the SEO settings for, and select SEO Settings, and the SEO Settings panel will open. Review all details carefully and ensure they accurately describe the page. ​ The updated information will be used for search engines and social sharing previews. Click here to know more about what to configure in the SEO Settings The SEO Settings panel contains the following fields: 1. Route (URL Path) The Route determines the page URL and forms part of the link visitors use to access the page. ​ Final URL: https://yourcompany.com/about-us ​

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: A clear and descriptive route helps both users and search engines understand what the page is about. ​ • Routes only support lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens The Page Title is the main title associated with the page. It appears in browser tabs and is commonly used as the clickable headline in search engine results. A good page title helps search engines understand the page content and helps users decide whether to visit the page. ​ Example: Recruitment Jobs in London | ABC Recruitment ​ The Page Description provides a short summary of the page content. Search engines often display this text below the page title in search results.

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: A well-written description gives visitors a preview of what they can expect on the page and can encourage more clicks. Example: Explore the latest recruitment and staffing opportunities in London. Apply directly through ABC Recruitment. Metadata provides additional information about the page that helps search engines better understand and categorize its content. While metadata is not always directly visible to visitors, it can improve how search engines interpret and index your pages. Use metadata to provide additional context about the page and its purpose.

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: The Thumbnail Image is used when the page is shared on social platforms or appears in supported link previews. A relevant thumbnail helps create a more professional appearance and can increase engagement when the page is shared. Use a high-quality image that represents the page content and aligns with your branding. ​ ​ 📋 Configure SEO Settings for a Career Page SEO settings for Career Pages follow the same process as website pages. ​ To update SEO settings for a Career Page: Open SEO Settings by clicking the three dots (⋮) next to the page that you want to configure the SEO settings for. Configure the Route, Page Title, Page Description, Metadata, and Thumbnail Image.

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: The SEO settings will be applied to the Career Page in the same way as standard website pages. • SEO settings are configured separately for each page • Routes only support lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens • Website pages and Career Pages follow the same SEO configuration process • SEO changes may take time to appear in search engine results • If you change the URL of a published page, Recruit Craft will display a warning because existing links may break Do I need to configure SEO settings for every page? No, but it is recommended for important pages such as Home, Careers, Jobs, About Us, and other key landing pages. Can different pages have different SEO settings?

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Yes. SEO settings are configured individually for each page. What happens if two pages use the same route? Recruit Craft does not allow duplicate page URLs. Each page must have a unique route. Will SEO changes appear immediately on Google? No. Search engines may take some time to crawl and update their search results. Do Career Pages use the same SEO settings? Yes. Career Pages follow the same SEO configuration process and support the same SEO fields as website pages.

chunks.t: SEO Settings in Recruit Craft
chunks.x: SEO settings help improve how your website and Career Pages appear in search engines and social sharing previews. By configuring clear routes, titles, descriptions, metadata, and thumbnail images for each page, you can make your content easier to discover and create a more professional experience for candidates and clients. chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: Currently, this feature is in beta version and can be enabled upon request. Please feel free to reach out to your Account Manager to have it enabled for your account. What does this feature do & when to use it? The Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders feature helps keep contractors, clients, approvers, and agency users informed throughout the timesheet lifecycle. How do Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders work? There are three types of notifications available for Timesheets to help contractors, clients, and you stay updated throughout the timesheet process: Automated Email Reminders , Custom Email Reminders , and Real-Time In-App Notifications .

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: Each notification type serves a different purpose based on the user role and timesheet status. Automated emails are system-generated notifications that are sent automatically when specific timesheet actions take place. Contractors receive these emails in real time when a timesheet is created for them, when the timesheet is approved by the Agency or Client, or when the timesheet is rejected by the Agency or Client. Each email includes a “View Timesheet” link, allowing contractors to directly access the relevant timesheet in the Contractor Portal.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: Contractor email notifications will not be sent if the contractor has been unassigned from the job, if the Contractor Portal is disabled, if the contractor does not have access to the Contractor Portal, or if the contractor is marked as Off-Limits. Note: Make sure the Contractor Portal is enabled for the contractor to receive email notifications Approvers receive automated reminder emails when timesheets with logged hours are submitted and are waiting for approval. A timesheet can be submitted by an Agency Recruiter, Client, or Contractor.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: A timesheet with zero logged hours can also be submitted, but it will not appear on the Approvers’ Review Timesheets page or trigger an automatic submission notification to approvers. The system checks for newly submitted timesheets every 4 hours starting from 00 UTC . An email reminder is sent only when submitted timesheets are found during that period. This includes newly submitted timesheets as well as timesheets that have been resubmitted after being rejected. The reminder email includes all timesheets that are currently awaiting approval for that approver, including older pending timesheets that have not yet been approved. Note — For clients to receive these notifications:

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: When an approver opens the email and clicks the provided link, they are redirected to the relevant place to review the timesheets. Agency approvers are redirected to Recruit CRM, while Client approvers are redirected to the Client Portal. Custom email reminders allow agency users to manually send reminder emails whenever follow-up is required. These reminders are sent immediately to the selected contractor or approver.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: Contractor reminders can be sent for timesheets that are in Open or Rejected status. Approver reminders can be sent for Submitted timesheets that are waiting for approval. This also includes zero-hour timesheets when a Custom Reminder is manually sent, even though these timesheets do not appear in the Approvers’ Review Timesheets page or trigger automatic submission notifications. ​ When a Custom Reminder is manually sent for a zero-hour timesheet, the approver receives the reminder and can review the timesheet. If multiple selected timesheets belong to the same recipient, Recruit CRM sends a single consolidated reminder email that includes all relevant timesheets requiring action. ​ ​

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: The following timesheet-related email templates are available under Standard Email Templates: Contractor Timesheet Reminder Email Template Approver Timesheet Reminder Email Template The Contractor Timesheet Reminder Email Template and Approver Timesheet Reminder Email Template are used when sending custom timesheet reminders. The Timesheet Created, Timesheet Submitted, Timesheet Approved, and Timesheet Rejected templates are used for timesheet notifications. You can customize the subject and body of these emails using placeholders such as Timesheet Period, Approver Name, Remark, View Timesheet, and Review All Timesheets. Note: This feature is available for accounts with Timesheets enabled.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: The configured templates will be used when the respective timesheet reminders or notifications are triggered. Important: Do not remove the link from the email template. This option allows recipients to directly access the relevant timesheet. Before sending a reminder email, Recruit CRM checks whether the required contractor or approver details are available. For contractors, reminder emails cannot be sent in the following cases: The contractor has opted out of receiving emails. The contractor has been unassigned from the job. For approvers, reminder emails cannot be sent in the following cases: The approver has opted out of receiving emails.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: The timesheet has not been shared with the contact. The online link is disabled for the client. If any validation check fails, the system will display the reason why the reminder could not be sent. Once the issue is resolved, you can revalidate the details and send the reminder again. Real-time in-app notifications help contractors, clients, and approvers stay updated on important timesheet activities directly within their respective portals.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: These notifications are available in the Contractor Portal, Client Portal, and Agency Portal . When a user receives a notification, they can click on it to directly open the related timesheet page, where they can review the details or take the required action. Contractors receive notifications when important timesheet actions take place, such as when a timesheet is created for them, when their timesheet is approved by the Agency or Client, or when their timesheet is rejected. Approvers receive notifications when a timesheet with logged hours is submitted for approval. This applies whether the timesheet is submitted by the Contractor, Client, or Agency user.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: Zero-hour timesheets do not generate submission notifications for approvers. If multiple timesheets require the same type of notification, the system may group them into a single notification instead of creating separate notifications for each timesheet. Users can access all relevant timesheets directly from the notification. In-app notifications will not be generated if the required portal does not exist, the portal has been disabled, or the Client online link has been turned off. Reimbursement Notifications & Attachments Recruit CRM also sends notifications for reimbursements, helping contractors, agency users, and clients stay informed throughout the reimbursement approval process.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: Automated Email Notifications for Reimbursements Contractors receive automated email notifications in real time when a reimbursement is Approved or Rejected by an Agency or Client approver. These notifications are sent only if the contractor has access to the Contractor Portal . Clicking View Reimbursement in the email opens the reimbursement tab of the related timesheet in the Contractor Portal. Agency and Client approvers receive automated reminder emails when a reimbursement is Submitted for approval by a contractor or agency user. These reminder emails are generated every 4 hours and consolidate all pending reimbursement approvals for the same approver into a single email.

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: If a reimbursement is reopened after a previous decision, it will be included in the next scheduled reminder email. Real-Time In-App Notifications for Reimbursements Real-time in-app notifications are also available for reimbursements. Contractors receive notifications when a reimbursement is Approved or Rejected , while Agency and Client approvers receive notifications when a reimbursement is Submitted for approval. Clicking a notification opens the reimbursement tab of the related timesheet, allowing users to review or take action immediately. Why didn't a contractor receive an automated email ? Contractor Portal does not exist (they haven’t been Invited/ No sign Up)

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: Contractor has been unassigned from the job Why can't I send a reminder for an approved timesheet? Approved timesheets are not eligible for reminder emails, since Timesheet Lifecycle is considered Complete upon Approval. What happens when I click a notification or email link? Depending on your Portal, you will be redirected to the relevant timesheet, approval page, or portal page associated with the notification, where you can perform the necessary Action. Do zero-hour timesheets trigger automatic notifications to approvers?

chunks.t: Timesheet Notifications & Email Reminders (Beta)
chunks.x: No. Zero-hour timesheets do not appear on the Approvers’ Review Timesheets page or trigger automatic submission notifications. However, an approver can still review a zero-hour timesheet when an agency or client user sends a Custom Reminder manually. With real-time notifications enabled, users can stay informed about important timesheet updates directly from their respective portals. These notifications help contractors, clients, and agency users quickly track timesheet activity, reduce manual follow-ups, and ensure timely action throughout the timesheet approval process. How to Create and Manage Timesheets? (Beta) Contractor Portal in Recruit CRM - Timesheets (Beta)

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature gives you the ability to hide all email communication with specific Candidates/ Contacts or a specific domain of your choice from the rest of your team by making their email IDs confidential. You can add individual candidate or contact email addresses, or entire domains, to a blocked list. Once blocked, all sent and received emails associated with those email addresses or domains are hidden from: The Related Emails tab on candidate, contact, and company records. The Sent Email Conversation KPI in Team Performance Reports.

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: These emails remain visible only within your personal mailbox in Recruit CRM, helping you control who can access sensitive or confidential communications. • You need to keep communication with certain candidates or contacts private from other team members. • You want to hide all emails associated with a specific client or company domain. Only the account owner, admins, and users with custom permissions can block email IDs and domains. Making an email ID or domain confidential is account-specific. All email exchanges with that email ID or domain and any user on your account will be hidden from the rest of the users.

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: Blocked emails will still be visible in your personal mailbox within Recruit CRM. Click on your profile icon in Recruit CRM and navigate to Email Settings → Blocked Emails/Domains . In the popup window, enter the email address or domain you want to block, then select the appropriate email ID, candidate, contact, or domain from the suggestions. Review the selected email address or domain and click Save . • A message will appear in the Related Emails tab indicating that the email address or domain has been blocked. • A Blocked tag will appear alongside the email communication in your mailbox and in Team Performance Reports, indicating that the emails are confidential.

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: If the account owner blocks an email ID, other users will not be able to unblock it. Only the account owner can unblock an email ID that they have blocked. Click on your profile in Recruit CRM and navigate to Email Settings → Blocked Emails/Domains . ​ Locate the email address or domain you want to unblock. You can use the search bar to quickly find a specific blocked email address or domain. Click Unblock next to the relevant email address or domain and confirm your selection.

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: Once unblocked, the email address or domain is removed from the blocked list, and email communication associated with it will no longer be treated as confidential. All the related emails will again be visible according to your account's normal email visibility settings. Problem: Emails with a candidate or contact are missing from the Related Emails tab. Likely cause: Their email ID or domain has been blocked (marked as confidential). What to check: Open Email Settings and go to the Blocked Emails and Domains tab. Search for the candidate’s email ID or their domain. Resolution: If you have permission and the email is blocked, click Unblock next to the email ID or domain to restore visibility.

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: Problem: You cannot unblock a specific email ID. Likely cause: The email ID was blocked by the account owner. What to check: Confirm that the email ID appears in the blocked list and that the Unblock option is not available for your role. Resolution: Contact the account owner and request that they unblock the email ID, as only the account owner can unblock email IDs they have blocked. What happens when I block an email ID or domain in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: When you block an email ID or domain, all sent and received email communication with that email ID or domain is hidden from the Related Emails tab and the Sent Email Conversation KPI in Team Performance Reports, and remains visible only in your personal mailbox. Only the account owner, admins, and users with custom permissions can block email IDs and domains in Recruit CRM. Is blocking an email ID or domain account wide? Yes. Making an email ID or domain confidential is account-specific. All email exchanges with that email ID or domain and any user on your account will be hidden from the rest of the users.

chunks.t: Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)
chunks.x: You will see a specific message in the Related Emails tab for that profile, and a blocked tag will appear for their email communication inside your mailbox and in the Team Performance Report. Using the confidential email (blocked emails and domains) feature in Recruit CRM lets you control who can see sensitive email communication with specific candidates, contacts, or domains while keeping your own records complete. Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential: Hide all Sent and Received Emails for Specific Candidates/Contacts or Domain Mark Email Conversations as Public/Private Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Through this feature, when posting jobs to LinkedIn through Recruit CRM, you can choose whether candidates apply directly via Easy Apply or get redirected to another page to complete the application. This helps streamline the application process and reduce friction. Note: LinkedIn Easy Apply is only available with LinkedIn Recruiter accounts. It won’t work on other types of LinkedIn accounts. 1. Go to the job you want to post, and click on Advertise Job . 2. You can edit the pre-filled name of your campaign or simply click Continue to keep it as it is. 3. On the Added Contracts page, you’ll see all your connected job board accounts.

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn (New UI)
chunks.x: 4. Click Add to Campaign under your LinkedIn contract: Click here to know how you can connect your LinkedIn Premium Contract Note: A Premium Recruiter account is required in order to connect to LinkedIn via the ATS. A Recruiter Lite account will not succeed. You can read more about the differences between the two types of accounts on LinkedIn's page here . Connecting your LinkedIn contract requires a multi-step process that includes logging in to the LinkedIn account that is authorized to use the contract’s job slot inventory. The steps below must be followed exactly in order to properly connect your LinkedIn contract. 1. You must have a LinkedIn Recruiter Account.

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn (New UI)
chunks.x: Go to LinkedIn and log out of that account. 2. Begin typing in the search field for MyContracts within the ATS platform to find the job board you wish to set up. In this case, search for “LinkedIn” (not Limited Listings) and select it from the drop down. Once you select the desired job board, the page will automatically render the instructions and fields that are specific to that job board. 3. To begin the setup/initialization process for LinkedIn, click the GREEN “Initialize Authentication” button. Clicking this button will take you to a LinkedIn login page. 4. Click Sign In and enter your login credentials to log in to LinkedIn. ​

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn (New UI)
chunks.x: 5. Once logged in to LinkedIn, you must select the contract that you intend to connect to MyContracts. If you have multiple accounts tied to your login, they will be presented here. Be sure that you choose the correct account. 6. After selecting the correct account, you must edit the Job Poster information. Click the Edit button to the right of “Job Poster” and under the name. It may already show the name correctly - you MUST complete this step. 7. After clicking the Edit button, you will need to retype your name and then press Save. This will initialize the connection between your LinkedIn posting account and the MyContracts delivery system. 8. Now return to the MyContracts setup screen.

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn (New UI)
chunks.x: Your LinkedIn Company ID will now appear in the COMPANY ID field. Verify that the Company ID is correct. 8. There are various optional fields that you can now use for managing your contract in MyContracts. Contract Alias allows you to give your contract a name. Contract Expiry allows you to set the date that your contract will expire. Purchase Price allows you to display the cost of the posting. This is informative for users, this does not result in a fee being charged. How Many Credits allows you to set the amount of posting inventory you have with a job board. MyContracts will track and display inventory in real time.

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn (New UI)
chunks.x: This is not reconciled with job boards - if you post a job directly to a job board and not through MyContracts, the credit tracker will not track that. 5. Fill in the posting details, then scroll down to the Application Type section. Here, choose On Site Apply (Apply Connect). Finally hit the "Confirm & Post Job" button. That's it! Any questions you want candidates to answer when applying via Direct Apply must be added to the Job Application Form : When candidates apply, their answers to these questions will be available under the Questions tab in their profile: How does using Easy Apply for LinkedIn change the candidate experience?

chunks.t: How to use Easy Apply for LinkedIn (New UI)
chunks.x: When you select On-site Apply as the application type, candidates complete their application directly on LinkedIn instead of being redirected to the Recruit CRM Job Application form. Will the Easy Apply work for all LinkedIn accounts? LinkedIn Easy Apply is only available with LinkedIn Recruiter accounts. It won’t work on other types of LinkedIn accounts. If you purchase job slots, will you be able to use Easy Apply? VONQ provides two types of LinkedIn contracts: LinkedIn Listing and LinkedIn Limited Listing. If you don’t have a LinkedIn Recruiter account, you won’t be able to use job slots, even if purchased separately.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Passcode for Public Pages feature allows you to protect external Recruit CRM pages with a passcode, ensuring that only authorized users can access them. Supported pages include online candidate list links shared with clients and candidate profile update request forms. You can configure a single account-level passcode for each type of public page, or create unique job-level passcodes that override the account-level passcode for specific online candidate lists. This feature is intended for account owners, admins, and users with the appropriate permissions who need greater control over access to externally shared Recruit CRM pages.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: • You share online candidate lists with clients and want to restrict access to authorized viewers only • You send profile update request forms to candidates and want to protect those links with a passcode • You want a single passcode to secure public pages across your account • You need unique passcodes for specific jobs while maintaining a default account-level passcode for all other public pages ​ Account Owners and Admins can now enable or disable passcodes independently for the Profile Update Request Form and Candidate Submission Links. Passcodes can include numbers, letters, and special characters, with a length requirement of 4 to 12 characters.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Users with edit permissions can set unique passcodes for individual jobs in the Candidate Pipeline tab. How to set a passcode for Profile Update Request Forms? Follow these steps to protect your profile update request forms with a passcode: Go to Admin Settings . Under Account Management , click Account . Scroll down to the Set Passcode for Public Pages section and select Request Update / Profile Update Request Forms . Enable the password toggle and enter the passcode you want candidates to enter before accessing the form. Click Save Passcode to apply your changes.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Once enabled, anyone opening a profile update request form will be prompted to enter the passcode before they can access and submit the form. Set a Passcode for Online Candidate List Pages (Account Level) Follow these steps to protect Online Candidate Lists shared with clients using an account-level passcode: Go to Admin Settings . Under Account Management , click Account . Scroll down to the Set Passcode for Public Pages section and select Online Candidate List Pages . Enable the Passcode toggle and enter the passcode you want clients to enter before accessing shared Online Candidate Lists. Click Save Passcode to apply your changes.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Once enabled, anyone opening an Online Candidate List shared from your account will be prompted to enter the passcode before they can view the candidate information. Note: If the account-level passcode is updated later, it will apply to all jobs except those that have custom, job-specific passcodes. Create a Unique Passcode for an Individual Job (Job-Level) If you want a specific job to have its own passcode, you can create a job-level passcode that overrides the account-level passcode for that job's Online Candidate List. Open the job for which you want to create a unique passcode. Navigate to the Candidate Pipeline section.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Scroll down and locate the Passcode for Online Candidate List option. Click the Edit (✏️) icon next to the passcode field. Enter the passcode you want to use for that specific job. Once saved, anyone accessing the Online Candidate List for that job will be prompted to enter the job-specific passcode. This passcode will override the account-level passcode configured for Online Candidate List pages. Which public pages can be protected with a passcode? When passcode protection is enabled, users will be required to enter the correct passcode before accessing the supported public pages. Currently, passcodes can be applied to the following Recruit CRM pages:

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Online Candidate Lists submitted to the client Online Candidate Lists are shared with clients when candidates are submitted for a job. Go to the Jobs list page and open the relevant job. Click on the ' Submit Candidates ' button to submit a list of candidates to the contact associated with that job. When a client receives an email, they will receive a list of candidates that can be accessed only by entering the passcode you shared. Once the candidate list is shared, the recipient will receive a link to the Online Candidate List. If passcode protection is enabled, they must enter the correct passcode before viewing the candidate information. ​

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Click here to know more on how to Submit Candidates to Clients Profile Update Request Forms are used to request updated information from candidates. Select one or more candidates whose profiles need updating. The candidate will receive an email containing a link to their profile update form. If passcode protection is enabled, they must enter the correct passcode before accessing and updating their profile information. ​ ​ Click here to know more about Requesting Candidate's Updated profile Problem: Client cannot access the online candidate list (passcode rejected)

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause : The passcode shared with the client does not match the active passcode. ​ ​ What to check : •Confirm whether a job-level passcode is set for that job. •Verify the passcode in the “Set passcode for public pages” section (account level) and in the job’s Candidate Pipeline section. ​ ​ Resolution: •Share the correct, current passcode with the client. •If needed, reset the passcode (either at account level or job level), save it, and resend the link with the updated passcode. Problem: Candidate cannot open the profile update request form

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Likely cause : The candidate is entering an incorrect passcode or the account-level passcode has recently changed. ​ ​ What to check: •Confirm the current passcode set under “Set passcode for public pages” for profile update request forms. •Ensure the candidate has the updated passcode. ​ ​ Resolution: •Provide the candidate with the correct passcode. •If you change the passcode, resend the profile update email with instructions to use the new passcode. Who can enable or disable passcodes at the account level? Only account owners and admins can enable or disable passcodes for profile update request forms and online candidate list pages in the admin settings.

chunks.t: Passcode for public pages (New UI)
chunks.x: Securing public pages in Recruit CRM with passcodes helps you control who can access candidate lists and profile update forms while keeping your data safe. If you need further assistance configuring passcodes or reviewing your setup, please contact your account owner, admin, or Recruit CRM support. How to remove Recruit CRM branding from external pages Requesting Updated Candidate Profiles (New UI)

chunks.t: Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Hide Your Emails feature allows you to keep your email conversations with candidates and contacts private from other users on your Recruit CRM account. When enabled, emails associated with your connected mailbox are removed from the Related Emails tab and are excluded from the Sent Email Conversation KPI in Team Performance Reports . These email conversations remain visible only within your personal mailbox in Recruit CRM. The setting applies to both past and future emails associated with the mailbox while it remains enabled.

chunks.t: Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: When disabled, previously hidden emails automatically become visible again in the Related Emails tab, and past email visibility is updated retroactively to reflect the new setting. • You want to keep your email conversations with candidates or contacts private from other team members. • You need to restrict access to email communication for confidentiality or compliance reasons. Please Note: The Hide Your Emails feature will hide all your email conversations in the Related Email tab. If you choose to hide your emails, you and your teammates will not be able to see any of the emails with candidates/contacts. Click your profile picture at the top right corner.

chunks.t: Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Select Email Settings from the menu to open your email configuration page. Ensure your email account is connected to Recruit CRM. If your email is not connected, connect it first to access this setting. In Email Settings, locate the Hide Emails toggle. If you have multiple email accounts connected, choose whether you want to hide conversations from all connected email accounts or from a specific email address only. ​ ​ 📌 Please note: Multiple email connections are available on the Business plan and above. ​ Turn on the Hide Emails toggle to hide your email conversations. Go back to Email Settings from your profile menu. Turn the toggle off to deactivate the Hide Your Emails feature.

chunks.t: Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Once deactivated, all previously hidden emails will automatically reappear in the Related Emails tab on associated records, and will again contribute to relevant email metrics. Problem: I do not see the Hide Your Emails toggle in Email Settings. Likely cause: Your email is not connected. ​ ​ What to check: •Open Email Settings and verify that at least one email address is connected. ​ ​ Resolution: •Connect your email to Recruit CRM, then reopen Email Settings to access the Hide Your Emails toggle. •If you still cannot see it, contact your account administrator or Recruit CRM support to confirm feature availability for your plan.

chunks.t: Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Problem: My emails are not contributing to the Sent Email Conversation KPI in team performance reports. Likely cause: The Hide Your Emails feature is turned on for your mailbox. ​ ​ What to check: •Open Email Settings and verify the status of the Hide Emails toggle. ​ ​ Resolution: •Turn off the Hide Emails toggle if you want your emails to count toward the Sent Email Conversation KPI and appear in team performance reports. What happens to existing emails when I enable Hide Your Emails?

chunks.t: Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: When you enable Hide Your Emails, all existing and future email conversations with candidates and contacts linked to your connected mailbox are hidden from the Related Emails tab and removed from the Sent Email Conversation KPI. They remain visible only in your personal mailbox in Recruit CRM. Who can configure the Hide Your Emails setting? Each user can configure the Hide Your Emails setting for their own connected mailbox in Email Settings . This setting is applied per user, not globally for the entire account. Can my teammates see my hidden emails anywhere in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: Hide Your Emails from Other Users in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: No. When Hide Your Emails is enabled, your email communication with candidates and contacts is not visible to you or your teammates in the Related Emails tab or in the Sent Email Conversation KPI. It is visible only in your personal mailbox in the Recruit CRM. Using the Hide Your Emails feature in Recruit CRM, you can control exactly who sees your email conversations with candidates and contacts while still working from your integrated mailbox. If you need further help configuring or understanding this setting, please reach out to your account administrator or Recruit CRM support. Hide all your emails from other users on your account Mark email IDs and Domains as Confidential (New UI)

chunks.t: Meeting Notetaker
chunks.x: The Meeting Notetaker can join your meetings, record the conversation, and generate a transcript for later reference. This will help you quickly revisit discussions, review important points, and extract useful insights without relying on manual note-taking. chunks.t: How to Navigate Candidates Within a Hiring Stage Using Sequence View (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature allows you to view and navigate through all candidates within a specific hiring stage of a job. From the candidate pipeline, you can open a candidate's profile and move through the remaining candidates in the same stage using the Next button, making it easier to review and manage candidates without repeatedly returning to the pipeline. While reviewing candidates, you can also see the total number of candidates associated with the job, view all candidates in the selected hiring stage, and perform actions directly from each candidate's profile details page. • You want to review all candidates in a specific hiring stage for a job

chunks.t: How to Navigate Candidates Within a Hiring Stage Using Sequence View (New UI)
chunks.x: • You need to quickly move between candidates in the same stage using the Next button • You want to evaluate candidate profiles directly from the job pipeline • You need to perform actions such as adding activities, updating records, or managing candidate profiles while reviewing candidates in a stage How to View and Navigate Candidates Within a Hiring Stage Follow the steps below to review all candidates within a specific hiring stage of a job: Navigate to the Jobs list page and open the job you want to review. Scroll down to the Candidate Pipeline , located at the bottom of the job page. Click on the hiring stage whose candidates you want to view.

chunks.t: How to Navigate Candidates Within a Hiring Stage Using Sequence View (New UI)
chunks.x: From the list of candidates in that stage, click on any candidate. The candidate's profile will open in Sequence View , which appears at the top of the page and allows you to navigate through all candidates within that hiring stage. Use the Next button to move through candidates one by one without returning to the pipeline. Note: The Next button only navigates through candidates within the currently selected hiring stage. It does not move between different hiring stages. • Move between candidates in the selected hiring stage using the Next button • View the total number of candidates available in that stage • Access candidate details, activities, notes, and other profile information

chunks.t: How to Navigate Candidates Within a Hiring Stage Using Sequence View (New UI)
chunks.x: • Continue reviewing candidates without returning to the Candidate Pipeline This view provides a faster way to review candidates stage by stage while staying within the context of the same job and hiring pipeline. ​ To learn more about how hiring stages work, please check this article: ​ Changing Hiring Stages Problem: The Next button does not appear or does not move to another candidate. Likely cause: There may be only one candidate in that hiring stage, or you are already on the last candidate in the sequence. What to check: Confirm how many candidates are listed in the hiring stage and review the total candidate count for the job.

chunks.t: How to Navigate Candidates Within a Hiring Stage Using Sequence View (New UI)
chunks.x: Resolution: If multiple candidates exist, continue using the Next button to move through them; if only one candidate is present, there will be no further candidate to move to. Use the Next button at the top right corner in the sequence view to move through all the different candidates that are in that particular hiring stage of that particular job. By using the candidate pipeline and sequence view inside a job, you can quickly review candidates in a specific hiring stage and manage their profiles efficiently from one place. Viewing the Candidate Sequence quickly inside a Job How to view the candidate hiring pipelines for jobs in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it Recruit Craft allows you to create and customize a website from scratch without any coding. You can start a new project using either a blank canvas or a pre-built template , then personalize it by editing pages, updating text and styling, adding sections and elements, and creating additional pages beyond the default homepage, job listing, and job description pages. You want to build a new website using Recruit Craft. You want to launch a website quickly by customizing an existing template. You need full control over your website's content, layout, styling, and navigation.

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: You want to create additional pages to expand your website beyond the default pages Log in to Recruit Craft and navigate to the Projects page. Click + Project in the top right corner, select Build Full Website , then choose one of the following: Blank Project to build your website from scratch. Template to start with a pre-designed website that you can customize. ​ If you're using a template, click View to preview it, then select Edit Template to begin customizing it. Use the page navigation within the editor to switch between the Homepage , Job Listing , Job Description , About Us , or any other page you want to customize. ​

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Every part of a page is editable. Simply click the element you want to modify, such as text, an image, a button, or another component. Once selected, the relevant configuration options will appear in the panel on the right. From the right-hand panel, you can customize the selected element based on its type. For example, when editing a text element, you can modify options such as: Other elements, such as images, buttons, sections, or forms, display their own configuration options, allowing you to customize their appearance and behavior. Review the page after making your changes to ensure the content, layout, and styling appear as expected.

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: To add new content to a page, open Elements from the left-hand panel and select the component you want to insert. Recruit Recruit Craft offers a variety of elements, including: Text (H1 to H6 headings and paragraph text) Custom HTML for embedding custom code or iframes After adding an element, click it to customize its appearance and behavior using the right-hand panel. Depending on the element type, you can configure options such as: Other advanced properties specific to the selected element Other advanced properties specific to the selected element ​

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Note: The available customization options vary depending on the selected element. For example, forms allow you to configure fields, layouts, and submission behavior, while videos provide playback and display settings. To quickly build your page layout, open Sections from the left-hand panel and drag the section you want onto your page. Recruit Craft includes several pre-built sections, including layouts with ready-to-use form components, such as: These ready-to-use sections include predefined layouts, making it easy to build pages without creating every section from scratch. Modify individual elements within the section Change text, colors, spacing, backgrounds, images, and links

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Add your own elements to Grid or Flexbox sections If you prefer to create a completely custom layout, start with a Grid or Flexbox section and build it by adding elements manually. ​ Repeat the same editing process for the Job Listing and Job Description pages by updating their content, layout, elements, and sections. Review each page to ensure the design and navigation remain consistent across your website, and save your changes regularly. To create pages beyond the default ones, open Pages from the left-hand panel and click Add New Page . Enter a name for the page, then customize its content, layout, and design using the same editing tools available throughout the website editor. ​

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Yes. You can add a Form element from the Elements panel or use a pre-built section that includes a form. Forms support multiple layouts and allow you to collect visitor information directly from your website. Forms support Text , Email , and Phone fields. Every form must include at least one field and a Submit button. First Name and Email are required for a successful submission. Can form submissions create records in Recruit CRM?

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Yes. You can choose to automatically create a Contact record in Recruit CRM for each form submission. The submitted First Name , Email , and Phone are mapped to the corresponding Contact fields, and the submitted message is saved as a note. If a Contact with the same email address already exists, the submission is added to the existing Contact instead of creating a duplicate. Will I receive notifications when someone submits a form? Yes. Recruit Craft sends an email notification to the email address associated with your Recruit Craft account whenever a website visitor submits a form.

chunks.t: How to Create a Website Using Recruit Craft
chunks.x: Yes. The Video element lets you upload videos directly from your device or embed videos using YouTube , Vimeo , or Loom links. Uploaded videos are stored for reuse, similar to uploaded images. Embed videos from YouTube , Vimeo , and Loom . Unsupported links display an error prompting you to upload a video or use a supported provider. When Autoplay is enabled, Mute is automatically enabled because most browsers require autoplay videos to be muted. Why are some playback settings unavailable for Loom videos? Due to limitations of the Loom player, the Loop and Show Controls settings are not available for embedded Loom videos. Building a Custom Careers Page with the Recruit Craft Website Editor

chunks.t: Job-Specific Application Form (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The job-specific application form feature in Recruit CRM lets you customize candidate fields uniquely for each job application form. You want each job opening to have its own tailored application form. You need to collect different information or questions for different roles. You want to set specific fields as mandatory for certain jobs. You want to hide or show certain fields only for selected job application forms.

chunks.t: Job-Specific Application Form (New UI)
chunks.x: Any modifications made in the job-specific form will specifically apply to that particular job itself and it won't change the default Job application form settings . ​ Please note that any changes that you make to the default Job application form settings in the admin settings DO NOT affect the customization you've already made for specific job application forms from the job's detailed profile page. Customizing the application form for each specific job 1. Navigate to the Job Details page for the job you want to configure and make sure the job application form is enabled for that job.

chunks.t: Job-Specific Application Form (New UI)
chunks.x: 2. Locate the Job application form URL button on the Job Details page and click the Settings option located alongside the Job application form URL. 3. Upon clicking, you can customize the form fields and: Set the field labels to words in your language by clicking on the edit button next to the field label. Choose which fields you want to be mandatory on the application form and turn off the visibility for the ones you don't wish to show. Reorder the sequence of the fields by dragging the fields up / down. Choose the questions you wish to add to the specific job form from the questions library you create.

chunks.t: Job-Specific Application Form (New UI)
chunks.x: To ensure that the 'Note for candidate' is visible on the job application form, you need to turn on the 'Note for candidates' field from the Job application form settings under the 'General Page Settings'. Accessing job-specific details submitted by candidates 📄 1. On the Job Details page, open the Candidate Pipeline tab. 2. In the Candidate Details section, click the Job Specific Details button to examine job-related information for each candidate. You'll be able to access all the job-associated files and review the candidate questions that the candidate has submitted for that specific job.

chunks.t: Job-Specific Application Form (New UI)
chunks.x: Note: You can enable the 'Job Application Form' by default for all the new jobs that you will create in your account by ticking the box/turning it on under the Job Fields page, which posts all the Open Jobs to your public Recruit CRM Jobs Page and partner job boards as well. Also, it does not affect the existing jobs in your database, and this will be applicable to all the new jobs created by you after this option is enabled only. Problem: The Note for Candidate is not showing on the application form Likely cause: The “Note for Candidate” field is not turned on in the job application form settings. Go to the job application form settings under the General Page settings.

chunks.t: Job-Specific Application Form (New UI)
chunks.x: Check whether the Note for Candidate field is enabled. Refresh or reopen the job application form to confirm that the note appears for candidates. Do changes to a job-specific application form affect the default job application form? No. Any modifications made in a job-specific form apply only to that particular job and do not change the default job application form settings. Customizing job-specific application forms in Recruit CRM lets you tailor each job’s application experience, collect only the most relevant information, and review targeted candidate details directly from the Job Details page. Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report detection builds directly on top of the Job Change Alert Report . Whenever Recruit CRM detects that a candidate has changed jobs, it takes one extra step and checks whether the candidate's new company matches any job the candidate was previously assigned to (Jobs created in the last 365 days) and where they were never marked as Placed. If the system finds a match, it marks it as a potential backdoor hire, since it suggests the candidate may have joined that company on their own, outside the placement you were working on. Backdoor Hiring Alerts are useful whenever you want to:

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: Catch cases where a candidate you sourced or submitted for a role may have been hired directly by the client. Track and resolve these cases with a clear status workflow, instead of managing them over email or spreadsheets. Log recovered fees against a record once a backdoor hire situation has been resolved commercially, so you have a record of the outcome. Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report is available only on the paid plans (Pro, Business and Enterprise). Users with view access to a specific candidate or contact records will be able to view only those records in this report.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: You need Edit access to a record to update the candidate profile or dismiss its job change alert. If you don't have edit access and try to click Update, you'll see a "No access" screen instead. On the Free plan, detection doesn't run at all, and you'll still see the Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report, but it will remain empty. If you later upgrade to a paid plan, detection for your account begins from the next monthly detection cycle. One Backdoor Hire record unlock consumes 5 Recruit CRM credits per candidate. How is a potential backdoor hire detected? There are 2 ways of accessing the potential backdoor hire that is detected:

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: Please note: This check only looks at jobs created within the last 365 days, and only jobs the candidate is currently assigned to at the time of the check. If you later unassign the candidate from that job, it's no longer considered for backdoor hire detection going forward. 1. Go to Reports → Backdoor Hiring Report , where you can review, unlock, and track it. Search by the record's name or company to find a specific record quickly. 3. Backdoor Status: You can assign a status to each record to track resolution. The default status is Backdoor Hire . Updating status does not remove the record from the report.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: When Recovered is selected, a pop-up allows entry of the recovered fee (in the Job's currency); this appears in the Recovered Amount column and can be edited by selecting Recovered again. From within the Update Status option, you can also add a task directly against a record, so you don't lose track of what still needs resolving.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: 4. Total Recovered Amount is shown at the top right. Amounts are shown at two levels: The Recovered Amount column for an individual record is shown in that job's currency. The Total Recovered Amount shown at the top right of the report is shown in your account's currency, and it recalculates automatically whenever you apply filters — so it always reflects the total for whatever subset of records you're currently viewing.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: Bulk Actions: You will be able to update Status and Update Profile. When updating status in bulk, an option to simultaneously update profiles is shown. Selecting Recovered in bulk applies the entered fee to each candidate separately. Records already at the chosen status or already updated are skipped. Sort & Filters: Column-level sorting; filters for New Organization, Assigned Job, Hiring Stage, Start Date, and Status; search by candidate name and company name. When a potential backdoor hire is detected, a Backdoor Hire Detected badge appears on the candidate's profile:

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: Note: If a candidate has both a pending Job Change Alert and a Backdoor Hire Detected alert at the same time, only the Backdoor Hire Detected badge is shown on their profile as it takes precedence, since it's the more significant of the two. You can still update the candidate's profile directly from this badge. The badge stays until you click on ' Update Profile' or ' Dismiss' , or a newer job change is detected. Dismissing removes the alert from both the profile and the report, and the same alert won't reappear in future cycles, but a new one will appear if the candidate moves jobs again. The system updates the Current Organization and Current Title/Position of the candidate.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: Creates a new work history entry with the detected job details. If the previous work history entry had "Currently working in this role" toggled on, its End Date is set using the publicly available data (left blank if unavailable). If the candidate has reached the maximum number of work history entries, the oldest is removed to make room. If the new employer doesn't exist as a company record, it is stored as plain text and no company record is auto-created.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: Note: When a work history entry is created via the job change alert update, mandatory work history field validation is bypassed. If mandatory fields configured in your account are not available from the publicly available data, those fields will remain empty in the new entry. Under the Backdoor Hire/ Lost Fee Report, each record shows: Please note: The first 2 records in your report are unlocked for free. Every record after that stays blurred until you unlock it, which costs 5 Recruit CRM Credits per candidate.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: You can use 'Unlock All' to unlock everything at once. If you don't have enough credits to unlock every blurred record, unlocking proceeds in order, starting with the oldest detected record, until your credits run out. By default, the report is sorted by when the Assigned Job was created — the older the job, the earlier it appears in the list; the more recently the job was created, the later it appears. If the same candidate happens to match more than one job at the same company, this is still only treated as one alert, and only costs you one unlock.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: You can clear an alert from a candidate's profile in one of two ways: change their Backdoor Status away from the default "Backdoor Hire" to any other status, or dismiss the alert directly from the badge on the candidate's Details Page. Note: If you delete a candidate record, it's removed from both the Backdoor Hiring Report and the Job Change Alert Report. If you merge two candidate records where either one had a pending alert, the detection checks rerun on the resulting merged profile, and any relevant alerts are surfaced again on that profile and in both reports.

chunks.t: Backdoor Hire/Lost Fee Report
chunks.x: Backdoor Hiring Alerts give you visibility into candidates who may have joined a company outside your placement, without needing to track it manually. Review such records in the Backdoor Hiring Report, unlock the ones you need, and use the status and recovered amount fields to keep track of how each case is resolved.

chunks.t: Additional Pages Included in the Recruit CRM UI Revamp
chunks.x: As part of our ongoing UI revamp, we're rolling out the new Recruit CRM interface to additional pages between July 22, 2026, and August 31, 2026 . The rollout will take place in phases, with different pages being revamped throughout this period. This article provides an overview of each page included in the rollout, each section includes a short GIF highlighting where to access the page or pop-up in the current interface, making it easier to identify what is being revamped. The pages and GIFs in this article highlight selected locations where the updated interface will be available.

chunks.t: Additional Pages Included in the Recruit CRM UI Revamp
chunks.x: For instance, the Assign Candidates to Job pop-up is shown below only in a few sections for reference. Please note that wherever the same pop-up is available elsewhere in Recruit CRM, it will also reflect the revamped interface. The same approach applies to other pop-ups and pages across the platform. Job Details Page → Assign Candidates pop-up. Job Kanban View → Assign Candidates pop-up. Company Details Page → View All Contacts. Job Details Page → Candidate Pipeline → View All Candidates. chunks.t: Generate a Branded Candidate Summary with Claude Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: With Recruit CRM's MCP (Model Context Protocol) connector, you can ask Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to pull a candidate's resume and other supporting files directly from their profile and turn them into a clean, structured, branded summary ready to send to your client in minutes. 1. You need to have access to Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity (web, desktop, or mobile app) with the Recruit CRM MCP connector added to your respective Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity account. 2. Recruit CRM MCP is available only on the Business and Enterprise plans. 3. The candidate's profile in Recruit CRM should have their resume and any other relevant files such as portfolios, certifications, and reference notes uploaded.

chunks.t: Generate a Branded Candidate Summary with Claude Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: 4. By Default, Account Owner and Admins have MCP access. Users on the custom roles with access to MCP can also have MCP access. 📋 How to Generate a Candidate Summary Using Claude? Step 1. Open AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity and confirm the Recruit CRM MCP Connector Is Active: Log into Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity and check that the Recruit CRM MCP connector appears as a connected source in the AI assistant's settings. If the Recruit CRM MCP connector isn't connected yet: Click here to learn more about connecting the Recruit CRM MCP connector to AI assistants. Step 2. Ask Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to Retrieve the Candidate's Profile:

chunks.t: Generate a Branded Candidate Summary with Claude Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Start a new chat with Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity and ask it to pull up the candidate using their name. If you're working with a common name, include the job title to help Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity find the right profile. For example: "Pull up [Candidate Name]'s profile from Recruit CRM, including their resume and any other files on their profile." Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity will use the Recruit CRM MCP connector to retrieve the candidate's profile, including their resume and any other files uploaded to that profile. Step 3. Ask Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to Generate the Branded Summary:

chunks.t: Generate a Branded Candidate Summary with Claude Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: This is the main prompt, and it works best when you're specific about three things: what to highlight, the tone, and the format. For example: "Using [Candidate Name]'s resume and any other files on their profile, generate a structured and branded Candidate Summary. Highlight their main skills and key information relevant to the role, so I can share this with the client. Use our standard branded format — [agency name] header, clean section headings, and no internal notes or contact details."

chunks.t: Generate a Branded Candidate Summary with Claude Using Recruit CRM MCP

Confirm that no confidential information has been pulled in from the candidate's file. chunks.t: Submit candidates to contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The Submit Candidates feature allows you to share candidates assigned to a job with clients, hiring managers, or other contacts directly from Recruit CRM. It provides a centralized way to present shortlisted candidates, collect structured feedback, and collaborate on hiring decisions. Using shared candidate lists or email submissions, you can control which candidates and candidate fields are visible to recipients, collect feedback in a structured format, and allow contacts to update candidate hiring stages directly. • You want to send shortlisted candidates to a client or hiring manager directly from Recruit CRM.

chunks.t: Submit candidates to contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: • You need an efficient way to collect candidate feedback without relying on lengthy email threads. • You want clients or interviewers to review candidates through a shared list or Kanban-style view. • You want contacts to update candidate hiring stages directly from the shared link. 📌 Note: Candidates do not receive any email or notification when their profiles are submitted to a contact through the Submit Candidates feature. Follow the steps below to access the Candidate Pipeline and share candidates with a client or hiring manager. Navigate to the Jobs list page and click on the job whose candidates you want to submit. You will be taken to the Job Details page.

chunks.t: Submit candidates to contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: Scroll down to the Candidate Pipeline section, where you can view all candidates assigned to the job and manage candidate submissions. From here, you can configure candidate visibility, choose which fields to share, and submit candidates to your contacts. Before submitting candidates, you must decide which candidates should be visible to the client. ​ Use the visibility toggle next to each candidate to control whether they will appear in the shared candidate list. • Visibility ON – The candidate will be visible to the client. • Visibility OFF – The candidate will not be included in the shared list. • Not Available – Candidates in the Applied stage cannot have their visibility updated.

chunks.t: Submit candidates to contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: To update the visibility, please update the stage from 'Applied' to another hiring stage. ​ ​If you need to update the visibility of multiple candidates at once, click Set Candidate Visibility button at the top of the Candidate Pipeline tab and choose whether to turn visibility on or off for all candidates in the job. ​ You can control which candidate information is visible to clients. In the Candidate Pipeline, click Fields Shared & Kanban Customization . ​ Select the candidate fields you want clients to see for that particular job from the list on your right. These settings only apply to the selected job. Navigate to Admin Settings → Fields Shared with Clients .

chunks.t: Submit candidates to contacts (New UI)
chunks.x: Select the fields that should be shared with clients across the account. These settings become the default for all jobs. Once visibility and shared fields have been configured: In the Candidate Pipeline , click Submit Candidates . Select one of the available submission methods: • Email with Attachments and Candidate Grid For Online Candidate List and Email with Attachments and Candidate Grid , you can configure an automation that updates the candidate's hiring stage when the submission email is sent. ​ This option sends an email containing a secure link to the selected contact. • Candidates whose visibility is turned on • Fields that have been configured for sharing ​

Your email needs to be connected here to generate the shared link, or the preview list. ​ Here's how to connect your email if it's not connected: Connecting Your Email (Gmail) To Recruit CRM Using Nylas Connecting Your Outlook/Office365 Email To Recruit CRM Once the client opens the link, they can switch between: • Move candidates between hiring stages ​ Click here to know how to customize Kanban cards for clients

Enable the Let Clients Use option for that stage. ​ Only stages with this option enabled will be available to clients when they move candidates between stages from the shared List or Kanban view. ​ You can also decide whether clients can download the shared candidate list as a CSV file. chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Please note: This feature is currently in Beta and will be gradually rolled out to all users. Recruit CRM Credits provide a shared credit balance that can be used across multiple credit-based features within Recruit CRM, including: • AI Job Candidate Matching • AI Sourcing • Job Change Alerts • Backdoor Hiring Alerts • AI Edits in the Resume Formatting Agent • LinkedIn Integration • Advanced Analytics • Workflow Automation (Workato) Recruit Craft and the Additional 10k Records add-on are not part of the Recruit CRM Credits system and continue on their existing billing.

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Depending on your subscription plan, you'll receive a monthly allocation of complimentary credits that can be used across supported features. This gives you the flexibility to use your monthly credits where they're most valuable for your recruitment workflow. Business and Pro plan users receive complimentary Recruit CRM Credits every month based on the number of purchased user licenses on your account.​ 📌 Please note: Free credits are automatically allocated based on your plan and purchased seat count. They expire at the end of your billing cycle and do not roll over. ​

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Your Recruit CRM Credits can be used across several features. The number of credits deducted depends on the feature and the action you perform. Data Enrichment: 1 credit for a work email (contact), 3 credits for a personal email (candidate), 4 credits for a phone number (either entity). Job Posting via VONQ: 25 credits per job posting. Calling and SMS: Credits are deducted based on the existing calling and SMS pricing. Filter-based search: 1 credit per results page (up to 100 results). Natural language search: 3 credits per results page (up to 100 results). Job-based search: 3 credits per results page (up to 100 results). Matching: 3 credits per results page (up to 100 results)

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Refining criteria: Re-running the search after refining the matching criteria consumes 3 credits again. Refreshing matches: 2 credits when the refresh finds new matching candidates. Job Change Alerts: 1 credit per update, charged when you accept the job change update. Backdoor Hiring Alerts: 5 credits per unlocked record from the Backdoor Hiring report. AI Edits in the Resume Formatting Agent : 0.5 Recruit CRM credits per edit.\ LinkedIn Messages Integration: 150 credits per user per month, or 1,500 credits per user per year. You can purchase the LinkedIn Messages Integration for specific licenses as needed.

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Advanced Analytics : 300 credits per user per month, or 3,000 credits per user per year. Workflow Automation: Your existing task bucket is converted to an equivalent credit charge (for example, a 1,000-tasks/month bucket becomes 500 credits). Meeting Notetaker: 9 credits per hour of usage, with no credits deducted for meetings lasting less than 1 minute. Learn more about Meeting Notetaker credit usage here. WhatsApp Integration: 100 Recruit CRM Credits per connected user/per month. Once enabled: WhatsApp access remains active for 30 days. Access automatically renews after 30 days if the option remains enabled.

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: If disabled before renewal, no additional credits are deducted, and access ends at the end of the current period. You can purchase the WhatsApp Integration for specific licenses as needed. ​ Here is how you can access your Credits within Recruit CRM: Navigate to Admin Settings and click on Recruit CRM Credits . ​ • View your Data Enrichment and AI Sourcing usage logs 📌 Please note: This page will be deprecated on November 30, 2026 . Historical Data Enrichment and AI Sourcing logs from before the Credit Log was released will not be migrated to the new Credit Log page and will remain available only on this page until it is deprecated.

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: If you need to retain these historical logs, please export them before November 30, 2026 . Viewing and managing your credits: the Credit Log The Credit Log page replaces the existing Recruit CRM Credits page, currently available in Admin Settings . It provides a combined view of your free, recurring, and non-expiring credits , along with a detailed log of credit usage across different features. Expand each row to view additional usage details. ​ Export the credit log: Account Owners and users with access to the Credit Log can export the credit usage data. Schedule credit log emails: Account Owners can schedule the credit log to be emailed on a recurring basis, similar to Audit Logs . ​

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: When you use a credit-based feature, Recruit CRM automatically consumes credits in the following order: Free / Complimentary credits - auto-allocated by plan and seat count, expire at the end of your billing cycle, don't roll over. Recurring Subscription credits - purchased monthly or annually, also expire at cycle end and don't roll over. Auto-Reload and Non-Expiring credits - never expire and carry forward indefinitely. This ensures your oldest, soonest-to-expire credits are always used before anything permanent. To buy more credits, go to Admin Settings > Plans & Billing and click on Edit Current Plan . From here, you can buy any of the following three types of credits: ​

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: 1. Recurring Credit Subscription (monthly or annual) Buy a recurring credit subscription in the amount you choose as there's no fixed package to pick from, you enter the number of credits directly. This is independent of whether your main Recruit CRM plan is monthly or annual: you can subscribe to a monthly credit subscription, an annual one, or both at the same time. Each has its own billing cycle and can be cancelled separately from the other. Annual recurring: minimum 1,000 credits Once subscribed, you're billed the same amount on each renewal date, and the credits are added automatically.

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: ​ 2. Auto-Reload If you're not sure how many credits you'll need, Auto-Reload automatically tops up your account when your total balance (free + recurring + non-expiring credits combined) drops to a threshold you set. You choose both the threshold and the reload amount, and you can cap how many times it triggers per month (up to 15). Auto-Reload requires at least one active recurring credit subscription; if that subscription is cancelled or a payment fails, Auto-Reload won't trigger. ​

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: 3. Non-Expiring Credits (one-time purchase) If you don't want to commit to a recurring subscription, you can buy non-expiring credits as a one-time purchase. These also cost 25% more per credit than recurring subscription credits, but they never expire and carry forward indefinitely. ​ 📌 Please note: Any single purchase- recurring, Auto-Reload, or non-expiring is capped at 500,000 credits or $50,000, whichever comes first. You cannot purchase more credits once this amount has been hit.

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: On the same page, use the Credit Calculator to estimate how many credits you’ll need based on your expected usage. Enter the expected usage for each add-on, such as LinkedIn Integration for 5 users, 100 AI Sourcing searches per month, and 100 Data Enrichment records , and click Estimate Credits . ​ The calculator shows the recommended number of credits based on your expected usage, as both a monthly and an annual amount. Select Monthly or Annual under Recommended Credits to add those credits to your bill, then review and complete your purchase. Upgrading or downgrading your recurring credit subscription

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Upgrade: The higher credit plan takes effect immediately. You’ll only be charged for the prorated difference for the remaining days in your current billing cycle, and the additional credits are added accordingly. From your next renewal, the full subscription amount and credit allocation will apply. Downgrade: Your current subscription and credits remain unchanged until the next renewal. At renewal, the lower subscription amount and corresponding credit allocation will take effect. Which plans receive complimentary Recruit CRM Credits?

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Complimentary Recruit CRM Credits are available on all plans, including Free, Pro, Business, and Enterprise (and their Emerging Market variants). The allocation amount varies by plan. • AI Job Candidate Matching • AI Sourcing • Job Change Alerts • Backdoor Hiring Alerts • LinkedIn Integration • Advanced Analytics • Workflow Automation (Workato) • AI Edits in the Resume Formatting Agent Do my complimentary credits depend on the number of users? Yes. Complimentary credits are allocated per purchased user license , so your total monthly credit allocation increases with the number of users on your account.

chunks.t: Understanding Recruit CRM Credits
chunks.x: Recruit CRM first uses your complimentary (Free) credits, followed by any purchased Recurring Subscription credits, and then any Auto-Reload or Non-Expiring credits on your account. This ensures your oldest, soonest-to-expire credits are always used before anything permanent. Recruit CRM Credits provide a flexible way to use AI, enrichment, communication, job advertising, analytics, and automation features from a shared credit balance. By understanding how credits are allocated and consumed, you can make the most of your available credits across the platform.
