chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM automatically checks your existing candidates' and contacts' records publicly available data and lets you know when it detects a job change. This could mean the candidate/contact has moved to a completely new company or simply gotten a new title while staying at the same company, either way, you'll see it reflected as an alert under the 'Job Change Alert' Report.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: When Recruit CRM detects a change, a badge appears on the record's details page, showing the previous organization/title alongside the newly detected organization/title. Every pending alert also shows up under Reports → Job Change Alert Report , so you can review them individually from a profile or handle several at once from the Reports section. Job Change Alerts are useful whenever you want to: Know when a candidate or contact has moved to a new company. Catch a title change at the same company, which can signal a promotion or shift in seniority worth noting on their record. Keep current organization and title fields accurate across your database without manually checking each profile.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: Job Change Alert report is available only on the paid plans (Pro, Business and Enterprise). Users with view access to a specific candidate or contact records will be able to view only those records in this report. You need Edit access to a record to update or dismiss its alert. If you don't have edit access and try to click Update, you'll see a "No access" screen instead. On the Free plan, detection doesn't run at all, and you'll still see the Job Change Alert Report, but it will remain empty. If you later upgrade to a paid plan, detection for your account begins from the next monthly detection cycle.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: One Manual job update/Automated job update (candidate or contact) will consume 1 Recruit CRM Credit. For any record to be checked, it needs a valid LinkedIn profile URL added under the default LinkedIn Profile URL field, and the system uses it to match the record against the data source. Along with the valid LinkedIn profile URL: For candidates: The record needs at least one Work history entry with "Currently working in this role" toggled on, along with a start date for that role, company, and title filled in for that entry.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: For contacts: The record needs a current title and company name on the record. If a contact is linked to more than one company, the system checks against all the companies. Once the required data in the fields is available, the system matches records via LinkedIn URL against the publicly available data. An alert is generated only when the publicly available data's latest job start date is more recent than the record’s work history in Recruit CRM and either the company or title has changed. This detection check runs once every month, so alerts are refreshed on a monthly cycle rather than in real time. Accessing/Reviewing/Updating the Job Change Alert

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: There are 2 ways of accessing the Job Change Alert that is detected: From the Candidate/Contact's Details Page. You can review the alert, update or dismiss the alert. 1. Go to Reports → Job Change Alert Report to see every candidate and contact with a pending alert in one place. Filter the list by record type, so you can look at candidate updates or contact updates separately. Search by the record's name or company to find a specific person quickly. You can check the 'Start Date' column, which reflects the start date of the record's newly detected job. You can apply Filters on the 'New Organization' and 'Start Date' columns.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: Name column shows the name of the candidate or contact record the alert belongs to. Current Organization and Title shows the current organization and title currently saved on that candidate or contact's record inside your database. New Organization and Title shows the new organization and title we've detected for them. You can scroll towards the right of the page and click on the 'Update' button to update the candidate's/contact's record individually: Or you can bulk select the records and click on the 'Update Profiles' option to update the records in bulk: Since bulk updates can take a moment to process, they run in the background, and you'll get a notification once they're complete.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: From the Candidate/Contact's Details Page: 1. When a job change is detected, an alert badge appears on the record's details page showing: An Update button to apply the change and each accepted update consumes 1 Recruit CRM Credit. The badge stays until you click on the ' Update Profile' or ' Dismiss' , or a newer job change is detected. Dismissing removes the alert from both the profile and the report and the same alert won't reappear in future cycles, but a new one will appear if the candidate/contact moves jobs again. The system updates the Current Organization and Current Title/Position . Creates a new work history entry with the detected job details.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: If the previous work history entry had "Currently working in this role" toggled on, its End Date is set using the publicly available data (left blank if unavailable). If the candidate has reached the maximum number of work history entries, the oldest is removed to make room. If the new employer doesn't exist as a company record, it is stored as plain text and no company record is auto-created. Note: When a work history entry is created via a Job Change Alert update, mandatory work history field validation is bypassed . If mandatory fields configured in your account are not available from the publicly available data, those fields will remain empty in the new entry.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: The system updates the Company and Title fields. For contacts linked to more than one company: the system check the publicly available data for an end date on each company. If a company has an end date, it's removed from the contact's record. Companies without an end date stay as they are, and the newly detected company is added on top. If the new company doesn't exist in your account, it is auto-created as a company record (name, website, logo filled from the publicly available data). Mandatory field validation for company creation is bypassed in this scenario.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: If you'd rather not review these manually every time, you can turn on automatic updates. Users with access to the Recruit CRM Credits page will be able to perform this action: 1. Go to Admin Settings → Recruit CRM Credits. Click on the 'Enable Credits For' option. 2. Turn on 'Auto Update Candidate Records' and 'Auto Update Contact Records' under the Job Change Alert section and click on Save. This can be switched on separately for candidates and for contacts, depending on which record type you want automated. Please note: Each successful update, whether you apply it manually or it happens automatically, uses 1 Recruit CRM Credit.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: Once you turn this on, any updates that were already pending for your account are applied immediately. From then on, new updates are applied automatically every month as part of the regular detection cycle, as long as you have enough credits to cover them. The system checks for updates every 30 days and applies them automatically. A badge on the work history entry indicates an automated update; hovering shows "Updated by Recruit CRM." If credits run out mid-cycle, automated updates pause and the Account owner and all Admins receive an in-app and email notification: "Automated job change updates paused due to low credits." Updates resume once credits are available.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: You can enable/disable the toggles for Manual Update for Candidate/Contact records using the 'Manual Update Candidate Records' and 'Manual Update Contact Records' under the Job Change Alert section and click on Save. Duplicates: The system won't generate duplicate alerts for the same record (unless there is a newly detected job/company). A dismissed alert won't reappear unless the person moves to a different role or company later. Merged records: When two records are merged, the job change check re-runs for the merged record and alerts are surfaced accordingly. Deleted records: Deleting a candidate or contact removes their entries from the Job Change Alert Report.

chunks.t: Job Change Alert Report
chunks.x: Manual work history match: If you manually add a work history entry matching an active Job Change Alert, the badge and the corresponding report entry are automatically removed. Job Change Alerts help you keep candidate and contact records up to date without manually checking each profile. You can review and apply updates one at a time from a record's badge, handle several together from the Job Change Alert Report, or turn on automated updates so the system applies them for you every month. chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? You can post all open jobs on your company website or Job Boards to get applicants directly into your database. Recruit CRM also lets you customize Job Application Forms with fields of your choice and you can control the information collected during the application process. It helps you create a consistent, branded application experience while ensuring applicants are captured directly in your Recruit CRM database. You can use this feature when you want to: Customize application form fields, labels, placeholders, field order, visibility, and mandatory requirements.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Configure general application page settings, including job description visibility, social sharing options, and candidate terms. Configure language and proficiency fields, including default languages and proficiency levels. Control which logo appears on job application forms, including the account logo, job company logo, or no logo. The Job Application Form Settings page is the central location for managing your job application experience in Recruit CRM. From here, you can configure how application forms look and behave, including page settings, form fields, automated emails, candidate questions, branding, and job-specific application forms.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: To access these settings, navigate to Admin Settings → Job Settings → Job Application Form Settings . The first tab you will see is General Page Settings , which controls the overall appearance and behavior of your job application forms. ​ From this section, you can control what candidates see first when they open your Job. • Display the Job Description first, allowing candidates to review the role details before applying • Display the Job Application Form directly, allowing candidates to start their application immediately You can also control whether the job description appears at all on the application page. • Turn the toggle ON to display the job description on the job application form.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: • Turn the toggle OFF to hide the job description from the job application form completely. This allows you to tailor the application experience based on your hiring process and the amount of information you want candidates to review before applying. This setting allows you to control whether candidates can see social media sharing options on your job application form. When enabled, social media share icons will be displayed on the application page, allowing visitors to easily share the job opening across supported social platforms and help increase the visibility of your job postings. • Turn the toggle ON to display social media share icons on the job application form.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: • Turn the toggle OFF to hide the social media share icons from the job application form. 3. Automated "Thank You for Applying" Emails: Recruit CRM allows you to automatically send a confirmation email to candidates when they submit an application through the job application form. This helps acknowledge their application instantly and provides a better candidate experience. To configure automated application emails: First, create an email template that will be used as the automated "Thank You for Applying" email. Here's how you can create Email Templates for automated workflows.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: In the General Page Settings section, select the email template you want to use. If you do not have a suitable template yet, you can create one and then select it here. Choose the email account that should send these automated emails. You can select from users who have connected their email accounts to Recruit CRM. Once configured, candidates who apply through your job application forms will automatically receive the selected email from the chosen sender account. • Confirm that the application was successfully received. • Share next steps in your hiring process. • Provide additional information about the role or company. • Deliver a more professional and responsive candidate experience.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: This section allows you to configure the terms and policies that candidates must review and agree to before submitting their job application. • Candidate Terms – Terms and conditions related to candidate consent, data collection, data processing, and GDPR compliance. • Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy – The policy text displayed to candidates regarding equal opportunity and non-discriminatory hiring practices. The content entered here is shown directly on the job application form, allowing candidates to review the information before completing their application.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: • For the Candidate Terms section to be visible on the job application form, the GDPR Compliance toggle must be enabled in Account Settings . • For the Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy to appear on the job application form, the EEO toggle must be enabled in Account Settings . If either setting is disabled, the corresponding section will not be displayed to candidates on the application form. Enter your GDPR-related terms, general Candidate terms, and consent language in the Candidate Terms box. Add or update your Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy text as required. 5.Customize Button, Link Labels, and Additional Form Settings:

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: The Customize Button & Link Labels section allows you to customize the text displayed throughout the job application form, helping you tailor the candidate experience to match your preferred terminology, language, or branding. • Other application form text displayed to candidates You can also control the visibility of additional sections on the application form from here. ​ Simply turn the corresponding toggle ON or OFF to show or hide: • Note for Candidate – Displays additional instructions or information to candidates on the application form. • SMS Terms and Conditions – Displays SMS consent terms when applicable. ​

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: These settings allow you to further customize the application experience while ensuring candidates see the information that is most relevant to your hiring process. Configure Job Application Form Fields Settings The Job Application Form Field Settings tab allows you to control which fields appear on your application forms and how candidates interact with them. To access these settings, navigate to Admin Settings → Job Settings → Job Application Form Settings and then switch to the Job Application Form Field Settings. ​ Open the Job Application Form Field Settings tab to view all available application fields. ​

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: You can choose which fields should be displayed on the application form and hide any fields that are not required. To change the order in which fields appear, simply drag and drop them into the desired sequence. You can also mark fields as mandatory to ensure candidates provide the required information before submitting their application. ​ To customize a field, click the Edit button next to the field name. • Rename field labels to match your preferred terminology or language. • Add placeholder text to guide candidates while filling out the form. These customizations help align the application experience with your organization's branding and communication style. ​

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: 3. Add Job-Associated Files to the Application Form: Job-associated files allow you to collect additional documents from candidates that are specific to a particular job opening. These files are configured at the job level and can be used to request information that may not be relevant for every role, such as certifications, portfolios, work samples, licenses, or other supporting documents. When a candidate applies for the job, they will be prompted to upload the required files as part of their application. This is especially useful when different jobs require different supporting documents, allowing you to tailor the application process to the requirements of each position.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: For more information on configuring and managing job-associated files, refer to the article: Save/Share files associated with a candidates job application with your Contacts 4.Add Language and Proficiency Fields to the Application Form: You can collect language skills and proficiency levels directly through the application form, allowing candidates to provide information about the languages they speak and their level of expertise. This helps recruiters quickly assess whether applicants meet the language requirements for a role. ​

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: To streamline the application process, you can predefine one or more languages by updating the field values for the Language field. You can select these languages from the dropdown list in the Fields Values tab, these default languages will automatically appear on the application form for all candidates. When default languages are configured, candidates will be required to select a proficiency level for each predefined language as part of their application. This helps ensure that language information is collected in a consistent format across all applicants.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: If no default languages are added, candidates will have the flexibility to enter their own languages while completing the application form. They can add multiple languages and specify their proficiency level for each one, providing a more personalized overview of their language capabilities. All language and proficiency information submitted through the application form is stored as part of the candidate's profile, making it readily available during screening and evaluation. 📌 Note: These settings apply globally across all job application forms unless overridden by a job-specific application form.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Candidate Questions allow you to collect additional information from applicants beyond the standard application form fields. These questions can be used to gather role-specific details, assess eligibility, collect screening information, or obtain any other information required during the application process. Once created, candidate questions can be reused across multiple jobs, making it easy to maintain a consistent screening process. Step 1: Create a Candidate Question Library

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Navigate to the Job Application Form Field Settings tab and scroll to the bottom of the page. Click Add Question , enter the question you want candidates to answer, and save it. Repeat the process to build a reusable library of screening questions that can be used across multiple jobs. Once your candidate questions have been created, they become available for selection while creating a new job or editing an existing one. When configuring a job, select the relevant questions from your question library. These questions will then be displayed to candidates as part of the application process for that specific job.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: This allows you to tailor the application experience by asking different questions for different roles while still managing all questions from a central location. When candidates submit their applications, their responses to the candidate questions are automatically saved within their profile. To view the answers, open the candidate record and navigate to the Questions tab. From here, you can review all responses submitted by the candidate, helping them evaluate qualifications, screen applicants more efficiently, and make better-informed hiring decisions. Recruit CRM allows you to choose which logo appears on the application form: If you want to change the logo for a specific job:

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Open the job and click the pencil icon to access the Edit Job form. Under Default Job Application Form Visibility , choose one of the following options: The selected logo option will be used only for that job's application form. Set a Default Logo for All Newly Created Jobs If you want all newly created jobs to use a specific logo option by default: Navigate to Admin Settings → Job Fields . Locate the Default Job Application Form Visibility setting. Select the logo option you want applied by default: If you want recruiters to choose a different logo while creating jobs, enable the corresponding toggle.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Once configured, the selected logo option will automatically apply to all newly created jobs unless a different logo is selected at the job level. Job Application Form Field Settings apply globally unless overridden by a job-specific application form. Currently the job application forms are not disabled if the account is inactive (users are active but don’t log in to the system). We only disable the forms and delete the setting on account deactivation.In this case, users have to log in and disable the job application URLs to disable the application forms.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: To ensure that the 'Note for candidate' is visible on the job application form, you need to turn on the 'Note for candidates' field from the Job application form settings under the 'Job Application Form Field Settings'. Problem: Candidate terms are not showing on the application form Likely cause: The GDPR setting is turned off. What to check: Go to Account Settings and confirm that the GDPR Compliance toggle is enabled. Resolution: Turn on the GDPR setting so that the candidate terms can appear on the job application form and make sure the Candidate terms are saved in the Candidate Terms box in the General Page Settings tab of the Job Application Form Settings.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Problem: Wrong logo appears on the job application form Likely cause: Default logo settings or Job specific logo settings are not configured as intended. At the job level, check job application form settings and logo selection. In Admin Settings > Data Customization > Job Fields , check the default logo configuration for newly created jobs. Resolution: Update the logo selection at the job level for individual jobs, or adjust the global default logo settings if you want a different behavior for new jobs. ​ Problem: Candidates are not receiving automated emails after applying Likely cause: Automated email configuration is incomplete, or the email template/sending email ID is not set.

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: What to check: In General Page Settings of the Job Application Form settings, verify: •A custom email template is selected. •An appropriate email ID is selected as the sender. Resolution: Set or correct the email template and sending email ID, then test by submitting a test application. Do changes in job application form field settings affect all jobs? Yes. Changes made in job application form field settings are global and apply to all job application forms created moving forward, but these do not apply to any Job Specific Application form. Can I customize the job application form for a single job only?

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: Yes. You can create a job-specific application form by opening the job, using the toggle next to the Job Application URL , and customizing the form for that specific job. How do I control whether the job description appears on the form? In General Page Settings , use the toggle to show or hide the job description and choose whether the job description or the job application appears first. Can candidates add their own languages if I do not set defaults? Yes. If no default languages are added to the form, candidates can add multiple languages and define the proficiency value for each. What logo options are available for job application forms?

chunks.t: Customize Your Job Application Form in Recruit CRM (New UI)
chunks.x: You can choose to show your account logo , the job company’s logo , or no logo at all on the job application form. You can set this per job or configure a default logo for all newly created jobs. Customizing your job application form in Recruit CRM lets you control candidate experience, data quality, and branding across all your open roles. chunks.t: How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Instead of guessing why a job has gone quiet, you can ask AI Assistants to pull hard numbers on where candidates are piling up in a pipeline, how long they've been sitting there, and what's likely causing the delay, then turn that into a short list of recommended next steps. 1. You need to have access to Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity (web, desktop, or mobile app) with the Recruit CRM MCP connector added to your respective Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity account. 2. Recruit CRM MCP is available only on the Business and Enterprise plans. 3.The job you're reporting on should have an active pipeline with candidates in more than one hiring stage.

chunks.t: How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: 4. By default, Account Owners and Admins have MCP access. Users on custom roles with access to MCP can also have MCP access. 📋 How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity? Step 1. Open AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity and confirm the Recruit CRM MCP Connector Is Active: Log into Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity and check that the Recruit CRM MCP connector appears as a connected source in the AI assistant's settings. If the Recruit CRM MCP connector isn't connected yet: Click here to learn more about connecting the Recruit CRM MCP connector to AI assistants. Step 2. Ask Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to Generate the Bottleneck Report:

chunks.t: How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: For example: "Give me a bottleneck report for [Job Title / Job ID] and suggest what to do next." This step is diagnostic only; Claude does not move any candidate's stage while preparing the report; nothing changes until you decide to act on a recommendation. Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity will typically return stage-by-stage candidate counts and average time-in-stage, along with two or three concrete recommendations, such as clearing a review queue before sourcing more candidates.

chunks.t: How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: If you agree with a recommendation, you can ask Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to take the next step directly, for example drafting outreach to candidates who are stuck in a stage. Any resulting change to a candidate's stage or a new task should be confirmed by you before Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity writes it back to Recruit CRM. ​ When you use this MCP server, your Recruit CRM data is sent to the AI assistant you're using (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT). This means: Candidate profiles , names, email, phone, job history, hiring stage, etc. will be exposed to the AI provider so that it can assist with the data.

chunks.t: How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Company and contact data , job details, notes, and call logs may also be exposed depending on what you ask. The AI provider processes this data on their servers according to their own privacy and data retention policies. Most AI providers (including Claude) have a data retention period - typically around 30 days for conversation data, though this varies by plan and provider. Always check the latest policies directly on their official websites: Claude: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy If your team or organization has data residency, GDPR, or other compliance requirements, confirm that using an AI assistant with live recruitment data is permitted.

chunks.t: How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Use good judgment about what you query - only ask for data that's necessary for the task at hand. By using this tool, you accept responsibility for ensuring its use complies with your organization's data policies and applicable regulations. Does this change anything in Recruit CRM? No. This use case is diagnostic only, nothing in the pipeline is changed unless you separately confirm a follow-up action, such as creating outreach tasks. Can I run this automatically on a schedule? Yes. This is one of the use cases well suited to a weekly scheduled task in Claude, though you can also run it on demand whenever a job feels stuck.

chunks.t: How to Generate a Pipeline Bottleneck Report Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: The Recruit CRM MCP connector allows Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to read a job's pipeline and time-in-stage data directly, so you can spot where candidates are piling up without opening a dashboard. Built for the moment a client asks "where are we," so you have a polished answer in 1. chunks.t: Advanced Analytics — MCP (Model Context Protocol)

chunks.t: How to Handle Duplicate Candidates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? When you add a candidate through the Add Candidate form and Recruit CRM finds that the candidate already exists in your database, Recruit CRM automatically fills any empty fields with the incoming information and then shows a comparison page for fields where existing information can be updated. You can review the incoming details and choose exactly what gets updated. Review what is different between an existing candidate and a new submission before anything changes Update only specific fields, or only fields that are currently empty Correct or refine incoming details before they are saved, without leaving the Add Candidate flow ​

chunks.t: How to Handle Duplicate Candidates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Step by step instructions when a duplicate is detected When you submit the Add Candidate form and Recruit CRM finds a matching existing candidate, it automatically updates any empty fields with the incoming information before opening the comparison page. The comparison page shows fields where the existing and incoming values differ, allowing you to review and control which existing information should be updated. Both default and custom candidate fields are included. ​ You can then review and control the update before applying it: Compare the existing and incoming values for each field. All eligible fields are selected by default. ​ Deselect any fields you do not want to update.

chunks.t: How to Handle Duplicate Candidates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Edit incoming values directly in the page if they need to be corrected by using the pencil icon next to the field. You can get the pencil icon by hovering over the field that you wish to edit. Apply the update. ​ 📌 Please note: Empty fields are automatically populated with available incoming information before the comparison page is shown. The comparison page is therefore focused on fields where existing information can be reviewed and potentially overwritten.

chunks.t: How to Handle Duplicate Candidates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Required fields: Required fields are marked in the comparison page. If you try to apply an update while a required field is left empty, the update is blocked, the field is highlighted, and a validation message appears. You can keep editing freely while the page is open; validation only runs when you apply the update. ​ Closing without applying: If you have made changes in the comparison page and try to close it, Recruit CRM asks you to confirm before discarding your edits, so partly reviewed changes are not lost by accident. ​

chunks.t: How to Handle Duplicate Candidates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When there is nothing to update: If Recruit CRM detects a duplicate but finds no new or different values to bring in, it skips the comparison page entirely. You are taken straight to the existing candidate's profile, with a notification letting you know no update was needed. ​ What happens when a duplicate candidate is detected? Recruit CRM automatically fills any empty fields with available incoming information and then opens a comparison page where you can review and control changes to existing candidate information. Can I edit values b efore updating the candidate? Yes. Incoming values can be edited directly within the comparison page before you apply the update.

chunks.t: How to Handle Duplicate Candidates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Which field types suppor t inline editing? Text, number, email, phone, URL, date, dropdown, multi select, skills, files, work history, and education history fields can all be edited. What happens if I leave a required field empty? The update is blocked until every required field has a valid value. What if there are no differences between the duplicate and the existing candidate? The comparison modal is skipped, and you are redirected to the existing candidate with a notification that no new data was available to update. Yes. If you have made changes and try to close the comparison modal, you will be asked to confirm before your edits are discarded.

chunks.t: How to Handle Duplicate Candidates in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Recruit CRM automatically fills empty candidate fields with available incoming information and gives you control over changes to existing information through the comparison page. You can review, edit, select, or deselect incoming values before applying the update, while the comparison step is skipped when there is nothing new to update. chunks.t: Sync HubSpot Records with Recruit CRM Using Workflow Automation
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? The HubSpot integration in Workflow Automation allows records to be automatically synced between HubSpot and Recruit CRM. When a new contact, company, deal, or note is created in HubSpot, the workflow checks whether a matching record already exists in Recruit CRM. If a match is found, the existing record is updated. If no match is found, a new record is created. This helps reduce manual data entry and keep information consistent across both platforms. You can use this integration when you want to: Automatically create or update contacts in Recruit CRM from HubSpot. Automatically create or update companies in Recruit CRM from HubSpot.

chunks.t: Sync HubSpot Records with Recruit CRM Using Workflow Automation
chunks.x: Automatically create or update deals in Recruit CRM from HubSpot. Automatically create or update notes in Recruit CRM from HubSpot. Keep HubSpot and Recruit CRM records synchronized. Set up separate workflows for different record types. The integration also supports syncing in the opposite direction, allowing records created in Recruit CRM to be automatically created or updated in HubSpot. Apps that are required to be connected for the recipe How to connect HubSpot in Workflow Automation 1. 1. Navigate to Admin Settings >>> Workflow Automation & Integrations . 2. Click on the Connections tab under the 'Workflows' section and click on the 'Create' button >>> 'Connection'.

chunks.t: Sync HubSpot Records with Recruit CRM Using Workflow Automation
chunks.x: 3. Use the search bar to search for the HubSpot app and connect it by following the instructions and setting the necessary permissions. Once the app is successfully connected, you will see a message titled 'Connection Established'. When the required app is connected, you can select the connected account inside the related steps of the recipe. How to connect your Recruit CRM account app in Workflow Automation 1. Navigate to Admin Settings >>> Workflow Automation & Integrations . 2. Click on the Connections tab under the 'Workflows' section and click on the 'Create' button >>> 'Connection'.

chunks.t: Sync HubSpot Records with Recruit CRM Using Workflow Automation
chunks.x: 3. Use the search bar to search for the Recruit CRM app and connect it by selecting it and entering the API key . Once the app is successfully connected, you will see a message titled 'Connection Established'. When the required app is connected, you can select the connected account inside the related steps of the recipe. ​ The HubSpot to Recruit CRM workflow follows the same basic pattern for contacts, companies, deals, and notes: New record in HubSpot → Search Recruit CRM → Check whether a match exists → Create or update the Recruit CRM record Step 1: Trigger a workflow when a new HubSpot record is created The workflow starts when a new record is created in HubSpot.

chunks.t: Sync HubSpot Records with Recruit CRM Using Workflow Automation
chunks.x: Depending on the recipe, the record can be a: Step 2: Search for the record in Recruit CRM The workflow searches Recruit CRM for a matching record using relevant identifying information, such as an email address. This step checks whether the HubSpot record already exists in Recruit CRM before creating a new record. Step 3: Check whether a matching record exists An IF condition checks the result of the search. If no matching record is found, the workflow proceeds to create a new record in Recruit CRM. If a matching record is found, the workflow skips creation and updates the existing Recruit CRM record instead.

chunks.t: Sync HubSpot Records with Recruit CRM Using Workflow Automation
chunks.x: If no matching record exists, the workflow creates a new record in Recruit CRM using the information received from HubSpot. The relevant HubSpot fields are mapped to the corresponding Recruit CRM fields during this step. If a matching record already exists, the workflow updates the existing Recruit CRM record with the latest information from HubSpot. This prevents duplicate records while keeping the information synchronized. chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it The Billing and Revenue Report helps you track key financial metrics related to contract staffing and understand your overall billing and profitability. You want to track Billable Hours and Payable Hours based on approved timesheets. You need to review Billable Amount, Payable Amount, Gross Profit, and Margin Percentage . You want to analyze billing and profitability for specific Companies, Jobs, or Contractors . You want to export report data or charts for further analysis. Note: The report includes data from approved timesheets within the selected date range. All amounts are displayed in the account currency.

chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: Report access follows your existing permissions for Companies, Jobs, Contractors, and Timesheets. Users can only select and view records permitted by their existing access levels, including Owned Only or Team Only permissions. A dedicated permission for the report is also available under Reports in Roles & Permissions . Generate and Analyze the Billing and Revenue Report 1. Navigate to the Reports section from the left-hand navigation menu and open the Billing and Revenue Report . 2. Use the Report Based On dropdown to choose how you want to analyze the report. You can select: Overall, Company, Job, Contractor.

chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: When selecting Company , Job , or Contractor , choose the specific records you want to include in the report. 3. Open the KPIs dropdown and select the metrics you want to analyze: Total Billable & Payable Hours, Total Billable Amount, Total Payable Amount, Gross Profit, and Margin Percentage. The Total Billable & Payable Hours KPI is calculated using approved billable and payable hours. Gross Profit is calculated as: Billable Amount − Payable Amount. 4. Choose the required date range from the dropdown. You can select a predefined date range or specify a custom date range to analyze billing and revenue for a specific period.

chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: 5. Click Generate Report to run the report. If you want to save the same configuration for future use, click Save & Generate Report . Once generated, the report displays the selected KPIs along with a chart and detailed table. Once the report is generated, it displays key metrics for the selected Company, Job, or Contractor , including: Total Billable Amount, Total Payable Amount, Gross Profit, Margin Percentage. The charts vary based on the selected KPI. The Overall report also includes monthly revenue and margin trends and current-year vs. previous-year comparisons where applicable. The overall report provides an account-level view of billing and profitability.

chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: The summary table below the charts can be expanded for applicable report types to view the records contributing to the reported billing and profitability figures. This expansion is available only for reports generated based on Company and Job. Report data can be exported for further analysis. Click any chart bar to view the related Timesheet records, where you can use available filters, search, export, column customization, and other Timesheet actions. You can export the Billing and Revenue Report in multiple ways: Click Export Report to CSV to download the detailed report data in CSV format. Use the Export option on the chart to download the chart as an image in PNG, JPG, or SVG format.

chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: Additionally, when viewing the related Timesheet listing, you can use the standard Export option to download the Timesheet data for further analysis. This allows you to use the report data for further analysis or share the visual representation of your billing and revenue performance. The report includes data from approved timesheets within the selected date range. Timesheets that have not been approved are not included in the report.

chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: All financial amounts are shown in the account currency . If a Timesheet uses a different currency, its financial values are converted to the account currency when the Timesheet is approved, using the exchange rate available at that time. Pay Amount, Bill Amount, and Gross Profit are then stored in the account currency. Until approval, these values appear as Not Available . Future exchange-rate changes do not affect the stored historical values. You can generate the report based on Overall, Company, Job, or Contractor , allowing you to analyze billing and profitability at different levels depending on your reporting needs.

chunks.t: Billing and Revenue Report
chunks.x: If a Timesheet overlaps with the selected reporting period, the entire Timesheet is included in the report, including its hours, billable amount, payable amount, and gross profit. The Billing and Revenue Report gives you a clear view of your billing and profitability based on approved timesheets, helping you analyze performance across Companies, Jobs, and Contractors over a selected period. chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? Related Emails lets you view emails associated with a candidate, contact, job, deal, or company directly from the relevant record. You can browse recent and older emails, filter emails, and manually resync your email data. ​ View the latest emails associated with a record Manage stored email data as an Account Owner Please note: This feature is released for some of the beta accounts and will be rolled out to all users in the coming weeks. The Related Emails tab displays the most recent emails associated with the record. To browse the complete email history, click View All .

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: The View All page uses infinite scroll, allowing you to continue browsing older emails as you scroll. ​ You can also use filters to quickly find specific emails based on: Each record's Related Emails tab includes a manual Resync option. You can use this to retrieve the latest emails associated with the record whenever needed. At the moment, Related Emails displays emails from the past one year only. After resyncing a record, you must wait 1 hour before you can resync the same record again.

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Deleting or archiving an email in Gmail or Outlook does not remove it from Related Emails. Once an email has been synced to Recruit CRM, it remains available in Related Emails unless you explicitly delete it there or delete the associated parent record, such as a candidate or contact. You can delete either an entire email thread or an individual message directly from Related Emails by clicking on the 3 dots and selecting the Delete option. ​ Delete a thread: Removes the entire email conversation from Related Emails. Delete a message: Removes only the selected message. The rest of the conversation remains available.

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: When a message is deleted from a thread that contains other messages, the conversation displays a "message has been deleted from this conversation" notice in place of the deleted message. When you delete an email from Related Emails, its content is permanently removed, and Recruit CRM does not retain the email itself. A small identifier, such as a unique email ID, is retained so the system can recognize which emails you previously deleted. If you disconnect and later reconnect the same mailbox, you'll be asked whether you want to sync those previously deleted emails back into Related Emails. They will not reappear automatically unless you choose to sync them again.

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Mailbox vs. Related Emails: The Mailbox reflects the current contents of your connected email account. Deleting or archiving an email in Gmail or Outlook affects your mailbox, but does not remove the email from Related Emails. Emails from a user's mailbox remain available in Related Emails even after the user is deactivated. These emails are clearly labelled to indicate that they belong to a deactivated user . This allows you to continue accessing the email history associated with the record while making it clear that the mailbox owner is no longer active. ​

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Account Owners can manage stored email data for the entire account from Account Management in Admin Settings . This setting is available only to the Account Owner. ​ View all users whose mailboxes are currently connected. View users whose mailboxes were previously connected but still have stored email data. Delete stored email data belonging to disconnected mailboxes or deactivated users. ​ Stored email data cannot be deleted while a mailbox is actively connected. The delete option becomes available only after the mailbox has been disconnected or the user has been deactivated. Does Related Emails work with all email providers?

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Yes. Related Emails supports all email providers connected to Recruit CRM . Which entity records support Related Emails? Related Emails is available for candidates, contacts, jobs, deals and companies . What happens to emails when a user is deactivated? The user's stored emails remain visible in Related Emails and are labelled as belonging to a deactivated user . The Account Owner can delete the stored email data if it is no longer required. At the moment, Related Emails displays emails from the past one year only. You can manually resync a record whenever needed, but after a resync, you must wait 1 hour before resyncing that same record again.

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Does deleting an email from Gmail or Outlook remove it from Related Emails? No. Deleting or archiving an email in Gmail or Outlook does not remove it from Related Emails. You can delete emails directly from Related Emails when you want to remove them from the CRM. Can I delete an email from Related Emails? Yes. You can delete an entire email thread or an individual message directly from Related Emails. When is an email removed from Related Emails? An email is removed when you explicitly delete it from Related Emails or when its associated parent record, such as a candidate or contact, is deleted. Can a previously deleted email be synced again?

chunks.t: How to Use Related Emails in Recruit CRM
chunks.x: Yes. If the same mailbox is connected again, Recruit CRM asks whether you want to sync previously deleted emails back into Related Emails. Related Emails gives you a centralized and searchable view of the email history associated with your Recruit CRM records. You can browse recent or older conversations, use filters to find specific emails, and resync records to retrieve the latest available emails. Account Owners can also manage stored email data across the account, including data from disconnected and deactivated mailboxes. chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: What this feature does and when to use it? This setup lets you use a custom domain or subdomain, such as yourcompany.com or careers.yourcompany.com, for your Recruit Craft Website. Connect a custom domain or subdomain to your Recruit Craft Website. Generate the required DNS records in Recruit Craft. Add those records to your IONOS Cloud DNS primary zone. Complete or verify your custom domain setup in Recruit Craft. Access to Custom Domain settings in Recruit Craft. An IONOS Cloud account with a primary zone already created for your domain. Your domain's name servers at your registrar pointed to the four name servers assigned to your IONOS Cloud DNS zone.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: Access and manage DNS permissions on your IONOS Cloud account. Contract administrators, owners, and users with this permission can create and manage DNS records. The domain or subdomain you want to use for your Website, such as yourcompany.com or careers.yourcompany.com. ​ Generate your DNS records in Recruit Craft Before adding anything to IONOS, first generate the DNS records required to connect your domain. 1. In Recruit Craft, go to Custom Domain from the panel on the left. 2. Under Default Project URL, set a unique name for your project and click Save. For a full domain setup, this name must match the domain you want to connect. ​

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: 3. Under Custom Domain, enter your domain in both fields to confirm it, then click Connect. Recruit Craft generates a CNAME record for SSL verification, plus one or more A records with static IP addresses to point your domain to your career page. 1. In Recruit Craft, go to Custom Domain from the panel on the left. 2. Under Custom Domain, enter your preferred career page subdomain in both fields to confirm it, then click Connect. Make sure the subdomain matches the name of your Default Project URL in Recruit Craft.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: 3. Recruit Craft generates two CNAME records. Copy the Name and Value for both records because you'll need to add each one separately to IONOS. ​ Record 1: Used to verify your SSL certificate, which helps secure your career page connection. Record 2: Used to point your subdomain to your Recruit Craft career page. ​ 📌 Please note: Keep your records handy before moving to IONOS. You will need to add each one separately. Once you have your records from Recruit Craft, add them to your domain's primary zone in IONOS. The SSL verification record is always a CNAME. The record that points your domain to your career page is a CNAME for a subdomain, but an A record for a full domain. ​

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: For a subdomain , repeat the following steps for each of your two CNAME records: ​ 1. In the IONOS Data Center Designer (DCD), go to Menu → Network Services → Cloud DNS → Public zones. 2. Select Primary Zones from the dropdown. 3. Select the zone for your domain, or click Details and Records next to it. 5. In Name, enter the Name provided by Recruit Craft exactly as shown, including the domain. 6. In TTL, enter a value in seconds. 3600 seconds is the IONOS default. Under Type, select CNAME. 7. In Content, enter the Value provided by Recruit Craft exactly as given. 8. Check the Preview to make sure the record looks correct, then click Save.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: 📌 Please note: IONOS does not require a trailing period (.) at the end of the Content value for a CNAME record. Enter the value exactly as provided by Recruit Craft. For a full domain , add the SSL verification record first, then the pointing record: 1. In the IONOS Data Center Designer (DCD), go to Menu → Network Services → Cloud DNS → Public zones. 2. Select Primary Zones from the dropdown. ​ 3. Select the zone for your domain, or click Details and Records next to it. ​ 5. In Name, enter the Name provided by Recruit Craft exactly as shown, including the domain. ​

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: 6. In TTL, enter a value in seconds. 3600 seconds is the IONOS default. Under Type, select CNAME. ​ 7. In Content, enter the Value provided by Recruit Craft exactly as given. ​ 9. Click Create record again to add the pointing record. 10. In Name, enter your root domain. In TTL, enter a value in seconds, or use the 3600 second default. Under Type, select A. In Content, enter the static IP address Recruit Craft provided. If Recruit Craft provided a second static IP address, repeat the last five steps to create a second A record with the same Name and the second IP address. After saving both CNAME records, the DNS changes may take some time to become available.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: When your domain's name servers are already pointing to IONOS, record changes are typically available quickly, although the exact timing depends on the TTL configured for the records. 📌 Please note: If you have just pointed your domain's name servers to IONOS for the first time, that initial change can take longer to propagate and may take up to 48 hours in some cases. This is separate from the propagation of the CNAME records. Once the records have propagated, return to Recruit Craft to continue or verify your custom domain setup. Problem: Recruit Craft is asking you to add CAA records before you can continue with custom domain setup

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: Why this is required: Recruit Craft uses AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue the SSL certificate for your custom domain. A CAA record authorizes Amazon to issue a certificate for your domain. If Recruit Craft displays CAA records during the custom domain setup, add those records to IONOS and verify them before continuing with the CNAME records. ​ If Recruit Craft provides a CAA record, add the record to IONOS exactly as shown in the Recruit Craft Custom Domain settings. In the IONOS Data Center Designer (DCD) , go to Menu → Network Services → Cloud DNS → Public zones . Enter the Name provided by Recruit Craft exactly as shown.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: Enter the CAA value provided by Recruit CRM in the corresponding CAA field(s), exactly as shown. Leave the TTL at its default value unless you have a specific requirement to change it. Return to Recruit Craft and select Verify . Once the CAA record is successfully verified, you can continue with the CNAME record setup. ​ 📌 Please note: If you already have CAA records for other certificate authorities, do not remove them unless you understand the impact. If Recruit Craft provides a specific CAA record, use the values provided by Recruit Craft rather than creating a different one. Can I connect my root domain, like yourcompany.com?

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: Yes. Full domain setup uses an A record rather than CNAME for the record that points your domain to your career page. A records work at the root of a zone in IONOS Cloud DNS, unlike CNAME. What if IONOS says a record already exists for that name? This usually means another DNS record already exists for the same name. Check your existing DNS records and edit or remove the conflicting record before adding the CNAME provided by Recruit Craft Do I need to format the Value from Recruit Craft in a specific way? No. Enter the Value exactly as provided by Recruit Craft . IONOS does not require a trailing period ( . ) at the end of the value. Who can create or manage DNS records in IONOS Cloud DNS?

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: DNS records can be created and managed by contract administrators, owners, and users with the Access and manage DNS privilege . How long does it take for my custom domain to work? DNS record changes within an existing IONOS zone are typically available quickly, depending on the TTL. If you have just pointed your domain's name servers to IONOS for the first time, that change can take up to 48 hours in some cases.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to IONOS
chunks.x: Adding the DNS records provided by Recruit Craft to your IONOS Cloud DNS primary zone connects your custom domain or subdomain to your Recruit Craft career page. A subdomain uses CNAME records throughout; a full domain uses a CNAME for SSL verification plus one or more A records. Once the DNS changes have propagated, return to Recruit Craft to complete or verify the connection. chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: This article walks through connecting either your full domain (for example, yourcompany.com) or a subdomain (for example, careers.yourcompany.com) to your Recruit Craft career page, from generating the DNS records in Recruit Craft, to adding them in GoDaddy, to verifying the connection. A subdomain uses CNAME records throughout. A full domain uses a CNAME for SSL verification and one or more A records to point your domain to your Website. ​ Access to Custom Domain settings in Recruit Craft. Sign-in access to the GoDaddy account that manages your domain. The domain or subdomain you want to use for your career page (for example, yourcompany.com or careers.yourcompany.com)

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: Generate your DNS records in Recruit Craft Before making any changes in GoDaddy, you first need to generate the DNS records required by Recruit Craft. These records tell your domain provider where your Recruit Craft career page is hosted. ​ 1. In Recruit Craft, go to Custom Domain from the panel on the left. 2. Under Default Project URL, set a unique name for your project and click Save. For a full domain setup, this name must match the domain you want to connect. ​ 3. Under Custom Domain, enter your domain in both fields to confirm it, then click Connect.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: Recruit Craft generates a CNAME record for SSL verification, plus one or more A records with static IP addresses to point your domain to your career page. 1. In Recruit Craft, go to Custom Domain from the panel on the left. 2. Under Custom Domain, enter your preferred career page subdomain in both fields to confirm it, then click Connect.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: 3. Make sure the subdomain matches the name of your Default Project URL in Recruit Craft. Recruit Craft generates two CNAME records. A CNAME (Canonical Name) record is a type of DNS record that directs a domain or subdomain to another address. Copy the Name and Value for both records. You will need to add both records to GoDaddy. ​ Record 1: Used to verify your SSL certificate, which helps secure your career page connection. Record 2: Used to point your subdomain to your Recruit Craft career page. 📌 Please note: Keep your records handy before moving to GoDaddy. You will need to add each one separately. ​

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: Once you have your records from Recruit Craft, add them to your domain's DNS settings in GoDaddy. The SSL verification record is always a CNAME. The record that points your domain to your career page is a CNAME for a subdomain, but an A record for a full domain. Sign in to your GoDaddy Domain Portfolio . ​ Select the domain you want to configure to open its Domain Settings page, then select DNS to view the existing DNS records. Select Add New Record, then select CNAME as the record Type. In the Name field, enter the Name provided by Recruit Craft. When entering the Name, GoDaddy applies the following restrictions: Periods (.) are allowed but not as the first or last character

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: 63 characters in a row not separated by a period (.) Example: 63characters.63characters.coolexample.com In the Value field, enter the Value provided by Recruit Craft. Set the TTL to 1/2 hour. Select Save. Review the confirmation box and select Change, then Save to confirm. Repeat for the second CNAME record. ​ 📌 Please note: If Domain Protection is enabled, GoDaddy may ask you to verify your identity before the record can be saved. 1. Sign in to your GoDaddy Domain Portfolio . 2. Select the domain you want to configure to open its Domain Settings page, then select DNS.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: 3. Select Add New Record, then select CNAME as the record Type, to add the SSL verification record. In the Name field, enter the Name provided by Recruit Craft. In the Value field, enter the Value provided by Recruit Craft. Set the TTL to 1/2 hour, then select Save. ​ 4. Select Add New Record again, then select A as the record Type, to add the pointing record. In the Name field, enter @ to apply the record to your root domain or companyname.com . In the Value field, enter the static IP address Recruit Craft provided. If Recruit Craft gave you a second IP address, select Add another value and enter it there, rather than creating a second A record. Set the TTL to 1/2 hour, then select Save.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: GoDaddy's CNAME record type doesn't support the root domain, which is why the pointing record for a full domain is an A record instead. If Recruit Craft provides two IP addresses, both serve the same content — this is a standard DNS pattern called round robin, used for redundancy. If Domain Protection is enabled for your GoDaddy domain, GoDaddy may ask you to verify your identity using 2-step verification or a one-time passcode before either record can be saved. After saving the CNAME record, it may take some time for the DNS change to become available. ​

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: 📌 Please note: Most DNS changes take effect within an hour, but they can take up to 48 hours to fully propagate. If your custom domain does not work immediately, wait for the DNS change to propagate and check again. ​ Once the record has propagated, return to Recruit Craft and continue or verify your custom domain setup. chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: Why this is required: Recruit Craft uses AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue the SSL certificate for your custom domain. The CAA record authorizes Amazon to issue a certificate for your domain. If Recruit Craft displays CAA records during the custom domain setup, you must add those records to your DNS provider and verify them before you can proceed to the CNAME records. ​ ​ Resolution: If Recruit Craft provides a CAA record, add the record to GoDaddy exactly as shown in the Recruit Craft custom domain setup. ​

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: To add the record in GoDaddy: 1. Sign in to your GoDaddy Domain Portfolio . 2. Select the domain you want to configure, then go to Domain Settings > DNS . 3. If GoDaddy provides a CAA RDATA field, enter the complete value provided by Recruit Craft, for example: ​ 0 issue " amazon.com " GoDaddy may automatically separate this into the corresponding CAA fields. If the fields are shown separately, enter: ​ Flag: 0 ​ Tag: issue ​ Domain: amazon.com 6. Leave TTL at its default value.

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: 7. Select Save . 8. Return to Recruit Craft and select Verify . Once the CAA record has been successfully verified, Recruit Craft will allow you to continue with the CNAME record setup. ​ Please note: If Recruit Craft provides a CAA record, use the values provided there rather than creating a different CAA record. If you already have CAA records for other certificate authorities, do not remove them unless you understand the impact of doing so. Can I connect my root domain, like yourcompany.com? Yes. Full domain setup uses an A record to point your domain to your career page, and GoDaddy supports A records at the root domain, the Name field accepts @. ​

chunks.t: How to Connect Your Recruit Craft Career Page to GoDaddy
chunks.x: What if GoDaddy says the name is already in use? This usually means another DNS record already exists for the same name. Check your existing DNS records and edit or remove the conflicting record before adding the CNAME provided by Recruit Craft. ​ How long does it take for my custom domain to work? Most DNS changes take effect within an hour, but allow up to 48 hours for the change to fully propagate.

chunks.t: How to Run Client Health Scoring Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Some jobs go quietly cold long before a client picks up the phone to ask why. This flags any open requisition past 45 days where nobody has made it beyond the first interview, so account management can get ahead of the conversation instead of 1. You need to have access to Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity (web, desktop, or mobile app) with the Recruit CRM MCP connector added to your respective Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity account. 2. Recruit CRM MCP is available only on the Business and Enterprise plans. 3.The job you're reporting on should have an active pipeline with candidates in more than one hiring stage.

chunks.t: How to Run Client Health Scoring Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: 4. By default, Account Owners and Admins have MCP access. Users on custom roles with access to MCP can also have MCP access. 📋 How to Run Client Health Scoring Using Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity? Step 1. Open AI assistants like Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity and confirm the Recruit CRM MCP Connector Is Active: Log into Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity and check that the Recruit CRM MCP connector appears as a connected source in the AI assistant's settings. If the Recruit CRM MCP connector isn't connected yet: Click here to learn more about connecting the Recruit CRM MCP connector to AI assistants. Step 2. Ask Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to Flag At-Risk Jobs:

chunks.t: How to Run Client Health Scoring Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: For example, here is a sample prompt that you can use : "List every open job older than 45 days where no candidate has progressed past the first interview stage. For each one, tell me the client, the job owner, and how long it's been open. Don't close or edit any job — just flag these as at-risk for account management follow-up." This step is flag-only. No job status or record is changed. Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity will typically return a list of jobs open past the threshold you gave it, each with the client, job owner, and days open, ready to hand to account management. Step 4. Follow Up with Account Management:

chunks.t: How to Run Client Health Scoring Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Once you have the flagged list, you can pass it to account management or reach out to the client yourself ahead of them raising it. When you use this MCP server, your Recruit CRM data is sent to the AI assistant you're using (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT). This means: Candidate profiles , names, email, phone, job history, hiring stage, etc. will be exposed to the AI provider so that it can assist with the data. Company and contact data , job details, notes, and call logs may also be exposed depending on what you ask. The AI provider processes this data on their servers according to their own privacy and data retention policies.

chunks.t: How to Run Client Health Scoring Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Most AI providers (including Claude) have a data retention period - typically around 30 days for conversation data, though this varies by plan and provider. Always check the latest policies directly on their official websites: Claude: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy If your team or organization has data residency, GDPR, or other compliance requirements, confirm that using an AI assistant with live recruitment data is permitted. Use good judgment about what you query - only ask for data that's necessary for the task at hand. By using this tool, you accept responsibility for ensuring its use complies with your organization's data policies and applicable regulations.

chunks.t: How to Run Client Health Scoring Using Recruit CRM MCP
chunks.x: Does this change anything in Recruit CRM? No. This use case is flag-only; no job status or record is changed. The Recruit CRM MCP connector allows Claude/ChatGPT/Perplexity to check every open job's age and stage progress directly, so at-risk accounts get flagged before a client raises the concern. No job is closed or edited, this use case only flags jobs for follow-up.
